13673016.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
13673016.value: 中國政府於2013年提出將政府購買服務作為國家福利發展手段，促進地方政府從社會服務的提供者轉變為監管者，藉此提高服務質素及降低成本。然而，一方面，地方政府及非政府機構的能力可能不足以實施此項新政策。作為一個社會主義國家，中國的中央政府與地方政府一直是社會服務的主要提供者，僅有個別省市有向非政府機構購買服務的經驗。多數政府官員缺乏購買服務與監管質素的相關專業知識和管理技能。另一方面，由於早年規定非政府機構須在政府部門的支持下方可完成註冊，內地參與社會服務購買的非政府機構數量可能並不足以滿足實際需求。在此背景下，本研究致力於比較分析三個主要地區（珠江三角洲，長江三角洲，環渤海經濟帶）的合共六個城市實施政府購買社會服務的情況。具體而言，本研究採用Van Slyke 基於代理理論與管家理論的整合分析框架，檢驗中國地方政府及非政府機構之間的互動關係。現有關於政府購買服務的研究主要在2013年以前，並集中於單一城市的分析，或者同一省份內少數城市的比較，對政府購買服務及福利治理的地區差異研究甚少。本研究致力於填補這一研究空白。基於官方數據，非政府機構的機構數據，本研究將闡明在以上三個主要地區內提供社會服務的非政府機構的發展歷程。通過與民政局官員，非政府機構管理者和前線工作人員進行深度訪談，本研究將分析政府實施購買服務的情況，辨識地方政府及非政府機構在購買及提供服務時的知識缺陷及培訓需要，及在此過程中雙方互動關係的轉變。本研究的實證分析及比較視角亦有助於探索實施政府購買服務以來中國福利體制的轉變。

13673016.label: Realisation of objectives
13673016.value: After critical policy reviews and extensive literature reviews contracting out social services being introduced across different parts of China, the research team identified a few major case studies for conducting fieldwork and interviews with key informants who are knowledgeable of contracting out social services in China. From January 2018 to May 2019, the research team conducted in-depth interviews in the selected cities. There are three groups of targeted respondents in each city, including scholars on social work and civil society, officials from bureaus of civil affairs and financial departments, and practitioners of nonprofit social service agencies, as well as managers of non-governmental organizations across different parts of China. Putting the above observations / major findings generated from the fieldwork conducted in China, together with our critical policy reviews, case studies analysis, the present research contributes to a better understanding of not only how policy of contracting out social services has been implemented in China but also how the Chinese government has made use of the social governance reforms to shape the state and non-governmental organization relationship. The following discusses how the present research contributes to the field of social policy analysis and social governance reforms in China. Welfare contracting becomes a part of reciprocal cooperation between an agency head and an individual bureaucrat. The network mechanism can work together with the hierarchical and market mechanism. Our comparisons of the three different regions in China when implementing social service management reforms through the government procurement of social services have clearly suggested three different social governance models/approaches in Guangzhou, Shanghai, and Beijing. The analysis has clearly suggested “Similar policy agenda with Diverse policy practices” happening across the country when social governance reforms are introduced. The comparisons across different cities when implementing contracting out social services highlight the importance of regional variations when policy of contracting out social services is implemented. The city comparisons clearly show the closer the local governments to the central government is, the less open their approaches are when managing social service delivery reforms. Although the central government has called for the enhancement of social governance in the Mainland through policy learning from other countries, the actual policy implementations across different parts of the country demonstrate diversity in policy practices. The diverse approaches that the seven cities being presented above clearly show regional variations when implementing the same policy agenda. A scrutiny of different city practices, this present research has demonstrated how politically tactical the governments in Guangzhou, Shanghai and Beijing are when promoting government procurement of social services. The different social governance approaches across these three cities/regions show the interplay between politics and the market, shaping the diverse approaches in social governance. Analyzing the relationship between the state and the third sector NGOs in China, we observe the NGOs when being engaged in the Chinese social governance is far from the “empowerment and participation” strategy since they do not fully participate in policy-making and they cannot fully represent the voices of individuals, groups and communities. Our findings suggest the NGOs, when taking up the social service provider role in China, they experience insufficient support from the state. Unlike the expansion of NGOs in social welfare provision and social service delivery in the Western economies where the “third sector” is also becoming more prominent, the present article shows a different development experience that the third sector organizations experience in China. The state-NGOs relationship in China has been shaped by the welfare strategy of pragmatic instrumentalism, thereby the third sector organizations are not empowered by the state / government but they only act like a tool employed by the government for better social governance. Responding to the new policy call for offering citizens’ more choice in social services is achieved through the formation of the governed market with strong government influences, hence citizens’ choice is bounded though the involvement of NGOs has increased. More importantly, the above conceptual discourse has drawn us to reflect critically the relationship between the state and the third sector organizations in social governance from a broader political economy perspective. Zinka Kolaric (2009) conducted a theoretical and methodological review of the third sector organizations in the changing welfare systems of Central and Eastern European countries, his analysis has provided useful insights for analyzing the Chinese welfare systems in transition. Equally important, our above discussions of changing state-NGOs relationships in social governance provide us new perspectives in analyzing the role of the state in managing complex market transition and state-society relations. As Mok (2017) argued elsewhere that the Chinese state has become an adaptive regulatory state through mobilizing the state sector (at the subnational level) and non-state sectors / actors, as well as markets, to manage the increasingly complex social and economic issues. Reaching out to the third sector NGOs in social governance has thus been a logical response by the Chinese state as a means of bolstering governance capacities, or as an instrumental response by governments to penetrate society, regulate social relationships, extract resources and appropriate resources in determined ways as what Migdal (1988) described. Our above discussions of the state-NGOs relationships clearly demonstrate how the single political party system operates in China. The dominant role of the one-party rule makes the division between state and party and state and society blurred. Hence, governance innovations by incorporating the third sector NGOs in social governance needs to be “conceptualized not only in absolute terms as the rise of market rationality to the detriment of the state or of state / party authority, but rather as an extension of state reach within society in ways which are mutually transformative of both the apparatus of the state and the social configurations it produces” (Mok, 2017, p.319, see also Migdal, Kohli and Shue, 1994). Even though the Chinese government adopts ideas and practices along the lines of neo-liberalism in transforming social service management, the “welfare market” in the country is very much a “governed market”, whereby the state still plays a significant role to determine the state, NGOs and the welfare market relationships. Working as an arm of the state (the appointing units as local governments), the state-NGOs relationship through the contracting out of social services clearly shows an unequal power relationship between the two (Lei and Chan, 2018). As Guan (2015) rightly stated, the Chinese experience of procurement of public services is very different from other Western economies with more third sector NGOs involvement in social governance. The Chinese case shows the strong presence of the state in the emerging third sector through the state’s strong intervention to co-develop these NGOs to carry out the newly stipulated state polices for enhancing social services to make citizens more satisfied. With the forces of the state strongly embedded in the society, the autonomy of third sector NGOs is limited (Guan, 2015). Could expansion of NGOs promote civil society? In their analysis of social cohesion and welfare reforms in China, together with the examination of contracting out social services experience in Guangzhou has suggested a “negative answer” to the question (Mok and Kang, 2020).

13673016.label: Major findings and research outcome
13673016.value: The present research has clearly revealed that social workers and social service agencies have experienced extraordinary booms in the past decade in China. The big bang of social organization, or so-called social force, partly went out of state’s control. Central and local governments stay alert to the potential opposition power from these various social organizations. In addition, while many public finances are invested in welfare contracting annually, service performance and corporate government of agencies may be far from state’s expectation. Both finance bureaus at every levels and street-level bureaucrats of grassroots governments raised concerns about the value for money and public accountability of welfare contracting. Thus, Chinese governments have systematically undermining the role of social service agencies (Hasmath et al. 2020), through Party-building and community governance. Against this background, local bureaucrats’ attitudes and social service agencies’ professional capacity are particularly important for state-society collaboration when implementing social governance reforms. In Pearl River delta, state and society work together through market mechanism and contractual relationship set by institutional framework. In Yangtze River delta, while market mechanism has its own role, state power and social force work more directly through bureaucratic hierarchical mechanism. In Bohai economic rim, given the political environment and fiscal capacity, state tends to dominate over society. Reflecting upon the policy learning and transfer experiences through the above cases, it is obvious that the Chinese government adopts a “softer” type of policy transfer when addressing the growing global influences through transcending the global forces to creative and innovative policy adaptations to meet the national and local needs. As Mok (2017) argued elsewhere that the Chinese state has become an adaptive regulatory state through mobilizing the state sector (at the subnational level) and non-state sectors / actors, as well as markets, to manage the increasingly complex social and economic issues. In conclusion, this research contributes not only enhances us to analyze contracting out social services as social governance reforms in China. Analyzing the social governance reforms from the broader political economy perspective, this research has enabled us to critically reflect upon the changing state-market-society relationships through engagements of NGOs. More importantly, the present research also helps us understand how the Chinese state, adopting an adaptive and entrepreneurial approach in managing the complex social governance reforms, has managed the growing complexity of the politics of transnational policy transfer.

13673016.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
13673016.value: The research can be extended to inland China. All the studied cities are mainly located at the coastal regions. These cities have better financial capacity, more social service agencies and more talents in local governments and social organizations. The situation in inland China may be totally different, such as party-state dominant system, less capable officials and social workers and conservative attitudes of public and officials towards social organizations.

13673016.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
13673016.value: Welfare contracting becomes a part of reciprocal cooperation between an agency head and an individual bureaucrat. The network mechanism can work together with the hierarchical and market mechanism. Our comparisons of the three different regions in China when implementing social service management reforms through the government procurement of social services have clearly suggested three different social governance models/approaches in Guangzhou, Shanghai, and Beijing. Guangzhou adopts the ‘Unit System’, Shanghai chooses the ‘Project-based’ system and Beijing employs ‘Multiple Approaches’ when implementing contracting out social services. The differences across these regions do not only reveal different funding models adopted but also diverse government–NGOs relationships. Our analysis has clearly indicated the different attitudes adopted by local governments across these three regions. Diverse practices of social service purchasing show the continuum presenting Guangzhou as the city that is more open to the emergence of the ‘social service market’ by involving NGOs in co-production of social services. Shanghai is in the middle, being less open to the ‘social service market’. Beijing is the most ‘unfriendly’ to the ‘market’ as NGOs are only treated as ‘service providers’ with strong state interference.

14100916.value: 青光眼是導致不可逆性失明的最主要病因，預計到2020年，中國將有2180萬名患者。雖然高眼壓治療研究（OHTS）建立了降低眼壓以減少青光眼發病風險的有效方法，仍有不到10％的未經治療的患者惡化並在5年內發展成青光眼。治療非進展性患者不僅會帶來不必要的治療費用，而且還導致不良反應，危害視功能和生活質量。利用OHTS-EGPS（歐洲青光眼預防研究）預測模型進行風險分級，已被建議用於識別高風險OHT（5年風險> 15％）並進行降低眼壓治療。值得注意的是，由OHTS-EGPS模型計算風險是依靠來自橫斷面研究的5種生物學參數，這些參數在隨訪期間可以是高度可變的。從低風險OHT中區分出高風險OHT的方法仍然不夠精確，而且對於何時開始降低眼壓治療仍然存在著很多不明之處。找到可以標識疾病惡化反應的生物標誌物，以指導降眼壓治療並預防視覺損害，仍然是處理OHT中一個尚未明確的重要問題。 我們推測漸進性RNFL變薄是預測後續視野（VF）進展的一種生物標記物，基於檢測到漸進的RNFL變薄而開始的降眼壓治療是應對OHT視野進展風險的一種有效途徑。我們提出了一個5年的前瞻性研究，隨機將310名OHT患者分成兩組，在降眼壓治療時機上予以不同的方案，（I）進展性RNFL變薄，對光學相干斷層掃描得到的系列RNFL厚度圖進行基於趨勢演算法的進展分析，根據其結果來判斷；或（II）根據OHTS-EGPS模型計算，5年的青光眼轉變風險> 15％者。所有患者將接受每4個月1次的臨床檢查、RNFL成像和視野檢查，共5年。 目標是比較兩組不同的治療方案中需要降眼壓治療的患者比例和發生視野進展的患者比例。我們預計，與方案二相比，隨機分配到方案I中需要治療的患者比例更小，而發生視野進展的患者比例相似或者更少。VF進展的風險因素將會被確認。 這項研究的發現將會改變OHT的治療方案。具體來說，我們能夠根據指示疾病惡化的生物標記，針對性地治療OHT來控制視野進展風險。這也將最小化成本和不良反應，並提高醫療系統內資源的合理再分配，以供給最需要治療的人群。

14100916.label: Realisation of objectives
14100916.value: 310 patients (620 eyes) with OHT were recruited in the study; 156 patients were randomized to Management Paradigm I and 154 patients were randomized to Management Paradigm II. By the end of 4 years, 272 patients remained in the study (retention rate 87.7%). The 5th year follow-up is ongoing. At the time of writing this report, 31 patients (10%) have completed the study with 5 years of follow up. While a manuscript has been prepared for submission (enclosed), we would like to submit the paper when all the patients have completed the 5th year follow-up. Realization of objectives (1) To compare the proportions of OHT patients requiring IOP-lowering treatment and the total treatment costs between those randomized to IOP-lowering treatment upon detection of progressive RNFL thinning (management paradigm I) and those randomized to IOP-lowering treatment upon detection of a 5-year glaucoma conversion risk >15% calculated with reference to the OHTS-EPGS risk prediction model (management paradigm II) in 5 years. For Management Paradigm I, 46 eyes from 34 patients showed progressive RNFL thinning by TPA and received IOP-lowering treatment; for Management Paradigm II, 99 eyes from 56 patients had an OHTS-EGPS risk score greater than 15% and received IOP-lowering treatment. In other words, the proportion of patients receiving IOP-lowering treatment was greater in the latter than the former (21.8% vs. 36.4%, P=0.005). The proportion of eyes receiving IOP-lowering treatment was also greater in those randomized to Management Paradigm II than those randomized to Management Paradigm I (14.7% vs. 31.8%, P<0.001). Taking the initiation of IOP-lowering treatment as the survival endpoint, the survival probability for patients in Management Paradigm II was significantly lower for patients in Management Paradigm I (P<0.001) (please refer to Fig.2 in the uploaded manuscript). The total cost of IOP-lowering treatment during the study period is summarized in Table 2 in the uploaded manuscript. The treatment cost of Management Paradigm II was 7 times more than Management Paradigm I. (2) To compare the proportions of patients with VF progression in 5 years between management paradigm I and management paradigm II. Twelve eyes from 10 patients developed likely visual field progression – 7 eyes (6 patients) from Management Paradigm I and 5 eyes (4 patients) from Management Paradigm II. Forty-three eyes from 38 patients developed possible or likely visual field progression – 26 eyes (23 patients) from Management Paradigm I and 17 eyes (15 patients) from Management Paradigm II. There were no significant differences in the proportions of patients/eyes with likely VF progression (3.8% vs. 2.6% (P=0.535), respectively, by patients; 2.2% vs. 1.6% (P=0.575), respectively, by eyes), or possible/likely VF progression (14.7% vs. 9.7% (P=0.180), respectively, by patients; 8.3% vs. 5.5% (P=0.168), respectively, by eyes) between the two management paradigms. Likewise, the rates of change of VF MD did not differ between Management Paradigms I and II (-0.16 dB/year vs. -0.17 dB/year, P=0.754). (3) To identify the risk factors for VF progression in Hong Kong Chinese with OHT. Among the five risk factors identified from the OHTS and EPGS, age, VF PSD, and VCDR were associated with possible or likely VF progression (please refer to Table 3 in the uploaded manuscript). The risk of development of VF progression increased by 5% (OR: 1.05, 95% CI: 1.01-1.09) for each year increase in age, 41% (OR: 1.41, 95% CI: 1.04-1.91) for each 0.1 unit increase in VCDR, and 3.5-fold (OR: 3.51, 95% CI: 1.19-10.4) for each dB decrease in PSD.

14100916.label: Major findings and research outcome
14100916.value: The funded study (14100916) has generated three manuscripts – one has been accepted for publication, one is currently under review in Ophthalmology, and one is pending for submission. These manuscripts have been uploaded in Part C. (1) Leung CKS, Lam AKN, Weinreb RN, Garway-Heath DF, Yu M, Guo PY, Chiu VSM, Wan KHN, Wong M, Wu KZ, Cheung CYL, Lin C, Chan CKM, Chan NCY, Kam KW, Lai GWK. Diagnostic assessment of glaucoma and non-glaucomatous optic neuropathies via optical texture analysis of the retinal nerve fibre layer. Nat Biomed Eng. 2022 May;6(5):593-604. Data collected from patients with ocular hypertension in the funded study were combined with data collected from glaucoma patients to validate the performance of ROTA (retinal nerve fiber layer optical texture analysis). ROTA is a novel algorithm developed to uncover axonal fiber bundles loss. In the published study, we found ROTA attained a higher sensitivity and specificity for detection of RNFL defects compared with conventional OCT RNFL/GCIPL thickness analysis. (2) Su CK, Guo PY, Chan PP, Lam AK, Leung CKS. Retinal Nerve Fiber Layer Optical Texture Analysis: Detecting Axonal Fiber Bundle Loss in Patients with Ocular Hypertension. Under review in Ophthalmology. This study reports that 10.8% of patients with ocular hypertension (i.e., no RNFL abnormalities in conventional OCT RNFL thickness analysis) had axonal fiber bundle loss in ROTA in at least one eye. (3) Leung CKS, Guo PY, Chan PP, Lai G. Progressive retinal nerve fiber layer thinning as a biomarker to guide intraocular pressure lowering treatment in patients with ocular hypertension – A randomized clinical trial. Pending Submission. This randomized clinical trial shows that treatment decisions guided by the evaluation of progressive RNFL thinning necessitated a significantly smaller proportion of patients receiving IOP-lowering treatments without increasing the proportion of patients who developed VF progression.

14100916.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
14100916.value: A cost-effective analysis study is underway with an objective of informing eye care professionals and health policy makers for consideration of the implementation of the new management paradigm in clinical practice. In addition to demonstrating that the new management paradigm based on the detection of progressive RNFL thinning necessitated a significantly smaller proportion of patients receiving IOP-lowering treatments without increasing the proportion of patients developing VF progression compared with the existing management paradigm based on OHTS-EPGS risk assessment, our study helps develop a new algorithm ROTA (retinal nerve fiber layer optical texture analysis) to uncover the optical texture and trajectories of axonal fiber bundles for early detection of axonal fiber bundle in patients with ocular hypertension. ROTA can reveal axonal fiber bundle loss in patients with ocular hypertension before detectable RNFL thickness abnormalities in OCT and VF sensitivity abnormalities. We will further investigate whether axonal fiber bundle loss detected by ROTA is a better biomarker to guide treatment decisions in patients with ocular hypertension.

14100916.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
14100916.value: Ocular Hypertension (OHT) is a condition in which the intraocular pressure (IOP) is higher than normal. Left untreated, it can lead to glaucoma, which is a leading cause of irreversible blindness. To prevent this, the Ocular Hypertension Treatment Study (OHTS) and the European Glaucoma Prevention Study (EGPS) risk calculator has been developed to guide treatment decisions for OHT. This study compared two different management paradigms in terms of how many patients needed to receive IOP-lowering treatments and how many patients developed visual field (VF) progression. The first paradigm involved providing IOP-lowering treatment upon detection of progressive retinal nerve fiber layer (RNFL) thinning. The second paradigm involved providing IOP-lowering treatment when the 5-year glaucoma conversion risk was >15% calculated according to the OHTS-EPGS risk prediction model. The results showed that the second paradigm led to a significantly larger proportion of patients receiving IOP-lowering treatment (36.4%) compared with the first paradigm (21.8%). However, there were no significant differences in the proportions of patients who developed VF progression (3.8% and 2.6% for the two paradigms respectively). This study showed that the first paradigm was more effective in terms of the number of patients receiving IOP-lowering treatments, without increasing the risk of VF progression.

14101816.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14101816.value: The primary aim of this project is to determine the safety profile of perioperative administration of dexamethasone in patients having major noncardiac surgery. Dexamethasone is an inexpensive and commonly administered drug in anesthesia. It is effective in preventing postoperative nausea and vomiting, improving pain relief and reducing fatigue after surgery. Although it is well known that long-term, large doses of dexamethasone are associated with higher rate of infection, it is unclear whether a single intraoperative dose of dexamethasone will also increase the risk of surgical site infection. We have recently reported the results of our ENIGMA-II trial in the Lancet – a randomized controlled trial evaluating the safety of nitrous oxide in 7,112 patients having noncardiac surgery. In a post hoc analysis of the ENIGMA-II trial, we observed a non-significant increase in surgical site infection (from 9.6% to 11.2%, p=0.097) among patients who received dexamethasone during anaesthesia. Similarly, in a systematic review of over 5,000 patients, there was a trend of increase in the odds of surgical site infection in the dexamethasone group compared with placebo [pooled odds ratio (95% confidence intervals): 1.18 (0.91-1.53), p=0.066]. Despite the limitations of these analyses, our findings highlight the potentially harmful effect of perioperative dexamethasone. In order to evaluate the risks and benefits of perioperative dexamethasone, we propose carrying out an international, randomized noninferiority trial to compare the effect of single-dose dexamethasone with a placebo on surgical site infection in 8,880 patients within 30 days after major noncardiac surgery. Secondary outcomes include other sources of infection (such as pneumonia, urinary tract infection, bacteremia and sepsis), postoperative nausea and vomiting, acute and chronic postsurgical pain and disability-free survival at 12 months after surgery. The findings of this trial are critically important to guide decision-making in perioperative management. Specifically, the benefit of an inexpensive and effective prophylaxis for postoperative nausea, vomiting and pain must be weighed against the risk of serious surgical site infection. If our study confirms that dexamethasone contributes to serious infection, then anaesthetic practice worldwide must be adjusted immediately to improve patient safety. 本項研究的主要目的是確定在圍手術期，對非心臟大手術的患者給予地塞米鬆的安全性。 地塞米松是在麻醉過程中經濟且常用的藥物。它可以有效地防止手術後的噁心和嘔吐，改善疼痛和減輕術後疲勞感。雖然眾所周知，長期的、大劑量的使用地塞米松是與感染高度相關的，但是目前還不清楚單一劑量的地塞米松是否也會增加外科手術部位感染的風險。 我們最近在Lancet上報導了ENIGMA-II臨床試驗的結果— 一項隨機對照試驗—評估在非心臟大手術的7112例患者中使用一氧化二氮的安全性。在ENIGMA-II試驗的後續分析中，我們觀察到，在麻醉期間接受地塞米鬆的患者中，外科手術部位感染率有轻微的增加（從9.6％到11.2％，P = 0.097）。同樣，在一項超過5000例患者的系統綜述中，通過與安慰劑組的比較，我們發現地塞米松組有增加外科手術部位感染機率的趨勢[合併比值比（95％置信區間）：1.18（ 0.91-1.53），P = 0.066]。儘管這些分析有其局限性，但我們發現在圍手術期使用地塞米松會有潛在的有害影響。 為了評估圍手術期使用地塞米鬆的風險和益處，我們建議開展一項國際性的、隨機的非劣效試驗，即在8880例非心臟大手術的患者中，對術後30日內給予單一劑量地塞米松和安慰劑的效果進行比較。其次是評估其他感染源（如肺炎、泌尿系感染、菌血症和敗血症）、術後噁心嘔吐、急性和慢性術後疼痛，以及手術後12個月無殘疾生存情況。 這項試驗的研究結果對於圍手術期管理的指導決策是至關重要的。具體來講，我們必須在經濟而有效的預防術後噁心、嘔吐和疼痛，和嚴重手術部位感染的風險之間進行權衡。如果我們的研究證實地塞米松會導致嚴重感染，那麼全世界的麻醉措施都需要進行調整，以保證改善患者手術的安全性。

14103316.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14103316.value: In this study, the primary objective is to establish a list of validated pan-genotype protein-interacting partners of human norovirus structural proteins viral protein 1 (VP1) and VP2. Human norovirus is classified as a pathogen in the highest priority group of public health importance by the European CDC. Human norovirus has superseded bacteria as a major cause of foodborne infections and all-cause acute gastroenteritis in developed countries. In children, human norovirus is ranked the number one cause of diarrheal diseases in post rotavirus vaccine era. Despite the public health importance and its discovery over 40 years ago, the biology of human norovirus is poorly understood, arguably due to the absence of a robust cell culture model and a representative small animal model. Cellular factors involved in norovirus infection and replication remain largely unexplored. It has long been known that virus surface contains determinants of host cell attachment and other steps of infection. For example, differential preference towards sialic acids by the viral surface hemagglutinin protein accounts for the host range of avian and human influenza viruses. In norovirus, there are two key structural proteins—major capsid VP1 and minor capsid VP2. Surprisingly, despite the apparent importance of structural proteins in the infection and pathogenesis of norovirus, efforts to identify their protein-interacting partners has been rare. There is only one study that hinted at a ubiquitously expressed 105-kDa protein as a norovirus attachment molecule. Here we propose a laboratory study to establish a host interactome of human norovirus structural proteins VP1 and VP2. Preliminary data suggests that GRP78, a chaperone used by hepatitis E virus, dengue virus, and coxackievirus A9, may interact with human norovirus. This clearly supports the idea that there are as-yet-to-be-identified protein-interacting partners of human norovirus. Using VP1 and VP2 of 3 leading norovirus genotypes (GII.4, GII.17, and GII.6), we will screen human cDNA library in yeast two-hybrid system to identify additional potential protein-interacting partners of VP1 and VP2. We will validate protein-protein interactions using mammalian co-immunoprecipitation and confocal microscopy. We will also characterize RNA and protein expression of candidate protein partners in multiple cell lines and human tissues. The pan-genotype interactome will provide important insights into cellular factors for human norovirus infection in steps such as attachment, uncoating, entry and/or later steps of pathogenesis. Last but not least, we will consider alternative functions of norovirus VP1 and VP2 and open up enquiries depending on the discovered protein-interacting partners. 這項研究首要目標是建立人類不同諾如病毒基因亞型結構蛋白VP1和VP2與宿主蛋白產生給合作用之名單。 諾如病毒被歐洲疾病預防及控制中心列為公共衛生重要性中最高優先組別。諾如病毒已經取代細菌成為先進成市透過食物感染急性胃腸炎的主要成因。自從輪狀病毒疫苗近年開始普及，諾如病毒在歐美等先進國家續漸取代輪狀病毒成為導致兒童腹瀉頭號致病體。儘管發現諾如病毒超過四十載，科學界至今對諾如病毒的致病機制及其生物特性所知甚少。其中一個重要原因可以歸咎於我們缺乏一個適合諾如病毒複製的細胞培養方法和動物模型，以致尚未清楚何種細胞因子會影響及主導諾如病毒感染和複製過程。 病毒通過與人類細胞表面蛋白或其他因子給合是開展感染的笫一步。例如人和禽流感病毒表面血凝素蛋白會和宿主細胞表面不同唾液酸結合從而入侵細胞。諾如病毒有兩個主要結構蛋白VP1和VP2。出乎意料，儘管結構蛋白在感染和發病機制上有相當高重要性，我們對VP1和VP2與細胞表面甚麼蛋白結合一籌莫展。文獻記載中只有一個十多年前的小型研究曾透露一種分子重量為105 kDa的蛋白有可能是諾如病毒依附因子。我們希望藉是項研究撥款申請，提出一系列實驗室研究，以確定人類諾如病毒結構蛋白VP1和VP2與宿主蛋白產生給合作用之名單。初步數據顯示，其中一種名為GRP78的蛋白可能是人類諾如病毒依附因子。GRP78同時是戊型肝炎病毒、登革熱病毒和腸病毒的依附因子，這清楚支持很可能尚有未被發現的諾如病毒依附因子。我們將利用3種最常見諾如病毒基因亞型所表達的VP1和VP2在酵母雙雜交系統進行篩選以辨認出更多與VP1和VP2產生給合作用的蛋白分子，然後用免疫沉澱法和螢光幕顯微鏡進行驗證。通過驗證後，我們將會對有關蛋白於不同細胞系和人體組織表達模式進行深入研究。這項研究將會提供重要數據提升我們了解諾如病毒致病機制。

14103516.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14103516.value: 動物進化的其中一個標誌是對基因功能的微分調節到指定不同類型的細胞，組織，內分泌系統，和形態。microRNA 調控動物基因的表達。儘管過去十年來許多研究已經顯示microRNA功能，破譯microRNA的生物學依然是現代最令人興奮的挑戰之一。 在一般情況下，一個microRNA產生兩個成熟miRNAs （5P和3P）。鑑於序列組成的差異，從同一microRNA生成的兩個成熟miRNAs有不同的定位特性和生物學功能。 以前的研究經常表明生產品中的一個成熟miRNA 將降解。不過，這一觀點迅速變化: 1) 5P和3P arms 可以產生具功能的miRNAs，和2）佔主導地位的成熟miRNA可以在不同的組織，發育時間，病理狀態，或物種之間交換表達水平 (microRNA arm switching)。 這些新的數據表明， miRNA arm 的使用和選擇很可能在發育生物學，內分泌學，進化和疾病有重要的作用，而了解microRNA arm switching有望揭示基因的表達的複雜性。然而，對於microRNA arm switching 的控制機制仍是未知。 最近，我們的團隊已經表明，microRNA arm 使用雙鏈外的編碼（ EMBO Reports 2011年，由F1000評估） ，且在microRNA側翼序列有顯著保守性（Proc Roy Soc B 2015年） 。建立在這兩條線，這提案旨在研究我們所熟悉的microRNA（Nucleic Acids Res 2013年）的側翼序列 。 這項目將提供microRNA arm switching 機制有價值和新的見解，並將是microRNA生物學必不可少的理解的研究領域。

14103516.label: Major findings and research outcome
14103516.value: This project aims to reveal the microRNA arm switching effects on the microRNA targets, as well as to reveal the sequence that is related to microRNA arm switching which are all poorly known at present. In this 30-month project, we have carried out detail investigation on cases of microRNA arm switching in different animals, including Drosophila, jellyfish, horseshoe crabs, insects, and millipedes. These include understanding the flanking sequence of microRNA in Drosophila, testing the microRNAs of Drosophila and millipedes arm switching (including mir-iab-8), pushing back the evolutionary origin of microRNA in animals, as well as understanding the dynamics of microRNAs and target fates. Research outcome: 5 publications (1 review and 2 high-quality research papers published, and 2 more high-quality research paper under review), few undergraduates trained, attended international conferences, make collaborations, and local community engagement.

14103516.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
14103516.value: There could be multiple lines (on both basic and applied science) that can be further built on this project, including: Basic science: 1) further more detailed mechanism - how different microRNAs regulate different types genes in genomes? 2) broader aspect in evolution - how have microRNAs in regulation of genes evolved in different animals or even other kingdom such as plants? Applied science: 3) use of findings to utilise microRNAs for aquaculture production, conservation, or combating agricultural pests.

14103516.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
14103516.value: Understanding microRNA biology is revealing hidden layers of gene regulation. Despite systematic investigations into their regulatory mechanisms and functions in recent years, a phenomenon named as microRNA arm switching remain to be poorly investigated. This study reveals the evolutionary origin of microRNA arm switching using jellyfish, elucidates the fates of microRNA arm switching and targets after duplication in horseshoe crabs, and identifies the mechanism of microRNA arm switching using millipedes and fruit fly.

14104716.label: Realisation of objectives
14104716.value: Background of this project: This project was originally awarded to Dr. Liyuan Chen on July 1st, 2016 and the project started on January 1st, 2017. Dr. Liyuan Chen was a Research Assistant Professor with a 3-years contract (from September 1st, 2015 to August 31st, 2018) at School of Life Sciences, CUHK. Dr. Liyuan Chen submitted the midterm report on May 28th, 2018 which was ranked “satisfactory” by RGC on August 27th, 2018. Unfortunately, Dr. Liyuan Chen left CUHK on August 31st, 2018 at the end of her contract for a new position in Shenzhen. Before her departure, Dr. Liyuan Chen had requested to transfer this project to Prof. Jiang with PI changed effective from September 1st, 2018 (approved by RGC on August 30th, 2018). Because of this PI changed, we subsequently requested to extend the project for six months with a new completion date of June 30, 2020 (approved by Research Committee of CUHK on August 1st, 2019 ). Objective 1: To address whether CRL3BPM E3 ligase could orchestrate the degradation of different R2R3-MYB transcription factors (TF), specific yeast-two-hybrid (Y2H) studies, biomolecular fluorescent complimentary (BiFC) assays and Co-immunoprecipitation (Co-IP) analysis were conducted for the identification of protein interactions. The results showed that MYB106 can interact with BPM1, BPM2 and BPM4, but not BPM3, BPM5 and BPM6.To investigate whether CRL3BPM E3 ligase affect the protein abundance of MYB106, dual-LUC method has been conducted. When MYB106 protein was induced with CUL3A and BPM proteins at the same time, the protein level of MYB106 decreased significantly. To further demonstrate that MYB106 is a substrate of the E3 ligase and is degraded through the ubiquitin-26S proteasome pathway, the protein levels of MYB106 were detected and compared after transient expression of MYB106-HA and GFP-HA in leaf protoplasts of the WT and cul3hyp mutant. The results showed that treatment with the proteasome inhibitor MG132 caused accumulation of MYB106 but not the control GFP, indicating that MYB106 protein was degraded by the 26S proteasome pathway. In addition, the mutation of CUL3 can also promote the MYB106 protein accumulation compared with WT, which further confirmed that the degradation of MYB106 protein was dependent upon the CUL3 E3 ligases. Taken together, we confirmed that MYB106 interacts with BPM proteins directly which are further identified by CRL3BPM E3 ligases as the substrate. These results have been published in Journal of Integrative Plant Biology in 2021. Thus, we have achieved the original objective 1 fully. Objective 2: To further study the transcriptional regulation profile of those different MYBs, RNA-seq analysis was performed with 3 independent biological replicates of the WT, myb106-1 and myb117-1 mutants. The RNA-seq results in WT and myb106-1 mutant revealed that there were 257 differentially expressed genes (|log2FC| ≥1 and p-value < 0.05), among which 183 genes were up-regulated while 74 genes were down-regulated. From a functional cluster analysis of differentially expressed genes between WT and myb106-1 mutants, we got the specific candidate pathway plot. Among these genes, different pathways have been identified, including genes involved in cuticle development, fatty acid elongation, wax biosynthetic pathways and cutin biosynthesis.Transcriptome analysis of myb117 mutants revealed 410 differentially expressed genes between wild type and myb117-1 mutants, where selective genes including the Flowering Locus T (FT) were further confirmed by qRT-PCR analysis. Moreover, KEGG pathway analysis revealed that MYB117 is putatively involved in protein processing in the endoplasmic reticulum, plant hormone signal transduction and oxidative phosphorylation pathways. These results have been published in Journal of Integrative Plant Biology and Plant Signaling and Behavior in 2021. Thus, we have achieved the original objective 2 fully. Objective 3: To further investigate the functional connection and regulation cascade of CRL3BPM E3 ligase and MYB TFs, we observed the flowering phenotype and detected Flowering Locus T (FT) expression levels in the WT, myb106 mutants and cul3hyp (cul3 hypomorph double mutant). Compared with WT, myb106-1 and myb106-2 mutants showed a significantly early flowering phenotype while the flowering process of cul3hyp delayed a lot. In myb106-1 and myb106-2 mutants, FT was up-regulated when compared to the WT which was consistent with the early flowering phenotype of myb106-1 and myb106-2 mutants. On the other hand, when compared to the WT, FT was down regulated in cul3hyp mutant which due to the accumulation of MYB106. These results suggested that MYB106 negatively regulates the expression of FT and CRL3BPM E3 ligases regulate the transcription of FT by modulating the protein abundance of MYB106. Taken together, we demonstrated that MYB106 functions as a novel negative regulator in controlling flowering time by directly suppressing the expression of FT, and the protein levels were modulated by CRL3BPM E3 ligase in Arabidopsis. These results have been published in Journal of Integrative Plant Biology in 2021. Thus, we have achieved the original objective 3 fully. In conclusion, all the original three objectives in the research project have been successfully achieved, which is demonstrated by the publications as well as the research findings summarized in this completion report. This RGC-funded project sheds light into the research about MYB106 and MYB117 function in regulation of plant flowering time. Moreover, this project has also nurtured and trained graduate students and young researchers (e.g., postdoc and research assistant), and resulted in publications in international journals.

14104716.label: Major findings and research outcome
14104716.value: 1. We have identified two R2R3-MYB transcription factors, MYB106 and MYB117, that involved in plant flowering time and development regulation. We have identified MYB106 as a novel negative regulator in the control of flowering time through FT and a new substrate for CRL3BPM E3 ligases, as well as MYB117 as a negative regulator to suppress the expression of FT in Arabidopsis. These results have been published in Journal of Integrative Plant Biology and Plant Signaling and Behavior in 2021. 2. We have found that the mutation of MYB106 induced early flowering phenotype while over-expression of MYB106 delayed Arabidopsis flowering. Transcriptome analysis of myb106 mutants reveals its potential target genes, among which FT was demonstrated to be a direct target gene of MYB106 in regulation of flowering time. Moreover, MYB106 functions as a substrate of CRL3BPM E3 ligases by interacting with BPM proteins. Besides, MYB117 was also found to be participated in the flowering time regulation in Arabidopsis by directly binding to the promoter of FT to suppress its expression. These results have been published in Journal of Integrative Plant Biology and Plant Signaling and Behavior in 2021. 3. With partially support from this project, we have also trained excellent postdoc and postgraduate students with very good research outputs. 4. The project has resulted in a list of very good publications (both Research and Review Articles) in international journals including Journal of Integrative Plant Biology, Plant signaling & Behavior, Current Opinion in Plant Biology, Plant Cell, Protoplasma, Trends in Plant sciences, and Frontiers in Plant Science. 5. As the new PI of this project from September 2018, Prof. Jiang had supervised and worked closely with both RPGs and postdoc on this project. To further promote young scientists for their future career development, Prof. Jiang has decided to offer Dr. Liyuan Chen (the original PI of this project) and Dr. Fangfang Niu (a postdoc with significant contribution to this project) as co-corresponding authors for the two latest research articles published in JIPB and PSB in 2021, even though Prof. Jiang is the PI of this project.

14104716.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
14104716.value: Support by this GRF grant, we have added MYB106 and MYB117 to the flowering time regulation network, especially to the FT regulatory complex. We have also developed a new working model on the roles of R2R3-MYBs in the regulation of flowering time in Arabidopsis. One of the future research directions will be focus on identifying and understanding the roles of elusive transcription factors (TFs) in regulating the formation and functions of vacuoles in different plant cell types in coming years.

14104716.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
14104716.value: Flowering time is crucial for successful reproduction in plants, whose onset and progression are strictly controlled. However, flowering time is a complex and environmentally responsive trait with elusive underlying mechanisms. Post-translational regulation of the activities of transcription factors is a dynamic and essential mechanism for plant growth and development. This study has identified MYB117 and MYB106 as new negative regulators in the control of flowering time through FT and MYB106 as a new substrate for CRL3BPM E3 ligases in Arabidopsis.

14105916.value: 此申請目標在於確立ABCA1-APOE通路在視網膜神經節細胞中的保護機制，並尋找與原發性開角型青光眼相關的ABCA1和APOE的基因變異。 原發性開角型青光眼是在香港及全球中的致盲主因。很多病人即使採取了降低眼壓的治療，但視網膜神經節細胞仍在損失中，造成漸進性視力喪失。目前原發性開角型青光眼尚無根治手段，而且病因非常複雜。基因學研究是展現複雜致病機制的先進手段，全基因組關聯分析是尋找原發性開角型青光眼致病基因的有效方法。 我們最近在中國人群中進行了原發性開角型青光眼全基因組關聯分析。在中國五個不同地區共2906例原發性開角性青光眼病人及5974例正常對照組中，進行了總數達900015個單核苷酸多態性分析，發現一個ABCA1基因多態性rs2487032 (p = 2.79 X 10-19)與原發性開角型青光眼顯著相關。ABCA1(三磷酸腺苷結合盒轉運體A1) 具有介導細胞內脂質轉運至無脂質結合的載脂蛋白A1(APOA1)及載脂蛋白E(APOE)的功能。重要的是，我們之前發現APOE基因也與原發性開角性青光眼顯著相關，並且ABCA1與APOE基因具有疊加效應。RNA測序結果顯示，Abca1和Apoe在小鼠體內分離出的視網膜神經節細胞中均有表達。ABCA1基因表達上調可抑制N-甲基-D-天冬氨酸誘導的視網膜神經節細胞凋亡，而與之相反，在ApoE敲除小鼠中由誘導高眼壓或視神經損傷導致的視網膜神經節細胞的死亡和視神經退化程度均有降低。因此，ABCA1表達上調和APOE表達下調應具有神經保護作用，揭示ABCA1和APOE如何減少視網膜神經節細胞退化對臨床預防及治療該疾病具有重要意義。我們在此提出進一步生物學研究，來揭示ABCA1-APOE通路對視網膜神經節細胞的保護機制。此外，該機制也會協助研究原發性開角性青光眼相關ABCA1與APOE基因多態性的生物作用。 此研究結果將在青光眼領域中引入新通路，並加深對青光眼發病機制的理解，也會為探索臨床治療手段提供一個新的平臺。

14105916.label: Realisation of objectives
14105916.value: Objective 1: To determine the protective effects and mechanisms by ABCA1 and APOE on retinal ganglion cells in vitro We found that POAG subjects had significantly higher plasma triglycerides (TG) (1.44 ± 0.87 mmol/L against 1.75 ± 1.50 mmol/L; P = 0.002) but lower high density lipoprotein (HDL) cholesterol (1.72 ± 0.58 mmol/L against 1.58 ± 0.48 mmol/L; P < 0.001) as compared to controls (Wu et al., manuscript submitted). We subsequently used the obese model of Apoe-knockout (KO) mice to investigate the effect of high fat contents on the survival of retinal ganglion cells (RGCs). Apoe-KO mice on high fat diet showed atherosclerotic plaque in the aorta without significant changes in intraocular pressure (IOP). Instead, the in vivo number of RGCs in the Apoe-KO mice after 6-week high fat feeding was less than that the Apoe-KO mice and normal C57BL/6 mice on normal diet. Similarly, after optic nerve injury, the in vivo number of RGCs in the Apoe-KO mice after 6-week high fat diet feeding was less than that the Apoe-KO mice and the normal C57BL/6 mice on normal diet. However, in ex vivo explant culture, the number of RGCs in the Apoe-KO mice after 6-week high fat diet feeding was less than that the Apoe-KO mice and the normal C57BL/6 mice on normal diet, with respectively higher numbers of RGCs. High fat diet through APOE therefore induced RGC death in mice, which is consistent with observations in POAG patients. Meanwhile, we had previously demonstrated that in rats after optic nerve (ON) injury, mild inflammation promoted retinal ganglion cell (RGC) survival and subsequently axonal regeneration. To search for extra-ocular regulations of ocular physiological and pathological mechanisms, we have identified effects of the GHRHR (growth hormone related hormone receptor) signaling pathway of the GHRH-GH-insulin like growth factor 1 (IGF1) axis in the regulation of ocular inflammation and optical neuroprotection. GHRHR agonists and antagonists are effective agents. Study on the mechanistic details revealed the GHRHR signaling pathway, in the presence of macrophage infiltration, regulated the ocular inflammatory responses for retinal ganglion cells protection after optic nerve injury (Cen LP PNAS 2021). GHRHR agonists and antagonists alleviate inflammation of retina tissue cells protect retinal ganglion cells from apoptosis and enhance axonal regeneration. This provides a novel therapeutic approach for POAG through supporting retinal ganglion cells survival. Objective 2: To determine the biological functions of the POAG-associated variants in ABCA1 and APOE genes Since genetic association analysis identified a significant association of CAV1 gene variant with POAG in southern Chinese POAG patients, we generated human CAV1-KO TM cells by CRISPR/Cas9 technology and found that the CAV1-KO TM cells less adhered to the surface coating than the wildtype TM cells by 69.34% (P < 0.05), with no difference in apoptosis (Wu et al., 2019). Higher endocytosis ability of dextran and transferrin was also observed in the CAV1-KO TM cells (4.37 and 1.89-fold respectively, P < 0.001), compared to the wildtype TM cells. Moreover, the CAV1-KO TM cells had higher expression of extracellular matrix-degrading enzyme genes (ADMTS13 and MMP14), autophagy-related genes (ATG7 and BECN1) and protein (LC3B-II) than the wildtype TM cells. Our results showed that the CAV1-KO TM cells have reduced adhesion with higher extracellular matrix-degrading enzyme expression, but increased endocytosis and autophagy activities, indicating CAV1 regulates adhesion, endocytosis, and autophagy of human TM cells. Objective 3: To determine the association of variants on ABCA1 and APOE, and other relevant genes, with POAG and its endophenotypes In the FOXC1 locus, we found LOC102723944 rs6596830, rather than rs2745572, showed association with POAG (P = 8.61 x 10-4, OR = 0.75) and HTG (P = 3.68 x 10-3, OR = 0.75) (Wu et al., manuscript submitted). ABCA1 rs2487032 was also significantly associated with POAG (P = 3.00 x 10-5, OR = 0.70) and HTG (P = 2.08 x 10-4, OR = 0.70). Joint analysis showed that carriers of homozygous non-protective alleles of ABCA1 rs2487032 and LOC102723944 rs6596830 had 2.99-fold higher risk of POAG (P = 1.27 x 10-3) than those carrying homozygous non-risk alleles. POAG patients carrying ABCA1 rs2487032 G allele had higher HDL cholesterol, and those with LOC102723944 rs6596830 A allele had lower LDL. This study revealed individual and joint association of ABCA1 and LOC102723944 variants with POAG. Subjects carrying non-protective alleles had increased risk to POAG, and corresponding genotypes would affect the lipid profiles. Moreover, we identified that CAV1 gene variant rs4236601 was significantly associated with NTG in the two Chinese cohorts (Pmeta = 0.0019, OR = 4.55, I2 = 0) (Lu et al., 2020). In contrast, rs4236601 was monomorphic in the Osaka cohort. The association of rs1052990 was insignificant in a meta-analysis combining Chinese and Japanese cohorts (Pmeta = 0.81, OR = 1.05; I2 = 64%), and the OR tended towards opposite directions between Chinese (OR = 1.26) and Japanese (OR = 0.69). There was no sex-specific effects of the SNPs in the logistic regression or Breslow-day tests of ORs (P > 0.05), although rs4236601 was significant in males (P = 0.0068; OR = 10.30) but not in females (P = 0.14; OR = 2.65) in the meta-analysis of Chinese subjects. This study confirmed the association of rs4236601 at the CAV1-CAV2 locus with NTG in Chinese. SNP rs4236601 is monomorphic, and rs1052990 tends towards a different direction in Japanese. In addition, we found association of the novel SIX6 gene variant rs12436579, with POAG in Hong Kong and Shantou Chinese (Pcombined = 4.3 × 10-5, OR = 0.72, I2 = 0) (Rong et al., 2019). The association of one known SNP, rs33912345 (Pcombined = 0.0061, OR = 0.69, I2 = 45%), was replicated with POAG in the Chinese cohorts but not in the Japanese cohort (P > 0.6). SNP rs10483727 was nominally associated with POAG in the two Chinese cohorts (Pcombined = 0.017, OR = 0.70, I2 = 53%). All these three SNPs were significantly associated with POAG when the three cohorts were combined in meta-analysis (Pcombined < 0.005). Furthermore, two haplotypes, C-C (Pcombined = 1.13 × 10-5, OR = 1.41, I2 = 0) and A-A (Pcombined = 0.045, OR = 0.68, I2 = 70%), defined by rs33912345-rs12436579 were associated with POAG in Chinese but not in Japanese. This study confirmed the association between two GWAS SNPs in SIX6 (rs33912345 and rs10483727) and POAG. Also, we found association of a novel SNP rs12436579 with POAG in Chinese. Furthermore, we identified 2 synonymous ABCC5 SNPs, namely rs939336 (p.Cys594Cys; P = 0.013; OR = 1.46; 95% C.I.: 1.08 to 1.97) and rs1132776 (p.Ala395Ala; P = 0.009; OR = 1.47; 95% C.I.: 1.10 to 1.95) in PACG (Tang et al., 2017). Mild associations were detected for ABCC5 rs9838667 (P = 0.024) and HTR3D rs12493550 (P = 0.035). Conditional analysis revealed that no SNP remained significant after adjusting for other SNPs, suggesting none of these tagging SNPs in this region is fully responsible for the association with glaucoma. In subgroup analysis, ABCC5 SNPs rs939336, rs1132776, and rs983667 and HTR3D rs12493550 were associated only with the chronic form of PACG. However, these associations could not withstand the correction for multiple testing. These findings enrich the allelic spectrum of ABCC5 in PACG.

14105916.label: Major findings and research outcome
14105916.value: This research project identified that ABCA1 gene variant rs2487032 was also significantly associated with primary open angle glaucoma (POAG) (P = 3.00 x 10-5, OR = 0.70), especially high tension glaucoma (HTG) (P = 2.08 x 10-4, OR = 0.70) in southern Chinese POAG subjects (Wu et al., manuscript under review). We also identified that LOC102723944 gene variant rs6596830 showed significant association with POAG (P = 8.61 x 10-4, OR = 0.75) and HTG (P = 3.68 x 10-3, OR = 0.75). Joint analysis showed that carriers of homozygous non-protective alleles of ABCA1 rs2487032 and LOC102723944 rs6596830 had 2.99-fold higher risk of POAG (P = 1.27 x 10-3) than those carrying homozygous non-risk alleles. POAG patients carrying ABCA1 rs2487032 G allele had higher HDL cholesterol, and those with LOC102723944 rs6596830 A allele had lower LDL. This research project also identified that SIX6 gene variants rs12436579 (P = 4.3 × 10-5, OR = 0.72) and rs33912345 (P = 0.0061, OR = 0.69) were associated with POAG in southern Chinese POAG subjects (Rong et al., 2019). Furthermore, two haplotypes of rs33912345-rs12436579 were also associated with POAG in Chinese POAG subjects (P = 1.13 × 10-5, OR = 1.41). Moreover, this research project identified that CAV1 gene variant rs4236601 was significantly associated with normal tension glaucoma (NTG) in southern Chinese POAG subjects (P = 0.0019, OR = 4.55) (Lu et al., 2020). Gender-specific analysis demonstrated that rs4236601 was significant in males (P = 0.0068; OR = 10.30) but not in females (P = 0.14; OR = 2.65) in the Chinese subjects. In addition, this research project identified that human trabecular meshwork (TM) cells with CAV1 gene knockout (KO) less adhered to the surface coating than the wildtype TM cells, but showed no difference in apoptosis (Wu et al., 2019). CAV1-KO TM cells also showed higher endocytosis ability of dextran and transferrin as compared to the wildtype TM cells. The CAV1-KO TM cells had higher expression of extracellular matrix-degrading enzyme genes as well as autophagy-related genes and protein than the wildtype TM cells. Furthermore, this research project identified that 2 synonymous variants in ABCC5 gene, rs939336 (P = 0.013; OR = 1.46) and rs1132776 (P = 0.009; OR = 1.47), were significantly associated with primary angle closure glaucoma (PACG) (Tang et al., 2017). Subgroup analysis demonstrated that ABCC5 rs939336, rs1132776 and rs983667 and HTR3D rs12493550 were associated only with the chronic form of PACG.

14105916.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
14105916.value: This research project identified the association of CAV1, ABCA1, FOXC1 and SIX6 gene variants with primary open angle glaucoma (POAG), the correlation of POAG-associated genes with the POAG-related ocular examination outcomes as well as the in vitro biological functions of CAV1 gene in human trabecular meshwork cells. How these genes could be involved in the pathogenesis of POAG in glaucoma animal models and human POAG patients warrants further investigations. Moreover, further studies are needed to develop specific treatments targeting these POAG-associated genes and tested in pre-clinical animal models. In addition, the newly developed treatments will be assessed in POAG patients in human clinical trial studies. Our in-depth investigation on anti-inflammatory mechanisms have also identified the involvement of the GHRHR-GH-IGF1 axis in protection of the retinal ganglion cells through complicated regulations of the signal pathways that mediate retinal tissue cell inflammation by GHRHR agonists and antagonists. A new approach in protection of retinal ganglion cells is provided. Therapeutic potential of GHRHR agonists and antagonists are now intensively explored by us and other groups. Eventually, these novel treatments will become the routine clinical treatments for POAG patients.

14105916.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
14105916.value: Primary open angle glaucoma (POAG) is a leading cause of irreversible visual impairment and blindness, affecting more than 80 million people worldwide. Identifying the disease-associated genes and delineating the disease mechanisms helps to develop effective therapies for POAG treatments. This research project identified the association of CAV1, ABCA1, FOXC1 and SIX6 gene variants as the genetic variants associated with POAG. The correlation of these POAG-associated gene variants with the POAG-related ocular examination outcomes was evaluated. Moreover, the in vitro biological functions of CAV1 gene in human trabecular meshwork cells were also delineated. This research project established the genetic markers to determine the risk of POAG development for population screening in Hong Kong and southern China, delineated the underlying mechanisms of the POAG-associated genes in the pathogenesis of POAG, and identified the gene targets for the development of novel treatment strategies to cure POAG. Results of this research project will facilitate the development of clinical treatments for POAG patients in future.

14107116.label: Realisation of objectives
14107116.value: We have accomplished all the research objectives as originally proposed in this project. Our major findings are summarized as follows. Objective 1: As planned, we have determined and elucidated the functional significance of nuclear receptor ERRα in growth regulation of prostate cancer stem cells (PCSCs) in various proposed in vitro and in vivo prostate cancer models with either stable ERRα overexpression or its suppression (by shRNA-mediated knockdown or pharmacological inhibition by ERRα inverse agonists XCT790 or C29 treatment). Our results showed that increased expression of ERRα, as observed in clinical metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer (CRPC) tissues and isolated PCSCs, displayed poor clinical and pathological outcomes. ERRα overexpression could enhance, whereas its suppression could suppress the in vitro spheroid formation capacity (stemness) of prostate cancer cells as well as their in vivo tumorigenicities by (x 102-104) low-cell number injection of prostate cancer cells or isolated PCSCs. These results suggest that ERRα could play a positive role in the growth regulation of PCSCs. Objective 2: As planned, we have characterized and determined the significance of ERRα in the epithelial-mesenchymal transition (EMT) induction in prostate cancer cells with either stable ERRα overexpression or its suppression as described above in Objective 1. Our results showed that ERRα overexpression could result in characteristic EMT-associated morphological phenotype (elongated cell shape) and up-regulate the expressions of multiple EMT-associated mesenchymal biomarkers, including upregulation of Snail and vimentin; and its down-regulation could suppress the epithelial markers, particularly E-cadherin in prostate cancer cells. In addition, our functional and molecular analyses showed that ectopic TMPRSS2:ERG (T:E) fusion gene expression as under the ERRα regulation could promote both the in vitro invasion and in vivo metastasis capacities of AR-negative prostate cancer PC-3M cells and such T:E/ERG-mediated advanced malignant growth potentials could be significantly attenuated by ERRα knockdown, suggesting T:E fusion could be regulated by ERRα in AR-negative prostate cancer cells. Our detailed mechanistic analyses demonstrated for the first time that ERRα and ERG expressed by the T:E fusion gene could synergistically regulated each other at their promoter regions and form a reciprocal positive regulatory loop to fuel the advanced malignant growth of prostate cancer. These results indicate that ERRα could play a regulatory role in the EMT induction and advanced growth in prostate cancer, including their metastatic capacities. Objective 3: As planned, we have characterized the significance of ERRα in the energy metabolism regulation in prostate cancer cells. Our results showed that isolated PCSCs (PCSCs-enriched prostatospheroids derived from different prostate cancer cell lines by a novel ultra-low adhesion 3D-culture method) exhibited significant higher oxygen consumption rate (OCR) (OXPHOS) and ATP production but lower extracellular acidification rate (ECAR) than their corresponding 2D-culture adherent cells, suggesting that PCSCs preferred a status of OXPHOS as their primary source of energy. Besides, we also evaluated the mitochondrial dynamic status in isolated PCSCs, which showed that PCSCs-enriched prostatospheroids displayed more fragmented mitochondria, with higher expression levels of mitochondrial fission regulators and higher mitochondria membrane potential (MMP) as compared to their corresponding 2D-culture adherent cells, that was in line with the enhanced mitochondrial fission activity shown in PCSCs. Our detailed functional analyses revealed that ERRα overexpression could significantly increase, whereas its suppression could lower the OCR (OXPHOS), ATP production and the mitochondrial fission activity in prostate cancer cells and PCSCs. These results suggest that ERRα overexpression could induce a switch from glycolysis to OXPHOS in glucose metabolism and potentiate mitochondrial fission activity in prostate cancer cells and PCSCs. Objective 4: As planned, we have determined the targets and signaling pathways involved in the ERRα-mediated growth regulation of prostate cancer cells and PCSCs. It is well-characterized that citrate serves as an important intermediate among the key tricarboxylic acid/TCA outputs, and the mitochondrial aconitase (m-aconitase/ACO2), a limiting TCA enzyme and whose activity is inhibited by the intracellular zinc, is responsible for the citrate to isocitrate conversion in prostatic glandular/epithelial cells. Our results showed that (a) isolated PCSCs showed enhanced ACO2 enzymatic activity and very low or barely detectable intracellular zinc levels as compared to their 2D-culture adherent counterparts; (b) ERRα overexpression could promote, whereas suppression of ERRα (as exerted by shRNA-mediated knockdown or activity inhibition by inverse agonist XCT790) could suppress the ACO2 expression/activity as well as the expression of mitochondrial fission factor (MFF) in various in vitro and in vivo prostate cancer models; (c) In contrast, ERRα overexpression could increase, whereas its suppression could reduce the expression of the major zinc uptake transporter-ZIP1 and thus the intracellular zinc levels in prostate cancer cells and PCSCs; (d) ERRα could directly transactivate the gene expressions of ACO2 and MFF, and transrepress the expression of ZIP1 as indicated by chromatin immunoprecipitation (ChIP) and reporter gene assays. These results strongly suggest that ERRα could play a regulatory role in TCA cycle and zinc homeostasis in PCSCs via its direct transcriptional regulation of mitochondrial enzyme ACO2 and zinc transporter ZIP1 in citric acid metabolism, thus resulting in an energy metabolism status shifting towards TCA cycle coupled with OXPHOS. Besides, ERRα could also function to regulate the growth of PCSCs through its modulation of mitochondrial fission activity via its transcriptional control of MFF expression. • Some of our results as revealed by the study Objectives 1-4 have been published recently (Xu et al., Oncogene 2018;37:6259-6274; Xu et al., Theranostics 2020;10:4201-4216; Wang et al., Mol Aspects Med 2021;78:100921; Zhou et al., Oncogene 2021;40(15):2625-2634). • Some of our results as revealed by the study Objectives 3-4 are under preparation for submission.

14107116.label: Major findings and research outcome
14107116.value: Our major findings as obtained by this GRF-funded study on the role of nuclear receptor ERRα in PCSCs are summarized as follows: 1. A small subpopulation of prostate cancer cells, termed as PCSCs, being characterized by their enhanced self-renewal and differentiation capacities, and resistance to androgen-deprivation therapy (ADT) may contribute significantly to tumor recurrence and castration-resistant growth of prostate cancer. However, the signaling pathways responsible for the growth regulation of PCSCs still remains poorly understood. One major finding of this study is that nuclear receptor ERRα, which displayed increased expression pattern in clinical metastatic CRPC and isolated PCSCs, could function to regulate the growth of PCSCs through its modulation of TCA cycle and zinc homeostasis via a mechanism of its direct transcriptional regulation of mitochondrial enzyme ACO2 and zinc transporter ZIP1 in citric acid metabolism that could leads to an energy metabolism shift towards TCA cycle coupled with OXPHOS. Moreover, ERRα could also modulate the growth of PCSCs through its control of mitochondrial fission activity via its transactivation of MFF expression. Our findings also provides an insight that targeting ERRα could be a potential therapeutic strategy for CRPC management as pharmacological suppression of its activity by its inverse agonists (XCT790 or C29) could help to attenuate the stem-like properties in prostate cancer cells. Some of our findings have been published recently (Xu et al., Theranostics 2020;10:4201-4216; Wang et al., Mol Aspects Med 2021;78:100921; Zhou et al., Oncogene 2021;40(15):2625-2634). 2. Another major finding of this study is that ERRα could play a positive role in the EMT induction in prostate cancer cells as evidenced by ERRα overexpression-induced morphological phenotype (elongated cell shape) and its regulation of the expressions of several EMT-associated mesenchymal markers, including upregulation of Snail and vimentin, and down-regulation of epithelial markers, particularly E-cadherin, in prostate cancer cells. In addition to these findings, we also demonstrate that ERRα and the oncogenic transcription factor ERG expressed by the TMPRSS2:ERG (T:E) fusion gene could synergistically regulate each other at their promoter regions and form a reciprocal positive regulatory loop to potentiate the advanced growth of prostate cancer cells, including their metastatic capacities. Our findings also provide a novel insight that targeting ERRα could be a potential therapeutic strategy for management of aggressive T:E-positive prostate cancer as ERRα activity could be inhibited by ERRα inverse agonists. Some of these findings have been published (Xu et al., Oncogene 2018;37:6259-6274; Wang et al., Mol Aspects Med 2021;78:100921).

14107116.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
14107116.value: 1. In this GRF-supported study, we have characterized the roles of ERRα on its regulation of PCSC growth through its modulation of TCA cycle and zinc homeostasis via a mechanism of its direct transcriptional regulation of ACO2 and ZIP1 in citric acid metabolism that leading to an energy metabolism shift towards OXPHOS, and also through its control of mitochondrial fission activity via its transactivation of MFF expression. Besides, we have demonstrated that ERRα could induce the EMT phenotype, and also form a reciprocal positive regulatory loop with ERG expressed by T:E fusion gene to fuel the advanced growth of prostate cancer, including the metastatic capacities. 2. Moreover, we also revealed that pharmacological targeting ERRα could attenuate the stem-like properties of prostate cancer cells, and also suppress their metastatic potential. These inspiring findings open a new research avenue that targeting ERRα could be of therapeutic value to advanced prostate cancer patients. This potential therapeutic approach is different from the conventional regimens for prostate cancer by merely targeting to the AR itself or its signaling. It will be worthwhile to further assess the therapeutic significance of targeting ERRα in clinically relevant in vivo models of prostate cancer, such as patient-derived xenograft or organoid models.

14107116.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
14107116.value: Prostate cancer is a common male-specific cancer in Hong Kong. This cancer is unique in its initial androgen-dependence; and surgery and hormone-therapy are the two mainstream treatment options. Unfortunately, majority of the hormone therapy-treated patients will inevitably progress to a fatal hormone-independent stage (described clinically as castration-resistant prostate cancer/CRPC). A small subset of prostate cancer cells, termed as prostate cancer stem cells (PCSCs) characterized by their enhanced self-renewal and differentiation capacities, can play crucial roles in the therapy-resistance and metastasis in CRPC. In this study, we demonstrate that nuclear receptor ERRα is a key driver of CRPC as it can function to promote advanced growth of prostate cancer by means of multiple pathways, including regulation of PCSC growth through its modulation of citric acid metabolism, or through its control of mitochondrial fission activity. Besides, ERRα can induce the EMT phenotype, and form a reciprocal positive regulatory loop with ERG expressed by the T:E fusion gene to fuel the prostate cancer progression. One noteworthy finding is that ERRα could be a potential therapeutic target for advanced prostate cancer as its targeting by pharmacological suppression could help to attenuate the stem-like properties of prostate cancer cells, and also suppress their metastatic potential.

14107216.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14107216.value: We plan to continue our research into the role of magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) in the early detection of nasopharyngeal carcinoma (NPC). NPC is endemic in Hong Kong and arises at the back of the nose close to the skull base and brain. Early NPC is curable with radiotherapy but early cancers may cause no clinical symptoms. In order to improve patient survival and decrease treatment toxicity, it is important to find new ways to detect early cancers and identify patients at risk of developing NPC in the future. Currently we are performing a population screening study using a blood test for the Epstein Barr virus (EBV) DNA, which is a marker for NPC. Asymptomatic subjects with raised plasma EBV DNA, undergo endoscopic examination of the nasopharynx to detect the cancer. MRI is performed also because it is able to detect some early cancers that cannot be visualized by endoscopy. This ongoing study has successfully identified asymptomatic subjects with early NPC, but there are subjects with persistently raised plasma EBV in whom NPC has not been identified. These subjects present a clinical dilemma for further management, because they may have an early NPC that is masked by co-existing inflammation in the nasopharynx or they may be at risk of developing NPC in the future. In this study we plan to perform a follow-up MRI at 3 years in 100 subjects from the screening population with persistently raised plasma EBV DNA, but without a diagnosis of NPC on the initial endoscopy and MRI. The follow-up MRI will employ the same short MRI screening protocol as the initial MRI, together with an additional diffusion weighted imaging (DWI) sequence using a new technique which reduces susceptibility artifact, so allowing small structures in the nasopharyngeal wall to be examined in more detail. The first aim is to identify further patients from this population screening study who have NPC and determine whether follow-up imaging by MRI is of potential value in the management of this group of subjects. The second aim is to determine whether we need to refine of our current MRI criteria and develop new DWI criteria to discriminate small cancers from inflammation. The third aim is to observe changes in EBV DNA levels with changes in patterns of inflammation on MRI, to determine if there is a potential relationship between infection and inflammation seen on MRI. 我們計劃繼續研究磁力共振在早期發現鼻咽癌的作用。鼻咽癌是香港地方性流行的病，它出現在鼻背部，接近顱底和腦。早期的鼻咽癌是可以用電療治愈的，但早期癌症可能無臨床症狀。為了提高患者的存活機會和降低治療毒性，找新的方法來檢測早期癌症並鑑定在未來有機會有鼻咽癌的患者，是非常重要的。 目前，我們正在執行一個用驗血(驗EB病毒DNA，一個鼻咽癌的標記)驗鼻咽癌的人口篩查研究。無症狀而血清中EB病毒DNA持續高水平的受試者會經過鼻咽鏡檢查去檢測癌症。磁力共振檢驗都進行，因為它是能夠檢測不能由內窺鏡可看見的一些早期癌症。這個持續的研究已成功確認無症狀的早期鼻咽癌患者，但還有血清中EB病毒DNA持續高水平並尚未確定鼻咽癌的受試者。這些受試者是否需要進一步臨床管理是一個問題，因為他們可具有在鼻咽共存的炎症掩蔽的早期鼻咽癌，或者他們可能是在將來有機會有鼻咽癌的患者。 在這項研究中，我們計劃在血清中EB病毒DNA持續高水平的篩查人口中的100個未在鼻咽鏡和磁力共振確定鼻咽癌的受試者進行跟進的磁力共振檢驗。這跟進的磁力共振檢驗將採用相同的短磁力共振檢驗為最初的檢驗，另加上外的擴散磁振造影 (DWI) 的磁力共振檢驗，這檢驗使用新的技術，該技術減少的敏感性偽影，允許更詳細地進行檢查在鼻咽壁小的結構。 第一個目標是在篩查人口找出有鼻咽癌的患者並確定跟進的磁力共振檢驗是否在管理這組受試者有潛在價值。第二個目標是確定我們有否需要改進我們目前磁力共振的診斷標準並制定新的擴散磁振造影標準去辨別發炎和小腫瘤。第三個目標是去觀察EB病毒DNA級別對磁力共振看到發炎的變化，去確定感染和磁力共振看到發炎有否潛在的關係。

14107216.label: Realisation of objectives
14107216.value: Objective 1. Identify subjects with NPC from our NPC screening population who are at risk of disease because of persistently elevated plasma EBV DNA, but do not have a diagnosis of NPC after the initial investigations, and use this data to determine whether follow-up MRI has a role in the management of this group of subjects. There were 161 subjects from our NPC screening population with persistently raised EBV-DNA on two occasions without biopsy-proven diagnosis of NPC after the initial set of investigations with endoscopic biopsy and MRI who had a third positive plasma EBV-DNA. Of these 161 subjects 126 consented to undergo a follow-up endoscopic examination and plain-scan MRI after two years. In these 126 subjects the nasopharyngeal MRI at the time of the initial investigations had been graded 1= 13 (normal); graded 2= 61 (low index of suspicion); graded 3= 47 (intermediate index of suspicion); graded 4= 5 (high index of suspicion). Six/126 (4.8%) subjects had cancer proven at follow-up, four with undifferentiated NPC and two with another head and neck cancer outside the nasopharynx. In the four subjects diagnosed with NPC at follow-up the initial MRI had been graded 3 (intermediate index of suspicion ) in 2 (2/47= 4.3%) and grade 4 (high index of suspicion) in 2 (2/5 = 40.0%), and in the two subjects without NPC, who had another head and neck cancer outside the nasopharynx, the initial MRI had been graded 2 (probably benign). The objective was achieved and details of the six subjects with cancer proven after follow-up are shown in appendix 1 Table 1. The grading system is shown in appendix 1 Table 2. Objective 2. Improve the diagnostic performance of MRI for distinguishing inflammation/hypertrophy from small NPCs. Diffusion weighted imaging and analysis was performed in 16 subjects with nasopharyngeal inflammation/hyperplasia and 16 subjects with biopsy proven T1 (early stage) NPC according to the planned sample size. Diffusion data was acquired from both groups using conventional DWI with a mono-exponential model to obtain the apparent diffusion coefficient (ADC) using six b-values (0, 200, 400, 600, 800, 1000 sec/mm2) and intravoxel incoherent motion with bi-exponential model to obtain D (pure diffusion coefficient), D* (pseudo-diffusion coefficient) and f (perfusion volume fraction) using 14 b-values (0, 20, 40, 50, 60, 80, 100, 200, 300, 400, 500, 600, 800 and 1000 s/mm2). The objective was achieved, and the results are shown in appendix 2. The diffusion parameters of the two groups with a statistical comparison are shown in table 1. The diagnostic performance of the optimal thresholds for the significant diffusion parameters, as well as the AUCs of these parameters for distinguishing early-stage NPC from inflammation/hyperplasia are shown in table 2 and the ROC curves for D, D* and ADC mean are shown in figure 1. Objective 3. Provide preliminary data for determining whether there is any potential link between EBV infection and patterns of inflammation/hypertrophy in the nasopharynx on MRI. One hundred and seventeen/120 subjects with a positive plasma EBV-DNA test on at least three occasions, without head and neck cancer, underwent follow-up MRI and plasma EBV-DNA on the same day, and endoscopic examination. The objective was achieved, and the results are shown in appendix 3. Table 1 shows the characteristics (age and smoking history), MRI findings (normal vs benign hyperplasia and volumes of benign hyperplasia) and plasma EBV-DNA results (positive vs negative and levels) of the 117 subjects. The MRI scan of EBV-DNA positive and EBV negative subjects was normal in 10/73 (13.7%) and 13/44 (29.5%) respectively and showed benign hyperplasia in 63/73 (86.3%) and 31/44(70.4%) respectively. Associations between the absence or presence of benign hyperplasia on MRI with plasma EBV-DNA (positive vs negative), age and smoking in all 117 subjects are shown in Table 2. In 94 subjects with benign hyperplasia on MRI associations between the volume of benign hyperplasia with plasma EBV-DNA level, age and smoking are shown in Table 3. Compared to the initial MRI two years before, the follow-up MRI in group 1 remained normal or showed resolution or reduction of benign hyperplasia in 47/117 (40.2%), while in group 2 benign hyperplasia either developed (previously normal), was stable or progressed in 70/117 (59.8%). The change in the MRI of EBV-DNA positive and EBV negative subjects was 21/73 (28.8%) and 26/44 (59.1%) respectively for group 1 and 52/73 (71.2%) and 18/44 (40.9%) respectively for group 2. Associations between the change in MRI (Group 1 vs Group 2) with plasma EBV-DNA results (remained positive vs became negative), change in age and smoking history are shown in Table 4.
