15334616.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15334616.value: Online learning algorithms are efficient for handling data with large and increasing size. In learning theory it is well understood that for algorithms to converge with real data that are noisy, regularization is necessary. In literature online regression and classification algorithms usually employ Tikhonov regularization. Some recent work on randomized Kaczmarz algorithms suggests that at least in finite dimensional space, Tikhonov regularization is not necessary, and a proper tuning on iteration step size leads possibly to faster convergence. In this project we focus on developing this analysis for online learning algorithms. The fundamental difficulty resides in the infinite dimension in learning settings. We will study the regularization of online learning algorithms via step-size control, and apply them to high dimensional data such as that in functional linear regression problems. 在線學習算法可以高效地處理規模巨大且不斷增長的數據。來自實際應用問題的數據包含噪音，處理時算法須要使用正則化之手段，這在學習理論中已經有充分的理解。文獻中，在線回歸和分類算法通常使用梯闊諾夫正則化方法。近來，一些關於隨機卡茨瑪茲算法的研究表明，至少在有窮維空間內，梯闊諾夫正則化方法並不是必須的，而經過正確調校迭代步長，收斂速度可能更快。在這個項目裡，我們會著重將這些分析方法發展到在線學習算法上。研究的本質難點在於學習算法通常都有無窮維空間的設定。我們會研究在線學習算法的步長控制正則化方法，並將發展起來的分析方法應用到高維數據分析上去，例如泛函線性回歸問題。

15334616.label: Realisation of objectives
15334616.value: The proposed project objectives have all been successfully achieved. In [1], we developed the convergence theory of randomized Kaczmarz algorithms in general real separable Hilbert spaces. Kaczmarz algorithms, and the randomized Kaczmarz algorithms were initially designed to solve large scale linear systems with reasonable time and memory complexity. In the literature, most research works on randomized Kaczmarz algorithm focus on Euclidean spaces, and typical error bounds decay exponentially as the number of iterations increases. However, the bases of most of the exponential error bounds are very close to one, and would converge to one as the condition number, or the dimension of the Euclidean space tends to infinity. So, these analyses do not generalize to Hilbert spaces. Also, there is a gap between the existing theory of exponential convergence, and the original mission of the randomized Kaczmarz algorithm to solve large-scale linear systems. In [1], we developed a polynomial rate of weak convergence of the randomized Kaczmarz algorithm in separable Hilbert spaces to fill the gap. Spectral analysis of operators on the space of Hilbert Schmidt operators is employed to obtain the convergence rate. The theory we developed has a straightforward yet significant application to high dimensional Euclidean spaces. By assuming the source condition of the target vector, our convergence rate is independent of the condition numbers of the linear systems. The strong assumption of positive lower bound of eigenvalues of the covariance matrix in the literature has been removed. The noise-free situation has been studied as an ideal scenario, and a neat convergence estimate with polynomial rate has been achieved. In the setting where the observations are contaminated by noise, the convergence rate is also derived. The obtained theory of Kaczmarz algorithms in Hilbert spaces has been extended to online stochastic gradient descent regression learning algorithms. Kernel-based online regression learning algorithms are studied. We derived polynomial convergence rates both in reproducing kernel Hilbert space metric and also in L2 metric. Our analysis significantly improved the state-of-the-art results in the literature, for example (Ying and Pontil 2008). We have also explored several applications of the ideas and methodologies developed in this project. In the conference proceeding (conference presentation item [5]) together with the journal paper [2], we studied a big data set of 119480 articles published by three mainstream Canadian newspapers (The Globe and Mail, The Toronto Star, and National Post) from January 1st 1977 to June 30th 2019. Eight topic modeling algorithms (latent semantic analysis, principal component analysis, factor analysis, non-negative matrix factorization, latent Dirichlet allocation, neural autoregressive topic model, neural variational document model, and hierarchical Dirichlet process) are compared on the big data set empirically. This research's main target is to provide reference on how the number of topics should be determined. These eight algorithms employ a wide range of modeling philosophies to leverage semantic information and attributes, and contribute to the methodological repertoire of topic modeling due to their shared purpose. The training of some algorithms (e.g., latent Dirichlet allocation), especially for large data set like the one we studied, is a typical online learning scheme application scenario. In [3], we studied the generalized linear regression problem with a special type of grouped and right-censored (GRC) data. Instead of typical integer-valued responses in classical generalized linear models, GRC responses are just indexes of groups (e.g., “0~3”, “4~6”, and “7+”). From the Monitoring the Future (MTF) project (which is the largest repeated cross-sectional survey on adolescent risky behaviors (e.g., drug use and juvenile delinquency) in the United States), we take a sample of size 2,768. We also generated artificial data set of size up to 10800. With these large sizes, the regression problem is a typical application scenario of learning with online stochastic gradient descent algorithms. In this work, we developed the methodology of deciding the best grouping scheme by comparing the Fisher information matrices. The best grouping scheme can be decided after a pilot study and before the formal sampling practice at a large scale. The paper [4] provides a holistic review and critical assessment of the overall methodological significance of the intrinsic estimator (IE) and related estimators in age-period-cohort (APC) analysis. The famous IE algorithm is designed to solve an over-determined linear system of equations by projecting the solution to the orthogonal complement of the null space of the APC design matrix. The collinearity of the linear system stems from the relation “period=age+cohort” in APC analysis. While it is computationally expensive to find the null space of the design matrix, the randomized Kaczmarz algorithm provides a good approximation of IE. This is because IE is the limit of the ridge regression estimator as the regularization parameter tends to zero. For data set of large size, such approximation is a significant trade-off between precision and computational complexity. The paper [5] investigates how marijuana use among adolescents in the U.S. varies by gender, racial group, age group, time period, and birth cohort from 1991 to 2018. We use hierarchical age-period-cohort (HAPC) logistic method and multiple structural breaks in time series test to analyze the marijuana use among 8th, 10th, and 12th graders from 28 waves of the Monitoring the Future survey (Monitoring the Future: A Continuing Study of the Lifestyle and Values of Youth (MTF), an ongoing national annual survey targeting school-aged adolescents in the United States since 1975), with a combined sample size of 1261667. The analysis of such a large data set by HAPC logistic regression model is a typical application scenario of the online stochastic gradient descent method. In the paper [5], we provide a few sociological observations from the analysis of data, for example, a clear age-related increase in the probability of marijuana use, a substantial increase of period effects over time, and the stable cohort effects over the period of study.

15334616.label: Major findings and research outcome
15334616.value: In [1], we analyzed three settings of randomized Kaczmarz algorithms, namely, constant step-size setting (RK-CS, free of noise, and Kaczmarz iterations are designed with constant step-size and indefinite number of iterations), finite-horizon setting (RK-FH, constant step-size but algorithm stops after a finite number of iterations), and online setting (RK-OL, with step-sizes decreasing as iterations proceed, and indefinite iterations). Unlike most works in the literature on Euclidean spaces, our analysis is on general separable Hilbert spaces. For setting RK-CS, we proved the polynomial rate of weak convergence. Consequently, we proved the strong convergence of the randomized Kaczmarz algorithm in Euclidean spaces with a rate independent of the condition number of the linear system or the dimension of the space. For setting RK-FH with observational noise, we proved polynomial rates of both strong and weak convergence of the randomized Kaczmarz algorithm in Hilbert spaces. As a consequence, kernel-based online stochastic gradient descent learning algorithm is analyzed, and polynomial convergence rate is derived in reproducing kernel space metric, which is arbitrarily close to the minimax optimal rate, and significantly improved the state-of-the-art results in the literature, for example (Ying and Pontil 2008); polynomial convergence rates are also derived in L2 metric. For setting RK-OL, polynomial rates of weak convergence are obtained. In [2] and the conference paper (conference presentation item 5), we compared eight topic modeling algorithms on a big data set of 119480 articles published by three mainstream Canadian newspapers and discussed algorithms to determine the number of topics. Some of the algorithms are typical application scenarios of online learning scheme for large data sets. In [3], we developed an algorithm to decide the optimal grouping scheme for GRC count data with generalized linear models (GLM). The parameter inference part of GLM with large-sized GRC data is a typical application scenario of the online stochastic gradient descent method. In [4], we provide a holistic review and critical assessment of the overall methodological significance of the intrinsic estimator (IE) and related estimators in age-period-cohort (APC) analysis. For large data sets, the randomized Kaczmarz algorithm provides a good approximation of IE through ridge regression. In [5], a large data set of size 1261667 is analyzed to study marijuana use, and some new patterns are identified. The HAPC logistic regression model is a typical application scenario of the online stochastic gradient descent method.

15334616.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
15334616.value: Strong convergence in the RK-CS setting could be explored in the future. The analysis of randomized Kaczmarz algorithm could be used to study natural gradient descent, and mirror descent algorithms in some types of Banach spaces, and therefore derive condition number-free convergence rate in Euclidean spaces. The new analysis we developed in this project could be extended to stochastic gradient descent algorithms for batch learning.

15334616.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
15334616.value: The randomized Kaczmarz (RK) algorithm is designed initially to solve linear system of equations by iterations. In each iteration, RK processes a randomly selected equation from the linear system. In this project, we study a generalized case of linear systems in infinitely dimensional Hilbert spaces, and link RK to online learning algorithms, which iteratively process data points and update the predicted function in each iteration after a new data point is processed. RK and online learning algorithms are analyzed mathematically. We also studied several algorithms of significant values in computational social science, where online learning algorithms can be adopted to reduce computational complexity.

15334816.label: Project Objectives
15334816.value: To investigate the individual and interactive effects of G238S, E104K and M182T point mutations on the structural and dynamic properties of TEM-type ESBLs.
rows: To investigate the individual and interactive effects of G238S, E104K and M182T point mutations on the structural and dynamic properties of TEM-type ESBLs.

15334816.label: Realisation of objectives
15334816.value: As proposed, the individual and interactive effects of three clinically important point mutations, including G238S, E104K and M182T, on the wild type β-lactamase TEM-1 were systematically investigated by hydrogen/deuterium exchange mass spectrometry (HDX-MS) in this project. Although the social incidents and pandemic in Hong Kong during the project period caused some delays in some of the experiments, the proposed objectives of this project have been fully achieved. 1. Study of changes in overall conformational dynamics of TEM-type β-lactamases upon mutations by global HDX-MS The wild type (WT) TEM-1, and five TEM-type extended spectrum β-lactamases (ESBLs), including TEM-19 (G238S), TEM-17 (E104K), TEM-15 (G238S/E104K), TEM-20 (G238S/M182T) and TEM-52 (G238S/E104K/M182T), were successfully produced and verified by SDS-PAGE and ESI-MS. Global HDX-MS showed that the G238S mutation caused significant increase in overall deuterium uptake, indicating increased flexibility, while the E104K mutation only induced minor change in the HDX behavior. Interestingly, the deuterium uptake for the double mutant G238S/E104K was significantly higher than that of the G238S single mutant, indicating that the combination of E104K and G238S mutations synergistically enhanced the flexibility of the protein. In correlation with the catalytic efficiency, which is G238S/E104K > G238S > WT, these observations implied that the enhancement in catalytic efficiency could be brought out by the increase in overall protein flexibility. In addition, we found that the deuterium uptake for the G238S/E104K/M182T triple mutant was lower than that of G238S/E104K, consistent with the proposed scenario that the M182T mutation could play a role in compensating the unfavorable structural and dynamic changes caused by the G238S and E104K mutations. 2. Study of changes in local conformational dynamics in TEM-type β-lactamases upon mutations by local HDX-MS To obtain further detailed conformational dynamics information, the HDX behaviors of different local regions of various mutants were also investigated. Our results interestingly showed that significant changes in HDX properties were found for some important regions, e.g., Ω-loop and its related regions (e.g., H5-H6 region), and connecting loops, upon the point mutations. Ω-loop (residues 163-169 and 170-179) Our results showed significant changes in the HDX behavior at the Ω-loop region upon the mutations, which is located at the entrance of the active site and directly involved in substrate hydrolysis. Both G238S and E104K mutations caused remarkable increase in HDX level and thus the flexibility to the Ω-loop, while the change observed for G238S was larger than that for E104K. Interestingly, the increase in HDX level was further more significant for the G238S/E104K double mutants compared to that for the G238S only, indicating that the combined G238S/E104K mutations synergistically enhanced the flexibility of this region. In contrast, the M182T mutation was generally shown to reduce the HDX level of the Ω-loop, revealing its stabilization effect to this region. These data indicated that the increase in flexibility of the Ω-loop could be an important factor for the enhanced catalytic efficiency of ESBLs. H5-H6 region (residues 140-150) This region closely interacts with the Ω-loop through several interactions (e.g., T149H5-H6 and L162Ω-loop). As similar to the Ω-loop, our results showed that both G238S and E104K mutations led to increase in HDX level and thus the flexibility, while the synergistic effect in enhancing the flexibility caused by the combination of these two mutations was also observed. Strikingly, we found that adding the M182T mutation to the G238S and G238S/E104K mutants caused significant reduction in deuterium uptake to a level even lower than that of the TEM-1 (WT), revealing the substantial stabilization effect of M182T to this region. Overall, we proposed that the H5-H6 region could affect catalytic properties by modulating the conformational dynamics of the Ω-loop. A loop connecting β-strand 2 and active site Helix 2 (residues 59-69) This loop, namely loop 1, connects β-strand 2 with Helix 2 region, which contains catalytically important residues such as active sites Ser70 and Lys73. From the local HDX-MS results, all mutants showed higher deuterium uptake than TEM-1, suggesting the higher flexibility of this loop in various mutants. Particularly, G238S caused greater flexibility enhancement when comparing with E104K and the combination of G238S and E104K mutations showed moderately higher HDX level than G238S. Introduction of M182T to G238S caused further flexibility enhancement, while this region became more compact when M182T was added to G238S/E104K. Other connecting loops between Helices/β-strands Significant increases in HDX uptake upon G238S and E104K mutations were also observed for other three connecting loops, namely loop 2 (connecting β-strand 1 and β-strand 2), loop 3 (connecting Helix 10 with β-strand 3), and loop 4 (connecting β-strand 4 and β-strand 5). The M182T mutation generally reduced the HDX level, indicating the stabilizing effect to these loops. In crystal structures, these loops are connective linkers between protein regions containing catalytically important residues. For example, loop 3 is connected with β-strand 3 containing Lys234 and loop 4 is connected with β-strand 4 harboring Arg244. β-strand 1 and β-strand 2 connected by loop 2 did not contain catalytically important residues, yet the plasticity of these regions could also assist the relief of steric hindrance. Overall, these results revealed that the changes in conformational dynamics of these connecting loops could allow more effective conformational adjustment for adapting and accommodating bulky third-generation cephalosporins, resulting in higher catalytic efficiency. 3. Study of conformational dynamics of cefotaxime-bound TEM-type ESBLs by global and local HDX-MS Global HDX-MS was performed by incorporating a deacylation-impaired mutation, E166A, to various β-lactamases in order to ensure the complete formation of complexes with cefotaxime, a third-generation cephalosporin. Our global HDX-MS results showed that the HDX level generally decreased for all proteins upon the substrate binding and the HDX levels of all the complexes were similar, except that the complex form of E104K mutant displayed lower HDX level than the other four. These data revealed that different β-lactamases were stabilized to a similar extent upon the substrate binding, while the stabilization effect was particularly significant for the E104K mutant. The HDX levels of most local regions were found to significantly decrease upon the substrate binding, yet some local regions showed different HDX behaviors compared with other regions. For example, the deuterium uptake and thus the flexibility of the Ω-loop in substrate-bound G238S and G238S/E104K was lower than those in other complexes. In contrast, the flexibility of the H5-H6 region, which closely interacts with the Ω-loop, in substrate-bound G238S and G238S/E104K was higher than that in the other four β-lactamases. These data suggested that the H5-H6 region might become more flexible in order to compensate the reduced flexibility of the Ω-loop, further supporting the role of the H5-H6 region in modulating the conformational dynamics of the Ω-loop.

15334816.label: Major findings and research outcome
15334816.value: This study provided detailed experimental information on the individual and interactive effects of various point mutations, including G238S, E104K and M182T, on the conformational dynamics of TEM-ESBLs, which remained poorly understood. The new findings obtained here allowed better understanding on the antibiotic-resistant mechanism of ESBLs and provided insights to the design of more effective antibiotics and inhibitors. Both the G238S and E104K mutations were found to enhance the overall flexibility of the enzyme, and the combination of these two mutations in the G238S/E104K double mutant, which exhibited higher catalytic efficiency than the single mutants, further increased the protein flexibility in a synergistic manner. These data revealed that enhancement in overall flexibility could relieve the steric hindrance resulted from bulky third-generation cephalosporins, leading to better accommodation of the antibiotic substrates and subsequent enhancement in catalytic efficiency. In addition, incorporation of the M182T to G238S/E104K mutant (M182T/G238S/E104K) reduced the overall flexibility of the protein, suggesting that M182T could compensate unfavorable conformational dynamic changes caused by the G238S and E104K mutations. Our local HDX-MS results for the first time showed that both the G238S and E104K mutations enhanced the flexibility of the catalytically important Ω-loop and the combined G238S/E104K mutations further enhanced the flexibility of this region. In contrast, the M182T mutation was generally shown to reduce the HDX level of the Ω-loop, revealing the stabilization effect to this region. As Ω-loop is a part of the active site pocket and directly participates in the substrate hydrolysis, the enhancement in flexibility of this region could facilitate bulky substrate accommodation and the hydrolysis process. We also for the first time found that the H5-H6 region might influence catalytic efficient by modulating the conformational dynamics of the Ω-loop. Particularly, we for the first time found that the G238S and E104K mutation led to increase in flexibility for some loops connecting catalytically important regions, such as the helix containing the active site Ser70. The enhanced flexibility of these connecting loops could allow more effective adjustment in conformational dynamics of their connecting regions, allowing the enzyme to effectively adapt different bulky substrates and hydrolyze them more efficiently.

15334816.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
15334816.value: To further understand the antibiotic-resistant mechanism of TEM-type ESBLs, a detailed kinetic study could be performed to determine the kinetic parameter of each individual step of the enzymatic reaction, including the dissociation constant (Kd), acylation constant (k2) and deacylation constant (k3). The kinetic results could be correlated with the HDX-MS data, from which the effects of conformational dynamics on each individual reaction step could be figured out. In addition, molecular dynamics (MD) simulation could be carried out to acquire complementary protein dynamics information, which can further support the scenarios proposed in this HDX- MS study. Furthermore, in collaboration with researchers in drug discovery, attempts could be made to design new antibiotics based on the findings obtained in this study. For example, it is possible to design drugs having interactions with various connecting loops, such that these loops could be stabilized and therefore the enzyme might be less proficient to adapt bulky antibiotic molecules through conformational adjustment.

15334816.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
15334816.value: TEM-type extended spectrum β-lactamases (ESBLs) with G238S, E104K and M182T mutations, which exhibited enhanced catalytic efficiency towards third-generation cephalosporins, are commonly found in clinics. Understanding the antibiotic-resistant mechanism is crucial for design of new antibiotics and inhibitors towards these enzymes. In this study, hydrogen/deuterium exchange mass spectrometry was employed to investigate the effects of these mutations on the conformational dynamics of the protein, which remained poorly understood. Our results showed that the G238S and E104K mutations caused increased global flexibility of the protein, which could relieve the steric hindrance resulted from bulky third-generation cephalosporins and allow better accommodation of these antibiotic substrates. In contrast, the M182T mutation reduced the overall flexibility of the protein, revealing that it might compensate unfavorable structural and dynamic changes resulted from the point mutations. Furthermore, we found that G238S, E104K and M182T exerted similar effects on the conformational dynamics of various local protein regions, including the catalytically important Ω-loop and some loops connecting different important regions. These results indicated that the conformational dynamics changes caused by the mutations could allow the enzyme to adapt and hydrolyze bulky substrates more effectively, providing new insights for development of more effective antibiotics and inhibitors.

15336716.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15336716.value: 在物質和藥學化合物合成，催化交叉偶聯過程已成為最直接和廣泛使用的化學結構組裝。事實上，這些方法已經徹底改變了化學家方式來執行複雜的有機合成。在這些合成技術的中心，催化劑的開發，允許選擇性鍵的裂解/建造使用相對不反應，但豐富的原料性質的部件將是非常有吸引力的。因此，催化劑的勘探和開發，是有機合成催化研究創新的中央。 通過高度部位選擇性地碳 - 氫鍵的直接芳基化一直是一個長期的挑戰和合成問題。事實上，某些區域選擇性官能化過程中可能會經歷不希望的多步合成。為了滿足通過直接與本站選擇性C-H功能化途徑簡單化學合成的需要，我們的目標是設計可調的配體/催化劑，將允許鍵形成。從催化劑發展的過程中和特異性交叉偶聯反應的基本原理獲得將是學術興趣知識和潛在的工業應用顯著價值。 芳香鍵施工方法，新的發展將推動當前的耦合過程，並向前發展催化研究。這個項目的目的是：(1) 合理設計，並通過一個淺顯的方式探索可調配體家族的新成員; （2）以調查困難立體擁擠偶聯過程; （3）建立高度挑戰性的選擇合併的配體啟用方法，並研究這些新配體的基本方面; （4），以研究對映方式空間位阻偶聯反應。 該項目預計將探索交叉偶聯反應的新領域。擬議進行的研究是基於我們以前在配體/催化劑的設計與合成的成功，以及我們在芳香債券建設的研究豐富的經驗。這些新的領域將為我們提供在作出了重大的進步，可以幫助我們在香港建立了精細化工產業奠定了基礎。

15336716.label: Realisation of objectives
15336716.value: This is the completion report of the funding GRF15336716 (16P) We commenced this project in January 2017. The PI relocated the laboratory from The Hong Kong Polytechnic University to The Chinese University of Hong Kong in March 2017. The funding transfer between universities needed time. The PI had spent time and tried his best in setting up the laboratory in the new location, even though the tendering process of instruments, e.g. GC/GC-MS required certain time. In the mid-term report, we had delivered three publications. At the late stage of this project in 2019, CUHK encountered a serious social unrest and the project progress was slightly delayed. Nevertheless, we delivered two other papers in Angewandte Chemie International Editions. The below are the details with respect to our accomplishments. In the early stage of this investigation, we had developed and explored a new family of heterocyclic phosphine ligands for palladium-catalyzed cross-coupling and relevant reactions. Particular ligands with appropriate geometry displayed exceptionally good activity in the coupling reactions. In these trials, we examined some of the ligands with respect to commercial sources in the cascade amination and site-selective acetone monoarylation under palladium/norbornene/ligand cooperative catalysis. This research contribution was published in August 2017 in Organic Letters. (Org. Lett. 2017, 19, 4335). In addition to the above investigations, we spent effort in exploring the site-selective (regioselective) synthesis of polycyclic aromatic compounds using aromatic pi-extension C-H bond arylation strategy. Steric hindered aromatic-extended arene structures as well as heteroatom-incorporated scaffolds were easily achieved from this versatile method. It should be noted that the heptagon-embedded skeletons were able to be accessed using this new modular approach. These results of this site-selective C-H bond arylation process was published in 2017 in Angewandte Chemie. (Angew. Chem. Int. Ed. 2017, 56, 7166). Given our published work done on regioselective C-H arylations, we were invited to contribute a review article in the area of palladium-catalyzed non-directed C-H bond arylation process. This article was published in Organic Chemistry Frontiers. (Org. Chem. Front. 2018, 5, 288). In continuing our previous success in Pd-catalyzed cross-coupling and site-selective C-H bond arylation in ACIE 2017, we further investigated the regioselective aromatic pi-extension of internal alkynes using a norbornene-controlled reaction sequence. With particular Pd/phosphine complex, the three-component cross-coupling/C-H arylation sequence proceeded well to generate a series of materially useful pi-extended scaffolds. Some of the sterically congested structures were able to be afforded and showed a non-planar aromatic geometry. These interesting results were published 2018 in Angewandte Chemie. (Angew. Chem. Int. Ed. 2018, 57, 3381). During the research project period, we had developed a series of pro-chiral mono-phosphine ligands. By installing the chiral auxiliary to the ligand scaffold, we were able to get the diastereomeric complexes. We spent a long period of time in surveying suitable solvent mixtures for delivering high d.r. of the corresponding diastereomers. We also performed preparative chiral HPLC in getting the chiral ligand and assigned their stereo-configuration using single X-ray crystallography. We subjected these chiral ligand series in enantioselective Suzuki-Miyaura cross-coupling reactions (tri-ortho-substituted biaryl synthesis). Nevertheless, the enantioselectivity of the desired biaryl products were found to be 10-20% ee. With our ground work of Pd/phosphine complex in promoting sequential C-H bond arylation and cross-coupling reactions, we also surveyed other inexpensive transition metal catalysts for this reaction. We delightfully found the Co complexes were able to show excellent site-selectivity in tandem C-H activation/C-C bond cleavage/C-H bond cyclization process. A series of commonly available aromatic amides were able to react with alkylidenecyclopropanes. The desired products also showed versatile structures. These research contributions were published in 2018 in Angewandte Chemie. (Angew. Chem. Int. Ed. 2018, 57, 6512). Regarding to this accomplishment, we were invited by the Editor-in-Chief for contributing a Cover Art of this ACIE paper.

The new Co-complex was able to show interesting activity in facilitating tandem C-H bond activation/C-C bond cleavage/C-H bond cyclization reaction. This achievement has been published in Angewandte Chemie. (Angew. Chem. Int. Ed. 2018, 57, 6512). 15510716.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15510716.value: Understanding how residents view and interact with tourists is one of the most important topics in the tourism literature. This issue is powerful and worthy of serious study because tourists’ experiences and satisfaction at a destination are largely determined by the treatment from local residents. Further, residents’ attitudes toward tourists may shape their attitudes toward tourism overall. For example, the quality of tourist-host interaction in Hong Kong (HK) has been shown to relate more to residents’ perceptions of tourists than attitudes toward tourism development in general. Negative emotional and behavioral responses to tourists by residents could damage the immediate and long terms interaction between these two parties. These negative responses are usually caused by negative stereotypes. Thus, this study will examine the triggers, content, and consequences of tourist stereotypes, with a specific interest in the characteristics of Mainland Chinese (MC) outbound tourists due to the importance of this market to many destinations worldwide. With an understanding of how residents view tourists and of the triggers to their stereotypes, resolutions to problems brought by stereotypes could be developed. This research is guided by the framework of Triggers, Content, Model (building a theoretical understanding) and Resolutions. The research team will take a multidisciplinary, mixed-method approach by incorporating concepts and methods applied in the fields of tourism, social psychology, anthropology, and consumer behavior. A tourist stereotype model, integrating the existing attribution theory and stereotype content models, is proposed to show the causal relationship among triggers (e.g., media reporting), content, and emotional (e.g., anger or gratitude) and behavioral (e.g., discrimination) consequences of stereotypes. To empirically test the model, a rigorous five-phase research plan is developed. Besides a comprehensive literature review, triggers will be examined by video vignettes and explored in in-depth interviews. Twelve 2-minute-long video vignettes will be developed to elicit residents’ views of MC tourists from two contrasting cities, HK and Sydney, of which MC tourists represented 78% of arrivals and 13% of international arrivals in 2014, respectively. Different tourist characteristics (e.g., gender, age, and travel mode-independent vs. group) and settings (e.g., subway, theme park, hotel, and shop) will be used to represent common tourist-resident interaction opportunities. Focus groups of residents, expert interviews, and a resident survey in HK and Sydney will also be conducted. In developing a tourist stereotype model, this study attempts to make a theoretical breakthrough in tourist-host interaction research, and promises new strategies for understanding and managing tourist stereotypes. 目的地居民如何看待外來遊客、以及如何與遊客互動長期以來一直是旅遊研究中最重要的課題之一。 這個課題之所以長盛不衰、並值得更認真的深入研究，是因為遊客在旅遊目的地的體驗和滿意度在很大程度上是由當地居民對他們的接待品質決定的。 另外，居民對遊客的印象也會影響到他們對本地旅遊發展的整體印象和態度。 例如，在香港，當地居民和遊客的關係品質更主要地是影響了居民對某一外來遊客群體的看法、而非對香港旅遊整體發展的看法。 居民對遊客表現出來的、無論是態度上還是行為上的消極反應都可能會損害這兩個群體之間短期和長期的關係。 而居民對遊客的消極反應通常也源于一些負面的刻板印象。 因此，本研究將以中國大陸出境遊客為調查物件，探求遊客刻板印象形成的誘因、內容以及造成的後果。 隨著近年來中國大陸出境遊客的迅速增長以及這一客源市場對越來越多的國際目的地的重要性不斷提升，如果能夠探明大陸遊客在不同目的地居民心目中的刻板印象如何、並挖掘出造成這些刻板印象的深層原因，那麼找到解決那些由刻板印象引起的各種問題的辦法也就指日可待了。 本研究將在「誘因 —— 內容——模型 —— 解決方案」這樣一個框架的指導下進行。 課題小組會採取多學科的混合研究方法，將旅遊學、社會心理學、人類學和消費行為等研究領域裡的一些概念和方法綜合利用起來。 通過整合現有的歸因理論和刻板印象內容模型，本研究將建立一個「遊客刻板印象模型」，綜合展現誘因（如媒體報導），刻板印象的內容、以及相應的情緒（如憤怒或感激）和行為（如歧視）反應之間的因果關係。 為了對該理論模型進行實證檢驗，課題組設計了一個包含五個步驟的嚴密的研究計畫。 首先，基於全面的文獻回顧，遊客刻板印象的誘因將通過視頻情境實驗法和深度訪談法進行探究。 十二段經過精心設計和專業拍攝的情境視頻（每段長約2分鐘）將被用來引導被試者對中國大陸遊客印象的討論。 在設計情境視頻時，課題組將考慮到不同遊客的特點（例如，性別、年齡、出行方式——自由行或跟團游），並儘量囊括常見的遊客-居民互動發生的地點和場合（例如，地鐵、主題公園、酒店和商場）。 被試者將從香港和悉尼這兩個截然不同的目的地的永久居民中進行挑選。 截止2014年，大陸遊客已佔據訪港總人數的78% ，澳大利亞國際遊客總數的13%。 此外，居民焦點小組、專家訪談、以及居民問卷調查，也將一一在兩地展開、繼續探討兩地居民對大陸遊客刻板印象的維度和各種情緒及行為反應。 總之，本研究通過建立並驗證「遊客刻板印象模型」，力爭對遊客-居民互動研究做出理論上的突破，並承諾對不良遊客刻板印象提出新的管理原則。

15510716.label: Realisation of objectives
15510716.value: All research objectives have been achieved. A comprehensive review of literature was conducted in sociopsychology, sociology, anthropology, marketing, and tourism studies. To produce authentic and valid video vignettes used in formal data collection, 20 preliminary in-depth interviews were conducted with Hong Kong permanent residents to collect personal stories about encounters with Mainland Chinese tourists (MCTs). Scenarios were designed based on the 57 stories provided by the informants, and scripts were created for video filming. Ten self-script videos were produced, repeatedly tested of their authenticity and effectiveness, and used in the formal interviews. A total of 32 video-vignette induced interviews was conducted and each video received 9 views. The interview results revealed (1) six types of triggers (i.e., appearance, language/accent/voice, age, travel style, manners/attitude, behaviors) of tourist stereotypes, (2) attributes and descriptors (i.e., content of stereotypes) that residents used to stereotype various groups of tourists who visit Hong Kong, and (3) respondents’ emotional and behavioral responses to the tourist-host interaction scenarios by linking their own previous experiences. Results show that Hong Kong residents’ attribution efforts have significantly weakened their previously held negative stereotypes toward MCTs before watching the videos, because the attribution task gave them an opportunity to explain MCTs’ behaviors from new and multiple perspectives. Thus, attributional inferences stimulated by stereotype-disconfirmation or suppression could challenge existing stereotypes and help mitigate tourist stereotypes. To further validate the attributes of tourist stereotypes used by residents to evaluate MCTs and to elicit more generalizable dimensions of tourist stereotypes content, an online survey was completed among Hong Kong permanent residents, representing the local population in terms of age, gender, education level, monthly household income, and residential area. Their evaluation of the provided 14 tourist groups (nationality x age x travel style) and interpretation of the perceived similarities reflected three major dimensions of tourist stereotypes content - civility, travel behavior, and economic power. The proposed structural model and measurement of tourist stereotype content found evidence with data collected from the current study. In addition to video-vignette induced interview-based research in identifying triggers, content, and consequences of tourist stereotypes, we also conducted innovative analyses of respondents’ emotional responses to the stereotyped tourists while watching the self-script videos by comparing emotions measured by facial expressions and self-reports. The analyses revealed that residents’ implicit emotional responses to the stereotyped tourists are more positive than stereotypes-elicited emotions, thus providing new opportunities to suggest resolutions to tourist stereotype induced problems to improve tourist-host relationship. The study findings could inform the development of public policies and communication strategies. Different from previous studies that revealed mainly negative stereotypes of Hong Kong residents towards Mainland Chinese tourists, this study identified the coexistence of negative stereotypes and positive expectations in the mind of Hong Kong residents. Unfavorable tourist stereotypes held by local communities must be seriously considered since they likely manipulate hosts’ attributions of encounters with any member of the stereotyped tourist group. Educating the public should also be treated as an effective measure to deal with tourist-host conflicts. Attribution intervention or reattribution training has been documented as capable of arousing attitudinal and behavioral changes. The Hong Kong Tourism Board/Commission and local media should promote a better image of Mainland tourists to gradually modify local residents’ negative stereotypes and reduce stereotypes-elicited emotions. For tourists, aside from using facial expressions as a main channel to understand hosts’ emotional responses, more attention needs to be paid to residents’ verbal expressions. Comprehending each other’s emotional responses from multiple channels is necessary for a friendly inter-personal/group relationship. Mainland tourists could also improve their behaviours in Hong Kong by respecting local rules and customs, to meet local residents’ expectations and foster desires-derived emotions to benefit mutual relations.

15510716.label: Major findings and research outcome
15510716.value: Video-vignettes induced interviews and a repertory grid test collected a wealth of qualitative and quantitative data. In-depth analyses have yielded many interesting findings beyond our expectations which will help us compose more research articles than originally planned. As a result, it took longer than planned for the team to strategize publication plans. The paper, “Creating Quality Video Vignettes: Protocol and Indicators,” under review by Annals of Tourism Research (A+ journal), documented a four-step procedure of producing good-quality video vignettes and a series of quality indicators were developed and tested to assess the credibility and validity of the ten self-script video vignettes. Interview results are discussed in a paper under preparation by employing/enhancing a conceptual framework previously published by the research team. Findings clarified the role of stereotypes in residents’ judgement of tourists from various source markets, and the caused emotional and behavioral responses. The paper is aimed for submission to Journal of Hospitality and Tourism Research (A journal) by October 2020. To elicit attributes and dimensions of tourist stereotype content generalizable to any tourist groups, an online survey was conducted. Findings not only confirmed the triggers of tourist stereotypes obtained from video-induced interviews, but also revealed three dimensions of tourist stereotypes that residents used to describe or evaluate any tourist groups – civility, travel behavior, and economic power. Details are discussed in a paper under preparation for submission to Journal of Travel Research (A+ journal) with a target date of August 2020. Additionally, two research papers were drafted based on the analysis of 10 video vignettes and the facial expression of the viewers. One paper (titled “Facial Expressions versus Words: Unlocking Complex Emotional Responses of Residents towards Tourists”) is under review by Tourism Management (A+ journal), which employs sophisticated facial expression recognition technique (i.e., FaceReader) to deepen understanding of residents’ emotional responses towards tourists expressed implicitly. A dual-process model of emotion formation was proposed to interpret the emotion expressive discrepancies and enhance the theorization of tourism studies on emotion. The second paper, which will be submitted to Annals of Tourism Research by July 2020, examines relationships between emotional responses of residents (interviewees) and tourists (actors in the videos) based on multi-modal analysis (i.e., voice, facial expression, and words). One additional journal manuscript will be prepared based on quantitative data analysis to report the testing of the tourist stereotype model, with antecedents and consequences, to identify the nomological network of tourist stereotypes.

15510716.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
15510716.value: The tourist stereotype content model could be further validated in the context of residents from other countries. Moreover, the research team is interested in expanding the current project to a series of studies on mutual stereotyping between tourists and residents. For example, the ten self-script video vignettes which costed us a lot of human and financial resources can be reapplied to examine the stereotyped tourists’ (i.e., MCTs’) views and responses, which is related to meta-stereotypes. They can also be shown to other host communities whose dominant source market comprises MCTs to explore potentially different perceptions or judgements, especially in a cross-cultural context. Additionally, longitudinal research can be conducted to track changes in tourist stereotypes. Monitoring stereotype change may provide Destination Management Organizations and travel operators with timely and prospective suggestions on destination promotion and tourist experience design. It is also anticipated that several subsequent publications will be prepared in the next two years as the project collected a wealth of data yet to be fully explored within the project period. The research team will prepare a follow-up study proposal for funding from GRF, and possibly from the Public Policy Research Funding Scheme.

15510716.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
15510716.value: Stereotyping tourists is a common practice by local residents to deal with large numbers of culturally different tourists who remain only a short time at the destination. This study investigated Hong Kong residents’ stereotypes of tourists through a variety of research methods. Six types of triggers (appearance, language/accent/voice, age, travel style, manners/attitude, behaviors) and three general content dimensions (civility, travel behavior, and economic power) of tourist stereotypes were identified. Residents’ emotional responses to a negatively stereotyped group of tourists (i.e., Mainland Chinese tourists) were examined via different formats of emotion expression (verbal and facial expression). Residents expressed emotional reactions to stereotyped tourists implicitly and explicitly, and the emotional codes hidden in their facial expressions and voices were not usually expressed explicitly in words. The study can provide stakeholders with promising opportunities to improve host-guest relationship and travel experience. Residents should be reminded to recognize an inner desire for a positive/sustainable relationship with tourists and reflect on the stereotypes they hold towards tourists, thereby treating tourists with a more tolerant and unbiased manner. Tourists need to be aware of their hosts’ stereotypes and emotions to reduce the effects of stereotype threat whereby improving their own travel experiences at destinations.

15513016.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
15513016.value: In this project, we examined why and how various types of off-job experiences in the evening have differential effects on employees' daily proactive behavior during the subsequent workday. It is very interesting to note that off-job mastery in the evening related positively to next-morning high-activated positive affect and role breadth self-efficacy, off-job agency in the evening related positively to next-morning role breadth self-efficacy and desire for control, and off-job hassles in the evening related negatively to next-morning high-activated positive affect; next-morning high-activated positive affect, role breadth self-efficacy, and desire for control, in turn, predicted next-day proactive behavior. Off-job relaxation in the evening related positively to next-morning low-activated positive affect, and off-job detachment in the evening had a decreasingly positive curvilinear relationship with next-morning low-activated positive affect. However, as expected, these two types of off-job experiences and low-activated positive affect did not relate to next-day proactive behavior.

15522516.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15522516.value: The triple bottom line has been popular with the notion that corporate development must consider three key goals – economic, social and environmental improvement. Beyond a conventional notion of economic goal in a corporation, the corporate personhood underlies the fundamental idea of this study, which posits that a corporation has moral responsibilities toward society and the environment as a person. Thus, corporations have the ability to decide the degree to which they can commit to enhancing social and environmental welfare. Ha-Brookshire (2015) proposed Moral Responsibility Theory of Corporate Sustainability (MRCS). This theory explains that when a corporation regards sustainability as a perfect duty, its activities would be more strictly regulated and planned toward supporting sustainability all the time in all situations. By contrast, when a corporation views sustainability as an imperfect duty which is discretionary, its activities toward sustainability will vary from time to time. Especially, if the sustainability-related decisions undermine its profit, the corporation would be hesitant to give priority to sustainability, resulting in corporate hypocrisy amongst employees. This study focuses on consumer’s responses to hypocritical companies in the marketplace with three research questions: (1) what the views of consumers are toward corporate sustainability, (2) whether consumers perceive hypocrisy from a mismatch between a corporation’s mission and its sustainability-related activities, and (3) what the consequences of consumers’ perceptions of corporate hypocrisy are. In order to answer to the first research question, an inventory of a specific corporation’s sustainable activities will be developed via content analysis of various corporate sustainability reports. The inventory items will be also surveyed by consumers in Hong Kong and the U.S. to examine and compare consumers’ perceived level of corporations’ sustainability activity within the morality spectrum between perfect and imperfect duties. The second and third research questions will be answered by an online experimental study. With 2 (corporation mission: perfect vs imperfect duties) X 2 (sustainability activity: perfect vs imperfect duties) scenarios, this study will recruit participants from Hong Kong and the U.S. The findings would provide insights into the potential differences and similarities of consumers’ views on corporate sustainability between Hong Kong and the U.S. More broadly, the outcome of this research will highlight the consequences for corporations that may consider sustainability as a discretionary responsibility. Consequently, the study urges corporations, governments, and consumers to consider sustainability as an absolute responsibility that all have to bear at any time in all circumstances. 本研究聚焦于消费者对于伪善型公司所做出的市场反应，着重于探讨三个研究问题：（1）消费者对于企业的可持续发展持什么样的观点；（2）在企业的使命与它进行的可持续发展相关活动之间存在不匹配时，消费者是否会从中感知到伪善；（3）消费者对企业伪善的知觉会导致什么样的结果。 研究的发现将会带来深刻的洞见，有助于人们理解香港与美国消费者对企业可持续发展所持观点上潜在的差异与相似之处。在更广泛的意义上，本研究的结果将会对那些视可持续发展的责任为儿戏的企业予以警示。基于此，研究敦促企业、政府及消费者要将可持续发展视为一种至上的责任，在任何时间与情况下都应加以承担。

15522516.label: Realisation of objectives
15522516.value: Our research team developed an inventory of moral responsibility in corporations to achieve the research objective. Specifically, we conducted surveys to US consumers and HK consumers concurrently, and found common types of moral responsibility in US and HK data, respectively. To further confirm the commonality, we compared other country data with US and HK data (note that other county data collection was not supported by this grant). However, for the cultural comparison statistically, equivalence between HK and US samples was not supported, meaning that we cannot directly compare findings between countries. Thus, we could not completely achieve this research objective, limiting understanding of the cultural influence on findings (Refer to Cross-cultural comparison of the MRCS model from perfect duty to imperfect duty). Therefore, we may need another sets of surveys to confirm a statistical equivalence between two country samples. As the survey has been already built up, we can simply repeat the data collection procedure. So, for this, we may need a month to complete it. In order to find consumers’ perceived hypocrisy level from the mismatch conditions, we conducted a number of pre-tests and refined stimuli. These procedures have taken almost 1.5 years, which was longer than our initial expectation. It was easy to conceptualize mismatch between corporate mission and activities, but in reality, the manipulation could not lead to hypocrisy feeling in consumers’ mind even in the negative incongruence condition (perfect mission – imperfect activity). This might be because we created a virtual corporation, so respondents might not fully immerse into the virtual scenarios. After refining the experimental stimuli multiple times, now our research team is collecting main survey data in the US. It may take few more weeks for data analysis. However, the research team confirm that the manipulations were successful with the data again. Thus, we collect HK data and for the cross-cultural comparison, an equivalence test were confirmed. We confirmed negative consequences of corporate hypocrisy, and the result was developed as a conference proceeding (Refer to What to say and what to do: Determinants of corporate hypocrisy and its negative consequence for customer retention intentions). This finding will be presented in Nov 2019. As mentioned above, we could not find measurement equivalence between US data and HK data as a result of the first round main survey, and thus we could not find cultural differences yet. However, we very positively expect to compare the model after we collect data from the second round main survey.

15522516.label: Major findings and research outcome
15522516.value: This project provided empirical evidence for how and what extent of corporate hypocrisy is formed by varying apparel companies’ sustainability mission statements and sustainability-related activities, which is one of the critical contributions of the project to the literature. Particularly, employing a concept of perfect and imperfect duty activities related to corporate sustainability, we showed a number of types of the mission statement-activity relationships and consequent differential extents of corporate hypocrisy that consumers might form against the apparel companies. Overall, the respondents who saw the clear sustainability goals in the apparel company’s mission statements had the lower level of corporate hypocrisy than those who did not see. When the mission statement and their activities related to corporate sustainability are matching (i.e., what they say and what they do match) were less likely to elicit corporate hypocrisy, such that when the apparel company did not claim sustainability as a mission and showed no sustainability-related activities, the respondents showed the lowest level of corporate hypocrisy out of the ‘no-sustainability mission’ conditions. That is, if an apparel company does not seek and communicate the sustainability goals explicitly, no matter what they do toward sustainability, consumers may view that as hypocrite. This level of corporate hypocrisy was even higher than those of negative mismatch conditions in which the companies’ sustainability activities did not fully meet their sustainability stated goal. The result revealed irrespective of activity types, when an apparel firm did not mention its sustainability goal clearly in the mission statement, a greater level of corporate hypocrisy was triggered than those in sustainability mission condition. Hence, despite negative mismatch in which actual activity may underperform the company’s sustainability stated goals, the respondents might evaluate it more positive, implying that it is critical to show an apparel firm’s willingness to achieve sustainability at least through its mission. This study empirically examined negative consequences of corporate hypocrisy regarding trust and customer retention. Based on commitment-trust theory, we theorized distrust as a full mediator in this relationship, and found that corporate hypocrisy increased consumers’’ switch intention and decreased their resilience intention indirectly through distrust. These findings urge apparel company managers to recognise the ripple effect on customer retention created by a mismatching relationship between their stated sustainability goals and their activities. Inappropriate messages and activities toward sustainability could lead to corporate hypocrisy, which in turn could increase distrust and customer retention intentions.

15522516.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
15522516.value: This project laid a new foundation for future sustainability research in the consumer behavior literature by showing consumers’ perspectives of corporate sustainability from the moral responsibility perspective, distrust toward companies which neglect and/or less pay attention to sustainability, and the impact of distrust on consumers’ retention intention. These findings served as a good starting point to consider potential determinants and consequences of corporate hypocrisy from the consumers’ perspectives. A number of potential extensions would provide guidance for valuable future studies. First, this study focused on apparel companies in which the company’s mission and activities were manipulated. However, consumers’ expectations to perfect duty sustainability activities may differ by industry. In this experiment, working condition support was used as a perfect duty sustainability activity, while transparency support was treated as an imperfect duty sustainability activity following Jung and Ha-Brookshire’s (2017) findings. Considering that the apparel industry is labor intensive (Kunz, Karpova & Garner, 2016), it might be reasonable that consumers expected that apparel companies must provide good working condition to employees as the companies’ fundamental responsibility. Although transparency support was regarded as an imperfect duty sustainability activity in this study, it could be more heavily emphasised for apparel companies which sell food products because clear information and transparent souring processes of the food products would impact consumers’ health and safety issues directly (Moreau, 2016).

15522516.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
15522516.value: When a firm claims to be something that it is not, consumers perceive the firm to be hypocritical, which often leads to negative attitudes and beliefs toward the firm and its activities. This project provided empirical evidence for how and what extent of corporate hypocrisy is formed by varying apparel companies’ sustainability mission statements and sustainability-related activities. We manipulated a number of types of the mission statement-activity relationships and consequent differential extents of corporate hypocrisy that consumers might form against the apparel companies. The result showed that the respondents who saw the clear sustainability goals in the apparel company’s mission statements had the lower level of corporate hypocrisy than those who did not. Moreover, when the mission statement and their activities related to corporate sustainability are matching were less likely to elicit corporate hypocrisy. This study also found that corporate hypocrisy increased distrust and thus jeopardizing customer retention. These findings urge apparel company managers to recognize the ripple effect on customer retention created by a mismatching relationship between their stated sustainability goals and their activities. Also, it may provide management with a guideline to formulate and communicate companies’ sustainability goals and activities.

15522616.value: 流程制度化何時影響組織創新性：知識吸收，IT能力以及企業聯盟的作用

15522616.label: Project Objectives
15522616.value: To empirically examine the impact of process-based quality techniques such as ISO 9000 on organizational innovativeness using longitudinal, panel data from the US manufacturing industry To study how the negative impact of process management techniques (using process certifications such as ISO 9000 as a proxy) on organizational innovativeness, if any, is likely to be reduced, or reversed, through the simultaneous attempt to build knowledge exploration capacity and enhance information capability in organizational settings. To examine, by constructing Dynamic Panel Data (DPD) Models, the interactive effects between process-based quality certifications such as ISO 9000 and i) knowledge absorptive capacity (R&D intensity as proxy); ii) IT capability (annual assessments by InformationWeek); and iii) knowledge inflow through partner alliances, acquisitions, and mergers (annual data from SDC). We speculate that the interaction between process management techniques and the dual structure that promotes proactive knowledge exploration is likely to reverse the process management systems’ negative impact on organizational innovativeness (i.e., leading to a dynamic capacity).

15522616.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15522616.value: 流程管理系統如 ISO9000 在組織層面的影響越來越充滿爭議。 爭議的來源在於，流程管理實踐往往以犧牲組織創新性為代價來 降低變異，提高效率。流程管理的準則和技術，就其本質和目的 而言，在於開發一套標準化的“最佳實踐”，這將導致流程制度化 和組織慣性。總體而言，流程管理體系強調利用組織現有的知識 和技能，精簡當前流程，保留最有效率的實踐活動。另一方面而 言，運營管理領域最新的研究強調同時建立利用型和探索型組織 學習的“雙元組織結構”的重要性，創建一個可以同時追求效率提 升和問題探索的企業環境。這使運營管理的學者和實踐者陷入了 困境：怎樣實現滿足這兩種對立目標的組織設計？ 本項目基於美國製造業的數據，旨在研究流程管理技術（用基於 流程的質量認證如 ISO9000 來測量）對組織創新性（用財富排名 來測量）的影響。我們將研究流程管理對創新性的作用如何被另 外一種以提高變異，尋求知識和探索問題為目的的組織結構所影 響。

15522616.label: Realisation of objectives
15522616.value: There are three major objectives of this research project. We have two papers related to this project, which have been accepted at Production and Operations Management (POM) and International Journal of Productivity and Quality Management (IJPQM). We have fully achieved all the three objectives. We directly examined the impact of ISO 9000 on organizational innovativeness using panel data from the US manufacturing industry. We maintain our original ideas by developing a model to examine interactive effects between process management techniques and some potential factors, aiming to understand how to reduce/enhance the process management techniques' negative/positive impact on organizational innovativeness. Following many valuable suggestions from different parties, we focused on various organisational and environmental factors, including i) operational slack, ii) recession period, and iii) market fluctuation in our IJPQM paper. In addition, we studied the interactive effects between R&D investment and process-based quality techniques (i.e., ISO 9000 and Six Sigma) as well as the interaction between R&D investment and operational efficiency on firms' financial return in our POM paper, respectively. We explained how the interaction between process management techniques and exploration capability of firms can promote a duality in operations, enhancing the process management systems’ impact on organizational innovativeness (i.e., leading to a dynamic capacity). Our IJPQM paper studies 266 manufacturing firms in the S&P 500 Index from 1987 to 2017. We examined the impact of ISO 9000 certifications on R&D expenditure of firms (Objective 1). We further investigated how such an impact is moderated by different operating environments (Objectives 2 & 3). We found that firms actually increase their R&D expenditure after ISO 9000 certifications (Objective 1). Our results indicated that ISO 9000-certified firms are more responsive to the changing operating environments for their R&D investments. ISO 9000 certifications reduce R&D expenses more swiftly under turbulence but expand more significantly with operational slack (Objectives 2 & 3). Our research also indicated that ISO 9000-certified firms seem to be more responsive to external environments in controlling their R&D expenditure (Objectives 2 & 3). Our POM paper studies 468 manufacturing firms in the U.S. from 2017 to 2014, we constructed a dynamic panel data (DPD) model to capture the effects of R&D investments on firms' financial returns in terms of Tobin's q. Using the system generalized method of moments estimator, our results indicate that the financial returns of R&D investments are significantly enhanced when firms adopt a process-based quality technique such as Six Sigma and ISO 9000 (Objective 3) and improve efficiency in operations, leading to better financial returns of firms. Our analyses suggested that such enhancement effects through quality and efficiency improvements are more pronounced under high operational complexity as approximated by labor intensity and geographical diversity (Objectives 2 & 3).

15522616.label: Major findings and research outcome
15522616.value: Many studies from an organizational perspective suggest that ISO 9000 certification may reduce firms’ explorative capability. These authors believe that the requirements and procedures of ISO 9000 certification are rigid and inflexible, leading to organizational bureaucracy and inertia and hindering exploration. However, from the operations management perspective, ISO 9000 helps firms develop structured organizational systems and routines, promotes organizational learning and enhances firms’ capability in both exploration and exploitation. Very few studies have been carried out to examine the impact of ISO 9000 certification on R&D expenditure. Based on an analysis of ISO 9000 certification in the U.S. context, we found that ISO 9000 certifications facilitate R&D expenditure. However, ISO 9000-certified firms are more sensitive to recessions and market fluctuations. In addition, ISO 9000-certified firms with slack resources expand their R&D investments more aggressively, indicating that they may be more responsive to the availability of resources for organizational exploration. We have provided empirical evidence that ISO 9000 certifications are not necessarily in conflict with R&D exploration. Instead, the certifications might provide better systems that regulate R&D expenditure in response to operating environments. ISO 9000 implementations lead to a stronger regulatory capability for responding to changes and reducing the risks for firms from organizational exploration. Besides, previous research examined a number of contextual factors for successful R&D activities. However, very little is known about the role of quality management programs and efficiency improvement initiatives in enhancing the financial returns of R&D investments. Based on operational and financial data from U.S. manufacturing firms, we constructed a DPD model to capture the effects of R&D investments on the financial returns of firms. Performing system GMM estimation of the DPD model, our results showed that firms’ financial returns from R&D investments are significantly enhanced when they adopt process-based quality techniques i.e., Six Sigma and ISO 9000, and improve operational efficiency. Our analyses showed that such a complementary effect is more pronounced under higher operational complexity. Our research supports the dynamic capability view on the competitive advantage of firms and the dualistic perspective that operational initiatives and R&D investments are mutually enabling and supplement each other in an organization. R&D and process improvements are highly dependent and complementary under dynamic and complex operating environments, driving the financial returns of R&D investments.

15522616.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
15522616.value: R&D expenditure is commonly considered an important indicator for organizational innovation but firms vary in the effectiveness of their R&D activities. Future researchers may also consider using patent data as a measure of organisational exploration. Also, we studied firms included in the S&P 500 Index so the results of this research are not generalizable to small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs). Further studies may look into the impact of Six Sigma/ISO 9000 certifications on R&D investments of SMEs. Future research can be conducted by considering other factors in addition to internal operational resources such as human capital, technology competence and supply chain capability. Moreover, we measured R&D investments based on firms’ R&D expenses as documented in their annual reports. Although this measurement approach is consistent with prior literature on R&D at the firm level, it cannot differentiate whether such investments are for incremental R&D, radical R&D, or both. It would be interesting for future research to provide a more direct measure of firms’ incremental and radical R&D investments, and examine how incremental and radical R&D activities might benefit differently from Six Sigma/ISO 9000 implementation and operational efficiency improvement.

15522616.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
15522616.value: Firms that invest heavily in organisational innovations in terms of R&D face many uncertain factors as a result of changes in the internal and external environments, increasing their risk exposure. Our analysis provides evidence on the importance of process-base quality techniques on organisational innovativeness. With ISO 9000/Six Sigma adoption, firms can develop more robust organizational routines that help them detect unfavorable factors, respond more swiftly and more carefully control their R&D expenditure. Managers can make use of a structured organisational mechanism to regulate their activities to minimize errors, enabling them to be more responsive and risk-sensitive. This is particularly important for businesses that invest heavily in innovations. Besides, firms in R&D-intensive industries need to regularly develop the best practice, strengthen processes, and restructure operational systems through various quality and efficiency initiatives. Taking the dynamic capability view on the positive interaction results documented in our study, it implies that not only R&D investments are supported by quality and efficiency improvements, but quality and efficiency initiatives are reinforced by R&D. So, firms should consider to carry out both innovation and quality management such as ISO9000/Six Sigma together, particularly the higher the synergy effect between R&D and process management was found in a more complex operational environment.

15524916.value: 為什麼有許多在美國上市的中國企業最近宣布要私有化？

We plan to test the various hypotheses proposed in the literature to see which ones are relevant to U.S.-listed Chinese firms’ going private decisions. 15524916.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15524916.value: It has long been considered prestigious for Chinese firms to list their common stocks on the U.S. stock exchanges. Currently, there are 109 Chinese companies, whose shares are listed there, with 63 traded on the NYSE and the remaining 46 on the Nasdaq. Intriguingly, 28 Chinese ADRs have announced to go private in the first eight months of 2015. Preceding this wave are another 28 cases of US-listed Chinese firms announcing to go private during the 2011-2014 period. Why have many US-listed Chinese firms recently announced to go private? Previous studies on publicly traded firms’ going private decisions have proposed several hypotheses for explaining the drawbacks of being publicly traded on stock markets for some firms, including undervaluation (Maupin et al., 1984); agency problems associated with free cash flow (Jensen, 1986); hostile takeover (Lowenstein, 1985), and high costs involved in SEC reporting required by the SOX act (Engel et al., 2007). The recent waves of Chinese ADRs going private, however, offer us a unique setting to examine how Chinese government’s economic policies and regulatory changes may attract US-listed Chinese companies to go private and then re-list their shares on China stock markets, and whether the accounting problems and financial frauds of some Chinese firms (e.g., China MediaExpress, Longtop Financial, and ChinaCast Education) may cause U.S. investors to mistrust and undervalue other Chinese ADRs, leading them to consider to go private. We plan to investigate the valuation effects associated with—and to identify the potential factors behind—US-listed Chinese firms’ going private decisions. We posit that (1) there are positive abnormal returns to the going-private announcement, which would indicate that minority shareholders of Chinese ADRs in general share the benefits of going private, as DeAngelo et al. (1984) note; (2) more undervalued Chinese firms, those with higher free cash flow, and those with opaque financial reporting quality are more likely to make going-private announcements; (3) Chinese firms facing financial constraints are more likely to involve venture capital to help finance going private transactions; (4) Chinese ADRs’ going private decisions are affected by China government’s regulatory changes; and (5) the valuation dynamics of the A-share markets in China will influence the likelihood of Chinese ADRs completing their going private process and exiting from the U.S. markets. Ultimately, we like to shed light on whether the going-private waves imply that U.S. capital markets have become unfavorable to Chinese firms in pricing and in raising capital. 长期以来，人们一直认为仅最具声望中国公司的股票才可以到美国的股市中上市。目前，在美国上市的中国公司共计109家，其中在纽交所（NYSE）上市的有63家、纳斯达克（NASDAQ）上市的有46家。然而有趣的是，其中28家以美国存托凭证（ADR）形式在美国上市的中国公司于2015年1月到2015年8月期间宣布了私有化决议，而在这波私有化浪潮之前，在2011年到2014年期间，一共也仅有另外28个类似的私有化案例。那么，为何近期有如此之多的在美上市的中国公司选择私有化？ 前人对上市公司私有化决策的相关研究提出了若干关于公司上市弊端的假设，这些假设包括：低估值问题(Maupin et al., 1984)、与自由现金流相关的代理问题(Jensen, 1986)、恶意收购问题(Lowenstein, 1985)以及在SOX法案要求下美国证监会（SEC）报告带来的高成本问题(Engel et al., 2007)。 近期中国ADR公司的私有化浪潮提供了一个检验中国政府经济政策和监管变化如何吸引美国上市的中国公司在美退市并回国上市的独特机会。并且可以检验部分中国公司的会计问题和财务欺诈问题（涉及公司包括，China MediaExpress中国高速频道、Longtop Financial东南融通、ChinaCast Education双威教育集团）是否会造成美国投资者对中国公司的不信任，从而低估其他的中国公司并促使这些中国公司主动选择退市。 我们将研究在美上市中国公司私有化问题中的估值效应并确定其背后的潜在影响因素。我们提出：（1）类似于DeAngelo et al. (1984)，私有化决议的公布将产生正向的超额收益，这表明小股东也将获得这些中国ADR公司私有化带来的收益；（2）越被低估、自由现金流越多、财务报告越不透明的公司将越有可能宣布私有化决议；（3）面临融资约束的中国公司更有可能出现风险投资介入以帮助其筹集私有化交易所需的资本；（4）中国ADR公司私有化决策受中国政府监管政策变化的影响；（5）国内A股的估值变化将影响中国ADR公司完成私有化进程的可能性。通过这一研究，我们希望从根本上阐明中国在美上市公司最近出现的私有化浪潮是否意味着美国资本市场在定价和融资方面已经不再受到中国公司青睐。

15524916.label: Realisation of objectives
15524916.value: It has been considered prestigious for Chinese firms to be listed on U.S. stock exchanges, as these exchanges tend to have a superior regulatory system and provide better guidance on corporate governance. Listing in the U.S. allows the firm to experience an environment of better corporate governance and attract a wide spectrum of international investors, who may be willing to pay a premium to get into the growing Chinese markets. The number of Chinese ADRs has grown rapidly since the first listing in 1993. It is interesting to note that 29 Chinese ADRs announced their decisions to go private in 2015. A similar wave of Chinese ADRs announcing to go private also occurred during the 2011-2014 period. Why have many US-listed Chinese firms recently announced to go private? I was lucky to find Mr. Owen Wong, a DBA student, who also found the research question interesting. We worked together, along with my colleague Dr Gang Hu and my RA Ms. Manning Yu, to develop this project with four objectives. First, we aim to analyze the valuation effects of going private by U.S.-listed Chinese firms and identify the sources of gains that go to their shareholders. Second, we plan to test the various hypotheses proposed in the literature to see which ones are relevant to U.S.-listed Chinese firms’ going private decisions. Specifically, we would like to know whether their decisions are motivated by undervaluation, agency costs associated with free cash flow, and/or recent changes in Chinese government policies. Third, we also plan to examine the role of U.S.-listed Chinese firms’ accounting quality in their valuation, and its association with their going private decisions. And, finally, we intend to understand how the valuation dynamics of A-share market affect U.S.-listed Chinese firms’ going private process. We have successfully achieved the four objectives of this project. Under my guidance and based on this project, Owen wrote his DBA thesis in which he describes how we achieved the four objectives. Briefly, for the first objective, consistent with previous studies, which show a going private premium of 20–30% (see, e.g., Deangelo et al., 1984; Lehn & Poulsen, 1989; and Renneboog et al., 2007), we find the average (median) going private premium of 23% (20%) in our sample. The premium provides evidence that the market has undervalued the firms going private, and implies that minority shareholders also gain from the going private decisions. For the second objective, we examine three potential rationales for going private decisions proposed by prior literature, namely, undervaluation, free cash flows and cash holdings, and financial visibility. Using the two waves of Chinese ADRs going private, we find support for these three rationales generally, especially for the undervaluation hypothesis. The findings suggest that the more undervalued Chinese firms, and those with higher free cash flows, opaque financial reporting qualities, and lower financial visibility, are more likely to announce going private. More importantly, we provide evidence supporting our new rationale: government policy changes, which played a significant role in the 2015 wave of Chinese ADRs going private. For the third objective, we observe that accounting problems, including misreporting and accounting scandals, have caused the SEC to bring dozens of fraud cases against China-based firms since 2010 (Chen et la., 2013). The accounting problems and financial frauds of some Chinese firms caused U.S. investors to mistrust and undervalue other Chinese ADRs, leading the undervalued ADRs to consider going private. For the fourth objective, we find that the valuation gap between Chinese ADRs and the Shenzhen GEM (GEM) existed during the period 2010–2014. The finding suggests that listing in the U.S. does not give a higher valuation to Chinese ADRs despite the stronger corporate governance in the U.S. relative to China. In sum, our study shows that the wave of Chinese ADRs announcing to go private in 2015 was motivated by the Chinese government’s economic policies and regulatory changes, and is different from the wave of going private during 2011-14, which was more likely motivated by undervaluation caused by the accounting problems and financial frauds of a few Chinese ADRs.

15524916.label: Major findings and research outcome
15524916.value: I am glad to report that this project has generated a paper published in Global Finance Journal. Here are the summary of the major findings: In this study, we propose a new rationale for firms' delisting and going private decision: voluntary delist then reissue shares and relist in the “home” country, because of favorable government economic policy and regulatory changes. 29 (27) out of 127 U.S.-listed Chinese ADRs announced going private during 2015 alone (2011–14). Using these two waves of Chinese ADRs going private, we first examine three potential rationales proposed by prior literature, namely, undervaluation, free cash flows and cash holdings, and financial visibility. We find support for them generally, especially for the undervaluation hypothesis. More importantly, we provide evidences supporting our new rationale: government policy changes, which played a significant role in the 2015 wave of Chinese ADRs going private. Overall, our study highlights intensive competition among major international stock exchanges and the importance of government policy in the modern era of increasingly inter-connected global capital markets.

15524916.value: While many Chinese companies pursue exchange listing in the U.S. and become publicly traded, we observe two waves of U.S. listed Chinese firms announcing to go private (i.e., de-listed from the stock exchange). In these two waves, 29 (27) out of 127 U.S.-listed Chinese ADRs announced going private during 2015 alone (2011–14). Using these two waves of Chinese ADRs going private, we first examine three potential rationales, namely, undervaluation, free cash flows and cash holdings, and financial visibility. We find support for them generally, which suggest that the more undervalued Chinese firms, and those with higher free cash flows, opaque financial reporting qualities, and lower financial visibility, are more likely to announce going private. More importantly, we provide evidence supporting our new rationale: government policy changes (to encourage oversea listed Chinese firms to relist in the “home” country), which played a significant role in the 2015 wave of Chinese ADRs going private. Overall, our study highlights intensive competition among major international stock exchanges and the importance of government policy in the modern era of increasingly inter-connected global capital markets.
