16642516.label: Major findings and research outcome
16642516.value: In the past, Victor Lieberman has claimed that the Mongol-Yuan “encouraged the creation of Tai client states” in the upper Mekong by providing them with “new military and administrative models” through their status as native officials. Other historians have hypothesized that Tai polities arose due to the power vacuum created by the Mongol-Yuan, but the process of their rise has never been investigated. One of the major achievements published in Daniels (2018) is the finding that (1) the Mongol-Yuan gained possession of former Dali kingdom territories in the upper Ayeyarwaddy and the upper Mekong through the agency of the Duan family, the former rulers of the Dali kingdom; (2) Mäng2 Maaw2 arose c. 1335-1350s after the withdrawal of Mongol-Yuan troops from the upper Ayeyarwaddy in1303; (3) the Duan family aided Mongol-Yuan administration of Tai and other ethnic polities by supplying lower level personnel to staff the yamen of Tai rulers appointed as native officials. These finding do not substantiate Victor Lieberman’s claims, and indicate that Mongol-Yuan models exercised limited influence as catalysts for Tai polity building. I conclude that Lieberman’s invocation of notions of “patronage” and “client states” are misleading because they downplay the centrality of the proto Tai/Tai as agents navigating their own way to polity building. Tai agency is verified by their ambitious acquisition of new skills, technologies and writing systems. The other important achievement is the finding that the Mäng Maaw kingdom deeply influenced the early Ming pattern of governance in Yunnan. The imminent threat of invasion from Mäng Maaw limited the ability of the Ming to implement policies for governing and reforming local society in Yunnan. Daniels (2019) has shown that pre-occupation with handling the emergency forced to the Ming to accommodate the existence of internal frontiers within Yunnan. My study of the internal frontier of Iron Chain Gorge, a conglomeration of autonomous upland ethnic communities in Western Yunnan, demonstrated that the emergency created an administrative infrastructure and pattern of non-intervention from the early fifteenth century that prolonged the existence of this internal frontiers which had its own autonomous political organization until 1574. This illustrates how a pre-modern Southeast Asian polity exerted long-reaching influence on Ming governance in fifteenth and sixteenth century Yunnan. Daniels (2021) investigates the expansion of state administration into the upper Ayeyarwady and upper Mekong in phases over the course of the eighth century. I clarified that the conquest of the upper Ayeyarwady and upper Mekong river regions by the Nanzhao kingdom in the eighth century opened up the communication routes used by the Mongol-Yuan, and were essential for Sinitic control over the region, see Daniels (2021). This article aims to contribute to the debate on whether the Nanzhao kingdom was a Southeast Asian kingdom. Previous studies have described it as a Sinitic state and have focused on Nanzhao’s relations with Tang China and on the heavy Tang influence on its political organization. By tracing the expansion of state administration into the upper Ayeyarwady and upper Mekong in phases over the course of the eighth century, this article argues that as a Sinitic state, Nanzhao influenced the course of history in Mainland Southeast Asia for the following reasons. First, the establishment of an administration from walled cities down to the upper Ayeyarwady and upper Mekong in the eighth century broadened Nanzhao’s entire power base. Second, the incorporation of these parts of northern Mainland Southeast Asia, particularly Mon-Khmer and Tibeto-Burman speaking peoples, into the body politic turned Nanzhao into a powerful kingdom that played a major role in Southeast Asian history through the control of trade routes to India and Pyū cities and through military campaigns

16642516.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
16642516.value: I have established that the Sinitic kingdoms of Nanzhao and Dali, and the successor regime of the Duan family, administrated large parts of northern mainland Southeast Asia until 1382, when the Mongol-Yuan fell. I intend to incorporate these findings into a monograph that shows how the advent of Ming dynasty rule in Yunnan changed the relationship between Yunnan and mainland Southeast Asia. It will examine how the transformation of Yunnan into a province of China administrated directly by the Ming court, especially the war with Mäng Maaw (Ch: Luchuan) and its administration of the border areas, shaped Ming policies towards Southeast Asia, and probe the issue of to what extent Tai polities influenced Ming administration in the province.

16642516.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
16642516.value: The study has empirically shown how the Sinitic polities of Nanzhao and Dali administrated large parts of northern mainland Southeast Asia until 1382, when the Ming dynasty conquered Yunnan. It has also demonstrated how Southeast Asian style small polities on the border between China and Myanmar deeply influenced the Ming pattern of governance in Yunnan. Most historians assume that the Chinese state influenced Southeast Asian societies, but do not consider the possibility that pre-modern Southeast Asian states could shape the way Chinese dynasties administrated provinces at the border. This project has for the first time empirically demonstrated the extent to which a Southeast Asian state (Mäng Maaw) limited the ability of the Ming to govern the entire province, forcing it to leave upland areas un-administrated. Therefore, the Ming was only able to govern and reform local society in the lowland areas and along the communication routes that it controlled. This study presents a different picture to the common notion of the Ming establishing complete control over Yunnan from the time of conquest in 1382, and illustrates how a pre-modern Southeast Asian polity exerted long-reaching influence on Ming governance in fifteenth and sixteenth century Yunnan.

16650016.label: Project Objectives
16650016.value: To construct an entrepreneurial narrative of the Macmillan House, focusing on the House’s textbook publishing in the changing legal frameworks of education and corporate governance from 1870 to 1936. To construct an entrepreneurial narrative about the Macmillan House, the Kinkodo (Tokyo), and the Commercial Press (Shanghai) in comparative and global perspective.

To construct an entrepreneurial narrative about the Macmillan House, the Kinkodo (Tokyo), and the Commercial Press (Shanghai) in comparative and global perspective.

16650016.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16650016.value: As an interdisciplinary study of business and legal history, this project aims at constructing an entrepreneurial narrative of the Macmillan house in London with a focus on its textbook business amid the company’s emergence in the domestic market and expansion overseas from 1870 to 1836. In order to contextualize this narrative of the Macmillan house in a global and comparative perspective, the project also aims at comparing the Macmillan house with the Kinkodo (literally, the Golden Harbor Press) in Tokyo and the Commercial Press in Shanghai. The significance of this project lies in two areas: First, it will generate new knowledge in a narrative form about one of the most important and successful publishing houses in Britain before the WWII. The implication of this resultant knowledge of a specific dimension of the Macmillan house will enrich the scholarly understanding of the house itself, the British history of books and publishing, and the historical interaction between entrepreneurship and legal change in Britain. Second, it will conceptualize the interplay between economic rationality and moral sentiments through the historical narratives of the entrepreneurship of three major publishing firms in Britain, Japan, and China, all through a converging legal framework. The historical knowledge thus produced will shed new light on the developments in publishing, education, company, copyrights, and entrepreneurship in a global historical context. The contribution of the proposed project can benefit those who engage in or are interested in the historical dimension of these areas in addition to those who specialize in British publishing history and the history of the Macmillan house. The historical narratives of this project will also have implications on some controversial issues today like the role of morality and law in business, the marketization of education, and the complexity of major entrepreneurial decisions, among others. All these are pressing issues in advanced market economies in the 21st century including Hong Kong. While the findings of this project will not directly address these issues, our narratives may generate evidence-based historical insights from which creative answers to those issues can emerge. We plan to publish our findings in journal articles and book chapters with national and international impact. 這個跨學科項目的研究對象是1870至1936年間倫敦麥美倫出版社的國內外教科書事業。目的是從全球及比較的視野建構一個企業精神的個案論述。為此，本研究亦從事麥美倫與上海商務印書館有限公司及東京金港堂書籍株式會社的比較。 本項目的重要性有兩點：其一、增進我們對二戰前英國最成功出版社之一的麥美倫公司的了解。我們的焦點在其教科書事業及麥美倫家族對法律及道德操守方面的企業家取向，可以補充了麥美倫企業史的空檔，對英國出版史及英企業與法律關係史也有裨益。其二、本項目以英、中，日三國的三家重量級教科書出版社為個案，探討在早期全球法律框架一體化的趨勢之下，不同文化背景的企業精神如何在經濟理性與道德操守的張力之間開展，並構成發人深省的企業故事。 由此構成的歷史知識，將為出版、教育、公司、版權及企業精神等具普遍性意義的議題，帶來新的全球視野。對研究這些議題的研究者，即便不是專注於麥美倫企業史及英國出版史，亦有參考價值。 本項目建構的比較企業論述也涉及當今一些重大爭議，例如商業行為中的法律及道德問題；教育市場化；企業決策的複雜非市場因素等。對包括香港在內的廿一世紀先進市場經濟體系來說，都是迫切的難題。本項目成果並不直接處理這類難題，但可以提供具實證基礎的歷史啟示，從而激發創意的答案。我們計劃通過期刊論文及論集篇章來發表相關的研究成果。

16650016.label: Realisation of objectives
16650016.value: Revised Objective 1. We visited the Macmillan Company archives at the New York Public Library in May 2017. We looked through all the correspondences related to the period and subject matters of our inquiry. The many documents we collected have never been mentioned in the pervious scholarship and they shed new light on the relationship and interaction between the Macmillan family in London and the New York Macmillan company as well as on the early business operation of the New York company in the American textbook market. Collection of data on Macmillan & Co. (London) was conducted at the British Library and the UK Company Registry in the summer of 2018. We were able to collect enough data to achieve the project's intended objectives. An unexpected gain was the opportunity for us to examine some uncatalogued archives of the company that was kept in the storage of the British Library ever since they were donated from the existing Macmillan Company in the 1980s. These materials contain a large number of rare documents such as minutes of the board of directors’ meetings and the company’s financial reports. Another important set of data from this uncatalogued source contains financial reports on the Indian depots of the Macmillan & Co. over a few decades after the London company was incorporated, which attest to the long-term operation of its textbook business in India. Data analysis for constructing a narrative of the Macmillan House—we have important findings not published in the previous scholarship which help us reconstruct a highly original narrative of the Macmillan House. Since these findings are more on the entrepreneurship side of the company, in particular, regarding the aspects of corporate governance, strategy and finance, we have decided to focus our research outputs in these areas first. From the data we collected, we should be able to construct an original narrative of the textbook business of the Macmillan enterprise, which has not been explored in detail or with archival evidence beyond impressionistic accounts of the contemporaries in the previous works on the UK or US Macmillan company. For instance, our preliminary observation on their textbook publishing—as seen in the correspondences among the senior management and with various textbook authors and printers, their annual financial reports, and commentaries of their contemporaries—points to the vital role of textbook business for the publishing house. Our data can also show the complexity in how Macmillan entered regionally divided textbook markets in North America, India and the United Kingdom, where political connection often played a decisive role in the choice of publishers for local schools. Their success in maintaining their status in the first three decades of the last century appears to be a combined result of publishing and social networking. In terms of narrative construction, the objective is largely completed, while the publication of a full narrative of the Macmillan house, both in New York and London, will take a longer time than the completion report deadline permits, due to the unexpectedly rich data we collected for this project. The story is now far more complex than a few articles can deliver. We plan to turn it into a future book project, to be carried out within the next three or four years. Revised objective 2. As we have already completed our project on Kinkōdō and the Commercial Press, we began to produce outputs on comparison between the Macmillan house and these two East Asian counterparts. So far, we are working on three articles for publication, two in English and one in Chinese. Section 6.1 provides further detail on the two English papers. A first one is the paper we presented at the 2016 conference in Paris. Our preliminary analysis was on corporate governance patterns of the four major publishers, namely, the Commercial Press in Shanghai, Kinkōdō in Tokyo, the Macmillan Company in New York, and the Macmillan & Co. in London, roughly from the 1870s to the 1930s. To sharpen the focus of the inquiry, we revised the paper for presentation at the 2018 conference in Seville, Spain, focusing only on two companies, i.e., Macmillan & Company London and Kinkōdō. At both the 2016 and 2018 conferences we benefited from the advice and comments from scholars of different disciplines such as history, finance, economics, anthropology and sociology, who research on different societies covering periods from the premodern era to the 20th century, including eminent economic historians like Patrick O’Brien, Ron Harris, and David Faure. They considered our research agenda, methodology, approach and data to be appropriate overall. We are currently revising this paper to turn it into a manuscript to be submitted to the Law and History Review. A second paper from this project was first presented at the conference in Lisbon in October 2017. We presented our findings on corporate performances of the New York Macmillan Company in light of its 1929 financial reports. Based on the feedback and comments received at the conference, we presented a revised version at the conference on global and China business history at Central China Normal University in Wuhan in December 2017. The conference was attended by eminent scholars in China economic history such as R. Bin Won, Ma Min, and Hamashita Takeshi. Encouraged by the positive feedback from the attendees, we are revising the paper to turn it into a manuscript to be submitted soon to the Journal of Economic History or a similar top-notch journal in the field. A third paper is a comparative study of the financial reports of the Commercial Press, the Macmillan Company New York, and the Zhonghua Bookstore around 1932-33. This manuscript has been accepted as a chapter in the book volume titled Studies on Chinese Business History: In Honor of the Late Professor Liu Kuang-ching, edited by Lai Chi-kong and Wang Fan-sen (Lien-ching Publishing). This more descriptive version of the paper consists mainly of the data that had been neglected in the previous scholarship in publishing history. A more analytical essay will be prepared in due course. We did not encounter any unexpected difficulties. The results, as of today, are meaningful enough to contribute significantly to one or more original narratives of the Macmillan & Company London and the Macmillan Company New York. What was unexpected is the very rich data we were able to gather. The outcomes of the archival search allow us to construct a far more original narrative for the Macmillans in both New York and London and a far more clear-cut comparison between the Macmillans and their two major East Asian counterparts. As a result of such fruitful completion of the project over the short period of two years, we were not only able to produce the outputs in the form of conference papers, journal articles, and a book chapter, but we are also envisioning a very original series of publication outputs in the coming three to five years, hopefully in more than one book, pertaining to the Macmillan house and a global history of entrepreneurship in the book industry.

16650016.label: Major findings and research outcome
16650016.value: Two major findings as presented in two articles in preparation for publication: 1. Entrepreneurship as seen in corporate finances: The Macmillan Company (MC) and the Commercial Press (PC) were considered the largest corporations in the book industry in New York and Shanghai respectively in the 1920s. This study attempted to examine the performance of the two corporations through their 1929 balance sheets. We explored how their corporate performances might be measured through financial data and what implications this new dimension of our study could shed on their respective corporate narratives. We argue that MC around 1929 was far more risk-averse and conservative in their business decisions than CP where business was operating in a relatively high-risk environment. CP expanded its scope significantly, out of necessity, to engage in wholesale and retail businesses as well as printing services other than book publishing, and became a publicly traded company with diffuse ownership structure. In the case of MC, manufacturing was outsourced and hence appeared to embrace the system of vertical disintegration, which could be driven by the desire of the publishing house’s small, close-knit team of board directors to take advantage of the gains from specialized production on a modest scale. 2. Entrepreneurship as seen in corporate governance: We examined the corporate governance patterns of MC London incorporated in 1896, terminating its 53-year partnership model, as well as its Japanese counterpart, Tokyo-based Kinkōdō incorporated in 1893, ending its family-owned business model since 1875. At that time, the impersonal corporate model governed by corporate law featuring the divorce of beneficial ownership from control of operations became fashionable among emerging entrepreneurs seeking to achieve economies of scale and boost profits with expansive public investments. However, Macmillan’s and Kinkōdō’s decision to incorporate was not necessarily driven by the economy-of-scale factor but by seeing incorporation as a tool for brand-building in the case of Kinkōdō and for ensuring family control of the company in the best possible manner in terms of economic efficiency in the case of Macmillan. In short, we argue that the corporate governance structure adopted by the late nineteenth-century entrepreneurs in Britain and Japan did not reflect separation of ownership from management in order to achieve economies of scale and that such structure was rather used as a means of improving efficiency in internal governance within a newly introduced legal framework of corporate governance or as a brand-building tool.

16650016.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
16650016.value: We will construct a narrative of the textbook business of the Macmillan enterprises in US and UK with solid archival evidence. Our preliminary observations about their textbook publishing, as seen from the data we collected so far, including, but not limited to, the financial reports, support the claim that despite the diversified branches of publishing by the Macmillans in London and New York, textbook publishing remained the most vital sector of their business. Furthermore, in order to remain a leader in the textbook publishing market, which was fiercely competitive and politically complicated, both George Brett of Macmillan New York and Sir Frederick of Macmillan London were able to retain a close-knit circle of well-respected authors as well as textbook decision-makers in their respective countries. Their entrepreneurship reflects a complex interplay of reputational pride, business interest, public morality, social responsibility, and political network. We plan to write at least one book on this, incorporating our findings in the same aspect of textbook publishing from the Commercial Press and Kinkōdō so as to provide a global and comparative perspective.

16650016.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
16650016.value: As an interdisciplinary study of business and legal history, the first purpose of this project was to produce an entrepreneurial narrative of the Macmillan house in London when the company was emerging in the domestic market followed by its expansion overseas which led to the establishment of Macmillan Company New York from 1870 to 1936. In order to look at the history of the Macmillan house in a global and comparative perspective, the project also compared the Macmillan house with Kinkōdō in Tokyo and the Commercial Press in Shanghai. The significance of this project lies in two areas: First, it generates new knowledge in a narrative form about one of the most important publishing houses in Britain before the WWII. The implication of the work on the Macmillan house can enrich an understanding of the house itself, the British history of books and publishing, and the historical interaction between entrepreneurship and legal change in Britain. Secondly, it helps to clarify the interplay between economic rationality and moral sentiments through historical narratives of entrepreneurship of three major publishing firms in Britain, Japan and China, all within a converging legal framework.

16651916.value: 主觀體驗中愉快程度與喚醒程度的關係：文化和性格差異的影響

16651916.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16651916.value: 主觀體驗中的情感在不同的心理現象中有著很重要的影響。因此，去了解情感的結構是心理學中一個長期的挑戰。情感中有什麼基本的因子? 因子之間有什麼關係? 因子間的關係又會否因著文化和性格差異而改變? 一般而言，情感的結構常被認為是人性的一部分，不會隨文化和個性差異而改變。 理論和研究指出情感的基本因子是愉快程度和喚醒程度，但是它們之間的關係至今仍然未被確實。兩者之間是否有著獨立的關係，還是共同的改變? 如果關係是共同改變的話，這個關係又會否隨著文化和性格而變遷? 文獻中提出了六個理論去解釋 或推測愉快程度和喚醒程度之間的關係。我們的研究建議書就是去驗證這些推測。 我們的團隊用了八個樣本去測試這六個假設的關係。研究發現愉快程度和喚醒程度之間有著一個微弱但對稱的V字形的樣式，表示越愉快就越喚醒，越不愉快也又越喚醒。我們發現這個V字形樣式會因性格差異而改變： 外向的人會有較深的V字形，而內向的人就會有較淺的V字形。我們還發現這V字形的傾斜度會因文化差異而改變： 西方文化 (如加拿大) 的V字形會比東方文化 (如日本) 的較傾斜。在香港的樣本當中，最適合的樣式就只是一條直線，代表愉快程度和喚醒程度兩者是獨立的。雖然這些初部結果令人鼓舞，但這個研究實在包含太少文化樣本，而且太部份參與者僅限於能說英語人士。故這個建議書的目的是把研究範圍擴展到更多不同的文化且包含更大的樣本。 在這個建議書中，我們會使用一個現存的跨文化研究網絡。當中涉及50個不同的地區，而每個地區都會提供多個樣本以測試研究結果的可信性，籍以制定堅穩的理論去了解情感的本質以及其與性格和文化差異之間的關係。

16651916.label: Realisation of objectives
16651916.value: We solicited collaboration around the globe resulting in 56 collaborators, covering 32 countries and 25 languages. Data collection was completed in November 2018. The final sample size is 8,590. We are in the process of analyzing the data, the results of which can be deployed to answer the four research questions proposed. However, we are slightly behind the schedule because of several unexpected delays and problems encountered in the journey. Problems with Data Collection: Because of the unexpected delay in preparing the project kick-off, we sent out our invitation to potential collaborators in December 2017, subsequent to which each collaborator was to work on the translation/back-translation during January to March 2018. Data collection was expected to have been completed by June 2018. Unfortunately, only 16 valid samples were received by then. Some collaborators were still waiting for ethical approval while others had difficulties recruiting subjects. We therefore extended the cut-off date to November 2018 by the end of which we received 34 samples (from 32 countries). Of the 34, 26 used online version, 4 used paper-pencil method, and 4 used both. Prior to any statistical analysis, we checked and cleaned each dataset. The number of missing and invalid data were screened and examined. Collaborators were contacted to clarify the missing data cases and to translate responses to open-ended questions. In summary, we encountered unexpected delays in the data collection process resulting in more than 12 months of delay. Problems with Datasets: Two datasets, both used the paper version, were found to have poor data quality. We asked the pertinent collaborators to mail us the completed questionnaires for further data checking. Problems with Statistical Analyses: The theme of the research was to examine the relationship between Valence and Arousal in subjective experience. To map out the Valence and Arousal across 34 datasets, we started with “affect in the clearest moment”. (We also measured “affect today”, and “normative affect”.) In that questionnaire, we asked participants to recall how they felt during a clearest moment using 32 items, on a scale from 1 (not at all) to 5 (extremely). Valence was defined by “happy, pleased, miserable, unhappy”; Arousal by “intense, determined, still, quiet”. Prior to making comparisons across cultures, we were to establish measurement invariance on Valence and Arousal. We tested the two-factor model through multigroup confirmatory factor analysis. Specifically, loadings relating the manifest variables of “pleasant” and “unpleasant” to the Valence construct were strong but the loadings relating the manifest variables of “activated” and “deactivated” to the Arousal construct were weak resulting in poor model fit. To improve the fit, we tested alternative models by selecting items that yield the most negative correlation between “activated” and “deactivated” in the datasets. Currently, we are refining the scales using modification indices and the finalized two-factor model is yet to be identified, after which we can relate the affect structure to the cultural and personality variables. By the end of 2020, we anticipate putting in the pipeline our first paper on examining the variations of the Valence-Arousal relationship within and across the cultures.

16651916.label: Major findings and research outcome
16651916.value: Owing to unexpected delays in data collection and cleaning, we are still in the process of analyzing the data. To define the key constructs, namely Valence and Arousal, across 34 datasets, we tested the two-factor model through multigroup confirmatory factor analysis. Unfortunately, the model fit was not acceptable thereby leading to our efforts in testing alternative models. Once the finalized model is identified, we can move on to test other hypotheses relating Valence-Arousal relationship with personality and cultural variables. Of the three basic papers anticipated, we expect to put in the pipeline by December 2020 one on the variations of the Valence-Arousal relationship within and across the cultures. In the subsequent year, we will be able to write up one on relating the Valence-Arousal relationship to personality variables; and another on relating the Valence-Arousal relationship to values.

16651916.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
16651916.value: The mapping of the affect structure across the globe scaffolds the development of a space capturing the variability of affective experiences. Such a network had not been possible because of small samples of cultures and lack of statistical tools used in prior research. Our project took a step forward by including 32 countries, and 25 languages. In the future, more countries and languages should be included. Using the affect structure, we examined its relationship with personality and cultural variables in the present project. In the future, more psychological variables and processes should be added to advance our understanding of human affect.

16651916.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
16651916.value: The subjective experience of affect is a central aspect of the mind playing an unequivocal role in diverse psychological phenomena ranging from behavior to attitudes to well-being, from memory to perception to moral judgments of right and wrong. Valence and arousal were identified as fundamental properties of affect. In this project, we studied how these two dimensions were related and whether their relationship varied with culture and with personality. The study of emotion has recently given rise to a new “affective science” parallel to “cognitive science,” but the success of that new science depends on the adequacy of its understanding of affect itself. We sought to map out the affect structure across 25 languages thereby forming a basis for theories of affect’s relation to other cultural and personality variables. If valence and arousal are empirically related, then the common practice of measuring and manipulating one while ignoring the other is challenged. Neuroscience often presupposes the independence of valence and arousal by trying to identify the circuitry of one while ignoring the other. If the relationship between these two dimensions is malleable and varies with other factors, our results would introduce a cross-fertilization between psychology and neuroscience.

16655916.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16655916.value: Historically, mule caravans created the transportation links that integrated the mountainous zones of subtropical Southwest China, tropical Southeast Asia and highland Eastern Tibet. This transportation system provided multi-layer social and physical networks for political, social and economic exchange and mobility, but it relied heavily on the human-animal relationship, especially mules, rather than horses, even though it was known as the “horse caravan band (马帮)”. Because the horse has a fierce temperament and is impatient, it is not suitable a carrier animal. Therefore, the most common pack animal between the Yangtse River and the Irrawaddy River is the mule. In order to manage a caravan for long distance trade, the muleteers must cooperate with animal businessmen circulated well-trained mules from mule husbandry communities on grasslands, to the communities of caravan muleteers along the transportation routes in the basins. Meanwhile, muse husbandry communities exist in the Tibetan highlands in Northwest Yunnan. These communities are very knowledgeable about rearing horses and donkeys and have a long tradition of hybridizing mule reproduction and training mules to seeve as carrier animals. Besides, the environmental advantage of high quality grassland, the mules reared in this region had very strong vital capacity when they worked in relatively lower altitude regions. However, according to Chinese veterinary tradition, the horsebean is the best feed for horses, donkeys and mules, and the largest horsebean harvest was provided by basin agriculture as their winter crop. As a result, communities of mule trainers in the northern mountainous area, the horsebean harvest fodder produced in the basins, and the communities of muleteers for long distance trade along transportation routes between Yunnan and Burma, were all connected and integrated through the mule circulation facilitated by groups of businessmen in the animal business, based on their specific knowledge of animal anthroposcopy. This project studies a Double-layer Network as a social mechanism linking different societies together: The first layer is its agency of interdependency between different environmental, economic and cultural elements; the second layer is its agency of cross-border mechanism, like mules as the means to bound China, southeast Asia and Tibet into a global trade system. 历史上的马帮贸易交通线，将中国西南部的亚热带山区、东南亚热带平原和青藏高原东部边缘地带整合为一个区域性整体。作为多层次社会与地理网络的基础，马帮道路交通体系为区域性的政治、社会、经济贸易往来和商品流动提供了保障。但是，这一道路交通运输体系的运作要依靠人与动物的配合来实现。当地人将从事运输的组织称为“马帮”，但是驮运的役使动物主要是骡子（骡马）而非马匹，这是因为马性急躁、发力快却缺乏耐性，难以作为运输役使动物，因此，历史上能够将长江与伊洛瓦底江之间的广大区域市场联系起来的运输动物主要是骡子。为了将骡子组织成马帮来经营远距离运输及贸易，赶马人需要从事动物贸易的商人向其长期提供训练有素的骡子。在夏秋季节，从事动物贸易的商人将滇藏交界的高山草场地区饲养训练的骡子，贩售给交通沿线各地坝子中长期从事马帮运输的赶马人。因为绝大多数从事畜牧业的大多社群分布于滇藏交界的高山草场地区，他们具有丰富的饲养和训练骡马的知识经验，传统上对品种培育和训练的技术非常熟悉。此外，在高海拔地区生长的因骡马肺活量大、载重力强、适应长途运输而备受欢迎。此外，根据中医兽医的经验，蚕豆是最适宜骡马的饲料，云南坝区冬春旱季小春作物以蚕豆种植为主，蚕豆的生产又为山区畜牧业发展提供了充足的饲料供应。因而，饲养训练骡马的山区社群与大规模生产蚕豆的坝区社群之间形成了长期相互依赖关系，共同为云南、缅甸之间的远距离贸易提供了运输所需的骡子。从事骡、马、驴等大牲畜贸易的商人，又以动物（骡子）流通作为媒介，深入整合了不同类型的山区和坝子从事畜牧业、农业、商业（或季节性兼营商业）的社群。而且，不同群体对动物的训练、对兽医知识经验的掌握、不同的役使动物方式，都因动物的联系而形成了一个相互之间既分工协作、又深入整合的社会体系。因此，本研究计划旨在提出“双重网络”的概念，来研究动物与不同社群之间的多样性联系：就第一层次而言，指的是不同环境、经济和文化要素之间的相互依赖关系如何透过地方社会与动物的关系而建立与维持社会能动性，特别是，在整体上，这一区域的社会群体之间形成了共享的社会能动性；第二层次指的是，这样的社会能动性如何能够建立起跨越不同社会界限类别的跨越与整合的社会机制。在这样的条件下，骡子就成为联结中国内地、东南亚和西藏与全球贸易网络之间的社会中介。

16655916.label: Realisation of objectives
16655916.value: With the support of the project No: 16655916, I was very activity, productive, and made some achievements from its beginning on January 1, 2017, and the project was completed on 30 June 2021. During the period of four and half years, I worked very hard and my research procedures went smoothly and very successful. All research purposes have achieved. During the period, I myself as the editor, two edited books were published by Routledge, which is a leading academic publisher in UK. Besides, eight refereed book chapters both in English and Chinese, and four journal articles in Chinese were published, plus nineteen conference papers were presented on international and local conferences. In general, this is an influential research project with very fruitful publications, as it is a great achievement indeed. In addition, I am writing a book manuscript now, and it is expected that this book will be published in 2022 as a part of outcome of this research project. This book writing project focuses on human and animal agency in social construction of Southwest frontier of China, thanks to the achievement of this project. In sum, I have done excellent job and I am satisfied with what I found, as this research project has led me to go ahead. Thus, I have submitted another GRF research project proposal to go further, focusing on questions about social historical agency and the construction of ethnicity from the 1450s to the 1850s in southwest China. This project becomes an important stage of my academic career, to build up a solid base for my historical anthropology research about human and animal agency in the shaping of imperial frontier of China in the Ming and the Qing dynasties, as well as and construction of Sino-Burma frontier societies in history. I am going ahead to study social agency of social reconstruction and its reaction with the state power to explain the scale and limitation of Chinese empire in the southwest frontier base on what I have achieved in this project. The following please find the details about what I have done during the period, including 12 researched articles or chapters published by important journals and academic publishers. According to the memorandum, the current available balance is $20751.90. I have to explain the reason of this balance. I planned to conduct field work and to complete the remaining tasks for data collection in 2020 for final stage of project research. However, my scheduled field trips were cancelled since February 2020, thus the remining budget could not be used up until June 2021, due to the ban of traveling under COIVD-19 pandemic. Finally, I was able to apply for special leave from June to August 2021, which was approved by the school dean and university president as a special case of date collection, but still, the balance could not be used, as I mainly did field work in July and August 2021, as I was taking domestic quarantine in a hotel in the mainland for two week in late June 2021. I feel quite sorry about that, even though I tried different ways to resolve the problem, but my study trips were not allowed under the ban of traveling outside Hong Kong until June 2021. This traveling ban has maintained for more than a year. In general, because of the special situation of COIVD-19 pandemic, the balance of budget could not be used up, which is in a very special situation under the ban of conducting field work, rather than a problem of project management.

17100816.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17100816.value: 生精上皮週期的第VIII階段，處於減數分裂細線期的精母細胞穿過由緊密連接（TJ）和外質特化結構（ES）組成的血睪屏障（BTB），向生精上皮的近腔部遷移，進一步發育。在不破壞血睪屏障的前提下，生精細胞的遷移需要精母細胞前端“舊的”BTB發生解聚以及末端 “新的”BTB發生聚合。進入近腔部之後，精母細胞進一步遷移到生精上皮，繼續分化形成成熟的精子。精母細胞在排精之前始終通過頂部的ES粘附于支持細胞（Sertoli cell）。第VIII階段晚期，頂部ES解聚，成熟的精子得以釋放。在精子發生的整個過程中，支持細胞與生殖細胞之間細胞連接的重建是促進生殖細胞遷移所必須的。 越來越多的證據表明，生殖細胞在生精上皮的遷移與炎症反應的白細胞遷移相似。例如，研究表明，免疫球蛋白超家族（IgSF）的粘附分子在白細胞以及生殖細胞的遷移都發揮重要的作用，包括細胞間粘附分子（ICAM）和連接粘附分子（JAM）。除了IgSF，整合素在白細胞的遷移過程也發揮了重要的作用。然而，整合素在生殖細胞遷移的功能研究還十分稀少。迄今為止，研究僅報道了α6β1整合素。在24種整合素中，LFA-1是唯一一個同時表達于中性粒細胞、單核細胞和淋巴細胞的整合素。LFA-1與IgSF蛋白有交互作用，例如ICAM和JAM。這些IgSF蛋白又表達于睪丸中，參與細胞連接的重建。已知LFA-1主要表達于V-VIII階段的生殖細胞，并定位於精子的凸側、頂部ES以及BTB，這些區域動態性地發生細胞連接的重組，協助生殖細胞的遷移。本項目負責人將探究LFA-1在睪丸中的功能以及交互作用的分子。本課題旨在尋找LFA-1的交互作用分子，并檢測LFA-1或其交互作用分子在生殖細胞遷移相關的細胞連接的重建過程的功能。本課題的研究成果將更好地了解生殖細胞的發育過程，為男性不育的未解之謎提供新的思路，為非激素男性避孕藥的發展提供新的方向。

17100816.value: One more manuscript is still in progress. We are now doing an additional animal experiment to address the physiological outcome of the knockdown of LFA-1 and CRT in testis by siRNA in vivo knockdown approach to wrap up the manuscript. During the project period, we encountered two major issues. We started this project with two workable and reliable anti-LFA antibodies, one from Santa Cruz Biotechnology and the another one is Life Technology (clone M17/4). However, anti-LFA antibody from Santa Cruz Biotechnology was discontinuous in the middle of the project period, we spent more than a year to find and test another workable one to continue all the Co-IP and immunoblot analyses. It is because the clone M17/4 is only suitable for IF analysis, but not for IB or Co-IP analyses. Also, COVID-19 causes a significant delay of work progress. During the time that the University announced the work from home arrangement, we followed the social distancing guideline. To protect the safety of the lab members, we were divided into two teams to work on shift. The total working time during that period was significantly affected and reduced.

17100816.label: Major findings and research outcome
17100816.value: qPCR and immunoblotting analyses have revealed that LFA-1 (L2) is expressed in both Sertoli cells and germ cells and it expresses abundantly in germ cells compared to Sertoli cells. Immunofluorescence staining also confirmed that LFA-1 can be found in different germ cells at the site of cell-cell contact. LFA-1 is localized extensively in elongated spermatids at the apical region of the seminiferous epithelium at the stage VIII of the seminiferous epithelial cycle. We also confirmed that LFA-1 is colocalized with other apical ES proteins such as JAM-C and Nectin-3, suggesting that LFA-1 may serve as an important ES structural protein to assist the attachment of meiotic germ cells and timely release of elongated spermatids at spermiation. To our surprise, LFA-1 doesn’t interact physically with the putative JAM-A and ICAM-1, we therefore employed down-pull assay coupled with LC/MS/MS to identify testis-specific interacting partners. Some of identified interacting proteins exhibit functions in relation to cell adhesion, focal adhesion, cell migration and some are related to cell differentiation and cell growth. Interaction of LFA-1 and the newly-identified proteins were further confirmed. Co-immunofluorescence staining confirmed that LFA-1 co-localized with calreticulin (CRT), 14-3-3 theta and doppel respectively. CRT and 14-3-3 theta is colocalized with LFA-1 at the concave side of the elongated spermatids. For doppel, it is colocalized apparently with LFA-1 at the cytoplasmic region of the elongated spermatids. We further confirmed that calreticulin can interact physically with the extracellular domain and cytoplasmic domain of LFA-1, while 14-3-3 theta and doppel found to interact with the cytoplasmic domain of LFA-1. To investigate the potential role of functional LFA-1/CRT and LFA-1/doppel complexes in spermatogenesis, we knockdown the expression of those proteins in germ cells. Single knockdown of LFA-1, CRT or doppel have no significant effect on the expression level of ES proteins such as nectin-2, JAM-B and JAM-C. However, knockdown of CRT could cause disorganization of actin filament and knockdown of LFA-1 cause diffused localization of some ES proteins such as CXADR at the site of cell contact. Dual knockdown of CRT and LFA-1 caused apparent disorientation of some apical ES proteins including CXADR and JAM-C from the cell contact area, suggesting that LFA-1/CRT complex is essential to maintain the stability of the apical ES. It also suggests that timely regulation of LFA-1/CRT expression may provide an effective mechanism to regulate the disassembly of CXADR-based ES to facilitate the release of elongated spermatids at spermiation.

17100816.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
17100816.value: Our current studies have clearly shown that the interaction of LFA-1 and its novel interacting proteins such as CRT and doppel plays important role in the structure and regulation of apical ES in the seminiferous epithelium. A thorough understanding on how LFA-1 interacts and regulates CRT in maintaining ES structure and dynamics are of great important in spermatogenesis. To further elucidate the physiological role of LFA-1/CRT complex in regulating the apical ES at spermiation. Further investigation by generation of double LFA-1/CRT knockout mice is warranted. This mouse model will unravel the physiological importance of LFA-1/CRT complex in male fertility.

17100816.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
17100816.value: In this study, the function of LFA-1 and its regulation have been examined. We have identified that LFA-1 does not interact with its putative protein partners JAM-A and ICAM-1 in the testis. Instead, a group of novel interacting partners including calreticulin (CRT, doppel and 14-3-3 theta were found to interact with LFA-1 in the testis. In our study, we found that LFA-1 is one of the apical ES protein that is important for elongated spermatid attachment to the seminiferous epithelium. Disruption of the LFA-1 and calreticulum interaction causes the disruption of the apical ES structure, suggesting such interaction may provide a crucial mechanism to regulate the attachment and the timely release of mature spermatids during spermatogenesis. In fact, the findings are not be limited to testicular physiology since LFA-1 are junction proteins that can be found in other tissues. Our studies serve as blueprints for other tissue models. This study provides two novel pieces of information that LFA-1 is in fact important transmembrane protein that facilitates cell adhesion between elongated spermatids and LFA-1/CRT complex serves as a signaling platform in regulating the release of mature spermatids in the testis.

17101616.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17101616.value: 亞洲野生綬草蘭花Spiranthes的物種形成、親緣地理學和保護遺傳學研究

17101616.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17101616.value: 亞洲野生綬草蘭花Spiranthes的物種形成、親緣地理學和保護遺傳學研究 蘭科（Orchidaceae）是有花植物裡面物種最豐富的一個科，大約有25000個物種。蘭科裡面最重要的一個進化問題是為什麼這個科有如此多的物種。利用綬草屬（Spiranthes）作為研究系統，我們試圖去揭開蘭科物種形成的模式。綬草是一個包含大概36 個物種的陸地蘭花屬，它的多樣性在北美。在亞洲，已鑑定的綬草屬物種要比北美少很多。我們實驗室的早前工作利用同工酶和線粒體DNA證明二倍體的绶草S. sinensis是異源四倍體香港綬草S. hongkongensis的母本。綬草S. sinensis在亞洲的地理分佈十分廣泛，東至日本，南到澳大利亞，北至西伯利亞，西到西喜馬拉雅（包括印度和尼泊爾）。在西喜馬拉雅，綬草S. sinensis和歐洲的旋花綬草S. spiralis同域分佈。我們想要檢驗的假設是，綬草S. sinensis和旋花綬草S. spiralis在西喜馬拉雅地區的自然雜交產生香港綬草S. hongkongensis以及旋花綬草S. spiralis 是S. hongkongensis的父本。此外，由於在亞洲發現的其他綬草新物種，比如說S. nivea和S. sunii，在型態上與香港綬草S. hongkongensis的區分並不是特別明顯，因此我們想進一步檢驗這些新報導的綬草物種是否有相同的異源多倍體起源。 由於廣闊的地理分佈以及形態上的變異，多個變種、亞種和新種在綬草S. sinensis物種複合體中被報導。在這個研究中，我們想通過研究大範圍內綬草S. sinensis複合體的系統發生和群體結構來檢測這些有著廣泛分佈的變種或亞種（比如說S. sinensis var. australis和S. sinensis var. amonea）與綬草S. sinensis的遺傳分化。 為了回答這些關於綬草的進化關係、親緣地理學和群體結構等問題，我們提議用核基因、質粒DNA序列以及通過雙酶切限制性位點關聯DNA測序（double digest restriction site associated DNA sequencing; ddRADseq）得到的基因組水平單核苷酸多態性去研究大範圍地理分佈多個種的多個個體遺傳變異。通過使用生物信息學工具，比如Stacks和pyRAD我們將檢測到分化的SNP位點去研究異源四倍體的物種形成，以及進一步研究群體遺傳結構和譜系分化。這個研究的結果也會對制定合適的方案去保護香港蘭花和全球蘭花起到指導作用。

17102316.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17102316.value: 局部炎症在間歇性低氧頸動脈體一氧化氮的缺乏的病理生理作用

17102316.label: Project Objectives
17102316.value: • Specific aim 1 is to determine the effect of anti-inflammatory drugs on the NO production in the CB or cultured cells in intermittent hypoxia. • Specific hypothesis 1 is that anti-inflammatory drugs ameliorate the IH-induced NO deficit in the CB. • In-vivo studies - arterial pressures, serum and tissue oxidative markers, the NO level and the expression of NO synthases (NOSs) and the local inflammatory markers and signaling mediators in the CB will be obtained in the IH rats (with inspired oxygen levels altering between 5-21% per minute for 8 hours per day for 1-10 days), concurrently treated with dexamethasone or ibuprofen. Results will be compared with the IH and normoxic groups. • The NO bioavailability will be evaluated by the expression and functional studies measuring the expression level of NOSs (eNOS, nNOS, p-eNOS), and also electrochemical measurements of the constitutive NO release (level reduced by NOS inhibitors) and the NO elevation in responding to acute hypoxia. • Local inflammation will be examined by the expression of inflammatory mediators, cyclooxygenases (COX) and chemokines, and macrophage infiltration. Superior cervical ganglion will also be used as a control tissue. In addition, results will be confirmed by invivo studies using the wild-type and COX-knockout mice. • The CB hyperexcitability will be assessed by patch-clamp study of potassium currents and spectrofluorimetric study of intracellular calcium ([Ca++]i) in responding to acute hypoxia in the chemosensitive glomus cells in the CB. Electrophysiological study of the afferent nerve activity of the chemoreceptor will be performed on the CB in anesthetized rats. Results will be compared with those of the IH group and normoxic controls. • In-vitro studies - In cultured PC12 cells as an oxygen-sensitive model or primary cultured type-I glomus cell of the CB, studies will be performed to examine the NO level and NOS expression, activation of NF-kb and signaling mediators (NF-kb activity, IKK phosphorylation, MAPKs) in the presence of vehicles, cytokine receptor antagonists, ERK/p-38/NF-kb inhibitors, COX inhibitors under hypoxic or control conditions. • The drug effects on the potassium current and [Ca2+]i responses to acute hypoxia in the PC12 or glomus cells will also be studied. The DNA-binding activity of NF-kb will be evaluated by EMSA. Western-blot will be performed to measure the total and phosphorylated levels of IKK and MAPKs. Results will be compared with those of the IH group and normoxic controls. • It is speculated that the decreased NO bioavailability and augmented chemoreceptor responses to acute hypoxia; the activation of NF-kb activity and the signaling mediators in the IH group, could be antagonized by anti-inflammatory drugs or the receptor blockers. • Specific aim 2 is to examine how cytokines down-regulate the NO production and lead to functional changes in the carotid body in IH. • Specific hypothesis 2 is that the cytokines up-regulate the expression of NADPH oxidase and renin-angiotensin system, leading to the NO deficit in intermittent hypoxia. • In-vivo studies – as aforementioned the in-vivo parameters, the NO level and the expression of NO synthases (eNOS, nNOS, p-eNOS), NADPH oxidase subunits (Nox2, Nox4), renin-angiotensin system (angiotensinogen, angiotensin-converting enzymen, AT1 receptors) and the local inflammatory markers and signaling mediators in the CB will be obtained in the IH rats concurrently treated with NADPH oxidase inhibitor (apocynin) or AT1 receptor antagonist (losartan). • As stated in specific aim 1, the CB hyperexcitability will be evaluated by measurements of the afferent activity, potassium current and [Ca++]i elevation in responding to acute hypoxia. Results will be compared with the IH and normoxic groups. • In-vitro studies - the NO level and the NOS expression profile could be confirmed by studies using cultured PC12 cells or primary cultured type-I glomus cell of the CB. Studies will be performed to measure the NO level and NOS expression, the expressions of Nox subunits and renin-angiotensin system, activation of NF-kb and signaling mediators in the presence of vehicles, apocynin or lorsatan under hypoxic or control conditions. The hyperexcitability will be evaluated by measuring the potassium currents, the catecholamine secretion, [Ca++]i elevation in responding to acute hypoxia. In addition, the pharmacological effects will be confirmed by gene silencing of NADPH oxidase subunits Nox2 or Nox4 with siRNA.

• Specific aim 2 is to examine how cytokines down-regulate the NO production and lead to functional changes in the carotid body in IH. • Specific hypothesis 2 is that the cytokines up-regulate the expression of NADPH oxidase and renin-angiotensin system, leading to the NO deficit in intermittent hypoxia. • In-vivo studies – as aforementioned the in-vivo parameters, the NO level and the expression of NO synthases (eNOS, nNOS, p-eNOS), NADPH oxidase subunits (Nox2, Nox4), renin-angiotensin system (angiotensinogen, angiotensin-converting enzymen, AT1 receptors) and the local inflammatory markers and signaling mediators in the CB will be obtained in the IH rats concurrently treated with NADPH oxidase inhibitor (apocynin) or AT1 receptor antagonist (losartan). • As stated in specific aim 1, the CB hyperexcitability will be evaluated by measurements of the afferent activity, potassium current and [Ca++]i elevation in responding to acute hypoxia. Results will be compared with the IH and normoxic groups. • In-vitro studies - the NO level and the NOS expression profile could be confirmed by studies using cultured PC12 cells or primary cultured type-I glomus cell of the CB. Studies will be performed to measure the NO level and NOS expression, the expressions of Nox subunits and renin-angiotensin system, activation of NF-kb and signaling mediators in the presence of vehicles, apocynin or lorsatan under hypoxic or control conditions. The hyperexcitability will be evaluated by measuring the potassium currents, the catecholamine secretion, [Ca++]i elevation in responding to acute hypoxia. In addition, the pharmacological effects will be confirmed by gene silencing of NADPH oxidase subunits Nox2 or Nox4 with siRNA.

17102316.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17102316.value: Recurrent episodes of apnea and hypopnea cause repetitive oxygen desaturation in patients with obstructive sleep apnea (OSA). Chronic intermittent hypoxia (CIH) plays significant pathophysiological roles in the clinical manifestation of the OSA syndrome, which leads to endothelial dysfunction, hypertension and increased risks for cardiovascular morbidities and mortalities. Peripheral chemoreceptors in the carotid body play a key role in the physiological response to hypoxia and also in the pathophysiological consequences of sleep apnea. The carotid chemoreceptor activity is significantly augmented by intermittent hypoxia, which is closely related to oxidative stress and local inflammation in the organ. Particularly, our studies have shown that: (1) proinflammatory cytokines, namely interleukin (IL)-1beta, IL-6, tumor necrosis factor (TNF)-alpha and their receptors are expressed in the carotid body and the expressions are significantly increased in CIH rats; (2) cytokines elevate intracellular calcium responses to acute hypoxia in the chemosensitive cell of the carotid body, and (3) a time-dependent decrease in the release of nitric oxide (NO) in the carotid body of CIH rats. These data suggest that the proinflammatory cytokines play an active role in the local inflammation and the NO deficit in the carotid body in intermittent hypoxia. In this proposal, I postulated that carotid body inflammation mediated by pro-inflammatory cytokines play a mechanistic role in the decreased NO bioavailability in the organ, which contributes to the augmented activity of carotid chemoreceptors in intermittent hypoxia. Specific aims of the proposal are focused on: (1) to investigate the effect of proinflammatory cytokines on the NO production in the rat carotid body in intermittent hypoxia; (2) to examine the role of oxidative stress mediated by the inflammatory response to intermittent hypoxia in the decreased NO bioavailability in the carotid body and the pathophysiological consequence. Experimental studies with molecular analysis, intracellular calcium measurement, electrophysiology, electrochemistry and in-vivo assessment are proposed to examine the pathophysiological roles of the locally expressed cytokines in the NO deficit in the rat carotid body in intermittent hypoxia. In the light of the new findings, we will provide new insights into the molecular and cellular mechanisms underlying the pathophysiological roles of the inflammatory response of the carotid body to intermittent hypoxia. The new information would be the base for better understanding of the pathophysiology and for developing novel therapeutic strategies for patients suffered from sleep apnea and diseases associated with chronic intermittent hypoxia/hypoxemia. 阻塞性睡眠呼吸暫停（OSA）呼吸暫停和低通氣反复引起患者的 氧飽和度下降的反复發作。慢性間歇性低氧（CIH）在OSA綜合 徵導致內皮功能障礙，高血壓和心血管疾病發病率和死亡率增加 的風險的臨床表現顯著病理生理作用。在頸動脈主體外圍化學 感受器對缺氧以及在睡眠呼吸暫停的病理生理後果生理反應起 到關鍵作用。頸化學感受器活性通過間歇性缺氧在氧化應激和局 部炎症器官密切相關顯著增加。特別地，我們的研究表明： （1）炎性細胞因子，即白細胞介素（IL）-1 beta，IL-6，腫瘤 壞死因子（TNF）-alpha和它們的受體在頸動脈體表達和表達是 顯著在CIH大鼠增加; （2）細胞因子的升高細胞內鈣響應急性 缺氧在頸動脈體的化學敏感細胞，和（3）在CIH大鼠頸動脈體 一氧化氮（NO）的釋放的時間依賴性降低。這些數據表明， 在間歇性缺氧促炎細胞因子在局部炎症的積極作用和在頸動脈 體NO的缺乏。在該提案中，我推測，通過促炎細胞因子介導的 頸動脈身體有炎症發揮在器官減少NO的生物利用度，這有助於 頸動脈化學感受器的間歇性低氧的擴充活動的機械作用。該建 議的具體目的主要集中在：（1）以調查對在間歇性缺氧大鼠頸 動脈體NO生產促炎細胞因子的作用; （2）檢查通過向間歇性缺 氧的炎症反應介導的氧化應激的作用在頸動脈體降低的NO生物 利用度，和（3）確定在CIH大鼠頸動脈體的NO逆差的病理生理 後果。與分子分析，細胞內鈣的測量，電，電化學和體內評估 實驗研究提出審查在間歇性缺氧NO的在大鼠頸動脈體缺乏局部 表達細胞因子的病理生理作用。在這些新的發現，我們將提供 新的見解的頸動脈體的間歇性低氧的炎症反應的病理生理作用 的分子和細胞機制。新的信息將是更好地了解病理生理機制以 及開發新的治療策略從睡眠呼吸暫停和慢性間歇性低氧/低氧血 症有關的疾病患者。

17102516.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17102516.value: DNA損害反應 (DNA Damage Response, DDRs)能被細胞中眾多機制激活，對維修復DNA和維持基因組穩定起重要作用。然而, 過多的DDRs亦會引致基因組的變異重組，細胞週期阻滯, 細胞衰老甚至凋亡。因此, 針對DDRs的負向調節機制必須存在和運作，以維持細胞正常生長。 文獻指出, RNF169是在哺乳綱生物DDRs的負調節因子之一。通過和DNA雙股螺旋斷裂 (DNA double-strand breaks, DSBs)周邊的染色質域結合, RNF169能防止過多的DNA修復蛋白和DSBs區域結合，因而抑制過渡DSBs修復, 推動細胞週期行進。 以RNF169為起點, 是次研究成功發現去泛素酶USP7和RNF169的交互作用，和USP7對DDRs的間接調控作用。USP7能去除RNF169蛋白上的泛素，從而延長RNF169在DSBs區域的停留時間及其負向調節DDRs的效力。實驗證明，當細胞中的USP7被移除或被抑制活性，高精度DNA修復的頻率明顯降低，細胞亦更易被具有基因毒性的化學物質侵害。目前, 實驗表明USP7的去泛素活性能以前饋模式，通過和RNF169作用，成為細胞自我調控DDRs機制的重要部分之一。 是次研究將會探討USP7如何通過和RNF169互動，從而促進高精度DNA修復。此外，本項目將進一步探討USP7-RNF169交互作用於維持基因組穩定的功用，以及不受控的DDRs在DSB區域微環境的影響。 綜上所述，不受控的DDRs會對細胞基因組的穩定性和繁殖造成巨大威脅，從而引致如癌症等重大疾病。通過探討去泛素酶USP7-環指蛋白RNF169的調控作用，是次研究不僅增加對細胞DDRs內衡機制之認識，亦為開發新型癌症治療藥物提供新的標靶和知識基礎。

17102516.label: Major findings and research outcome
17102516.value: Our major findings were - 1) We have uncovered a novel NLS sequence with dual functions on the RNF169 polypeptide. The NLS not only shuttled RNF169 into the nucleus but also mediates its interaction with USP7 to promote its stability. 2) We have elucidated how RNF169 occupancy on the damaged chromatin actively regulates choice of DNA double-strand break repair pathways, a decision that is key to maintenance of genome stability.

17102516.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
17102516.value: We are now in the process of screening small molecules that may target the USP7-RNF169 interaction with the hope that this can sensitise cancerous cells to DNA damaging agents.

17102516.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
17102516.value: USP7 is often misregulated in human cancer. Our findings identified RNF169 as a bona fide USP7 substrate, and that USP7 stabilises RNF169 to promote cancer cell resistance to IR-induced DNA damage. Our work not only highlights the USP7-RNF169 axis as a potential driver of human tumorigenesis, but suggests that targeting the USP7-RNF169 interaction may represent a rational anti-cancer therapeutic intervention for the treatment of human cancers.

17102616.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17102616.value: Background Cognitive impairment is a core feature of schizophrenia that is strongly linked to poor outcomes. However, current pharmacological treatments have limited therapeutic effect on cognitive impairment, and non-pharmacological treatments require long training periods and expensive equipment leading to restricted clinical use. Emerging evidence has suggested that transcranial direct current stimulation (tDCS), a non-invasive brain stimulation technique, is effective in enhancing cognitive function in patients with medical conditions. Despite it is highly promising and affordable, critical issues concerning the number of tDCS session and how long the benefit of tDCS can last in patients with schizophrenia remain to be answered. Aim We aim to explore the cognitive enhancement effects of 10 active tDCS sessions and 5 active tDCS sessions over 2 weeks, and to study the effect over time of these cognitive enhancement in a 6-week, double-blind, randomized, controlled trial in patients with schizophrenia. We hypothesize that patients would have differential cognitive enhancement effects over 6 weeks: 10 tDCS sessions > 5 tDCS sessions > 10 sham tDCS sessions. Methods Ninety-three patients with schizophrenia will be randomly assigned to receive either one of the following treatment over a 2-week period: (1) 10 active tDCS sessions, (2) 5 sham tDCS sessions followed by 5 active tDCS sessions, and (3) 10 sham tDCS sessions. Randomization will be stratified using patients’ baseline intelligence score. Cognitive function, psychopathology, social functioning, and side effects will be assessed at baseline, and then on a weekly-basis until week 6. The effect of different tDCS sessions (two active arms and one control arm) on cognitive function over time, as well as their interaction effects, will be analyzed using the analysis of variance with repeated measures. Possible results and implications More research is warranted to explore the differential cognitive effects to different number of tDCS session in schizophrenia patients for clinical application of tDCS. Data from this study will enrich our understanding towards the optimal number of tDCS session and how long these cognitive benefits can last in patients with schizophrenia. This has potential to become a useful non-invasive adjunct treatment to improve cognitive function and promote recovery in patients with schizophrenia. 背景 認知障礙是精神分裂症中一個與惡劣功能結果密切相關的核心徵狀。然而，目前的藥物對認知障礙的治療效果有限，而非藥物治療需要長時間訓練和昂貴的設備，限制了其臨床應用。最近出現的研究證據指出，經頭顱直流電刺激（transcranial direct current stimulation, tDCS）是一種非入侵性腦部刺激技術，能有效地提高不同疾病患者的認知功能。儘管它具有潛在效用和可付擔的優點，有關tDCS的適當次數及其效用持續性的關鍵問題在精神分裂症患者中尚待解答。 目標 我們的目標是透過6週雙盲隨機對照研究比較2週內10次和5次tDCS對精神分裂症患者的認知增強效果和時間的影響。我們推測不同組別患者在6週內會有不同的認知 增強效果：10次 tDCS > 5次 tDCS > 10次 模擬tDCS 方法 九十三位精神分裂症患者將被隨機分配到任何一組，在2週的時間內接受以下的治療：（1）10次 tDCS，（2）5次模擬tDCS接著5次 tDCS，以及（3）10次模擬tDCS。 病人將根據基線智力分數進行分層隨機。認知功能，精神病理，社會功能和副作用將會在基線，然後每週評估直到第6週。不同次數的tDCS（兩個治療組和一個對照組）對認知功能隨時間的效果，以及它們相互作用的影響，將會以重複方差分析方法進行分析。 可能的結果和影響 為了tDCS的臨床應用，更多關於不同次數tDCS對認知功能的效果是必要的。這項研究的數據將提供我們對tDCS對精神分裂症患者的適當次數及效用持續性的理解。這非入侵性的輔助治療具有潛力成為將來改善精神分裂症患者的認知功能並促進康復的有用工具。

17102616.label: Major findings and research outcome
17102616.value: When comparing all the three groups with a mixed-model, Group×Time interactions were statistically significant in short-term memory and executive function. The effects of immediate recall of logical memory test (P<0.05) and animal naming of category fluency test (P<0.05) for the 10 active and 5 active tDCS groups remained significant when age, gender and education years were included as covariates. The effect sizes were mild-to-moderate for the 10 active and 5 active tDCS groups. The effects on cognition observed at week 2 in both intervention groups were maintained at week 6 follow-up. There were no significant changes in other domains of cognitive functions, including attention, speed of processing, visual learning and social cognition between the 3 groups at week 2 and week 6. We did not find significant changes in either psychotic symptoms (P=0.639) or mood symptoms (P=0.477). There were no significant changes in social functioning between the 3 groups (P=0.497).

17102616.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
17102616.value: The application of tDCS as adjunctive treatments for cognitive enhancement in psychosis is worthwhile to be considered in view of its potential benefit in short-term memory and executive function and relatively free of side effects.

17102616.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
17102616.value: Impairments of attention and memory are evident in psychosis even in early phase of illness, and are associated with functional disability. In a group of stable, medicated patients with psychosis, we explored whether participating in a non-invasive brain stimulation intervention (transcranial direct current stimulation, tDCS) improved cognitive functions, clinical symptoms and social functioning. A total of 93 patients with psychosis joined a 6-week randomized controlled study of 10 active tDCS or 5 active tDCS sessions compared with control group (10 sham tDCS sessions). The primary outcomes were cognitive functions. Secondary outcome measures were the severity of psychotic and depressive symptoms, and social functioning. Data from 93 patients were included in the final analysis based on the intention-to-treat principle. Both 10 active and 5 active tDCS groups demonstrated significant improvements in short-term memory (P<0.05) and executive function (P<0.005) with mild-to-moderate effect size compared with the control group. However, there were no significant changes in other domains of cognitive function, clinical symptoms and social functioning. The application of tDCS as adjunctive treatments for cognitive enhancement in psychosis is worthwhile to be considered in view of its potential benefit in short-term memory and executive function and relatively free of side effects. 17108416.label: Project Objectives
17108416.value: We will measure serum and tissue levels of acetate during progressive lupus nephritis in NZBWF1/J mice and delineate their correlation with clinical, serological and histological parameters of disease, with particular focus on apoptotic, inflammatory and fibrotic processes. Age- and sex-matched BALB/c mice will be used as controls. We will assess gut commensal bacterial profiles in NZBWF1/J mice using bacterial 16S ribosomal RNA gene analysis and ascertain whether changes in acetate levels during disease pathogenesis is a consequence of increased acetate-producing bacteria and/or changes in mucosal permeability. We will determine whether administrating acetate to pre-nephritic NZBWF1/J mice can exacerbate clinical, serological and histological parameters of disease. We will determine whether reducing microbiota load using broad-spectrum antibiotics can decrease acetate levels in the circulation and kidney and improve clinical, serological and histological parameters of disease. We will determine the functional role of GPR-41 and GPR-43 in mediating the effect of acetate in HK-2 cells. We will over-express GPR-41 and GPR-43 in HK-2 cells and determine their roles in cell proliferation, viability, activation and apoptosis, activation of signaling pathways and mediators of inflammation and fibrosis.

We will over-express GPR-41 and GPR-43 in HK-2 cells and determine their roles in cell proliferation, viability, activation and apoptosis, activation of signaling pathways and mediators of inflammation and fibrosis.

17108416.label: Realisation of objectives
17108416.value: The role of gut dysbiosis and acetate, a bacterial metabolite, in the pathogenesis of lupus nephritis has not been fully defined. In this project, we investigated the effect of acetate or broad-spectrum antibiotics on clinical, serological and histological parameters of disease in NZBWF1/J mice, an established murine model of lupus nephritis, focusing on inflammatory and fibrotic processes. Our project had five Objectives. We have completed Objectives 1, 2 and 4, and Objective 3 and 5 are 85% completed. One postgraduate student dropped out after 18 months since he wanted to follow a different career path, and a senior staff member assigned to this project left halfway through the study to work overseas. We envisage that Objectives 3 and 5 will be completed within 4 to 6 months. Objective 1: Acetate levels in serum, kidneys and colon specimens of female NZBWF1/J mice at different stages of disease were determined using a commercially available acetate assay. Mice were sacrificed at 8, 16, 24 and 32 weeks of age, which represented pre-nephritis, anti-dsDNA antibody production, onset of nephritis and severe histopathologic changes respectively. Age- and sex-matched BALB/c mice served as controls. Serum acetate level was significantly reduced in NZBWF1/J mice prior to the development of nephritis, and the level was further reduced in mice that manifested active nephritis compared to age-matched BALB/c mice (P<0.05). Serum acetate level inversely correlated with proteinuria, serum creatinine level, anti-dsDNA antibody level and IgG and C3 deposition in the glomeruli of mice with active nephritis. Similarly, renal acetate level was significantly decreased in pre-nephritic NZBWF1/J mice compared to BALB/c mice, and was further decreased when lupus-prone mice developed nephritis (P<0.05). There was no statistical difference between colon acetate level in BALB/c and NZBWF1/J mice throughout the study. Objective 2: Fecal DNA from NZBWF1/J and BALB/c mice was analyzed by 16S rRNA sequencing. Gut dysbiosis in NZBWF1/J mice was noted before the development of active nephritis, evidenced by an increase in alpha-diversity as expressed by the Shannon Index when compared to BALB/c mice (P<0.05). In BALB/c mice, at the phylum level, the relative abundance of Actinobacteria, Firmicutes and Bacteroidetes showed no change with age, while Proteobacteria decreased with age. In NZBWF1/J mice, disease progression was associated with decreased Gram-positive bacteria Actinobacteria and Firmicutes, and increased Gram-negative bacteria Bacteroides and Proteobacteria. Acetate is produced by most enteric bacteria including Lactobacillus spp, Bifidobacterium spp, Ruminococcus spp, and Bacteroides spp. Our study demonstrated that the relative abundance of Lactobacillus spp and Bifidobacterium spp were decreased in NZBWF1/J with active disease, whereas there was no change in Ruminococcus spp, and Bacteroides spp. Gut permeability was investigated using of dextran-FITC or LPS-FITC. Serum dextran-FITC and LPS-FITC levels were significantly higher in NZBWF1/J mice with active nephritis compared to pre-nephritic lupus-prone mice or age-matched BALB/c mice, and this was accompanied by a marked decrease in ZO-1 and claudin-1 expression. Further assessment of colon specimens demonstrated that mice with active nephritis had increased number of infiltrating cells in the lamina propria and the crypts were deficient of goblet cells. Objectives 3 and 4: We conducted two murine studies to investigate whether acetate can impact on clinical, serological and histological parameters of disease, and whether reducing gut microbiota burden using broad-spectrum antibiotics could alleviate or delay disease progression in NZBWF1/J mice. In the first study, eight week old female NZBWF1/J mice were randomized to receive drinking water (untreated mice) or with sodium acetate (200 mM) for 30 weeks after which time, blood was collected and kidneys and colons harvested. Age- and sex-matched BALB/c mice served as controls. In untreated NZBWF1/J mice, assessment of kidney histology showed mesangial expansion, immune cell infiltration, progressive glomerulosclerosis, tubular atrophy and interstitial fibrosis, the latter attributed in part to collagen and fibronectin accumulation. IgG and C3 immune complex deposition was predominantly localized to the glomeruli, with IgG staining also detected along the tubular basement membrane although to a lesser extent. Kidney specimens from NZBWF1/J mice with active disease showed increased GPR-41 and GRP-43 expression compared to BALB/c mice, and both were predominantly localized to proximal tubular epithelial cells. Disease progression was accompanied by deterioration of kidney function as indicated by an increase in serum creatinine level, proteinuria and production of anti-dsDNA antibodies. Acetate treatment delayed proteinuria by 3 weeks, reduced serum creatinine level and significantly improved kidney histology although in a proportion of acetate-treated mice, accumulation of matrix proteins in the glomerular and tubulo-interstitial compartments appeared more prominent than in untreated mice. Acetate did not affect anti-dsDNA antibody level or immune complex deposition in the kidney parenchyma. In the second murine study, eight week old NZBWF1/J mice were randomized to receive drinking water alone or drinking water containing ampicillin (1.0mg/ml) and neomycin (0.5mg/ml) for 18 weeks to investigate whether reducing the gut microbiota load could improve disease manifestations. The Shannon Index was significantly reduced in antibiotic-treated mice compared to untreated mice (P<0.001). Although onset of proteinuria was similar in both groups of mice, proteinuria was significantly reduced in antibiotic-treated mice (P<0.05). Antibiotic treatment also attenuated abnormalities observed in the kidney and colon, but had no effect on anti-dsDNA antibody level or serum acetate level. Objective 5: In NZBWF1/J mice with active disease, GPR-41 and GPR-43 expression was increased in proximal tubular epithelial cells. HK-2 cells are normal human proximal tubular epithelial cells immortalized by transduction with the human papilloma virus 16 E6/E7 genes. We generated HK-2 cells that overexpressed GPR-41 and GPR-43 and investigated the role of these short chain fatty acid receptors in inflammatory and fibrotic processes. GPR-41 and GPR-43 overexpression had no effect on cell viability or proliferation compared to non-transfected HK-2 cells or cells transfected with the empty vector. Incubation of non-transfected HK-2 cells with acetate at concentrations detected in the kidney (10 to 50 mM) increased MCP-1, IL-1β, IL-6 and IL-8 secretion, and decreased IL-10 secretion in a dose dependent manner, but had no effect on IFN-α, IFN-γ, IL-17A, IL-18, IL-23 or IL-33 secretion. Increased fibronectin expression is considered an early event in tubulo-interstitial fibrosis, and serves as a temporary scaffold for the deposition of other matrix proteins such as collagen and laminin. Acetate increased fibronectin, collagen type I and laminin expression in a time- and dose-dependent manner and was mediated through activation of the ERK, p38 MAPK, JNK, PKC, and PI3K signaling pathways. GPR-41 or GPR-43 overexpression further enhanced secretion of pro-inflammatory cytokines and matrix proteins, and the effect was more prominent with GPR-43 overexpression. In summary, our data demonstrated that lupus nephritis is associated with gut dysbiosis and antibiotic-driven depletion of the gut microbiota improved kidney histology and function. Acetate levels in serum and kidneys of NZBWF1/J mice with active disease was significantly reduced. While acetate treatment showed a possible beneficial effect on kidney histology and function in NZBWF1/J mice, GPR-41 and GPR-43 overexpression in proximal tubular epithelial cells may increase inflammatory and fibrotic processes. Differential concentrations of acetate in different organs may play important roles in determining its impact on disease progression.

17108416.label: Major findings and research outcome
17108416.value: In this study, we demonstrated that acetate levels in the serum and kidneys of NZBWF1/J mice with active disease were significantly decreased compared to non-autoimmune BALB/c mice and this was associated with deterioration of kidney histology and function. Increased gut permeability was also noted with translocation of FITC-dextran and FITC-LPS from the colon to the bloodstream and kidney, attributed in part by a decrease in the expression of the tight junctions ZO-1 and claudin-1. Active nephritis was associated with an increase in the relative abundance of Gram-negative bacteria Bacteroides and Proteobacteria, and a decrease in Actinobacteria and Firmicutes. Acetate-producing Lactobacillus spp and Bifidobacterium spp were reduced in mice with active nephritis, whereas Ruminococcus spp, and Bacteroides spp showed no change. Treatment of NZBWF1/J mice with broad-spectrum antibiotics improved kidney histology and function but had no effect on anti-dsDNA antibody level, suggesting that gut dysbiosis contributes to active nephritis. Depletion of the gut microbiota also improved colon histology and significantly reduced gut permeability, but had no apparent effect on serum acetate level. In a separate study, treatment of NZBWF1/J mice with acetate also improved kidney histology and function compared to untreated mice, although a proportion of acetate-treated mice showed increased collagen deposition in glomeruli and interstitium. GPR-41 and GPR-43 are receptors for acetate and both receptors were increased in the kidneys of lupus-prone mice, localized to proximal tubular epithelial cells. We next generated HK-2 cells that overexpressed GPR-41 and GPR-43, and demonstrated that in the absence of any stimuli, both receptors contributed to increased MCP-1, IL-1beta, IL-6 and IL-8 secretion, and fibronectin expression, and these inflammatory and fibrogenic processes were further exacerbated in the presence of acetate, mediated in part, through increased activation of MAPK and PI3K signaling pathways. Taken together, our findings demonstrated that gut dysbiosis contributes to inflammatory and fibrotic processes in the kidney and depletion of the gut microbiota or supplementation with acetate improved kidney histology and function, although GPR-41 and GPR-43 overexpression may facilitate acetate-induced inflammation and fibrosis in proximal tubular epithelial cells. Part of these findings have been presented at the American Society of Nephrology Kidney Week (top-ranked international nephrology conference) in 2019 and 2021.

17108416.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
17108416.value: Based on our findings from this project, we demonstrated that there is an increase in the relative abundance of Gram-negative bacteria and a reduction in Gram-positive bacteria in NZBWF1/J mice with active nephritis, and this is associated with deterioration of kidney function and histology. This study focused predominately on the role of acetate in proximal tubular epithelial cells. There is evidence that acetate may impact on subpopulations of immune cells and alter immune responses in health and disease. We conducted preliminary studies to investigate the effect of acetate on peripheral mononuclear cells and demonstrated that acetate decreased M1 and M2 macrophages, B cells and T cells compared to untreated mice. It is possible that acetate can reduce systemic inflammation although further studies are warranted to confirm this. We will perform further preliminary studies, and if the results are encouraging, we will submit the preliminary data to the RGC General Research Fund 2023/2024 application round for consideration of funding.

17108416.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
17108416.value: Lupus nephritis is one of the most severe manifestations of systemic lupus erythematosus, an autoimmune disease characterized by a loss of self-tolerance, production of autoantibodies, and immune-mediated kidney injury. Insight into the underlying mechanisms that contribute to disease pathogenesis may offer novel targets for therapeutic intervention. Emerging evidence suggests that the gut microbiota and its metabolites may contribute to lupus nephritis. Acetate is a short chain fatty acid generated by fermentation of dietary fibre and it exerts different effects on immune and non-immune cells depending on the cell type and acetate concentration. In this project, we demonstrated that lupus-prone mice have a leaky gut, and acetate can enter the bloodstream from the colon. Serum acetate level is reduced in lupus-prone mice with active disease compared to control mice, and this is associated with deterioration of kidney structure and function. Administration of acetate or depletion of the altered gut microbiota in lupus-prone mice improved kidney structure and function. Receptors that bind acetate are called GPR-41 and GPR-43. These receptors are increased in the kidney of lupus-prone mice and together with acetate, contribute to kidney inflammation and fibrosis. The differential concentrations of acetate in different organs may determine its impact on disease progression.
