17164416.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17164416.value: 心臟房室傳導阻滯是一種可致命的心律不正。到目前為止，唯一有效的治療心臟房室傳導阻滯是植入電子起搏器。在香港，每年有超過 1,300宗電子心臟起搏器植入手術，其中大約百分之五十是用於房室傳導阻滯病人上。 雖然電子心臟起搏器能有效治療心臟房室傳導阻滯，但由於其有限的電池壽命，需要定期更換、 缺乏生理反應能力，及其相關的外科手術和導線引發的併發症等不足之處促使醫生及科學家搜索生物起搏器。我們的團隊已成功地建造人工生物竇房結心臟起搏器及在大型動物病竇綜合征模型中成功取代電子心臟起搏器。但竇房結的主要生理功是自發產生心臟起搏，心臟房室結主要功能是將心房電脈衝像電纜般以適當的生理傳導速度連接至心室。因此，創造人工生物房室結起搏器面臨的挑戰不僅相關要細胞的電生理特性，還要精確地安排這些細胞在三維宏觀結構中有效地傳導電脈衝來彌合心房和心室。未能建立三維度細胞網將嚴重阻礙了人工生物心臟房室結起搏器治療的前景。 在過去十年裡，通過誘導多功能幹細胞的發展提供可能組織再生提供了無限的自體的細胞來源。此外，三維度生物列印技術的進步使得製作功能的三維組織結構可以整合這兩個微型功能進行適當的細胞功能和宏觀力學和輸運性質可能。在這裡我們建議使用先進的三維度生物列印技術和誘導多能性幹細胞技術的組合來重建心臟房室結; 及有計劃地在我們最近設立的先天性房室傳導阻滯鼠(LMNA)模型評價其功能。這包括自主神經的回應能力等。結果從這項工作獲得將改善當前生物-人工起搏器的知識和經驗允許更好的下一代的生物人工起搏器，隨後可能會導致新的有效治療方法作為輔助治療或甚至更換電子心臟起搏器的設計。

17164416.label: Realisation of objectives
17164416.value: Atrio-ventricular (AV) conduction block (AV block) occurs when electric transmission through the atrio-ventricular node (AVN) is impaired. Conventionally, restoration of synchronized contraction in patients with AV block could be achieved by the implementation of electronic pacemaker at the ventricular region, although effective such approach is associated with significant health risks of infection, arrhythmia, or death. Other limitations include the need for periodic battery and lead replacements, lack of autonomic neuro-humoral responsiveness, and difficulties with implantation in young patients with small and growing hearts. Development of a biological pacemaker or AV bypass offers great advantages as an alternative therapy for heart block by overcoming the limitations of electronic pacemakers. This project aims at fabricating the cardiac muscle strips for AVN regeneration. We have accomplished objective 1 by successfully fabricated a functional bio-artificial AVN using 3D bio-printing and iPSC technologies, followed by detail molecular and electrophysiological assessments. Human iPSC-derived cardiomyocytes with high purity were well aligned on the 2D and 3D cardiac muscle strips with synchronized contraction and high expression level of cardiac markers. The results suggested that cell patterning induced better cardiomyocyte maturation, differentiation, and calcium handling properties than the unpatterned cardiac cell cluster under normal culture conditions. Furthermore, the optical mapping analysis showed that the hiPSC-derived cardiomyocytes on the muscle strips not only had intrinsic rhythm, but also responded to the external pacing with higher frequency, which demonstrate their ability to work as a secondary pacemaker. In order to reduce the amount of animal used and increase the cost-effectiveness as well as the reproducibility of the experiments, we designed not to use transgenic mice with LMNA gene mutation as the AV block model. Instead, we evaluated the ability of the 3D cardiac muscle strip to provide an alternative conduit to electrically connect the atria and ventricle during AV block by implanted the muscle strips onto the heart of rats subjected to ATP-induced AV block. The 3D cardiac muscle strips remained intact with high cell viability 2 weeks after implantation. Importantly, the implantation of 3D cardiac muscle strips relieved the complete AV block induced by bolus injection of ATP, suggesting the establishment of alternative electrical conduits that connected the atria and ventricle.

17164416.label: Major findings and research outcome
17164416.value: In this project, we established a novel method to fabricated engineered cardiac muscle strips with hiPSC-derived cardiomyocytes using 3D bio-printing technology. Our findings not only demonstrated that the 3D cardiac strip could form an “electrical conduit” that conducted the electrical impulse from one end to the other in vitro, but also provided important evidence for the ability of these fabricated cardiac muscle strips serve as biological pacemakers that restoring complete AV block in rat model. In this study, high purity hiPSC-derived cardiomyocytes was generated and used as the cell sources for AVN fabrication. The data showed that the iPSC-derived cardiomyocytes were well aligned in both of the 2D and 3D cardiac muscle strips with synchronized contraction and higher expression level of cardiac markers, when compared with a cardiomyocyte cluster cultured under normal conditions. The optical mapping data demonstrated that the cardiac muscle strips were closely electrically coupled with the electrical impulse propagated linearly along the long axes of the cell alignment, responding to the external higher frequency pacing, which have similar conduction velocity to that of native tissue. To further investigate the potential as biological AV bypass in vivo, the 3D cardiac muscle strips were implanted into the heart of rats subjected to drug-induced heart block. Two weeks after the implantation, the 3D cardiac muscle strips were found to be intact with the vascular formation and few inflammatory cells as demonstrated by the Trichrome and H&E staining. The survival of cell engraftment was also traced by immune-histochemical staining of human cell nucleic antigen (HNA). To further evaluate the ability of the implanted cardiac muscle to provide an alternative conduit to electrically connect the atria and ventricle during AV block, a transient AV block was generated in the SD rat by rapid intravenous bolus administration of adenosine triphosphate (ATP).The finding showed that ATP induced less transient complete block in rats implanted with 3D cardiac muscle strips with a significantly shorter maximum R-R interval than in the normal rats, suggesting the existence of an alternative conduction pathway during AV block in the rat hearts implanted with cardiac muscle strips. The findings were presented by a PhD student in two international conferences and the manuscript is in preparation and will be submitted to peer-reviewed scientific journal. (See attachment in Part C).

17164416.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
17164416.value: Development of a biological pacemaker or AV bypass offers great advantages as an alternative therapy for heart block by overcoming the limitations of electronic pacemakers. Our proof-of-concept study demonstrated that 3D cardiac muscle strips generated by bio-printing technology can resemble the native conduction tissue in terms of cellular structure and electro-physiology, which can be used as a model for regenerative medicine, drug screening, and heart disease modeling.

17164416.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
17164416.value: In this study, we proposed a novel method to fabricate a biological pacemaker that could restore AV conduction during AV block. The 3D cardiac muscle strips generated by 3D bio-printing and hiPSC technologies had well-organized, mature cardiac ultrastructure with spontaneous firing properties. When implanted onto the rat heart, the engineered cardiac muscle strips alleviated the transient AV block induced by bolus injection of ATP. These data demonstrated the potential of engineered cardiac muscle strips to serve as AV bypass for treatment of heart block.

17164716.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17164716.value: 稻米是世界一半人口，特别亚洲人口的主食。中国是最大的水稻生产国，每年生产稻谷两亿吨左右。除产量外，稻米品质改良已经成为水稻育种的重要目标。我们的在研项目开展一些重要测定技术如线切割、剥离测试、循环机械测试、剪刀切割等以及原子力显微镜数据的遗传基础，以期增进稻米食用品质的预测能力。这些结果将补充传统的稻米理化特性的信息。但是，还需要这些将物理参数结合米饭中与味觉和嗅觉感官参数有关的挥发物数据，才能建立全面的与感官品尝评定数据的关系。因此，本项目我们将米饭挥发物的味觉与嗅觉的信息与感官分析相结合。 将基于精确理解的米饭食用品质与目标感官参数相结合的水稻育种将提供给稻米消费者更多的选择。为了将理想的感官参数有效地转化到中国的水稻品种中，我们需要相关性状的更多信息，以供育种选择。我们还需要分子标记用于在幼苗期更大群体中筛选这些性状。米饭感官品质的遗传分析目前还没有充分研究，使之用于中国水稻育种材料的有效选择。 本项目的研究目标是： 1.建立利用感官评定、电子鼻、电子舌评价米饭挥发物的感官品质 2.利用高分辨率的气相色谱及气相/质谱鉴定米饭挥发物的方法。 3.米饭感官品质的全基因组关联分析。 4.建立分子标记辅助选择体系，有效地管理多组分性状选择并与米饭理想感官品质有关的挥发物和米饭质地参数相结合。

17164716.label: Realisation of objectives
17164716.value: Database development of the sequence data, the marker association data, and the volatile analysis has been completed. Further compilation and interpretation of the results is required. Rice eating and cooking quality is largely determined by starch physicochemical properties and volatile components. The diverse accessions in the USDA rice mini-core collection (URMC) facilitate extensive association analysis of starch physicochemical properties and volatiles with molecular markers specific to starch biosynthesis related genes. To identify significant trait-marker associations that can be utilized in rice breeding programs for improved starch quality and volatile chemical composition, we conducted two association analyses between 26 molecular markers derived from starch biosynthesis related genes and 18 parameters measured of starch physicochemical properties in two sets of the mini-core accessions successfully grown in two environments in China. Many significant trait-marker associations (P < 0.001) were detected in both association analyses. Five markers of Waxy gene, including the (CT)(n) repeats, the G/T SNP of intron 1, the 23 bp sequence duplication (InDel) of exon 2, the A/C SNP of exon 6, and the C/T SNP of exon 10, were found to be primarily associated with starch traits related to apparent amylose content (AAC), and two markers targeting the 4,3294,330 bp GC/TT SNPs and 4,198 bp G/A SNP of SSIIa gene were mainly associated with traits related to gelatinization temperature (GT). Two new haplotypes were found in the mini-core collection based on the combinations of the 23 bp InDel and three SNPs (G/T of intron 1, A/C of exon 6, and C/T of exon 10) of Waxy gene. Furthermore, our analyses indicated that the (CT)(n) polymorphisms of Waxy gene had a non-negligible effect on AAC related traits, as evidenced by significant variation in AAC related traits among rice accessions with the same Waxy SNPs but different (CT)(n) repeats. As the five Waxy markers and the two SSIIa markers showed consistent major effects on starch quality traits across studies, these markers should have priority for utilization in marker-assisted breeding. These approaches have been repeated for the volatile compounds and results are being compiled. This is a highly complex project and full completion within 2 years was not completely achieved. However, good progress was made and the original PI will continue to collaborate to pursue this overall project for the benefit of rice development in China.

17164716.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
17164716.value: Rice quality is increasingly important as consumers in China have greater ability to seek and afford premium grain. The main components of eating quality are textural (e.g. hardness or stickiness) which are essentially due to properties of starch structure and organization, and aroma-taste which are the result of mostly the composition and relative abundance of volatile aromatic compounds. Different human populations (national, regional, cultural) have different preferences for rice quality. A breeder may develop a high yielding agronomically good variety which is suitable for the tastes of only a limited number of people. With full understanding of the genetic basis and expression of rice quality parameters, breeders could quickly develop new isogenic lines of the good variety, using marker facilitated selection. We are attempting to offer guidance for full understanding of quality needs of consumers, and guidance for understanding the genetic basis of these quality needs.

17166016.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17166016.value: Obesity, which is caused by long-term energy imbalance when calories consumed exceeds calories expended, is a major risk factor for type 2 diabetes, cardiovascular diseases and many types of cancer. While the main function of white adipose tissue (WAT) is to store excess energy, brown adipose tissue (BAT), which is characterized by multi-locular vacuoles, high number of mitochondria and the presence of unique mitochondrial inner membrane protein uncoupling protein-1 (UCP-1), dissipates energy as heat. BAT-mediated adaptive thermogenesis represents is an important defense mechanism in response to cold environment or nutrient surplus for protection against hypothermia or excessive weight gain. A growing body of evidences suggests that enhancing the activity or biogenesis of brown adipocytes is a promising therapy to combat obesity and its related medical complications. FGF21 is a metabolic hormone with pleiotropic protective effects against a cluster of obesity-related cardiometabolic complications, including reduction of fat mass, hyperglycemia, hyperlipidemia, fatty liver, and atherosclerosis. We have recently found a markedly increased FGF21 expression in white adipose tissues in response to cold challenge (a commonly-used thermogenic stimulus). Furthermore, cold stress-induced browning and thermogenesis in subcutaneous WAT is severely impaired in mice with genetic depletion of FGF21 in adipose tissues, but not in liver. These impairments in adipose-selective FGF21 knockout mice were accompanied by decreased production of several type-2 cytokines and reduced number of adipocyte progenitor cells. In this study, we aim to test our hypothesis that adipocyte-secreted FGF21 is an obligatory mediator of cold stress-induced browning and theromogenesis in subcutaneous WAT, by acting in an autocrine manner to promote the secretion of IL33 and adiponectin, which in turn stimulate the production of type-2 cytokines and mediate the crosstalk between adipocytes and adipose-resident immune cells. To this end, we will employ several unique genetically-modified mouse models established in our laboratory to investigate the receptor and postreceptor signaling events underlying the browning effects of FGF21 in subcutaneous WAT, and will interrogate how FGF21 coordinates with other immunomodulatory cytokines to activate the thermogenic program by enhancing the biogenesis of brown progenitor cells. The findings will not only enrich our understanding on biology and physiology of adaptive thermogenesis, but also provide knowledge base for future development of FGF21 or its agonists as a drug to combat obesity and its associated medical complications. 肥胖症是一种因长期热量过剩导致的慢性疾病，常可引起包括2型糖尿病，心血管疾病及癌症在内的多种并发症。白色脂肪主要用于储存热量，而棕色脂肪因含有大量的线粒体和一种独特的线粒体内膜蛋白uncoupling protein1（UCP1）能够以热能的形式消耗热量。因此，棕色脂肪介导的适应性产热是一种防御机制，这种防御机制能够在寒冷环境和热量过剩的条件下抵抗身体失温和体重增加。越来越多的证据表明提高棕色脂肪的产生和活性可以作为治疗肥胖症及其相关并发症的有效疗法。 成纤维细胞生长因子21（FGF21）是一种多效性的代谢调控因子，它可以抵抗包括肥胖，高血糖，高血脂，脂肪肝及动脉粥样硬化在内的一系列与肥胖相关的心血管及代谢性疾病。我们最近的研究表明在低温情况下（一种常用的产热刺激条件），FGF21在白色脂肪中的表达水平显著增加。此外，只有在脂肪特异性FGF21敲除小鼠，而非肝脏特异性FGF21敲除小鼠中存在低温诱导的白色脂肪棕色化和适应性产热方面的功能障碍。上述功能障碍还伴随着几种2型免疫细胞因子和脂肪细胞祖细胞的减少。因此，我们提出了以下假设：在低温诱导条件下，FGF21自脂肪细胞产生，进而以自分泌方式来提高IL-33和脂联素（adiponectin）在脂肪细胞的产量，最终通过调节脂肪细胞和脂肪局部的免疫细胞之间的对话来促进白色脂肪向棕色脂肪的转化和适应性产热。为了验证这一假设，我们拟采用本实验室建立的一系列独特的基因改造小鼠模型来阐明在皮下脂肪中，FGF21在调控白色脂肪棕色化方面的功能及其作用的信号通路。此外，我们还将研究FGF21如何与免疫调节细胞因子协同作用，通过促进棕色脂肪细胞祖细胞的产生来启动适应性产热程序。这些研究成果不仅会加强我们对适应性产热的生理过程的理解，也会为进一步推进FGF21及其类似物作为一个新型肥胖症及其相关并发症治疗候选药物研究提供强有力的理论依据。

17166016.label: Realisation of objectives
17166016.value: 1. Objective-1: To interrogate the involvement of immune cells and type-2 cytokines in mediating cold-induced beiging and thermogenic activities of FGF21 in subcutaneous white adipose tissue (scWAT). Using adipose-selective FGF21 knockout (A-FGF21KO) mice generated from our laboratory, we have used flow cytometry, immunocytochemistry and real-time PCR to analyze the abundance, frequency and expression levels of several type-2 immune cells (eosinophils, ILC2s and M2 macrophages) and a panel of cytokines (IL4, IL13, IL5, IL33 and MetEnk) in in stromal vascular fraction (SVFs) of scWAT, in comparison with wild-type littermates (WT) housed under either thermos-neutral (30°C) or cold temperature (6°C) for 2 and 7 days). Our results demonstrated that cold exposure induced a marked elevation in the abundance of Siglec-F+ cd11b+ eosinophils and cd11clowcd206high M2 macrophages, but had no effect on ILC2 cells. Furthermore, chronic cold exposure induced the expression of several eosinophils and ILC2 cells-derived cytokines, including IL4, IL14, IL33 and MetEnk. Notably, all these stimulatory effects of cold exposure on recruitment of eosinophils and M2 macrophages in subcutaneous WAT (scWAT) were largely abrogated in A-FGF21KO mice. We further performed adoptive cell transfer experiments and confirmed that replenishment with either eosinophils or M2 macrophages was sufficient to partially reverse the impairment in cold-induced beiging of scWAT in A-FGF21KO mice, suggesting that eosinophils, M2 macrophages and their derived cytokines are obligatory downstream effectors of FGF21. Furthermore, local injection of IL4/IL13 was able to reverse the impairment of cold-induced browning in A-FGF21KO mice, further supporting the key roles of type-2 immune responses as a downstream target of FGF21 mediating cold-induced beiging of scWAT. 2. Objective-2: to employ adipocyte-specific βklotho knockout mice to determine whether the autocrine actions of FGF21 in mature adipocytes is required for its beiging effects in scWAT: To investigate whether the autocrine actions of FGF21 in mature adipocytes are important for beiging, we generated adipocyte-specific β-klotho (a co-receptor for FGF21) knockout (A-KLBKO) mice in C57BL/6J background, and compared the beiging and thermogenesis of scWAT between A-KLBKO mice and WT littermates exposed to cold temperature (6°C) for various periods, followed by immunohistochemistry, flow cytometry, Western blots, biochemical analysis for oxygen consumption. Our results demonstrated that cold-induced beiging of scWAT was markedly attenuated in A-KLBKO mice, as evidenced by reduced UCP1 expression, much less multi-locular cells, lower oxygen consumption and body temperature at the inguinal region, accompanied by impaired recruitment of eosinophils and M2 macrophages, and production of several type-2 cytokines. Furthermore, by using osmotic pumps for chronic delivery of recombinant mouse FGF21 (rmFGF21), we found that replenishment of rmFGF21 enhanced the effects of cold challenge in beiging of scWAT in A-FGF21KO mice, whereas A-KLBKO mice were refractory to the beiging and thermogenic effects of FGF21, suggesting that the autocrine actions of FGF21 in mature adipocytes are obligatory for its beginning activity in scWAT. On the other hand, Cold-induced thermogenic activity of interscapular brown adipose tissue (BAT) was not affected in either A-FGF21KO mice or A-KLBKO mice. 3. Objective-3: To investigate whether replenishment with recombinant IL33 and/or adiponectin can reverse the defects of cold-induced beiging and thermogenesis in FGF21-AKO mice: We have generated endotoxin-free recombinant mouse IL33 (rmIL33) and mouse adiponectin (rmADN), and chronically administrated into A-FGF21KO mice for two weeks using Alzet osmotic pumps, followed by measurement of cold temperature-induced beiging of scWAT as described above. Our results demonstrated that treatment with neither rmIL33 nor rmADN restored the impairment in cold-induced beiging of scWAT, suggesting that these two circulating cytokines/adipokines are not the downstream effector of FGF21 in adipocytes. By using omics-based analysis, we identified the chemokine CCL11 as a downstream target of FGF21 in white adipocytes, Importantly, we found that direct injection of rmCCL11 into the inguinal region was sufficient to reverse the defect of cold-induced activation of type-2 immunity and beiging of scWAT, Using FGF21-deficient and A-KLBKO adipocytes, we discovered a novel mechanism whereby FGF21 acts in an autocrine manner to mediate beiging of scWAT: adipocytes-secreted FGF21 promotes the secretion of CCL11 through activation of ERK1/2, thereby recruiting eosinophils into scWAT to create a micro-immune environment favorable for beiging and thermogenesis. 4. Objective-4: To further explore the roles of adipose-derived FGF21 in beiging and thermogenesis of scWAT induced by different pharmacological and physiological stimuli: We tested the role of adipcyte-secreted FGF21 in physical exercise, cold exposure and the β3 agonist CL316243-induced beiging of scWAT. Our result demonstrated that 12-week high intensity exercise- and CL316243-induced beiging and thermogenesis were comparable between A-FGF21KO mice and wild-type littermates, as measured by immunocytochemistry, real-time PCR for thermogenic genes, OCR etc. Only cold exposure-induced beiging and thermogenesis of scWAT was compromised in A-FGF21KO mice. These findings suggest that the role of FGF21 in mediating the beiging of scWAT is highly specific to cold exposure.

17166016.label: Major findings and research outcome
17166016.value: This study uncovered a novel role of adipose-secreted FGF21 in mediating the adaptation of cold exposure in triggering thermogenesis and heat production by coupling neurological and immunological signals, as summarized below. 1. Cold exposure leads to an over 60-fold elevation of FGF21 expression in mature adipocytes of subcutaneous WAT, but not in epididymal WAT (which is resistant to beiging) and liver; 2. Mice with deficiency in the FGF21 signaling cascade in adipocytes, including adipose-selective FGF21 knockout (A-FGF21KO) mice and adipose-selective β-Klotho knockout (A-KLBKO) mice display severely impaired beiging and adaptive thermogenesis in scWAT during cold exposure; whereas liver-selective FGF21 knockout (L-FGF21KO) mice show normal cold-induced beige cell formation; 3. The defects in beiging and adaptive thermogenesis in A-FGF21KO and A-KLBKO mice are associated with a marked reduction in accumulation of eosinophils and their effector cells, including alternatively activated M2 macrophages and adipocyte progenitors in scWAT after cold exposure; 4. Mechanistically, adipose-derived FGF21 acts directly on mature adipocytes through β-Klotho ( a co-receptor of FGF21) in an autocrine manner to induce the production of the chemoattractant C-C motif chemokine ligand 11 (CCL11) via ERK1/2, which promotes the recruitment of eosinophils into scWAT, leading to beige cell formation in scWAT; 5. Neutralization of endogenous CCL11 in scWAT by local injection of a monoclonal antibody against CCL11 abrogates the effects of FGF21 on recruitment of eosinophils and consequent beiging of scWAT during cold challenge in mice; 6. Conversely, replenishment of recombinant CCL11 in scWAT of A-FGF21KO mice rescues impaired cold-induced type 2 immune activation and beiging of scWAT; In summary, our study identifies the FGF21-CCL11 axis in adipocytes as a thermogenic circuit that drives the beiging reprogramming in scWAT by coupling neuronal and immunological systems with adipose physiology. The findings shed new light on how the neuronal system controls type 2 immune responses in adipose tissues to regulate energy homeostasis. This part of work has been published in Cell Metabolism (see part-C, publication-1 & Research output Award, Part C-other impact). 7. In addition, we have demonstrated a novel function of adipocyte SIRT1 in controlling systemic insulin sensitivity by modulating macrophages in adipose tissue. SIRT1 in adipocytes modulates expression and secretion of several adipokines, including adiponectin, MCP-1, and interleukin-4, which in turn alters recruitment and polarization of the macrophages in adipose tissues. These findings suggest that adipocyte SIRT1 controls systemic glucose homeostasis and insulin sensitivity via the cross talk with adipose-resident macrophages. (See Part-C, publication-2 in EMBO Report, 2017).

17166016.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
17166016.value: In contrast to white adipocytes which store energy as triglycerides, brown and beige adipocytes dissipate energy as heat, and possess multiple metabolic benefits. Therapeutic/Browning (bieging) of white adipose tissue (WAT) has become an attractive strategy to combat obesity and its related medical complications. In this study, we uncovered a novel link whereby adipocyte-secreted hormone FGF21 couples sympathetic nerves to type-2 immunity in the regulation of cold temperature-induced beiging and adaptive thermogenesis of WAT. Our findings open a new field in the neuroimmune crosstalk for metabolic regulation as well as immunometabolism. It also creates great opportunities for exploration of how micro-environments, especially secreted factors, modulate adipose biology and physiology. We have obtained a RGC Area of Excellence (AOE728/18-M) to further expand the study of this exciting area, with the long-term objectives of developing more effective therapies for obesity-related cardiometabolic diseases by converting white adipocytes to brown/beige adipocytes.

17166016.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
17166016.value: FGF21 is an important metabolic hormones with pleiotropic salutary effects on obesity-related disorders, including weight reduction, lowering of blood glucose and lipid levels and cardiovascular protection. Although liver is traditionally considered as the main site for production of FGF21, we detected the expression of FGF21 in white adipose tissue (WAT) of both mice and humans, and have identified adiponectin as a downstream effector mediating the metabolic effects of FGF21 on insulin sensitivity and glucose tolerance in mice In this study, we uncovered a novel regulatory role of FGF21 on type-2 immunity in WAT to control beiging upon cold exposure. We found that cold exposure led to a marked elevation of FGF21 expression in WAT. Mice with adipose-selective deficiency of FGF21 exhibited severely impaired beiging and type-2 immune response in their WAT during cold exposure. Mechanistically, FGF21 acted on adipocytes in an autocrine manner to promote the secretion of the chemokine CCL11, which drove the recruitment of eosinophils into WAT, leading to increased accumulation of M2 macrophages, and proliferation and commitment of adipocyte precursors into beige adipocytes. These findings shed new light on how the humoral factor FGF21 controls type-2 immune responses in WAT to regulate beiging. It also raises the possibility that targeting CCL11 in WAT may represent a promising therapeutic strategy to combat obesity and its related metabolic diseases.

17204516.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17204516.value: 將低溫熱能（<100℃）有效地轉化為電能是一個很大的挑戰。目前可用的熱電轉換裝置，如半導體熱電材料，在低溫差狀態下操作達到的效率不超過幾個百分比（<3％）。這個項目將研究電化學熱電容循環（TCEC）將低溫熱能轉化為電能。TCEC技術利用在碳電極/電解質界面的雙電層（EDL）隨溫度的改變，通過加熱和冷卻改變EDL厚度產生電容變化，進而轉化成電能。理論模型證明TCEC的熱電轉化效率，在低溫度範圍內比熱電材料高，但這個尚未以實驗證實。在我們的初步實驗中，使用活性炭電極的電容器在10℃和65℃之間循環，得到效率約3.05％。這些結果證實此方法的可行性和有效性。接下來，TCEC技術的主要問題是漏電引起的能量損失。此外，每個循環一開始需要充電，令系統的設計變得複雜，也限制了許多應用。因此，免充電TCEC裝置乃下一目標。 為避免源於活性炭細孔的緩慢離子擴散以及局部重疊EDL的問題，本項目將採用以溶液法製作之摻氮石墨烯納米薄片來製作碳電極。我們曾發表官能基能吸附在炭電極上的熱電效應之動力學的研究，該成果有助於本項目有關控制炭電極之正/負熱能電位差與自生電位的探討。本項目將致力發展製作高效能TCEC，利用強酸官能化的石墨烯電極以減低漏電，也將運用非對稱官能化石墨烯正負電極，來發展免充電TCEC。此外，本項目亦將研究炭表面官能基與溫度的關聯，及官能基受熱而產生之電位變化。有鑑於學界對EDL的熱/電化學反應的研究才剛起步，相信本項目能有效推動日後使用電化學循環回收低溫熱能之發展。

17204516.label: Realisation of objectives
17204516.value: We investigated thermal capacitive electrochemical cycle (TCEC) on commercial supercapacitor, activated carbon based supercapacitor and MEG based supercapacitor. TCEC on commercial supercapacitor gave a low conversion efficiency (<1%), which was resulted from the nonuniform heating on cylinder-type structure. In order to maximize the thermal voltage rise, and then subsequent discharge, we built up a homemade temperature control system and employed a two-electrode configuration cell based on activated carbon, which successfully enhanced the thermoelectric efficiency to a higher level of 3.05%. It was illustrated that the performance could be further improved as if we could decrease the energy loss resulted from the charge leakage. Self potential of MEG was tuned by nitric acid treatment. Pouch cell of MEG as cathode and HNO3-treated MEG showed a larger temperature coefficient and a climbing energy conversion efficiency of 3.95% while TCEC on it had a better durability and stability with an over 80% coulombic efficiency. This work proved that TCEC is a cost-effective electrochemical heat engine as it could use readily available carbon materials and operate without expensive ion-selective membranes. A TCEC is expected to have a faster cycle time than a TREC because the equilibration time to achieve a fully charged EDL and the CDLE response time are on a scale of minutes. Meanwhile, adjusting the concentration of strong acid group on the carbon electrode was proved to be an effectual way to increase the potential difference between the charged electrode and its self potential, which provides opportunities for TCEC optimization. A thermal cycle can be achieved with adequate mechanical design; for example, a heat wheel equipped with an electrochemical cell rotating between a hot and cold side, which could broaden the application of this technology in industry. Unlike temperature gradient technologies operating at low temperature differentials, the isothermal operation of a thermal cycle enables effective heat recuperation (50-70%) from the cooling process back to the heating process, which can considerably boost overall system efficiency.

17204516.label: Major findings and research outcome
17204516.value: This funding supported us to develop a thermal capacitive electrochemical cycle (TCEC) based on the carbon-supercapacitor system. TCEC technology is a cost-effective method for exploiting the temperature-dependent electrostatic potential in an electric double layer (EDL) at carbon electrode/electrolyte interfaces; it produces net electricity by altering the EDL thickness via heating and cooling. Pouch cell of MEG as anode and HNO3-treated MEG as cathode showed a good energy conversion efficiency of 3.05%. This funding also initiated us to develop a charging-free system, named direct thermal charging cell (DTCC) for converting low-grade heat to electricity. DTCC uses asymmetric electrodes of a graphene oxide/platinum nanoparticles cathode and a polyaniline anode in Fe2+/Fe3+ redox electrolyte via isothermal heating operation. DTCC attain a temperature coefficient of 5.0 mV K−1 and heat-to-electricity conversion efficiency of 2.8% at 70 °C (21.4% of Carnot efficiency) and 3.52% at 90 °C (19.7% of Carnot efficiency), outperforming other thermoelectrochemical and thermoelectric systems.

17204516.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
17204516.value: The technology will be further developed toward operation at human skin temperature (~32°C) for body-heat harvesting for self-powered sensing electronics, by searching for a new anode material with large negative temperature coefficient and small anodic onset potential, and engineer redox couples with large entropy change to better improve device performance, cycling stability, and operating temperature window.

17204516.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
17204516.value: The electrochemical heat-to-electricity converter is invented for efficiently converting low-grade heat to electricity. The technology has uniqueness and advantages for practical application including a wide operation window, isothermal and continuous charging/discharging operation, low-cost, bendable, simple system and the ability to form stacks of cells. By collaborating with industries, the invention has been moved from academic research toward real products in various applications, such as HVAC, smart window and self-powered/wearable technologies. It may open many new applications, bringing tangible economic and environmental benefits.

17206916.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17206916.value: Osteoarthritis (OA) is a degenerative disease of the joints that leads to morbidity. Due to limited regenerative capacity, cartilage degeneration inevitably leads to total knee replacement. Lately, many non-invasive therapies (such as intra-articular injections of hyaluronic acid) targeting early OA have shown therapeutic potential. Our studies on the pathogenesis and detection of early OA (2013 NM, OARSI) indicate that early intervention is critical to halting OA progression. Recently, several randomized clinical trials have illustrated the effectiveness of Platelet Rich Plasma (PRP) as a treatment for early onset OA. We have conducted our own PRP spontaneous OA animal model studies using Duking Hartley Guinea Pigs. Our results have been very promising not only treating symptoms of OA but also slowing down progression. PRP is an autologous, non-immunogenic concentrate of platelets and is a rich source of growth factors. It has been shown to be an effective adjuvant in tissue healing in several medical applications. The released growth factors culminate in cartilage repair through various mechanisms. However, despite this PRP still has variable therapeutic effects. Perhaps due to a lack of a standardized lab technique and the dual catabolic/anabolic effects of growth factors. Our aim is to address this issue and refine PRP therapy, specifically using it to target early onset OA and subsequent cartilage damage. Hydrogel scaffolds function as a delivery vehicle which augment platelet viability in PRP. They simulate a physiologic milieu similar to native platelet environments and prolong growth factor bioavailability. Thus gels are a means of refining PRP therapies. Our aim is to determine whether a tailored PRP combined with gel can enhance cartilage regeneration and impede OA progression in an early OA model. Through our pilot study we have shown enhanced healing with the addition of hydrogel and have already developed a way to standardize PRP platelet counts However, we wish to further tailor PRP by; 1) Using hyaluronic acid gel as a delivery vehicle and to enhance viscosupplementation and growth factor bioavailability. 2) Using platelets from cord blood which have a more robust growth factor assay conducive towards cartilage repair. We intend to investigate the efficacy of our treatment using Dukin Hartley Guinea Pigs a well-accepted spontaneous OA model. In doing this, we aim to develop an optimized and efficient treatment ideal as an early non-invasive intervention for OA. 骨关节炎（OA）是退行性关节疾病。由于再生能力有限，软骨退化最终不可避免地导致全膝关节置换。近年来，许多非侵入性的治疗（如透明质酸的关节内注射）具有靶向治疗早期OA的潜力。 我们对早期OA（2013 NM，OARSI）的检查和发病机理的研究表明，及早采取行动是制止OA进展的关键。最近，几个随机临床试验已经证实富含血小板血浆（PRP）对治疗早期OA有疗效。我们也使用了自发性OA动物模型Duking Hartley豚鼠进行PRP的研究。我们的研究结果也非常有前景，不仅可以治疗OA的症状，而且还减缓了OA的进程。 PRP是浓缩的非免疫原性的同源性血小板，也是生长因子的丰富来源。在若干医疗应用中，它已被证实是组织愈合的有效佐剂。释放出来的生长因子通过不同机制在软骨修复中积累。然而，尽管如此，PRP的治疗效果任然是不确定的。其原因可能是缺乏标准化的实验技术和生长因子分解/合成代谢的双重影响。我们的目标就是要解决这个问题并细化PRP治疗，特别是用它来针对发病初期的OA以及随后的软骨损伤的治疗。 水凝胶支架能够作为PRP的载体而强化血小板的活力。它能模拟类似于天然环境的血小板生理状态，并延长生长因子生物利用率。因此，凝胶成为一种精炼PRP的疗法。 我们的研究目的是为了确定合适的PRP凝胶组合是否能增强软骨再生能力，并在早期OA模型中的阻止OA的进展。通过预实验我们已经证明，加入水凝胶能够增强治愈效果，并已找到一种规范的PRP血小板计数方法。然而，我们希望通过以下方法进一步优化PRP； 1）使用透明质酸凝胶作为递送媒介物并提高粘弹性和生长因子的生物利用率。 2）使用拥有更强大生长因子的脐血血小板利于软骨修复。 我们计划使用众所周知的自发OA模型Duking Hartley豚鼠研究疗效。在这一过程中，我们打算研发一个优质且高效的早期无创介入治疗OA的方案。

17206916.label: Realisation of objectives
17206916.value: We have achieved both objectives with the following details: Assessment parameters: Normally in OA intervention studies, treatment modalities are assessed using subjective pain scales (such as WOMAC). However, since we have used an animal model, this was not a very practical assessment parameter. Thus, we chose to use CT analysis of the joints and histopathology which are more objective assessment parameters. Study design: In this animal model study we used Dukin Hartley guinea pigs as a spontaneous OA model. We will have 3 treatment groups with 5 guinea pigs per group. Each guinea pig will be given 3-6 intra-articular treatments in their right hind over a 3 month period starting at 6 months of age. After this period the guinea pigs will be sacrificed and their limbs will be harvested for histochemical and CT analysis. Our control group consist of the left hind knee which is the non-treatment limb. A flow chart of our study plan is illustrated as in our proposal. We were able to obtain an average PRP concentration of around 10 million platelets/ ml. We were also able to dilute that concentration to about twice the lower limit of guinea pig platelets counts 500,000 platelets/ml using an algorithm to dilute PRP with saline. PRP preparation as follows, Blood collected undergoes 2 spins in micro-centrifuge to concentrate platelets. Soft spin: 5400 rpm for 4 minutes. This separates blood into 3 cell layers. Top layer of platelets and plasma extracted, leaving behind buffy coat (containing white cells) and red cell layer. Hard spin, platelet plasma suspension then spun for 8 minuets at 5400 rpm, separating PPP (top layer) from PPP (bottom layer) . Preparation of PRP gel as follows, 100μl of PRP is combined with 100μl of Hydrogel gel (1:1 ratio). The gel and PRP are then re-suspended using micropipette tips and a vortex mixer to create a viscous suspension. 100μl of PRP gel is then administered intra-articulalrly into DH GP right hind joint using x-ray-imaging guidance after fixing the joint in maximum flexion. Treatments are administrated after 6 months of age since we are focused on treating early onset OA. Verification of treatment amount and site as follows, Pilot studies were conducted to verify the location of intra-articular treatment administration and determine the ideal amount of treatment. Blue dye was injected into the right hind joint penetrating the patellar ligament in a anterior-posterior manner. 100μl was determined to be a safe amount of treatment to deliver into the joint causing minimum swelling. Verification of Platelet distribution within gel: We tagged platelets with the cell tracker idium-111 radioisotope. We then used a confocal microscope to view the platelet suspension in gel. As seen in figure 8 the platelets (light green dots) were evenly distributed throughout the gel. Evaluation of DH guinea pig joint as follows, After 3 months of treatment (1 dose 100μl PRP gel every 4 weeks) followed by 3 months of observation the guinea pigs will be sacrificed and both the control joint (left hind joint) and the treatment joint (right hind joint) will be harvested fixed, decalcified and undergo 3 assessment parameters. 3D CT reconstruction and x-ray imaging of the joint will be used to assess gross changes to articular and bony morphology. The joint will be cut into sagittal sections for imuunohistochemical staining with H&E and Safrinin- O to assess GAG content and cartilage damage. In Vivo animal experimentation as follows, After sacrifice the limbs were assed by 2 methods; CT analysis and Histochemical analysis with Hemotoxyin and Eosin (used to asses the morphology of the cartilage) and Safrinin-O and fast green (See publications for details)staining (used to assess cartilage quality via GAG quantity). Based on these 2 assessment criteria, we did not notice any significant worsening in morphology of the cartilage receiving treatment compared to the control limb. Furthermore, the treatment limb actually had increased GAG content compared to the control limb. In summary, we have achieved our objectives, including Fabricate a tailored PRP using a standardized PRP concentration with platelets harvested from cord blood and augmented with gel.; and Evaluated the effects of tailored PRP on early onset OA with animal experimentation. Specifically, assessing the synergistic relation between hydrogel and hyaluronic acid gel and PRP and UCB PRP.

17206916.value: Generally Guinea pigs treated with PRP gel more frequently (i.e. every 2 weeks for 3 months) had the best out come. In terms of histopathology, this group had the most regular joint space architecture as well as a high GAG content. Furthermore on CT analysis this group displayed better bone surface to bone volume as well as a better Trabecular pattern compared to the PRP only and the control group. Thus, PRP was found to have an effective synergistic effect when combined as used at a high frequency for early onset OA in our animal model study. However, to get a better understanding of PRP’s synergistic effect with hydrogel, we must in the future, increase our sample sizes to make our statistical data more powerful. We must also experiment with the treatment frequency which seems to influence the efficacy of the treatment, possibly due to the short half life of platelets after activation. From current study, we found that Guinea pigs treated with PRP gel more frequently (i.e. every 2 weeks for 3 months) had the best out come. The better bone surface to bone volume as well as a better Trabecular pattern compared to the PRP only and the control group. 17206916.value: Osteoarthritis is a joint disease associated with morbidity and poor quality of life. Its etiology is not fully understood and although initially considered a “non-inflammatory” type of arthritis due to wear and tear, several studies have known shown that its pathogenesis is multifactorial. Factors which influence OA development include but are not limited to the Increased release of Pro-inflammatory Markers, Decline in the production of Growth factors and sex steroids, Decline in Bone mass and quality, and chondrocytes age. This is a justification for using tailored PRP to treat “early onset’ OA as we hypothesis that in its early stages the chondrocytes are more responsive to growth factor stimulation. 17211916.label: Project Objectives
17211916.value: Establishing advanced detailed balance model to unveil PVSC device physics. We will establish an advanced detailed balance model, which is different from other conventional models (see “Work done by others”), to simultaneously capture (i) photon recycling effect, (ii) radiative and nonradiative recombination, and (iii) CTL and defect influences in PVSCs. In the advanced model, (i) the photon recycling governed dark current (see “Research Plan and Methodology”) is computed with the black-body radiation spectrum of PVSCs at their operation temperatures; (ii) the nonradiative recombination due to the traps/impurities will be modeled. The radiative recombination current is calculated from the dark current by Maxwell-Boltzmann statistics; (iii) CTL affected carrier transport and defect influenced current leakage are captured by series and shunt resistances, respectively. Meanwhile, in the model, only three parameters, i.e. nonradiative recombination coefficient, series resistance, and shunt resistance, will be retrieved based on the measured device performances. We will thus fabricate PVSCs with representative device configurations (e.g. CTLs, perovskite materials, and perovskite thicknesses) and measure J-V characteristics and the refractive index of corresponding perovskites at various temperatures. The validation of the model and evolutions of these three retrieval parameters will be demonstrated through studying the experimental results of new PVSCs with different device configurations. Consequently, the advanced model can predict the device performances of PVSCs using only these three retrieval parameters, and has the capability to fully comprehend the above mentioned multi-physics effects in PVSCs. Examining Voc of PVSCs with the consideration of photon recycling effect. While the photon recycling effect and the approach to manipulate the effect for enhancing Voc are inconclusive in PVSCs, we will re-examine Voc by taking into account the effect. When one electron-hole pair recombines to generate a photon in radiative recombination, the photon will be reabsorbed at a different location in SC to create a new electron-hole pair (i.e. photon recycling). The photon recycling effect from the detailed balance between emission and absorption process will enhance Voc. Based on Maxwell-Boltzmann statistics, we will compute the (photon recycling governed) dark current and radiative current of PVSCs with different perovskites using our model. We will compare the amplitudes of radiative current to those of nonradiative current for understanding nonradiative recombination effects on Voc. With the understanding, we will carefully select perovskites to experimentally demonstrate the photon recycling effect and boost Voc with angular-restriction designs. Particularly, a wavelength-dependent angular restriction will be proposed to enhance Voc and suppress dark current without reducing the photocurrent. Since the dark current strongly depends on PVSC operation temperature, the temperature dependence will be examined. Consequently, through the study, the approach included photon recycling effect for manipulating Voc and dark current for high-performance PVSCs will be established. Examining Jsc of PVSCs with architectures tailored for light trapping structures. Jsc has been studied intensively, particularly in various light trapping designs. We will re-examine Jsc via configuring device architectures to match light trapping structures. According to detailed balance model, Jsc can be enhanced by changing absorptivity of cells spectrally with different light trapping designs. However, the improved Jsc will not always lead to enhanced efficiency due to the undesired dark current, increased nonradiative recombination, and unmatched CTLs. We are proposing an approach to design PVSCs with the consideration of different device-configuration parameters for matching a light trapping design by using our advanced model. As a proof of concept, we will use this approach to design PVSCs with a new class of quasi-periodic light trapping structure which is a macroscopically periodic and microscopically random nanostructure, and will fabricate the theoretically optimized PVSCs to demonstrate its effectiveness. Consequently, the proposed approach will allow us to optimize PVSC configurations with a light trapping structure through maximizing not only Jsc but also PCE. *** To show our capability to manage the project, we have started to work on the project. The preliminary results show that, compared to the conventional detailed balance model, our advanced model can better capture PVSC J-V characteristics and provide good prediction capability (see “Research Plan and Methodology” for details).

17211916.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17211916.value: 因為低成本和高功率轉換效率，有機 - 無機鈣鈦礦的半導體，例如（CH3NH3）PbX3其中X可以是碘，溴，或氯，已深入地研究用於薄膜太陽能電池。 傳統的幾個模型已經用於分析鈣鈦礦太陽能電池，例如電路模型和漂移擴散模型。前者是在理解電子行為有用的，但高度依賴於實驗結果。它不能提供的預測能力，也沒有短路電流（Jsc）和暗電流的電。後者具有在電子行為的預測能力，但太多的輸入參數使得難以適應電流密度-電壓特性。該模型不能捕獲光子循環效果，用於預測開路電壓的極限。 細緻平衡模型，其基於電（光載代），半導體物理（輻射複合，肖克萊 - 讀 - 霍爾非輻射複合，俄歇非輻射複合等）和黑體輻射法（光子循環效果），是強大的模型來確定太陽能電效限定值。然而，該模型忽略載流子傳輸層中的歐姆損失，表面複合，和雜質/感應電流洩漏缺陷的影響，不能預測鈣鈦礦太陽能電池的實際效率，這將導致太大的偏差。在這個項目中，我們提出了一個先進的細緻平衡模型。從傳統的細緻平衡不同，漂移擴散和電路模型，我們的模型同時捕捉（ⅰ）光子循環效應，（ⅱ）輻射和非輻射複合，並在鈣鈦礦太陽能電池（ⅲ）的載流子傳輸層和缺陷的影響。因此，高級模型能很好地預測多物理（光學和電的）特性，因此鈣鈦礦太陽能電池的性能。

17211916.label: Realisation of objectives
17211916.value: For Objective 1, exploring the way to predict and approach the solar cell (SC) efficiency limit by using the drift-diffusion model will enable us to gain more physical insights and design guidelines for emerging photovoltaics, particularly perovskite solar cells. Our work finds out that there are two prerequisites for predicting and approaching the SC efficiency limit. Firstly, the intrinsic radiative recombination needs to be corrected after adopting optical designs which will significantly affect the open-circuit voltage at its Shockley–Queisser limit. We offer a different approach to derive the accurate expression of intrinsic radiative recombination with the optical corrections for semiconductor materials. Secondly, the contact characteristics of the electrodes need to be carefully engineered to eliminate the charge accumulation and surface recombination at the electrodes. With the consideration of two prerequisites, the accurate prediction of efficiency limit and precise evaluation of efficiency degradation for perovskite solar cells are attainable by the drift-diffusion model [ACS Photonics, DOI: 10.1021/acsphotonics.6b01043]. We further develop the modified detailed balance model to capture the light-absorption dependent short-circuit current, contact and transport-layer modified carrier transport, as well as recombination and photon-recycling influenced open-circuit voltage. Our theoretical and experimental results show that for experimentally optimized perovskite solar cells with the power conversion efficiency of 19%, optical loss of 25%, non-radiative recombination loss of 35%, and ohmic loss of 35% are the three dominant loss factors for approaching the 31% efficiency limit of perovskite solar cells. We also find that the perovskite-interface-induced surface recombination, ohmic loss, and current leakage should be further reduced to upgrade device efficiency and eliminate the hysteresis effect. The work contributes to a fundamental understanding of the device physics of perovskite solar cells. The developed model offers a systematic design and analysis tool to photovoltaic technologies. [Adv. Energy Mater., 8, 1701586, 2018.] Regarding the electrical parameters of solar cells from time-domain measurements, they are based on integer-order impedance models. Meanwhile, in the frequency domain, the adopted circuit models usually contain a constant phase element. Therefore, inconsistency arises between the two analyses. We therefore propose to derive the time-domain relaxation response of a solar cell for comprehensively studying electrical parameters of solar cells [Org. Electron., 70, 42, 2019]. We further extend our study to experimentally and theoretically analyze the results of transient photovoltage measurements on perovskite solar cells with varied defect concentrations and inhomogeneous recombination rates to unveil the defects effects on device performances [Small Methods, 2000290, 2020]. Our work is fundamentally and practically important to mathematical modeling and physical understanding of solar cells. For Objective 2, in order to improve the Voc of perovskite solar cells, it is important to reduce the nonradiative recombination and understand its effects on Voc. We have introduced several new metal oxides including NiCo2O4, FeOx, and In:CuCrO2, nanoparticles as hole transport layer (HTL) [Adv. Energy Mater., 8, 1702722, 2018, Nano Energy, 47, 26, 2018, Adv. Function. Mater., 29, 1902600, 2019] and thick TiO2 as electron transport layer [ACS Energy Lett., 3, 2891, 2018], we reduce the non-radiative recombination at the interface between HTL and perovskite. Besides, we tune the workfunction and bandgap of the carrier transport layer to match with that of the active layer to improve device performances [Adv. Function. Mater., 28, 1706403, 2018.]. Interestingly, by introducing the metal oxide based carrier transport layers, we can also increase the grain size of perovskites and thus reduce the non-radiative recombination in perovskite and thus improve the Voc. [Adv. Energy Mater., 10, 1900903, 2019, Adv. Function. Mater., 29, 1804660, 2019.]. Regarding the perovskite film, we study different ligand additives to improve the qualities of Pb based perovskite film [J. Mater. Chem. A, 6, 23865, 2018, Adv. Mater., 31, 1805702, 2019] and grow single crystal Pb based perovskite to understand the crystallinity and defects effects on perovskite electrical and optical properties [Adv. Function. Mater, 29 1806984, 2019]. We also demonstrate a post-device ligand treatment to reduce the defects and encapsulate perovskite solar cells for improving their performances and stability [Energy & Environ. Sci., 11, 2253, 2018]. By improving the qualities and reducing defects of perovskites, we improve Voc of perovskite solar cells. For Objective 3, in order to improve the Jsc of perovskite solar cells, we propose a simple solution-process to make perovskite grating without any microfabrication process [Adv. Funct. Mater., 27, 1606525, 2017.]. Our results show that the introduction of different grating structures by the new approach can improve the light absorption and the crystallinity of perovskite and thus the Jsc. We have also proposed a new scheme of pyridine-promoted formation to achieve high-quality perovskite films at room temperature for the first time. In addition, we demonstrate the approach of employing an all-room-temperature solution process to fabricate the p-i-n planar structure for achieving high performance and stable perovskite solar cells. Our results show that room-temperature processed PVSCs with improved Jsc and PCE reaching 17.10%, which is the best results for PVSCs fabricated by all room-temperature solution-processed techniques to date [Adv. Mater., 29, 1604695, 2017]. Recently, we narrow the bandgap and thus increase Jsc by developing Sn/Pb mixed perovskite with improving crystallinity [ACS Nano, 13, 11800, 2019, Solar RRL, 2, 1800146, 2018, Adv. Function. Mater., 28, 1706068, 2018.]. From a device structure point of view, we introduce tandem architectures with the reduction of loss in the interconnection between the two units of solar cells to extend the absorption wavelength range and thus enlarge Jsc [Small Methods, 4, 2000093, 2020, Adv. Energy Mater., 8, 1801954, 2018, ACS Nano, 12, 10486, 2018]. We also study the electrode to favor the light propagation into the solar cells for improving Jsc [Small, 14, 1703140, 2018.]. It should be noted that the outputs stated in this progress report are achieved through the financial support from this GRF fund together with some other internal small seed funding, collaborative research funds from RGC.

17211916.label: Major findings and research outcome
17211916.value: The findings/outcomes of our projects are: (1) to establish the modified detailed balance model to capture the light-absorption dependent short-circuit current, contact and transport-layer modified carrier transport, as well as recombination and photon-recycling influenced open-circuit voltage to quantify the efficiency loss of the perovskite solar cells [Adv. Energy Mater., 8, 1701586, 2018]. We then re-study and modify the drift-diffusion model for predicting the efficiency limit [ACS Photonics, 4, 934, 2017.]. We also experimentally and theoretically study the results of transient device current and photovoltage response of perovskite to understand the device performance parameters and the inherent effects of defects and non-radiative recombination [Org. Electron., 70, 42, 2019, Small Methods, 2000290, 2020]; (2) to improve Voc by (a) developing a series of hole and electron transport layers [Adv. Energy Mater., 8, 1702722, 2018, Nano Energy, 47, 26, 2018, Adv. Function. Mater., 29, 1902600, 2019, ACS Energy Lett., 3, 2891, 2018] which can tune their work function and improve the crystallinity of the perovskite formed on them [Adv. Function. Mater., 28, 1706403, 2018., Adv. Energy Mater., 10, 1900903, 2019, Adv. Function. Mater., 29, 1804660, 2019.], (b) improving the crystallinity of perovskite film [J. Mater. Chem. A, 6, 23865, 2018, Adv. Mater., 31, 1805702, 2019; Adv. Function. Mater, 29 1806984, 2019] and (c) reducing the defects perovskite film [Adv. Mater., 29, 1604695, 2017, Energy & Environ. Sci., 11, 2253, 2018]; and (3) to enhance Jsc by (a) introducing a new kind of microfabrication-free light-trapping structures [Adv. Funct. Mater., 27, 1606525, 2017.], (b) narrowing the bandgap of perovskite by mixing Sn and Pb [ACS Nano, 13, 11800, 2019, Solar RRL, 2, 1800146, 2018, Adv. Function. Mater., 28, 1706068, 2018], (c) introducing new tandem architectures with low loss interconnection layer [Small Methods, 4, 2000093, 2020, Adv. Energy Mater., 8, 1801954, 2018, ACS Nano, 12, 10486, 2018], as well as (d) re-designing the electrode to enhance light propagation into the structure of the solar cells [Small, 14, 1703140, 2018.].

17211916.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
17211916.value: With the quantitively understanding of the efficiency loss in perovskite solar cells and the capability of the efficiency limit prediction, our work can offer guidelines for scientists to design a new class of solar cells made from perovskite materials which can be extended to other materials such as silicon, organic and other semiconductors. Besides, the knowledge of perovskite crystallization and the device structure design gained in this project can be adopted into other optoelectronic device development such as photodetectors and light emitting diodes. The series of low-temperature solution-processed metal oxide materials used as carrier transport layers in this project can be explored for developing emerging flexible electronics.

17211916.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
17211916.value: In this work, we have established the fundamental models for predicting the efficiency limit and quantifying the efficiency loss of solar cells made from the promising material of perovskites. From a material point of view, high quality perovskites with different bandgaps and efficient carrier transport layer materials have been demonstrated to improve device performances. We have also developed effective device structures including light-trapping structure and tandem device structure for improving light absorption of the solar cells. The project covering modeling, materials to device architectures provide not only a fundamental understanding of the device physics of perovskite solar cells but also new materials and device structures for improving device performances. The work therefore contributes to promoting the practical applications of perovskite photovoltaics as well as the development of green energy.

17212016.label: Project Objectives
17212016.value: To propose a new modeling approach for the ELP-MA based on operations research and auction theory. This approach will take into account the procurement of multiple items; that is, in the ELP-MA multiple carriers are required to meet one shipper’s demand. To devise efficient auction mechanisms for the ELP-MA. The proposed mechanisms will extend the well-known Vickrey-Clarke-Groves (VCG) auction to the multi-attribute multi-unit environments. To explore the underlying link between combinatorial and multi-attribute (multi-unit) auctions. To make the implementation of auction simple and transparent to market participants (i.e., simplicity and practicability). To test, evaluate and improve the proposed models and results using collaborators’ industrial data.

17212016.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17212016.value: Logistics and physical distribution have evolved substantially over the last decade and will continue on the path driven by e-commerce. Under such a trend, online auctions have been increasingly viewed as favorable tools for logistics service procurement. However, such auctions are price-only. It is clear that the price-only auctions are no longer valid for “complex procurement”, in which one shipper (e.g., a large manufacturer) cares about both the price and nonmonetary attributes such as delivery time and cargo insurance clauses. For example, in the B2B e-commerce logistics, the shipments of one shipper are usually characterized by their large volume, high value, and long transit time as compared to the less-than-truckload (LTL) industry. Due to the potential risk and damage during transportation, a shipper would involve performance factors rather than price. This project is among the first attempt to propose efficient auction mechanisms for the e-commerce logistics problem with multiple attributes (ELP-MA), which generally is the problem of matching transportation demands and supplies over an e-commerce logistics market where price and other attributes are jointly evaluated. This project will develop a one-sided Vickrey-Clarke-Groves (O-VCG) auction for the ELP-MA. It is expected that the O-VCG auction mechanism realizes incentive compatibility, allocative efficiency, budget balance and individual rationality. Based on insights from the known Ausubel auctions and the primal-dual algorithm, this project will next propose an efficient multi-round descending auction, called the primal-dual Vickrey (PDV) auction. The PDV auction aims to achieve VCG payments and truthful bidding for general valuations. It is also promising that carriers may reveal less private information in the PDV auction than in the O-VCG auction. This project will theoretically and numerically investigate the impact of self-interested shipper on market efficiency. Finally, this project will explore the underlying link between combinatorial and multi-attribute (multi-unit) auctions. This should open the door to the design of a host of efficient auction mechanisms for the multi-attribute multi-unit procurement. 本項目探討多屬性拍賣機制在電商物流服務採購中的應用。在理論研究的基礎上，結合合作企業的實際運作特點，在城市物流領域進行深入研究，建立物流服務電商交易平台。

17212016.label: Realisation of objectives
17212016.value: Overall speaking, all research objectives have been achieved. The first three objectives are grouped and the last two objectives are grouped as follows: Objective 1 - To propose a new modeling approach for the ELP-MA based on operations research and auction theory. This approach will take into account the procurement of multiple items; that is, in the ELP-MA multiple carriers are required to meet one shipper’s demand. Objective 2 - To devise efficient auction mechanisms for the ELP-MA. The proposed mechanisms will extend the well-known Vickrey-Clarke-Groves (VCG) auction to the multi-attribute multi-unit environments. Objective 3 - To explore the underlying link between combinatorial and multi-attribute (multi-unit) auctions. These three research objectives are mainly concerned with theoretical modeling and studies. The paper (Efficient multi-attribute multi-unit auctions for b2b e-commerce logistics. Production and Operations Management, 26(2), 292-304.) proposes efficient multi-attribute auction model for multi-item procurement. A Vickrey-Clarke-Groves (VCG) auction was developed for ELP-MA. The Primal dual Vickrey (PDV) auction is developed for single attribute multi-unit forward Vickrey (SA-MFV) auction. Both PDV and SA-MFV auctions realize VCG payments and truthful bidding for general valuations. The paper (Truthful, budget-balanced bundle double auctions for carrier collaboration. Transportation Science, 51(4), 1365-1386.) first proposes the auction model with multiple carriers and shipper. The paper also proposes a generalized collaboration model. Objective 4 – To make the implementation of auction simple and transparent to market participants (i.e., simplicity and practicability). Objective 5 - To test, evaluate and improve the proposed models and results using collaborators’ industrial data. Three papers have been produced for more practical application and implementation of the proposed auction models with specific focus on car park sharing services. They are “Private parking slot sharing, Transportation Research Part B: Methodological, 93, 596-617.)”, “Parking reservation disturbances, Transportation Research Part B 135 (2020) 83–97”, and “"IoT-Enabled Parking Space Sharing and Allocation Mechanisms," in IEEE Transactions on Automation Science and Engineering, vol. 15, no. 4, pp. 1654-1664, Oct. 2018”. The second area of application is the application of auction models for urban waste collection services (Variable neighborhood search and tabu search for auction-based waste collection synchronization, Transportation Research Part B: Methodological Volume 133, March 2020, Pages 1-20).

17212016.label: Major findings and research outcome
17212016.value: In terms of research outcomes, this project has enabled the research team to produce a number of research papers in reputable journals. The research has extended auction models to include time and space attributes which are essential in ecommerce logistics in addition to price. The power of spatial-temporal auction models allow us to consider various forms of operational synchronizations. In addition, a significant research outcome of this project (together with other basic research activities in the field) is the successful award of a major ITF project entitled "iPark: Core Technologies of Intelligent Ecommerce Logistics Parks (ITP/079/16LP)" during the period of 06 Feb 2017 - 05 Feb 2019 with HK$7.6M from ITC and matching from industries. This ITF project has extended the scope of R&D substantially and involved many business associations and logistics companies in Hong Kong and Mainland China. Two PhD research students were trained and graduated with partial financial supports from this project. It was fortunate that they continued to work on related research as post-doc research fellow with further funding from the ITF iPark. This has allowed the team to complete working papers and eventually got them published in top journals in the field.

17212016.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
17212016.value: The first area of further exploration would be from theory to practice. Auction models should be further simplified for more direct applications for daily operations in ecommerce logistics service procurement. This project has identified the power of auction models for investigating synchronization of logistics operations by treating time slots as commodities for auction. This finding has inspired the team to explore in other areas such as manufacturing operations and healthcare (hospital) operations that should be synchronized instead of using make-span or punctuality as objectives traditionally. The project has created theoretical foundation for the design of efficient auction mechanisms for the multi-attribute multi-unit procurement.

17212016.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
17212016.value: The rapid growth of ecommerce has reshaped logistics (both last-mile city logistics and inter-city logistics) and physical distribution over the last decade. This has been especially critical during the Covid-19 pandemic. This project has developed online auction models aiming to develop practical tools for logistics service procurement. A unique contribution of these auction models is its multi-attribute property where not only the price but also nonmonetary attributes such as delivery time and cargo insurance clauses are considered. The B2B e-commerce logistics demonstrates its characteristics that the shipments of one shipper are usually characterized by their large volume, high value, and long transit time. The multi-attribute auction models allow the shipper to consider performance factors not just limited to price. This project has involved in-depth theoretical studies into a one-sided Vickrey-Clarke-Groves (O-VCG) auction. This O-VCG auction mechanism realizes incentive compatibility, allocative efficiency, budget balance and individual rationality. Another exploration made in this project is the development of another efficient multi-round descending auction, called the primal-dual Vickrey (PDV) auction. The PDV auction achieves VCG payments and truthful bidding for general valuations. With this auction model, carriers are allowed to reveal less private information than in the O-VCG auction. The practical applications have also been investigated in two areas. One is the urban waste collection logistics and the other is the car park sharing services in addition to ecommerce logistics.

17212416.value: 高斯置信傳播算法的收斂性分析及其在分佈式參數估計中的應用

17212416.label: Project Objectives

rows: Deriving necessary and sufficient convergence condition for vector-form non-pairwise Gaussian belief propagation.
Seeking easily verifiable convergence conditions tailored for large-scale problems.

17212416.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17212416.value: Gaussian belief propagation (GaBP) is a low-complexity method for computing the marginal probability density function (PDF) of a particular variable from a high dimensional joint Gaussian PDF. By cleverly exploiting the local probabilistic relationship expressed on factor graph, this local message-passing method finds it well-suited for solving a wide range of large-scale and distributed parameter estimation problems, from sparse Bayesian learning, factor analyzer networks, cooperative beamforming in communication networks, distributed state estimation in power grid to peer-to-peer rating in social networks. It is known that GaBP operating on tree-structured factor graphs give the exact marginal PDF, but its corresponding consequence on loopy factor graphs is more mysterious. Although not lacking empirical successful applications of GaBP on loopy factor graphs, the validity of GaBP ultimately conditioned on its convergence, which unfortunately has no guarantee. Existing convergence conditions of GaBP, not only limited by their conservative nature, but also apply only to the subclass of scalar and pairwise connected factor graph. This makes the convergent (or lack of convergent) behaviors of many GaBP applications unexplainable. This study will analyze the convergence of GaBP on the general class of vector-form non-pairwise connected factor graphs. In particular, we intend to derive the necessary and sufficient convergence condition, which would include existing results as special cases. Effects of message-passing schedule, initialization set, and damping will be investigated. Furthermore, in order to facilitate the verification of convergence condition in large-scale applications, where gathering of information from the whole problem might not be feasible, an array of easily verifiable sufficient conditions will be developed, with each having a different trade-off on how easy the condition can be verified and how large the class of model it covers. After obtaining a full understanding on the convergence conditions of GaBP, we will corroborate the theoretical results with GaBP applications involving vector variables and non-pairwise connections. For example, we will look into the distributed state estimation in power grid and distributed beamforming in wireless network, where convergence is currently not fully understood. Furthermore, novel distributed algorithms for channel estimation in infrastructure-less device-to-device communications will be developed. With the wide applicability of vector and non-pairwise GaBP, it is expected that the newly developed convergence theories would foster many more applications than this project can cover, and have a far-reaching consequence to many research communities and industries. 高斯置信傳播算法是一種從聯合高斯概率分佈中求解邊緣概率分佈的低複雜度算法。它通過利用因子圖中的變量關係表示，實現圖上消息的局部傳遞，其非常適用於大規模及分佈式參數估計問題，包括稀疏貝葉斯學習、因子分析、協作波束成型、電網狀態分佈式估計以及社交網絡中的端對端評級。 眾所周知，高斯置信傳播算法在樹狀因子圖中可以準確求解邊緣概率分佈函數，但其在具有環結構因子圖中的結果卻仍然是一個迷。雖然高斯置信傳播算法在環結構因子圖中不乏經典成功應用範例，但其有效性最終取決於算法的收斂，而這一點卻很難保證。目前存在的高斯置信傳播算法收殮條件，不僅過於保守，而且只適用於標量及對連的因子圖情形。因此，高斯置信傳播算法在很多應用中的收殮性還無法解釋。 此研究將分析高斯置信傳播算法在向量及非對連因子圖情形下的收殮性問題。首先，我們將推導高斯置信傳播算法收殮的充分必要條件，並將已有收殮結果納入其中。同時，我們將研究消息傳遞機制、初始化條件以及阻尼機制對收殮的影響。此外，為了便於在大規模分佈式網絡中的收斂性判定，我們將提出一系列容易驗證的充分收斂性條件，而這些條件將會在複雜度和適用範圍二者間折中。 通過對高斯置信傳播算法收斂性條件的充分研究，我們將為向量及非對連情形下提供堅實理論基礎。比如，我們將研究電網中的狀態分佈式估計和無線網絡中的分佈式波束成型問題，而目前它們的收斂性研究還遠遠不夠。另外，在設備間通信中，我們可以開發新型的分佈式信道估計算法。最後，我們期望通過新的高斯置信傳播算法收殮性理論，使其適用性更廣，並對學術及工程領域產生深遠影響。

17212416.label: Realisation of objectives
17212416.value: Both the revised objectives are 100% realized. The first objective: ---------------- We considered inference over distributed linear Gaussian models using factor graphs and Gaussian belief propagation (BP). The distributed inference algorithm involves only local computation of the information matrix and of the mean vector, and message passing between neighbors. Under broad conditions, it is shown that the message information matrix converges to a unique positive definite limit matrix for arbitrary positive semidefinite initialization, and it approaches an arbitrarily small neighborhood of this limit matrix at a doubly exponential rate. A necessary and sufficient convergence condition for the belief mean vector to converge to the optimal centralized estimator is provided under the assumption that the message information matrix is initialized as a positive semidefinite matrix. The proposed convergence condition in the setup of distributed linear Gaussian models is shown to be strictly weaker (i.e., easier to be satisfied) than other existing convergence conditions and requirements, including the Gaussian Markov random field based walk-summability condition. On the other hand, the analysis above is based on synchronous scheduling, which might be too restrictive in practical implementation. Therefore, we further studied a new class of asynchronous scheduling, called quasi-asynchronous scheduling. For this quasi-asynchronous scheduling, we derived the necessary and sufficient convergence condition. Since the quasi-asynchronous scheduling includes the synchronous scheduling as a special case, we also proved that the necessary and sufficient convergence condition under quasi-synchronous scheduling reduces to that of synchronous scheduling under certain condition. The second objective: ---------------- Since the necessary and sufficient convergence condition requires verification of the spectral radius of a certain matrix, it is important to investigate easily verifiable convergence conditions. Using the synchronous scheduling, it is further shown that Gaussian BP always converges when the underlying factor graph is given by the union of a forest and a single loop. This is an easily verifiable condition since it only depends on the network topology and can be used without any computation. Furthermore, for the quasi-asynchronous scheduling, we introduced the concept of probabilistic convergence (mean-square convergence and expectation convergence). Under these newly established definitions, we derived the sufficient convergence condition, which requires the verification of the spectral radius of a smaller matrix than that in synchronous scheduling. The relationship between quasi-asynchronous scheduling and damping is also revealed for the first time. To show how these easily verifiable convergence conditions can be used in practice, we carried out numerical experiments on three applications: 1) solving system of linear equation, 2) signal detection in cloud radio access network, 3) distributed downlink beamforming. These results showed the correctness of the established theories and revealed many unknown convergence properties of these applications.

17212416.label: Major findings and research outcome
17212416.value: The necessary and sufficient convergence condition, and the easily verifiable convergence conditions under synchronous scheduling have been published in Journal of Machine Learning Research (journal publication #1 in Part C). The necessary and sufficient convergence condition, and the probabilistic convergence conditions under quasi-asynchronous scheduling have been published in IEEE Transactions on Signal Processing (journal publication #2 in Part C).

17212416.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
17212416.value: In previous research of convergence of Gaussian BP, all the works focus on the convergence of messages from factor nodes to variable nodes. During the research of this project, we found that it is also possible to study the convergence from another kind of message, which is from variable nodes to factor nodes. Since these two types of messages depend on each other, there must be some kind of relationship in the convergence conditions from these two perspective. As a first step, we analysed the convergence condition from this new perspective, and found that whether BP converges is equivalent to asking if fixed-point exists in the update equation for the message from variable nodes to factor nodes. This is a totally new result, and is unaware of in the research community. We published this result in another paper in IEEE Transactions on Signal Processing (journal publication #3 in Part C). We believe there are many other relationships yet to be discovered from this novel perspective, and the PI is continuing to investigate such matter.

17212416.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
17212416.value: Gaussian belief propagation is a simple and distributed algorithm for computing the marginal distribution from a very high dimensional joint Gaussian distribution. It finds many applications in machine learning, signal processing, wireless communications, image processing, etc. But it is known that Gaussian belief propagation may not converge. This project aims at unveiling the convergence conditions of Gaussian belief propagation such that researchers from other fields can easily determine when the technique can be safely applied. The results from this project filled many knowledge gaps in this topic, and built a more complete picture on the properties of Gaussian belief propagation.
