17261916.label: Major findings and research outcome
17261916.value: • A novel chemical-biological process with coagulants-facilitated sedimentation and enhanced sludge hydrolysis was developed for the carbon self-sufficient municipal wastewater treatment. MBBR filed with sponge-like LEVAPOR biocarrier cubes was applied for the organic removal and nitrification in low strength CEPS-treated wastewater. For heterotrophic denitrification, VFAs-rich CEPS-FL is an efficient carbon source for biological nitrogen removal. Based on the batch test, the CEPS-FL exhibited a much higher denitrification rate (410.3 g N/kg VSS/d) and a lower N2O emission potential (1.14%) than methanol. Besides, a CEPS-PNA system has been developed for enhanced nitrogen removal in wastewater treatment and the rapid start-up of the PNA system can be successfully achieved in two months with pre-cultivated anammox biofilms on biocarriers (Guo et al., 2019; Li et al., 2020b; Li et al., 2021). • In Fe-CEPS, over 90% of TP in municipal wastewater can be concentrated into the CEPS sludge. Based on the X-ray absorption spectroscopy (XAS) analysis, iron-enhanced P removal was mainly achieved by precipitation as ferric phosphate (24.2%) and adsorption onto hydrous iron oxide (60.3%). The increase in fermentation time and organic load, as well as the decrease in solution pH would enhance the P recovery, while the accumulation of aged ferrihydrite and specially goethite in sludge would limit P release. By the two-chamber electro-fermentation technology, phosphorus dissolution efficiency could greatly improve to 56%, and about 70% of the released ammonium and 50% of iron in sludge could be driven by the current from the sludge suspension into the cathode chamber for recovery (Lin et al., 2018; Lin et al., 2019; Li et al., 2020a). • A coagulation-flat-sheet ceramic membrane filtration (C-FSCMF) system was successfully developed for municipal wastewater treatment. In C-FSCMF, approximately 90.0% of COD and 99.0% of P can be redirected to side-stream for resource recovery. In the membrane filtration units, since the large CEPS sludge flocs could not enter the membrane pores, the fouling of FSCM was remarkably mitigated, giving rise to a much high flux (41.7 LMH) for sewage filtration (Meng and Li, 2019; Zhao et al., 2019, 2020a). Besides organic and phosphorus recovery, Ti-based CEPS sludge can be used for making photocatalysts or adsorbents towards wastewater treatment. Ti-CEPS sludge calcinated in the absence of N2 atmosphere can transform sludge to carbon-doped TiO2 as a photocatalyst, and the carbonization of the sludge in the presence of N2 produces adsorbent, for pollutant removals (Zhao et al., 2020b).

17261916.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
17261916.value: This project on CEPS, FSCM filtration, sludge fermentation and hydrolysis, and biological nitrogen removal culmination has yielded deep understanding of the individual components. The research outcomes have also demonstrated the feasibility and more importantly, the synergistic effects achieved through the integration of these components. In the next phase, the research team will develop and pilot-test an integrated CeFSCM-CfSBBR system for advanced wastewater treatment. The new system comprises of two novel technologies, i.e., the chemically-enhanced flat-sheet ceramic membrane (CeFSCM) module and the cross-flow suspended bed biofilm reactor (CfSBBR) module, which will be integrated with CEPS and anaerobic sludge fermentation to form a compact treatment system for (1) rapid and enhanced removal of pollutants and pathogens, (2) treatment of emerging contaminants such as endocrine disrupting chemicals (EDCs), and (3) waste bio-sludge reduction. We propose to construct a pilot-scale CeFSCM-CfSBBR system and to conduct the pilot trials in one of the Sewage Treatment Works (STW) in Hong Kong. For the proposed pilot study, we will seek for support from Drainage Services Department (DSD) and apply for funding from Innovation and Technology Fund (ITF). Results from this pilot-scale study will be definitive in directing the innovative technologies into a persuasive evidence for industrial application.

17261916.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
17261916.value: Conventional wastewater treatment is an energy-intensive and resource-wasting process, in which the oxidation of organics and ammonium nitrogen consumes quantities of energy. Besides, external organic carbon sources are often needed for enhanced biological nitrogen removal. In this study, a new chemical-biological process was developed for municipal wastewater treatment. With chemically-enhanced primary sedimentation (CEPS) and ceramic membrane filtration, most of the organics and phosphorus in sewage can be concentrated into the primary sludge before entering biological treatment units. Undergoes hydrolysis and acidogenesis, organics in the CEPS sludge can be recovered as volatile fatty acids (VFAs), which can be used to make up the carbon deficit in the mainstream, achieving carbon self-sufficiency in WWTPs. Phosphorus and nitrogen in the sludge can also be effectively recovered. With the electro-fermentation treatment, 56% of phosphorus can be recovered and about 70% of ammonium ions can be separated, providing a VFAs-rich liquor with a high CODVFAs/NNH4 ratio for denitrification or the production of value-added products. Overall, with the CEPS and sludge fermentation, organics and phosphorus in sewage can be effectively recovered and nitrogen in wastewater can be removed by a more energy-saving and carbon self-sufficient process.

17263316.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17263316.value: 计算带面积约束的最优区域分割问题(下称OCCP问题) 是计算机科学、工程学和运筹学中的基本问题，对于解决计算机图形学和几何处理中的最优采样和网格生成等问题极其重要，在机器人传感器网络和信息可视化等领域也有广泛的应用。 我们举一个简单的例子来描述OCCP问题的应用场合。假设在某个地区要部署一些服务中心(称作站点)，为该地区的居民提供服务。那么，我们如何决定每个站点的位置以及它的服务范围使得整个服务代价最小(居民去尽可能近的站点接受服务并且各个站点的服务人数与其服务能力匹配)？ 由于OCCP问题是高度非线性的，因此有必要采用迭代的数值方法进行求解。已有的方法假定OCCP的定义域是欧氏空间，其代价函数依赖于L2测度，并且收敛速度很慢。正因为在普适应性和效率上的缺陷，它不能适用于一般的几何域或者站点数目特别多的情形。 为了适应当今几何处理任务的需求，我们将研究在一般的几何域（如曲面）上计算OCCP问题的快速方法，比如定义了黎曼测度的曲面。具体地讲，我们将围绕以下方面研究OCCP问题。 (1) 提出在一般几何域上求解OCCP问题的变分框架; (2) 研究在一般的几何域(比如网格曲面)上定义合适的数据结构表达OCCP问题，以便计算广义的带权Voronoi图; (3) 提出计算OCCP问题的超线性收敛的数值算法。初步实验表明我们的新方法比现有的OCCP计算方法快了一个数量级; (4) 研究带不等式面积约束的最优分割问题; (5)将我们的理论和算法推广至更为一般的情形，比如说站点携带了各向异性的度量以及不等式面积约束。总之，不管是在理论上还是在计算方法上，本项目的研究成果将是对OCCP问题的重要贡献。

17263316.label: Realisation of objectives
17263316.value: A partition of a geometric domain is a collection of disjoint constituent parts whose union is equal to the whole domain. Finding an optimal partition by some criteria is a central issue in many applications. Optimal partitions, with or without capacity constraints, are used in computer graphics and geometric computing for point sampling, information visualization, shape segmentation, and mesh generation. The optimal partitioning problem with capacity constraints is also studied in engineering and economics for optimal resource location or provision of services. It is known that a capacity-constrained partition can be obtained as a power diagram with the squared L2 metric. We present a method with super-linear convergence for computing optimal partition with capacity constraints that outperforms the state-of-the-art in an order of magnitude. We demonstrate the efficiency of our method in the context of three different applications in computer graphics and geometric processing: displacement interpolation of function distribution, blue-noise point sampling, and optimal convex decomposition of 2D domains. Furthermore, the proposed method is extended to capacity-constrained optimal partition with respect to general cost functions beyond the squared Euclidean distance. Specifically, an L-BFGS method with empirically super-linear convergence is developed for computing capacity-constrained centroidal power diagram, assuming the squared Euclidean distance as the cost kernel. We show its superiority to previous method and validate it in two applications: displacement interpolation of function distribution and blue-noise point sampling. Furthermore, the method is extended to computing optimal capacity-constrained partition with a general cost function. Furthermore, based on the centroidal power diagram, an effective method is developed for decomposing a 2D polygonal region into convex and compact cells with capacity constraints.

17263316.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
17263316.value: Computing an optimal partition of a geometric domain with capacity constraints on its constituent parts is a fundamental problem in computer science, engineering and operations research. It is also encountered in many important tasks in computer graphics and geometric computing, such as optimal sampling, mesh generation, optimal coverage of robotic sensor networks, and information visualization. The problem can simply be described as follows, using an example of service provision. Suppose that some service centers, also called sites, with specified service capacities shall be deployed to serve a region. How should we determine the sites of the service centers and the partition of the region so that the total cost of serving the region by the service centers is minimized? It is required that each partitioned sub-region be served by one distinct center and the area or population of the sub-region match the capacity of its serving center. In this project we study the theory and methods for this topic and demonstrate our research outcomes in several applications.

17264016.label: Project Objectives
17264016.value: Evaluate the density and energy levels of the grain boundary traps in polycrystalline organic films developed by a carefully controlled solution shearing method. The effects of the fabrication parameters including the deposition temperature, substrate surface energy, solvent boiling point and shearing speed will be examined in detail through experiments. Optimize the sensitivity of the polycrystalline crystal temperature sensor by examining the differences in the activation energy for the device with different grain sizes, boundary densities and orientations. The temperature dependence on intra- and inter-grain carrier transport will be investigated. After considering the heat conduction paths in the laboratory sized polycrystalline crystal temperature sensor, the sensor will be increased in scale through integration with an active matrix transistor driver to form temperature sensor array.

17264016.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17264016.value: 柔性電子產品的迅速發展引發了新的應用，諸如穿戴式傳感器或柔性顯示器。它們已被證明能提供獨特的性能，如設備的拉伸性和透明性，同時這些特性導致​​了更廣泛的應用和研究。由於這些柔性有機電子器件的尺寸被減少，並在同一時間，它們的工作功率增加，局部加熱和熱誘導降解已成為其性能表現關鍵的因素。例如，產生上的有機場效應晶體管的活性層中的熱導率可引致在有機膜的不同方向有不同程度擴張，並導致缺陷，令外，相分離在活性通過局部加熱引起的聚合物太陽能電池的主層也將導致轉換效率的下降。要分析這種浪費的餘熱，常用的單點測量方法如熱電偶可能不適合。雖然更複雜的熱電偶陣列可作為二維溫度測量，但每個傳感器的單獨電極限制了其空間分辨率。此外，非接觸式紅外攝像機用於測量包封或封閉的設備時，也會受限於測量的表面溫度。因此有強烈需要開發新的柔性溫度傳感器，使得這些傳感器可以定位熱源和非破壞性​​地確定實時散熱路徑。除此之外，新一代的大面積和柔性的溫度傳感器還可以提供在生物醫學工程或機器人新穎應用。在目前的項目中，我們提出了一種新方案行用多晶有機薄膜開發出一個新高度敏感的溫度傳感器。我們會利用電荷傳輸在多晶有機膜的晶以感測熱信息。在活化能（E_ACT）和熱導率（k）的陷阱態能量和晶界密度的影響進行調查。如果單個的柔性的溫度傳感器與多晶有機薄膜的發展是成功的，我們的目標將是增加從實驗室規模的尺寸推廣到大面積溫度傳感器陣列的有源矩陣結構。

17264016.label: Realisation of objectives
17264016.value: In the whole project, we have developed four grain boundary generation and modification approaches based on the solution shearing. The four methods are, (i) dual solution shearing method, (ii) marangoni effect enhanced bar coating method, (iii) matching of the solvent boiling point and deposition temperature, and (iv) hybrid deposition based on solution shearing and thermal evaporation. These four methods are utilized to address the three objectives of the project. Control of the density of the trap states and grain boundaries by solution shearing The dual solution method is performed by two consecutive blade coating deposition. In the first deposition, we deposited a layer of C10-DNTT with significant grain boundaries as shown in Figure 1. The morphology of this first C10-DNTT layer is strongly depending on the solute concentration, shearing speed and the substrate deposition temperature. Based on the first deposition, we deposit another layer of C10-DNTT by repeating the shearing process. In the second deposition, strongly depending on the substrate temperature and solute concentration, monolayer or multiple layer of C10-DNTT can be achieved. The C10-DNTT films has domain size up to millimeter scale. The OFET devices with show a distinguished carrier mobility of up to 10.4 cm2 V−1 s−1, which is the highest among the reported values of solution-processed monolayer devices. Variation of the solution shearing parameters Since the meniscus-guided coa is mainly applicable on the soluble organic semiconductors with strong - overlap, and able to crystallize into thin films after the evaporation of solvents. In the project, two major objectives are to address the crystallization and grain boundary of the organic thin films. We adjusted four elementary factors including shearing speed (v), solute concentration (c), deposition temperature (T) and solvent boiling point (Tb), and analyze the crystal growth behavior in the meniscus-guided coating. By carefully varying and studying these four key factors, we confirm that v is the thickness regulation factor while c is proportional to crystal growth rate. The MGC crystal growth rate is also correlated to latent heat (L) of solvents and deposition temperature in an Arrhenius form. The latent heat of solvents is proportional to Tb. The transistor channels grown by the optimized MGC parameters show uniform crystal morphology (Rq < 0.25 nm) with decent carrier mobilities (average μ = 5.88 cm2 V-1 s-1 and highest μ = 7.68 cm2 V-1 s-1). We have also generalized the formulas to estimate the effects of these fabrication parameters which can serve as the crystal growth guidelines for the MGC approach. Investigate the strain induced during shearing and the crystallinity of the deposited film In this part of the work, through finite element modeling and experiments, we investigate the negative effect of C8-BTBT OFET active layer. In our study, the Marangoni flow is induced by the temperature gradient caused solvent composition, and how to use Marangoni effect induced by localized concentration difference of solvents. We utilized the surface tension generated by the Marangoni effect at the meniscus line to assist the mass transport of the dissolved organic semiconductor molecules toward the contact line, and fabricated very thin, highly crystallized, closely packed, and continuous organic films. By using this method, we can enhance the shearing speed of the modified bar-coating method increased by fivefold up to 1 mm s−1, and the deposited with a few monolayers thickness can achieve a carrier mobility up to 16.0 cm2 V−1 s−1 with a very good uniformity over an area of 2 × 2 cm2. After that, we applied the in-plane X-ray diffraction (XRD) to investigate the anisotropic strain effect in the crystalline thin film under different shearing speeds. Strain effect in the organic thin film under fast shearing The samples formed from m-xylene/DCB blended solvents under the marangoni effect enhanced bar coating method are further characterized by both out-of-plane and in-plane XRD analyses. The separate peaks from (001) to (009) in the out-of-plane direction can still be clearly observed except that the intensity is a bit lower due to 50% drop in film thickness. Furthermore, from Φ-scan of (020) peak intensities, can can notice that the dominated peaks (1-1′, 2-2′, and 3-3′) are deviated by 180°. By fixing the sample at the different angles in from 0° to 360°, we perform a 2θχ scan to measure the corresponding d-spacing of the (020) planes of that crystal domain. Along the shearing direction, a negative shift of peak positions can be observed, which represents a tensile strain. In contrast, a compressive strain is observed in the direction perpendicular to shearing. The strain results clearly show that the fast shearing of blended solvents will alter the (020) spacing both in compressive and tensile means. Hybrid deposition of organic thin film for trap states modifications and temperature sensor applications Solution-processed two-dimensional organic semiconductors have drawn considerable attention because of their novel applications from flexible optoelectronics to biosensors. However, obtaining well-oriented sheets of 2D organic materials with perfectly aligned crystals and low defect density still poses a challenge. In this part of the project, a highly crystallized C10-DNTT monolayer crystal with large-area uniformity was obtained by an ultra-slow shearing method and its growth pattern shows a kinetic Wulff’s construction supported by theoretical calculations of surface energies. The resulting seamless and highly crystalline monolayers were then used as templates for thermally depositing another C10-DNTT ultrathin top-up film. The organic thin films deposited by this hybrid approach show an interesting coherence structure with a copied molecular orientation of the templating crystal. The organic field-effect transistors developed by these hybrid C10-DNTT films exhibited better crystallinity and lower trap states energy 50% lower than the pure thermal evaporation (100% improvement). As a result, it suggests the thermal evaporation thin film is a better choice to serve as temperature sensor due to the higher conductivity dependence on the temperature. Utilization of the solution processed organic thin film as temperature sensor For the C10-DNTT samples, we utilized it as a temperature sensor by preforming a temperature dependence current (mobility) measurement from 80K to 340K. It can be noticedthat the bi-layer sample shows a band-like transport behavior. On the other hand, the mobility of monolayer device shows that hopping is the main carrier transport mode, as revealed by the Arrhenius relationship with the temperature. This thermal response confirms that the grain boundary of the monolayer layer C10-DNTT transistor has different carrier transportation mechanism with the bi-layers or multi-layers, and it also verified their applications as temperature sensor. Experimental study of thermal conductivity measurements of organic thin film The thermal conductivities of the organic thin film are measured by the 3-omega setup in our laboratory. In the 3-omega experiment, we deposit a heater/thermomemter electrode onto the top of the organic thin film, and a reference sample has no organic thin film on it. The temperature increase between these two samples are due to the extra thermal resistance from the organic thin film. We have measured the C10-DNTT thermal conductivity to be 0.28 W/m-K. Based on the thermal conductivity measurement results of the C10-DNTT, we believe the cross-plane value of k can be further improved by ensuring better crystallinity in the organic thin film, especially in the c-direction. For the practical application of these devices, the c-axis thermal conductivity should be further improved to enhance the thermal diffusion time.

17264016.label: Major findings and research outcome
17264016.value: We have investigated how would the solution shearing parameters affect the crystallinity and trap states activation energy of the two commonly used organic semiconductors for transistors, (i) C10-DNTT and (ii) C8-BTBT. We have employed four different approaches to examine the properties of the organic thin films. In the dual solution shearing method, the C10-DNTT films has domain size up to millimeter scale. The OFET devices with show a distinguished carrier mobility of up to 10.4 cm2 V−1 s−1, which is the highest among the reported values of solution-processed monolayer devices. In the low speed solution shearing, we adjusted four elementary factors including shearing speed (v), solute concentration (c), deposition temperature (T) and solvent boiling point (Tb), and analyze the crystal growth behavior in the meniscus-guided coating. By carefully varying and studying these four key factors, we confirm that v is the thickness regulation factor while c is proportional to crystal growth rate. We have employed C10-DNTT as a temperature sensor for its operation between 80 K to 340 K. We also noticed that the grain boundary of the monolayer layer C10-DNTT transistor has different carrier transportation mechanism with the bi-layers or multi-layers, and it also verified their applications as temperature sensor. Another key achievement of the current project is our 3-omega thermal conductivity setup which is very suitable for the thermal conductivity measurements. Based on the thermal conductivity results obtained by this setup, we can simulate the performance of the temperature sensor structure. Based on the experimental findings on the organic transistor temperature sensors, we have also expanded the temperature sensors to thermal ablation heater based on conformal metal thin film. Such devices have shown promising application potentials in biomedical engineering.

17264016.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
17264016.value: The success of the current project has demonstrated the excellent potentials of the thin film temperature sensors on biomedical or electronic reliability applications. It will be great if these devices can be further commercialized or scale up for the mass production. Other than the sensing of the thermal information, another potential direction would be integrating the temperature sensor with other electrophysiological signals such as EEG, ECG, or EOG sensors to serve as a real time health monitoring device. Other than that, another possible further development direction would be the integration onto ultrathin substrate down to 1 um or less. The ultrathin substrate can significantly reduce the bending stress on the device and make it extremely suitable for direct conformal applications.

17264016.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
17264016.value: This project lets the research community knows better the growth mechanical of the organic semiconductors, which is consider as the next generation semiconductor for the flexible electronics. The findings of the current project are important and valuable for the research community to further explore the potential application directions of these new class of semiconductors. The results also demonstrated the potentials of the organic semiconductors and metal thin films as the health monitoring devices. One can imagine if the patients in the hospital, especially the children or elderly, are wearing the temperature sensors and have their temperature monitored by a wifi system every 5 minutes. The man power require to do the measurements as well as the response speed would be a lot quicker. For the patients who have communication difficulties, providing them the suitable therapeutics on time is extremely important.

17264116.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17264116.value: With the rapid development of online social networks (OSNs), large-scale, instantaneous information dissemination through the influence cascade among social network users becomes possible. This offers the potential to use OSNs to advertise products and services. One form of such advertising is Sponsored Viral Marketing (SVM), in which influential users (celebrities or seed nodes) are paid to participate in promoting advertisements. As the coordinator between advertisers and seed nodes, the advertising platform (the underlying social network operator or an independent party) needs to design a set of revenue-maximizing advertising strategies, including the advertisement pricing or payment strategy, and the strategy of allocating advertisement tasks to seed nodes. Although traditional online advertising mechanisms such as sponsored search and banner ads have been intensively studied, they are not easily adapted to SVM since the latter depends on the information diffusion process. On the other hand, while information diffusion has been intensively studied in the context of the Influence Maximization Problem (IMP), which tries to maximize the information spread through seed node selection, IMP studies seldom investigate the relevant pricing strategies. Therefore, a general model of SVM, which captures both advertisement pricing and influence maximization, is highly desired. In this project, we propose such a general model for pricing and allocation strategies in SVM. In particular, we account for the behaviors of advertisers, advertising platform operator and seed nodes, as well as their interactions. Our proposed project is divided into three parts. Firstly, we model the design of pricing strategy as a double auction game, accounting for the interactions among sellers (seed nodes). Secondly, we study how to allocate advertisement tasks to different seed nodes. Specifically, the allocation strategy accounts for multiple advertisements with different payments and budget limitations, the interactions (cooperation/competition) among advertisements, and heterogeneous costs and load capacities of seed nodes. Information diffusion mechanisms, which have been intensively studied and validated based on various large scale datasets, are utilized in estimating the advertising performance. Finally, we design auction mechanisms to determine the optimal pricing with a given advertisement allocation strategy. We will further analyze the equilibrium of auctions with our proposed mechanisms. This interdisciplinary project is expected to impact the science of information diffusion in OSNs and in advertisement auctions. Based on empirical studies and validations with real-world data, our proposed models and algorithms will also be instructive to the fast-growing OSN advertising industry, especially in SVM.

17264116.label: Realisation of objectives
17264116.value: To address Objective 1, we have developed a general framework for sponsored viral marketing [2,3], in which each party, namely, the sponsor, the platform and the spreader (seed node, used interchangeably afterwards) is assumed to be rational and tries to maximize its own utility. The framework allows any information diffusion model to quantify influence in number of expected final activations. Interactions among parties and among players in each party, especially seed nodes, are also allowed. To address Objective 2, we studied the allocation strategy for the platform in a noncooperative scenario [1]. Assuming each node can reserve its influence capability in the diffusion process, we proposed a modified hierarchy-based seed node selection strategy for influence maximization. We further proposed a game-theoretic model to characterize the behavior of noncooperative nodes and designed a Vickrey–Clarke–Groves (VCG)-like scheme to incentivise cooperation. We also studied the allocation strategy under the proposed framework in an online scenario [2]. Spreaders become available stochastically and needs to be allocated immediately to existing advertisers. Assuming the objective of the platform is to maximize the social welfare, we deduced that the simple-greedy algorithm is the best choice for the platform and further found the performance bound compared to the offline optimal. In [4], we studied how to design an incentive strategy in the online social network and explained how the incentive strategy influences the diffusion. We also proposed a framework which incorporates a multi-state diffusion model. People’s purchasing behavior, which may be influenced by the rewards received in the incentive marketing strategy, is divided into different states in the diffusion model. People in different states have different influence power. Simulations are performed to illustrate our framework and it is shown that the incentive marketing strategy performs well in activating more people and achieving more revenue. To address Objective 3, we modeled the pricing competition between spreaders as a pricing game and tried to find the Nash equilibrium (NE) under different allocation strategies [3]. The most important conclusion is that given the platform is using the simple-greedy algorithm, the existence of NE cannot be guaranteed if there are at least 4 spreaders. Moreover, we deduced that if the platform adopts the ‘double-greedy’ algorithm, unique NE exists and both the upper and lower bounds of the platform’s profit can be found. Previous studies on social network marketing focused on how to propagate information widely and neglected that price is a key factor that influences information diffusion. In [5], we studied the problem of how to design pricing strategies in order to maximize the revenue when the product usage or promotion time is limited. With limited promotion time, the prices assigned in the different promotion stages of the pricing sequence can be increasing. To better understand the problem, we proposed a framework which incorporates the influence maximization problem and a multi-state diffusion model. We designed several pricing strategies under our framework with different pricing sequence order and different promotion time. Simulations were performed to illustrate the concepts in our framework and compare different pricing strategies. With our framework, we can provide some guidelines for the seller when designing the pricing strategy. 1. Yang, Yile, Zhiyi Lu, Victor O.K. Li, and Kuang Xu. 17264116.label: Major findings and research outcome
17264116.value: We have developed a general framework for sponsored viral marketing [2,3]*, in which each party, namely, the sponsor, the platform and the spreader (seed node, used interchangeably afterwards) is assumed to be rational and tries to maximize its own utility. In [1], we studied the allocation strategy for the platform in a noncooperative scenario. We further proposed a game-theoretic model to characterize the behavior of noncooperative nodes and designed a Vickrey–Clarke–Groves (VCG)-like scheme to incentivise cooperation. We evaluated our proposed schemes on large coauthorship networks, and the results show that our seed node selection scheme is robust to noncooperation and the VCG-like scheme can effectively stimulate a node to become cooperative. In [2], we proposed the online simple-greedy algorithm for such allocation problem. We proved the algorithm is guaranteed to achieve an expected welfare of at least 1 – 1/e of the expected offline optimum, and further showed it is the best that a polynomial-time algorithm can achieve. In [3], we modeled the pricing competition between spreaders as a pricing game and tried to find the Nash equilibrium (NE) under different allocation strategies. We concluded that given the platform is using the simple-greedy algorithm, the existence of NE cannot be guaranteed if there are at least 4 spreaders. We also found that the unique NE exists and the utility of the platform is at least 1/2 to the optimality and also bounded by 1/2 to the influence of all spreaders. In [4], we studied how to design an incentive strategy in the online social network and explained how the incentive strategy influences the diffusion. We also proposed a framework which incorporates a multi-state diffusion model. We showed that the incentive marketing strategy performs well in activating more people and achieving more revenue. In [5], we studied the problem of how to design pricing strategies in order to maximize the revenue when the product usage or promotion time is limited. With limited promotion time, we showed that the prices assigned in the different promotion stages of the pricing sequence can be increasing. * See Section 5.3 for the reference list.

17264116.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
17264116.value: In online social networks, such as facebook, twitter, etc., celebrities may be paid to promote products via posting or forwarding ads or related information. But how much should be paid to the celebrity? Two factors play vital roles in deciding the price. First, how is the influence valued by the buyers (advertisers)? Second, how is one celebrity’s price affected by the price of other celebrities? In this project, we considered that the influence is measured by the number of purchases under some product information spreading processes, and studied the price competition. We modeled the scenario as a pricing game where celebrities compete with each other under the selection policy of the advertiser, who is trying to maximize its own profit. Our work provides a framework whereby different players in this online social network marketing system can properly design their pricing strategies.

17267416.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17267416.value: Cold-formed steel sections with aesthetic appearance and sound structural efficiency, such as semi-oval and oval hollow sections, have recently been fabricated. Semi-oval hollow sections and oval hollow sections offer the architectural attributes of circular hollow sections, together with the structural advantages associated with the possession of different major and minor axes properties that allows semi-oval and oval hollow sections to be orientated to the most efficiently bending axis in resisting applied loads. However, existing international design specifications do not have design rules on cold-formed steel semi-oval and oval hollow sections. These cold-formed steel sections are relatively new and lack of research at this stage. Experimental and numerical investigations of cold-formed steel semi-oval and oval hollow sections columns and beams will be conducted. The experimental and numerical results will be used for the development of design rules. Therefore, new design rules for cold-formed steel semi-oval and oval hollow section columns and beams will be proposed. 冷弯型钢截面具有外形美观和良好的结构性能近年来得到发展，比如半椭圆和椭圆空心截面。半椭圆和椭圆形空心截面在建筑外观上具有圆形截面的特点，同时在结构优点上具有不同强轴弱轴的特性。这种特性使得半椭圆和椭圆空心截面可以以最有效的受弯轴承受设计荷载。然而，现今国际上的设计规范并没有冷弯型钢半椭圆和椭圆空心截面的设计条例。由于这些冷弯型钢空心截面相对较新，因此现阶段缺乏实验与数值研究。本项目将对冷弯型钢半椭圆和椭圆空心截面的柱和梁进行试验与数值研究。这些试验和数值研究的结果将被用来发展设计条例和公式。这些新提出的条例和公式适用于冷弯型钢半椭圆和椭圆空心截面的柱和梁的设计。

17267416.label: Realisation of objectives
17267416.value: The structural performance of cold-formed steel semi-oval and oval hollow sections have been investigated. A series of tensile coupon tests was carried out to determine the material properties of cold-formed steel semi-oval and oval hollow sections. It should be noted that both flat and curved coupon specimens were tested. In addition, residual stresses of cold-formed steel semi-oval and oval hollow sections were obtained by method of sectioning. The stub column test specimens were fabricated and tested. The section strengths of the semi-oval and oval hollow sections were obtained from the stub column tests, which included the cold-forming effect. Furthermore, a series of four-point bending tests on cold-formed steel semi-oval and oval hollow section members was conducted. The semi-oval and oval hollow sections failed by different buckling modes, such as local buckling, flexural buckling and interaction of local and flexural buckling. Finite element models of cold-formed steel semi-oval and oval hollow section columns and beams were developed and verified against the test results. In addition, an extensive parametric study for stub columns and beams was performed. Different cross-section sizes and steel grades of cold-formed steel semi-oval and oval hollow sections were considered. Initial imperfections of the sections were included in the finite element models. Numerical results were obtained from the parametric study. The numerical and experimental results were used for the development of design rules. Different design methods, such as the equivalent diameter method, the equivalent rectangular hollow section approach as well as Direct Strength Method, were evaluated. The Direct Strength Method was modified for cold-formed steel semi-oval and oval hollow sections. It is shown that the modified Direct Strength Method provides accurate and reliable design strength predictions. In this project, design rules for cold-formed steel semi-oval and oval hollow section stub columns and beams have been proposed. The objectives of this project have been achieved.

17301116.value: 拓撲魏爾半金屬的量子輸運理論

17301116.label: Project Objectives
17301116.value: To develop quantum theory of Weyl fermions in the presence of external magnetic and electric field. Calculation of field dependence of conductivity will be the key task of this proposal. It is anticipated to develop a transport theory for topological and non-topological semimetals in an extended range of magnetic field. To explore the effect of a pair of Weyl fermion nodes. Each Weyl node carries a magnetic monopole in momentum space. Since the total magnetic monopoles carried by Weyl fermions should be zero in a solid, the Weyl nodes always appear in pairs in Weyl semimetals. Intrinsic constraints on the Weyl fermion nodes have deep origin of topological properties of the band structure. The presence of surface electrons or Fermi arc is a direct consequence of this property. We shall try to establish a theory to realize this constraint in Weyl semimetals and explore possible consequences or new phenomena in Weyl fermion transport.

17301116.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17301116.value: The last decade has witnessed great advances in novel quantum materials with unconventional band structures in condensed matter physics and material sciences. The materials such as graphene and topological insulators provide platforms to simulate the relativistic particles in two dimensions. Newly discovered Weyl semimetals such as TaAs can host electrons which behave like relativistic massless particles with linear dispersion in three-dimensional momentum space or Weyl fermions, which are well known and long sought, but have not yet been observed in high energy physics so far. The emergent quasi-particles in the materials inherit many properties of Weyl fermions, including the non-conservation of electric charge known as the chiral anomaly, and lead to the unconventional magneto-transport behaviors such as negative magentoresistance in a weak field and extremely large magnetoresistance in a strong field. In the Weyl fermions their momenta and spins are locked in, and possess the handedness or chirality, and fermions with opposite chirality always appear in pair. Topology of the unconventional band structures generates the surface electrons, named as Fermi arc, as a consequence of the bulk-boundary correspondence, which have been also observed experimentally. Unconventional magnetoresistivity and Fermi arc are two key features of Weyl semimetals, one reflects the properties of the bulk electrons, and the other is from the surface electrons. Possible relations between these two phenomena stimulate the present proposal. The primary objectives of this proposal are to develop a quantum transport theory for Weyl fermions, to understand the unconventional magnetoresistivity and high mobility in topological Weyl semimetals, and to explore topological origins of unconventional transport properties. This project will help us to understand novel topological quantum matters, enrich the knowledge of condensed matter physics, and explore possible applications of topological Weyl semimetal to quantum electronic devices in the future. 過去十年間新穎的量子材料研究在凝聚態物理和材料科學方面取得了巨大進步。這些材料具有非常規的電子能帶結構，如石墨和拓撲絕緣體，為模擬兩維相對論性的粒子提供平台。新發現的魏爾半金屬如TaAs可以承載電子的行為就像三維動量空間裡具有線性色散關係的無質量粒子，即魏爾費米子。魏爾費米子是眾所周知的，並且是人們長期尋找的，但至今尚未在高能物理中觀察到的。這些材料中的新興準粒子具有魏爾費米子的許多特性，包稱為手徵電荷不守恆的手徵異常，從而引起非常規的磁性運輸行為，如在弱場下的負磁阻和強場下的線性磁阻。魏爾費米子的動量和自旋是鎖定在一起的，並擁有手徵性。不同手徵的費米子總是成對出現。拓撲魏爾半金屬的能帶結構可以產生表面電子，它們的能量色散關係被命名為費米弧，是體態與邊界對應的結果， 目前已被實驗觀察到。反常磁阻和費米弧是魏爾半金屬的兩個關鍵特性，一個是體現了體態電子的性質，另一個是表面電子的性質。這兩種現象之間可能存在某種關係。 該提案的主要目標是發展一個魏爾費米子量子輸運理論，理解拓撲魏爾半金屬中反常磁阻和高遷移率，並探討反常輸運性質的拓撲起源。該項目將幫助我們理解新的拓撲量子材料，豐富凝聚態物理方面的知識，並探討拓撲魏爾半金屬在將來量子電子設備中可能的應用。

17301116.label: Realisation of objectives
17301116.value: The main objective of the project is to develop quantum theory of Weyl fermions in the presence of external magnetic and electric field. The Weyl fermions were first predicted in high energy physics, and discovered in condensed matter in recent years. The relevant materials has exhibited a series of peculiar transport properties in the presence of magnetic field. It is anticipated to develop a transport theory for topological and non-topological semimetals in an extended range of magnetic field. Over the last few years, PI has published 6 papers relevant to the present project, 4 in Physical Review B, 1 in Frontier of Physics, and 1 in Science Bulletin. Topological responses from chiral anomaly: Multi-Weyl semimetals are a kind of topological phase of matter with discrete Weyl nodes characterized by multiple monopole charges, in which the chiral anomaly, the anomalous nonconservation of an axial current, occurs in the presence of electric and magnetic fields. Electronic transport properties related to the chiral anomaly in the presence of both electromagnetic fields and axial electromagnetic fields in multi-Weyl semimetals are systematically studied. It has been found that the anomalous Hall conductivity has a modification linear in the axial vector potential from inhomogeneous strains. The axial electric field leads to an axial Hall current that is proportional to the distance of Weyl nodes in momentum space. This axial current may generate chirality accumulation of Weyl fermions through delicately engineering the axial electromagnetic fields even in the absence of external electromagnetic fields. Therefore this work provides a nonmagnetic mechanism of generation of chirality accumulation in Weyl semimetals and might shed new light on the application of Weyl semimetals in the emerging field of valleytronics.[Phys. Rev. 96, 085201(2017)] Giant anisotropic magnetoresistance and planar Hall effect: Anisotropic magnetoresistance is the change tendency of resistance of a material on the mutual orientation of the electric current and the external magnetic field. Here, we report experimental observations in the Dirac semimetal Cd3As2 of giant anisotropic magnetoresistance and its transverse version, called the planar Hall effect. The relative anisotropic magnetoresistance is negative and up to −68% at 2 K and 10 T. The high anisotropy and the minus sign in this isotropic and nonmagnetic material are attributed to a field-dependent current along the magnetic field, which may be induced by the Berry curvature of the band structure. This observation not only reveals unusual physical phenomena in Weyl and Dirac semimetals, but also finds additional transport signatures of Weyl and Dirac fermions other than negative magnetoresistance.[Phys. Rev. B 97, 201110(R)(2018)] Intrinsic magnetoresistance: Negative longitudinal and positive in-plane transverse magnetoresistance have been observed in most topological Dirac/Weyl semimetals and some other topological materials. Here, we present a quantum theory of intrinsic magnetoresistance for three-dimensional Dirac fermions at a finite and uniform magnetic field B. In a semiclassical regime, it is shown that the longitudinal magnetoresistance is negative and quadratic of a weak field B while the in-plane transverse magnetoresistance is positive and quadratic of B. The relative magnetoresistance is inversely quartic of the Fermi wave vector and only determined by carrier density, irrelevant to the external scatterings in the weak scattering limit. This intrinsic anisotropic magnetoresistance is measurable in systems with low carrier density and high mobility. In the quantum oscillation regime a formula for the phase shift in Shubnikov–de Haas oscillation is present as a function of the mobility and the magnetic field, which is helpful for experimental data analysis. [Phys. Rev. B 98, 081202 (R)(2018)] Quantum magnetotransport in massive Dirac materials: Massive Dirac fermions break the chiral symmetry explicitly and also make the Berry curvature of the band structure non-Abelian. By utilizing the Green’s function technique, we develop a microscopic theory to establish a set of quantum diffusive equations for massive Dirac materials in the presence of electric and magnetic fields. It is found that the longitudinal magnetoresistance is always negative and quadratic in the magnetic field, and decays quickly with the mass. The theory is applicable to the systems with non-Abelian Berry curvature and resolves the puzzles of anomalous magnetotransport properties measured in topological materials. [Phys. Rev. B 101, 125203 (2020)] Review of quantum transport in topological semimetals: Topological semimetals are three-dimensional topological states of matter, in which the conduction and valence bands touch at a finite number of points, i.e., the Weyl nodes. Topological semimetals host paired monopoles and antimonopoles of Berry curvature at the Weyl nodes and topologically protected Fermi arcs at certain surfaces. We review our recent works on quantum transport in topological semimetals, according to the strength of the magnetic field. At weak magnetic fields, there are competitions between the positive magnetoresistivity induced by the weak anti-localization effect and negative magnetoresistivity related to the nontrivial Berry curvature. We propose a fitting formula for the magnetoconductivity of the weak anti-localization. We expect that the weak localization may be induced by inter-valley effects and interaction effect, and occur in double-Weyl semimetals. For the negative magnetoresistance induced by the nontrivial Berry curvature in topological semimetals, we show the dependence of the negative magnetoresistance on the carrier density. At strong magnetic fields, specifically, in the quantum limit, the magnetoconductivity depends on the type and range of the scattering potential of disorder. The high-field positive magnetoconductivity may not be a compelling signature of the chiral anomaly. For long-range Gaussian scattering potential and half filling, the magnetoconductivity can be linear in the quantum limit. A minimal conductivity is found at the Weyl nodes although the density of states vanishes there.[Frontier of Physics 12, 127201 (2017)] In summary, we have developed a quantum field theory for topological response from chiral anomaly in Weyl semimetal, discovered a new mechanism of intrinsic magnetoresistance in Weyl/Dirac materials with lower carrier density, and theory of magnetoresistance for massive Dirac materials. In the collaboration with experimental colleague in HKUST, we observed in anisotropic magnetoresistance and the planar Hall effect in Dirac semimetal Cd3As2. Finally we presented a review article for quantum transport in topological semimetals. Thus, we can say that we have achieved the main objectives of the present project.

To explore the effect of a pair of Weyl fermion nodes. Each Weyl node carries a magnetic monopole in momentum space. Since the total magnetic monopoles carried by Weyl fermions should be zero in a solid, the Weyl nodes always appear in pairs in Weyl semimetals. Intrinsic constraints on the Weyl fermion nodes have deep origin of topological properties of the band structure. The presence of surface electrons or Fermi arc is a direct consequence of this property. We shall try to establish a theory to realize this constraint in Weyl semimetals and explore possible consequences or new phenomena in Weyl fermion transport.

17301116.label: Major findings and research outcome
17301116.value: Major finding and research outcome (maximum 400 words; please make reference to Part C where necessary) The major finding and research outcomes are 1. We have developed a quantum field theory for topological response of chiral anomaly in multi-Weyl semimetals. The electronic transport properties has been studied systematically in the presence of both electromagnetic field and axial electromagnetic fields. It provides a nonmagnetic mechanism of generation of chirality accumulation in Weyl semimetals. 2. An intrinsic magnetoresistance is discovered in a large class of massless and massive Dirac materials. The relative magnetoresistance is inversely quartic of the Fermi wave vector and only determined by carrier density, irrelevant to the external scatterings in the weak scattering limit. It is believed that the intrinsic magnetoresistivity is attributed to the non-Abelian Berry curvature of the band structure. 3. By utilizing the Green’s function technique, we develop a microscopic theory to establish a set of quantum diffusive equations for massive Dirac materials in the presence of electric and magnetic fields. It is found that the longitudinal magnetoresistance is always negative and quadratic in the magnetic field, and decays quickly with the mass. 4. We observed the giant anisotropic magnetoresistance and the planar Hall effect in the Dirac semimetal Cd3As2. This observation reveals unusual transport phenomena and Berry phase related physics in Weyl and Dirac semimetals.

17301116.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
17301116.value: Weyl and Dirac semimetals are one of topological materials which exhibits unconventional magnetotransport properties. Although extensive efforts are made over the last few years, there are still a lot of questions to be addressed, such as the quantum interference effect and disorder effect. PI has already started a new project and continue exploring novel physics in topological quantum materials.

17301116.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
17301116.value: The primary objectives of this proposal are to develop a quantum transport theory, to understand the unconventional magnetoresistivity, and to explore topological origins of unconventional transport properties in a class of topological Weyl semimetals. The main findings relevant to the project are theory of the relative intrinsic magnetoresistivity and negative magentoresistivity in massless Weyl and massive Dirac materials, and the discovery of giant anisotropic magnetoresistance and planar Hall effect in Dirac semimetals Cd3As2 in collaboration with experimentalists. The research outcome reveals the relation between the unusual transport phenomena and the topology of the band structures in quantum materials. This project will help us to understand novel topological quantum matters, enrich the knowledge of condensed matter physics, and explore possible applications of topological Weyl semimetal to quantum electronic devices in the future.

17304116.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17304116.value: Coral reefs are amongst the most productive and biodiverse ecosystems on Earth. Yet, these critical habitats are in perilous decline. Even the best managed reefs are losing living corals at constant rates annually, due to myriad factors that can be categorized as global (ocean warming, extreme weather, & acidification) or local (pollution, over-harvesting, etc.). This is particularly true for SE Asia, where rapidly developing nations threaten the biodiversity and functioning of their coastal marine habitats of the South China Sea. China bears a particularly important role in the region, given their maritime trade-based economy, a disproportionately large footprint on marine resources, and major on-going reclamation projects in the region. For these reasons, China has an opportunity to take a leading role in environmental restoration and conservation. However, in order to restore and conserve coral reefs for the future, we must first understand the factors that caused their demise in the past, and remediate those factors that prevent their recovery in the present. Owing to the fact that coral skeletal fragments are well-preserved in sediments I propose to utilize sedimentary records of coral abundance and diversity to reconstruct the timing of coral decline along the Chinese coast of the South China Sea. This proposal focuses on recent and historical sedimentary records in 4 key sub-tropical and tropical areas of the Chinese coast that differ in latitude and land-use history; 1) Hong Kong, one of the most densely populated areas on Earth with a long history of development and environmental degradation, 2) Xiamen, which lies at the northern limit of coral distribution in China, 3) Hainan, which has seen it’s once vibrant and diverse coral reefs destroyed by human activities, and 4) Xisha Islands, perhaps the last pristine reefs in the South China Sea. At each site, surveys of coral fragments on beaches, and subtidal push cores will be used to reconstruct the former distribution and diversity of corals in the region. Using elemental dating methods we will reconstruct a time-series of ecosystem change. Further, in Hong Kong we propose to conduct an archaeological dig at lime kiln sites, to test the hypothesis that reef degradation began long before the Industrial Revolution. Taken together, these important data can be used to contrast with current coral distributions to assess how much as been lost, and define a new baseline from which future restoration efforts can be measured. 珊瑚礁是地球上最具生產力和最高生物多樣性的生態系統之一。然而，這些重要的棲息地正嚴重退化。在全球性的因素(如海洋變暖、極端天氣和海洋酸化)，以及局部地區性的因素(如污染​​，過度捕撈)的影響下，即使在管理得最好的珊瑚礁上的珊瑚也正在每年恆常地消失。這情況尤其發生在東南亞發展中國家，它們快速的發展威脅著南海沿岸海洋生境的生物多樣性和運作。鑑於中國在該地區海上貿易為基礎的經濟，不成比例的大面積海洋資源，以及在該地區正進行的填海工程項目，它承擔著一個重要角色，亦能在環境恢復和保護的方面擔當主導。然而，我們必須先了解過去什麼原因導致了珊瑚礁現處的困境，從而修復那些因素，令它們能在未來能恢復和受保護。 由於珊瑚骨骼碎片能在沉積物中完好地保存，沉積記錄中的珊瑚豐富性和多樣性能作重建中國南海沿岸珊瑚退化的時間歷史。該建議主要集中在中國沿岸的四個關鍵亞熱帶和熱帶地區內近代和歷史沉積記錄。這四個地區處於不同的北緯上而且土地利用的歷史亦不同，它們分別是1）香港，一個人口最稠密的地區之一 ，亦有著悠久發展與環境退化的歷史，2）廈門，位於在中國珊瑚分佈的北面界限，3）海南，曾經擁有著多樣化的珊瑚礁，但其後被人類活動破壞，4）西沙群島，也許在中國南海最後一片原始的珊瑚礁。在每個站點，海岸上珊瑚碎片的調查和潮下帶插管取芯將會用來重建該地區珊瑚分佈和多樣性的歷史。我們亦會使用測年法去重建生態系統變化的時間序列。此外，我們會在香港的石灰窯遺址進行考古發掘來檢驗珊瑚礁於工業革命開始前退化的假說。綜合起來，這些重要的數據可以用來對比目前的珊瑚分佈，以評估消亡的多少，並定義一個新的基準來測量未來恢復工作的成果。

17304116.label: Realisation of objectives
17304116.value: Our efforts in subtidal push coring and beach collections were very fruitful. A PhD Student championed this work and collected a number of push cores from local waters. Beach sediments were sampled to effectively reconstruct the range of rare Acropora (staghorn) corals, and revealed a shocking 40% decline in their range across the SAR. In Hoi Ha, push core evidence of Acropora dominance was used to convince the Marine Parks Council to approve a reintroduction of Acropora to the Marine Park - they have not been recorded in the park for more than 16 years. Push core analyses showed a remarkable pattern of community composition shifts, especially in Southern HK where a number of genera have been eliminated. Relative stability was observed in the East where most coral communities persist. Using multivariate analysis we identified water quality as a primary causative agent for this change in community composition - corroborating other studies by our group and others. Much of this work has been accepted for publication in Science Advances (IF = 13.1). To place the project's results in context - I was awarded ~18% of the requested amount for this work. Following the advice from our research office, I applied in the following year for an extension of the same work to the Biology & Medicine panel which was rejected. For these reasons, the required funding was well short of that required to achieve all of the objectives. We had to severely constrain the study area to Hong Kong only and scrap plans for fieldwork elsewhere. Further, we encountered many challenges in one facet of the proposed research - an archaeological dig at the lime kiln sites in the Hoi Ha Village. A significant portion of our funding was used to contract an archaeologist to engage with government stakeholders and seek permission to excavate the target site. We were met with complete obstruction by government agencies. The Antiquities and Monuments Office mandated a comprehensive review of other alternative sites which we obliged and all were found to be unsuitable for our purposes. Requests for historical documents were met with similar obstruction - we were only allowed to copy 1/8th of any document requested and were told that all historical images from past reports "had been destroyed". In order to excavate the kiln site, the EPD mandated that we apply for an Environmental Permit which would require an Environmental Impact Assessment. We instead applied for a waiver of this requirement under the grounds that our work was an investigation of a historical fishery. The AFCD was consulted and rejected our justification. We do not have the time or resources to conduct a EIA at the site. The AMO squeezed the life out of the project by limiting the excavation to a few spades of soil - we would be barred from a pit or auger excavation (so any professional excavation would be impossible) and all of our digs would need to be backfilled daily owing to safety concerns. In the process, these government stakeholders exhausted our resources very quickly through frivolous ventures that seemed only designed to deter us from the work. In the end, this element of the project was never realized. I was frankly astonished that a RGC - government funded - project received such resistance to cooperation from other government agencies.

17304116.label: Major findings and research outcome
17304116.value: This work has revealed that major changes to the regional marine ecosystem was underway more than 3,000 years ago - a time when land clearing for rice cultivation was increasing in Guangdong Province and changing the sedimentation and freshwater outflows from the Pearl River. At this time, corals were widespread in Hong Kong and marine sediments were carbonate dominated, with sensitive species like staghorn corals being found within the present day river delta. Yet, today their range has contracted by 40% and the species range is limited to the areas most distance from human activities and maximum influence by the South China Sea. Indeed, our data analysis has revealed that water quality deterioration is the most likely cause of these changes which have all taken place well before climate change impacts. There are significant cascading effects of these past changes to modern-day ecosystem functioning. Staghorn corals, once dominant have been extirpated from most sites. Massive species like Platygyra, Favia, and Pavona are now dominant at most locations and therefore provide a very different seascape to marine species. Staghorn corals are critical habitat builders whereas massive species are important for sustaining the reef foundation - they are unable to provide the rich complexity of the staghorn group. Our work has been highlighted internationally at a number of high-profile conferences. The student undertaking the work has been given prestigious recognition from the National Geographic Society which has led to enhanced media exposure for public outreach. More recently, the work has been accepted for publication in a top science journal with the editors remarking how important the study is for the Greater Bay Area of China. Perhaps most importantly, the historical data on Acropora abundance was used to justify a reintroduction of the species to the Hoi Ha Wan Marine Park after convincing the Marine Parks Council of their importance for ecosystem functioning.

17304116.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
17304116.value: There is still great potential in HK's extensive archaeological sites for reconstructing past biodiversity to inform modern policy and management. Not only the lime kilns but fossil middens have been sampled previously by the Antiquities and Monuments Office. Accessing archived materials is effectively impossible based on our experience, but a wealth of knowledge is locked up within government storage. This information is critically important if the government continues to push an active management agenda in marine protected areas which benefit from historical justification for marine species reintroductions and habitat modification.

17304116.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
17304116.value: Few people in Hong Kong realize that we have more coral species than the Caribbean - many believing that corals are too sensitive to survive in our urbanized environment. Yet, corals have persisted here for thousands of years and were once more widespread than they are today with rich communities surrounding the southern coast of Lantau Island. Today, these habitats as well as those along Southern HK Island have been severely changed from centuries of water quality deterioration. This change began more than 3,000 years ago with the rise of agriculture in southern China and continuing today with widespread urbanization and water pollution in the Greater Bay Area. The range of sensitive species like staghorn corals has been reduced by 40%, going from 50% of the coral community to 0% in a famous marine park. So severe has this change been that even the composition of marine sediments have changed in western areas and eastern sites are now dominated by massive species with unknown consequences for marine biodiversity. Remarkably, this work has been used to justify the reintroduction of staghorn corals to a marine park - a major policy outcome.

17304716.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17304716.value: Quantum key distribution (QKD) is an important quantum information processing task for two cooperative parties to share a unconditionally secure secret key through preparation, transmission and measurement of quantum states. In 2014, Sasaki, Yamamoto and Koashi surprised the community by introducing a QKD scheme known as the round-robin differential-phase-shift (RRDPS) protocol whose security does not depend on the Heisenberg uncertainty principle. Contrary to common belief, their protocol also shows that it is possible to completely eliminate the costly channel noise estimation step in QKD making it more efficient. That is why Curty remarked in his Nature Physics' New & Views commentary that the RRDPS protocol "may well revolutionize the field as we know it today". The main innovation used in the RRDPS protocol is to carefully encode excessive amount of classical information in a quantum state in a large enough Hilbert space so that an eavesdropper has little chance to correctly obtain the actual information transmitted without disturbing the quantum state. Lately, I discovered another QKD scheme (Chau15) which demonstrates that it is the size of the Hilbert space rather than the encoding of excessive amount of classical information in it that makes these type of schemes secure, efficient and highly error-tolerant. Moreover, using a carefully designed local operation plus two-way classical communication (LOCC2) post-processing, the Chau15 scheme can tolerate up to 50% bit error rate (BER) through the transmission of quantum states in four-dimensional Hilbert space using ideal photon source and detectors, making it the first finite-dimensional-qudit-based prepare-and-measure QKD scheme that achieves the theoretical limit of 50% BER. The Chau15 scheme is also easier to implement although the aggressive LOCC2 post-processing makes the key rate extremely low. Since the Chau15 scheme and its closely related RRDPS protocol are so important from the conceptual and practical view points, it is timely to study and extend them on multiple fronts. I will further investigate the security and key rate of the Chau15 scheme in realistic settings (that is, using realistic photon source and detectors) using one-way rather two-way classical communications (so as to increase the key rate at the expense of a lower tolerable BER). I will also study the security and efficiency tradeoff of variations of the RRDPS protocol and the Chau15 scheme that encode classical bits of information in qudits. Understanding the inner workings of these variations will enable me to optimize the performance of this type of QKD protocols. 在量子資訊處理中，其中一個重要的研究是量子密鑰分配(QKD)，即是如何透過準備、傳送和測量量子態讓合作的雙方能夠產生並分享一個無條件安全的密鑰。在2014年，Sasaki, Yamamoto 和Koashi 發現一個令同行頗驚訝的QKD通訊協定-叫循環差分相移(RRDPS)，當中並沒有依賴海森堡的不確定性原理(Heisenberg's uncertainty principle)。另外，這個通訊協定亦展示出可以完全不需要估算高成本通訊渠道的干擾，突破傳送時的效率。而Curty亦在Nature Physics 中評論指RRDPS可能會顛覆這個研究領域。RRDPS主要的革新是利用一個足夠大的希爾伯特空間去小心地編入額外的古典資訊，令竊聽者只有微小的機會在不干擾量子態的情況下，取得完整正確的資訊。 之後，我發現另一個通訊協定(Chau15)可以演示出這種通訊協定的安全性、高效益和高容錯率是基於希爾伯特空間的大小，而不是編入額外的資訊。此外，利用一個精心設計的局域操作和雙向古典通訊(LOCC2)後期處理，Chau15協定可以在利用四維的希爾伯特空間和完美光子源和測量儀器下達到50%的容錯率，是目前第一個成功達到理論上最大的容錯率的有限維數的基於測量的QKD協定。雖然LOCC2的方法使密鑰率非常低，但實驗上非常容易實行。 由於Chau15協定和其有很大關係的RRDPS協定都在概念和應用都非常重要，因此值得在不同方面研究和發展。我將會研究Chau15協定在現實環境(即是考慮現實中的光子源和測量儀器)和單向的古典通訊(這使容錯率下降，但密鑰率會提高)情況下的安全性和密鑰率。我亦會研究不同RRDPS協定和Chau15協定在安全性和效率之間的取捨關係。深入了解當中的原理，最後能發展出優化所有這類別的QKD協定的方法。

17304716.label: Realisation of objectives
17304716.value: I discovered several improvements of the Chau15 scheme (the improvements are now called the Chau-Wang-Wong scheme and the Chau18 scheme) and performed security and performance analysis of all the these three schemes. More importantly, I found that even though the Chau-Wang-Wong scheme has the same error tolerant capability as the well-known six-state scheme, they are not of the same class in the sense that they are not unitarily equivalent to each other. In this regard, they have the same performance is likely to be accidental. So the question is which one is more feasible from the experiment point of view. The joint works with my experiment collaborators in Hefei showed that the Chau-Wang-Wong scheme is more feasible through two proof-of-principle experiments. On a different front, I systematically extended the decoy state method (which applies to all non-continuous state quantum key distribution with Possionian distributed photon sources) to arbitrary number of decoy state with the use of a beauty inversion formula of the Vandermonde matrix plus an extension of a powerful concentration inequality in mathematical statistics known as the McDiarmid inequality. These discoveries are perhaps even more important that the analysis of the Chau15 scheme and its extension because of its generality --- something that is totally unexpected at the beginning of this project.

17304716.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
17304716.value: I analyzed the security of several quantum cryptography methods and found via theoretical analysis and experiment demonstration that the so-called Chau-Wang-Wong scheme proposed in my group is more feasible than the well-known six-state scheme. More importantly, there is an unexpected finding in this research, namely, the use of powerful techniques of using certain mathematical statistics methods to give a better efficiency (in terms of the so-called provably secure key rate) of many quantum cryptography methods without the need of changing the experimental setup. This is essential in making large scale high bandwidth quantum cryptography more feasible.

17305416.label: Project Objectives
17305416.value: To determine the energy distribution of shocked particles using bow-shock PWNe. We will measure the broadband spectra of selected sources using multi-wavelength observations, and fitted the results with an emission model to infer the energetics of the injected particles. We wish to determine if the latter can be described by a broken power law, or additional components such as a Maxwellian is needed. To compile a comprehensive sample of the spectral index distribution of young PWNe in X-rays. We will analyse the archival data of all young PWNe that are well detected in X-rays, and apply a uniform analysis to determine the radial variation of their spectral indices. The comprehensive sample will serve as essential inputs for subsequent theoretical modeling of particle transport and cooling processes. To test the model of particle transport in young PWNe. We will compare the spectral index distribution sample we obtain with predictions from the diffusion model, which was suggested as the primary mode of cosmic rays transport in young PWNe. We wish to confirm if the constant diffusion coefficient and magnetic field used in the model are good approximations for all young PWNe.

17305416.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17305416.value: 當大質量的恒星用盡燃料後，會以超新星爆炸形式結束生命，並產生脈衝星或黑洞。脈衝星擁有宇宙最強的磁場，可提供極端的條件作物理實驗。強電磁場會把帶電粒子如電子等加速，以高速吹離脈衝星表面，產生一股脈衝星風。當這粒子風碰到外面的星際物質時會減速並形成終端震波，粒子在震波中會再次被加速，到達相對論速度，並放出從射電到X光的寬帶同步輻射。這就是脈衝風星雲。 維克托·赫斯1912年發現了宇宙射綫，並於1936年獲得諾貝爾物理學獎。至今一世紀多以來，這些來自宇宙的高速粒子起源一直是個謎。脈衝風相信可提供一部分宇宙射綫中的輕子，但傳統的磁鏡加速方法在脈衝風星雲的相對論激波中會變得很沒有效率。各種新的理論相繼被提出，他們對粒子能譜有不同的預測。我們提出一個新的方法，就是用弓形震波的脈衝風星雲去測試這些理論。弓形震波是脈衝風星雲的最終形態，脈衝星以超音速在星際介質移動，因此其星雲只包含最年輕的粒子，大大簡化了模型的複雜性。 粒子在脈衝風星雲內的傳輸真接影嚮到宇宙射綫產生的效率。有研究指在年輕的星雲中，主要為擴散作用，並只須固定的擴散系數及磁場。為了驗証這個假設，我們打算建立一個全面的樣本庫，包含年輕脈衝風星雲的X光冪律譜指數分佈。我們會仔細比較理論跟觀測數據。這樣本庫也可成為日後理論或模疑研究的重要參考。 此研究將與之前脈衝風星雲內的磁場研究互相呼應，幫助解開宇宙射綫之謎。

17305416.label: Realisation of objectives
17305416.value: This project aims to study the shocked particle distribution of pulsar wind nebulae, using multiwavelength observations. We have successfully compiled the broadband spectrum of the Mouse Nebula, a prototypical example of bow-shock PWN. We built a simple one-zone model to simulate the observed spectrum, and show that a broken power-law model is preferred for the shocked particle distribution over a simple power law and power law plus Maxwellian distributions. We also presented a systematic study of nine brightest X-ray PWNe that are well resolved with the Chandra X-ray Observatory. We compiled a database of spatial variation of their spectral index, and fit with an analytical model. Our results show that pure diffusion is sufficient to explain spectral variation and surface brightness.

17305416.label: Major findings and research outcome
17305416.value: 1. We show that the energy distribution of shocked particle in a PWN is best described by a broken power-law model. Neither a single power law nor a power law plus Maxwellian fit. This supports the theory of magnetic reconnection as particle acceleration and rejects some other theoretical models. 2. We compiled a comprehensive database of spectral variation of bright X-ray PWNe and successfully built a model to explain the variation and surface brightness using pure diffusion. This shows that diffusion, rather than advection, is the main particle transport mode in PWN.

17305416.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
17305416.value: Pulsars are powerful particle accelerators in the Universe, a main production site of cosmic rays arriving Earth. We employed observations and modeling to understand particle acceleration process in pulsar environment. The results help reject some theoretical models, help unveil the mystery of the origin of cosmic rays.

17307716.label: Major findings and research outcome
17307716.value: We succeeded to carry out the first attempt for in-beam γ-ray spectroscopy of 100Sn. 100Sn is the heaviest self-conjugate doubly magic nucleus (N=Z=50) while locating at the proton dripline and the single-particle nature of its neighboring nuclei are of great importance to examine the rigidity of the core 100Sn by comparison with theoretical predictions and extrapolations. We succeeded to measure the reaction cross sections of 101Sn to 100Sn and 102Sn to 100Sn on Carbon and Hydrogen targets. Though statistics is low, it is promising that we observed a bound excited state in 100Sn spectrum which is believed to be the first 2+ state. Moreover we also obtained the gamma spectra of neighboring nuclei 101Sn, 99Cd and 99,100In which are being analyzed to examine the single-particle nature of the low-lying states. The results are being compared to the theoretical calculations which will give us more quantitative understanding about the structure and magicity of this special nucleus 100Sn. This also provides stringent constraints to establish reliable theories and verifies a reasonable truncation for nuclear shell models making the calculation of complex nuclei feasible in A= 100 regions. We also completed the simulation and found the optimal configuration of the LaBr3 array. This proposed new γ-ray detection array capable for higher precision γ-ray spectroscopy will lead to the next significant new insights into the nuclear structure.

17307716.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
17307716.value: Since we have obtained cross sections of 101Sn to 100Sn and 102Sn to 100Sn and observed the bound first 2+ state, we could reliably estimate the beam time needed for the full in-beam gamma experiment for achieving the first 2+ transition with sufficient statistics for meaningful conclusions. We will submit a full proposal around the end of 2020 to RIKEN to request ~10 day beam time for that. On the other hand, grant application based on the designed configuration of LaBr3 will be submitted in the future.

17307716.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
17307716.value: We investigated the structure of 100Sn (N=Z=50), particularly the energy of the first 2+ state, and the low-lying states in the neighboring nuclei, via in-beam gamma spectroscopy technique using RIKEN facility. 100Sn is the heaviest self-conjugate exotic doubly-magic nucleus. It lies on the proton drip-line and on the astrophysical rp-process path. Characterizing the magicity of 100Sn and the nature of single-particle states in its neighboring nuclei is therefore essential not only to the fundamental understanding of nuclear forces and nucleo-synthesis, but also benchmarking structure theories. We also studied the new detector named LaBr3. Next significant new insights into the structure of nuclei would require new gamma-ray detection array capable for higher precision gamma-ray spectroscopy. We carried out a serial of detector performance tests and simulations for LaBr3(Ce). Integrating LaBr3(Ce) array into the upgraded-DALI2 with optimal configuration for future’s experiments at RIKEN are fully examined. This R&D work is essential to the application of a big equipment research fund for LaBr3(Ce) array construction.

17307916.label: Project Objectives
17307916.value: Femtosecond time-resolved transient absorption (fs-TA) and other time-resolved spectroscopy methods will be used to examine the excited states and intermediates associated with the photophysics and photochemistry of blebbistatin in aqueous solutions. Additional experiments like ultraviolet/visible absorption, resonance Raman spectroscopy and mass spectrometry techniques will be used to characterize any photoproducts produced. Reaction mechanism(s) will be deduced and proposed from the preceding data. Similar time-resolved spectroscopy and product analysis experiments as described in Objective 1 will also be performed for other blebbistatin derivatives like deoxyblebbistatin and blebbistatin-O-benzoate in aqueous solutions. Comparison of the results for blebbistatin, deoxyblebbistatin and blebbistatin-O-benzoate will elucidate whether or not an ESIPT reaction mechanism may occur in the excited state(s) of blebbistatin. In addition, blebbistatin-O-benzoate may be able to photorelease blebbistatin via a homolysis C-O bond breaking in blebbistatin-O-benzoate and these proposed experiments will determine whether or not this is possible. Time-resolved spectroscopy and product analysis experiments as described in Objective 1 will be done for simvastatin as an example of the naturally derived type I statin drugs. These results will be used as a benchmark to better understand the excited states, intermediates and reaction mechanism(s) associated with the photophysics and photochemistry of a typical and widely used type I statin. Similar time-resolved spectroscopy and product analysis experiments as indicated in Objective 1 will also be carried out to explore the photophysics and photochemistry of other type I statins like lovastatin and pravastatin in different solutions. These results will help better understand the substituent effects on the photochemical reaction mechanisms and elucidate the reactivity of the key intermediates that are associated with the phototoxicity induced by typical type I statins. Time-resolved spectroscopy and product analysis experiments as detailed in Objective 1 will be done for rosuvastatin as an example of synthetic type II statin drugs. These results will be used as a benchmark to better understand the excited states, intermediates and reaction mechanism(s) associated with the photophysics and photochemistry of a typical and widely used type II statin. Similar time-resolved spectroscopy and product analysis experiments as detailed in Objective 1 will also be carried out to investigate the photophysics and photochemistry of other type II statins such as fluvastatin, pitavastatin and atorvastatin in different solutions. These results will help better understand the substituent effects on the photochemical reaction mechanisms and elucidate the reactivity of the key intermediates that are associated with the phototoxicity induced by typical type I statins. The results obtained for Objectives 3 to 6 will be compared to one another to examine the similarities and differences in the photophysics, photochemistry and reaction mechanisms so as to see if there are any correlations between the structures of the naturally derived type I statins and the synthetic type II statins in their phototoxicity and/or photostability.
