17628816.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17628816.value: This research aims to explore the growing significance of landscape design in the planning of Chinese cities from 1914 to 1937. It seeks to explore three important but under-examined aspects of this shift. The first is the changing meanings ascribed to new types of landscape spaces that emerged in this period; including public parks, botanical gardens, children’s playgrounds and other recreational venues, which had by the 1920s become key sites of modernization and nationalist social reform under the government of the Republican of China. Second, it considers the interconnection between studies of landscapes and other newly established professional disciplines, including botanical science, civil engineering, public health, urban planning and urban administration. Third, it examines how modernist landscape spaces were articulated in a variety of narratives, such as academic writings, social commentaries, fictions, textbooks and children’s primers. By tracing the multiple interpretation of the roles of landscape and connecting them with key planning projects initiated in this period, this research elucidates the complex forces behind the shaping of forms and norms of cities in China in the early 20th century, an unsettling epoch in which social discontent, simmering nationalism, and emergent aspirations for a better urban future intersect. Although not formally established as a professional discipline in China until 1952, the term “landscape architecture” (美術建築學, or 風景園藝學) began to appear in Chinese academic articles in the mid-1910s, with a majority focusing on comparing the aesthetic merits of traditional and modernist landscape design and on the latter’s role in enabling social betterment. These discussions were expanded in the 1920s along with a growing number of writings on city planning, urban administration and other science disciplines emphasizing the urgent need to improve the urban environment and “civilize the habits" of Chinese citizens. The research will begin by contextualizing these discussions within new conceptions of planning and urban governance emerging in the 1910s, including the Garden City Movement, which originated in England and was adapted by planners and developers in other parts of the world. The second part of the research will investigate several major planning initiatives in four metropolises: Beijing, Shanghai, Nanjing and Guangzhou, where modernist landscape design projects played a prominent role in the conception of the city’s urban future. The final part will map the multiple interpretations of landscape spaces in different mediums and consider how popular imaginaries have contributed to the construction of a new moral topography and emergent developmental discourse. 本研究旨在探討園境設計在1911至1949年間中國城市規劃中日趨重要的地位。研究將探討這一改變中的三個重要卻未被充分研究的方面。第一，這時期湧現的新園境空間類型被賦予了不同的意義。而這些空間，包括公園、植物園、兒童遊樂場以及其他娛樂場所在二十世紀二十年代成為民國政府現代化運動以及民族主義社會改革的重要場地。第二，研究將考慮園境建築學研究與其他新興專業學科的相互聯繫，包括植物學、土木工程、公共衛生、城市規劃以市政學。 第三，研究探討不同敘述，包括學術著作、社會評論、小說、教科書和兒童讀物，如何闡述現代主義園境空間。在二十世紀初期這個激盪的時代，社會的不滿情緒、醞釀中的民族主義以及對城市美好未來的新渴望交織在一起。通過追溯對園境建築角色的多重詮釋，並將這些詮釋與同時期的重要規劃項目相關聯，本研究將解讀這一時期中國城市形態與規則形成背後錯綜複雜的力量。 雖然園境建築學直到1952年才正式成為一個專業學科，但是“美術建築學”或者“風景園藝學”早於1910年代中期開始出現在中文的學術文章中。這些文章多聚焦傳統和現代主義園境設計美學的比較以及後者的社會改良作用。二十世紀二十年代，出現越來越多關於城市規劃、市政學及其他科學的著作，它們強調改善城市環境及培養中國民眾“文明的習慣”的迫切需要。有關園境建築的討論也得到進一步發展。本研究首先將這些討論置於1910年代的歷史脈絡中。當時湧現出一系列關於規劃和城市管治的新概念，其中包括源自英國及後為全球規劃師及發展商所仿效的花園城市運動。研究的第二部分將檢視四個中國大都市，包括北京、上海、南京和廣州的若干個主要新規劃。現代主義園境設計在這些城市未來的構想中扮演了重要角色。在最後部分，研究將展現不同媒體對園境空間的多重詮釋以及探討大眾的意象如何幫助建立一個新的道德地形（學）及新的發展話語。

17628816.label: Realisation of objectives
17628816.value: All the objectives set out in the proposal have been achieved. During the research period, the PI and her research assistant carried out substantive archival research in China and Taiwan to examine original documents on the planning and design of Chinese cities in the early 20th century. These materials, which include administrative reports, planning documents, academic writings, personal memoirs and a large number of general-knowledge texts published in the popular press, have enabled the PI to gain an in-depth understanding of the burgeoning ideas of modernization and emergent roles of professional experts played in the shaping of modern built environment in Republican China. Importantly, the materials clearly indicate the diffusion of ideas across disciplinary boundaries and how discussions of planning, architecture and landscape design were interpreted by a wider range of social actors beyond the professional fields, including a fast growing middle-class reading public longing to live in more modern and healthier environments, and real estate developers and speculators seeking to capitalize on these desires by initiating new development projects. These multiple narratives have been crucial for elucidating the formation of new discourses about the city and its relationship with the countryside and how planning and development practices were intrinsically tied to growing collective aspirations for a better future. These dynamics have been illustrated in each of the publications arising from the research. While each focuses on a specific theme within the larger topic of modernization in China, they collectively demonstrate the merits of the use of diverse sources in revealing previous unknown connections between different groups of social actors and institutions. The enquiries also highlight the importance of interdisciplinary historical research by drawing attention to the linkages between language use and social processes and how language played an important part in structuring what was expressed in different types of text. Methodologically, the research illustrates what I call an “unsystematic” introduction to the histories of planning and the built environment that enables new understandings of competing interpretations of the modernizing city and how these have come to shape the urban milieu and longer term development trajectories.

17628816.label: Major findings and research outcome
17628816.value: Outputs of this research include three peer-reviewed journal articles and a published working paper. Based on findings from the early phase of the research, the first article examines how the garden city idea was introduced to China in the early 20th century and subsequently promoted by Chinese planners and urban administrators as a means to promote urban improvement, economic development and nation-building. By examining the planning and design concepts of several garden city projects and the multiple narratives around them, the article illustrates how a foreign planning idea was adapted in China as well as how it interacted with existing discourses about the city, the countryside, and the roles of the state and citizens in modernization. The second article turns to examine the development of the landscape architecture discipline in China by tracing academic writings and education programs on landscapes and its allied fields from 1910s to 1950. It is argued that although the professionalization of landscape architecture was an integral part of China’s modernization, its early affiliation with agriculture and resource management complicated its professional identity. The paper also illustrates the active exchange of knowledge between China and other countries in this period and how a new logic of “developmental thinking” became rationalized across built environment professions. Finally, the third article (currently in preparation), examines the emergent conceptions of modern parks and recreational landscapes in Guangzhou and Hong Kong between 1910s and 1930s. By revisiting the planning and design processes of a number of public parks, the paper illustrates how planning models and urban visions originated in the West had been adapted in “non-Western" contexts by local actors and institutions.

17628816.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
17628816.value: Although this project originally proposed to focus on the 1920s and 30s, findings from the early phase of research suggest that it was necessary to extend the study period from the late Qing to the early years of the People’s Republic of China. This is because the rationales behind many policies and projects implemented in the Republican era were built upon those in earlier times, particularly initiatives introduced in the 1900s under the New Policy Program. At the same time, some of the planning and design ideas (including unbuilt projects) developed in the 1920s and 30s were adopted in major state-led development schemes in the 1950s. These dynamics suggest that the histories of planning and landscape architecture did not necessarily fit well with changes of political regimes and associated ideologies. This thus opens up opportunities for future research on the continuities and discontinuities of built environment histories in 20th century China. Seen this way, the outputs of this project would also act as catalysts for new research endeavours that may extend to other professional disciplines. Over the course of the research, the PI has uncovered a large amount of original archival sources relating to China’s modernization and development. These sources covered little known projects, both built and unbuilt, that have not been discussed by historians before. At the same time, they also reveal the transnational exchange of knowledge between China and other countries, in particular Japan and France, that was more extensive than previously known. These discoveries will provide valuable new evidence for further studies of the evolving rationales of modernist planning and landscape design and the roles of their advocates in the future.

17628816.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
17628816.value: This project aims to reposition the early 20th century as a significant historical moment in which modernist planning and landscape design played a prominent role in China’s modernization process. It does so by examining the ways in which ideas of planning and design were introduced to China and subsequently appropriated by Chinese planners and administrators as a means to promote urban improvement, economic development and nation-building. By examining a number of major development schemes and the multiple narratives around them by a wide range of social actors, the research has enabled a better understanding of the production of new knowledge in this period and the conflicting forces contributing to the shaping of urban milieus. This study thus illuminates historically specific circumstances, while also identifying longer-term and contemporary impacts of these trajectories.

17628916.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17628916.value: In the past three decades, suicide and depression have been gradually recognized as important public health issues both locally and globally. Research and services in mental health and suicide prevention have also been progressing in Hong Kong (HK) and mainland China (CN), but are still challenged by stigma and myths. According to the social construction of reality theory, the mass media’s representation and agenda setting has significant impacts on how policy makers and the public perceive and attribute certain issues, whereas authorities such as the government and experts in the relevant fields are often involved in co-construction of media representation. However, the discursive representation of suicide and depression in the media, government documents, and academic publications was barely examined in HK and CN, not to mention a longitudinal examination on their changes. The proposed project aims to reveal what reality/realities of suicide and depression was/were represented in the mass media, government documents, and academic publications, in the past three decades, and who or what forces contributed to the media discourse. We will apply the crowdsourcing approach and state-of-the-art natural language processing (NPL) methods, such as sentiment analysis and topic modelling to aid researchers to analyze the considerable media content. Specifically, our first research objective is to comprehensively and exhaustively trace articles relating to suicide and depression and published by the media, the HK/CN government, and the academic fields in the past three decades, and examine the publication frequency trends. The second objective is to examine the discursive characteristics of the media and authoritative publications. We will also compare the patterns in HK and CN to explore whether there is any cross-border interaction. The third is to focus on the media discourse, which is directly related with the public’s perception, and examine who or what forces influenced the media discourse of suicide and depression. The project will provide insights into the differences and commonalities in constructing social attitudes and norms towards mental health issues in the context of One Country, Two Systems. Its implications can inform more effective and culture-sensitive de-stigmatization of suicide and depression and promotion of mental well-being. The database generated by this project can be an informative resource for future research on sociology of mental illness and suicide. Also the computerized programs developed by this project will contribute to long-term surveillance of how the public discourse frames mental health issues. 在過去的三十年裡，自殺和抑鬱症逐步被本地及國際社會認可為重要的公共健康議題。香港和中國內地對於精神健康及防止自殺的研究和服務工作逐漸進步，但仍受到污名化和各種迷思誤解的阻滯。根據社會建構真實理論，公眾及政策制定者對某一議題的認知受到大眾傳媒的呈現和議程設置的重要影響；而另一方面，傳媒的呈現和議程設置又受到政府、專家等權威機構／人士的影響。遺憾的是，我們目前對中港傳媒、政府、專家過往如何表述自殺和抑鬱症仍欠缺了解，更遑論跨越三十年的長期觀察研究。 本研究致力於揭示在過去的三十年間，中港大眾傳媒、政府公文、學術發表如何呈現、論述自殺及抑鬱症問題，以及哪些社會力量對大眾傳媒的論述產生了影響。我們將採用最新的眾包及自然語言處理方法（例如情感分析、主題模型）來協助分析大量的文本數據。 具體來講，我們的第一個研究目標是要全面地收集、審閱1985～2015的三十年裡，中港傳媒、政府、學術界發表過哪些與自殺及抑鬱症有關的文章、文件，並檢驗發表頻率隨著時間改變的趨勢。第二個研究目標是檢驗這些發表在論述自殺及抑鬱症時的文本特徵，並對比中港之間是否有交互影響。第三個目標則是聚焦在傳媒論述，檢驗哪些人物或社會力量影響到傳媒對自殺及抑鬱症的論述。 本研究將對有助於我們了解在“一國兩制”的環境下，中港社會如何建構對自殺及抑鬱症的態度和認知 。研究成果將有助於我們更加有效、有文化針對性地對自殺和抑鬱症去污名化，推動精神健康。本研究總結的數據庫將為未來精神疾病及自殺的社會學研究提供資源。本研究開發的文本分析程序亦將有助於未來長期、持續地監測大眾傳媒如何建構精神健康議題。

17628916.label: Realisation of objectives
17628916.value: The project has achieved its objectives. In total, the project screened more than 230,000 news articles, 62,613 English and Chinese research publications, and 7,170 government documents concerning suicide, including but not limited to those related suicide with depression, in Hong Kong and Mainland China. After screening by both manual checking and machine learning classification, 138, 539 news articles, 6,430 research publications, and 4,143 government documents were classified as eligible for further review and analysis. Drawing on the agenda setting and framing theories and applying systematic review and thematic content analysis methods, the publication trends over the years, the dynamics of framing and linguistic characteristics in different sources of discourse, and the key contributors to those publications were examined. The commonalities and differences between Hong Kong and Mainland China were compared to identify any cross-border interactions. The project has generated a rich database for future research into the social representation of suicide in Hong Kong and Mainland China. If other researchers are interested in making use of the dataset, they are welcome to contact the PI for collaboration. Some of the research findings have been published, including two papers published in peer-referred journals, two papers accepted by peer-referred journals, and two presentations at international conferences (see details in Part C). In certain aspects, the project has over-achieved its objectives. For example, when reviewing suicide research publications, the project has reviewed publications not only in Mainland China and Hong Kong, but also Macau. When studying news articles and government policy documents related to suicide, the project has extended its review period from 1985~2015 to 1985~2019 to keep up to date. In addition, the project innovatively applied the text mining methods to suicide research, which has attracted attention from international colleagues and resulted in methodological publications in a Q1 journal. The major challenge for this project was the shortage of time. It was partially attributed to the PI’s job changes from one university to another. The transition caused a major delay as it took a long time for the budget to be transferred and for the PI to recruit and train a new research assistant. In addition, the heavy workload of data collection exceeded my early estimates by a sizeable amount. A large number of news archives and government documents have not been digitalized, for which I had to train and supervise helpers to manually check hardcopies at libraries. Those archives are mostly stored as special collections by the university/public libraries in Hong Kong and Beijing. The special collection libraries often have shorter opening hours than regular libraries and only allow one person to check one stack at a time. All those restrictions prolonged the data collection process. The challenge was further complicated by the shortage of manpower. Originally the project proposed to recruit a large crew of online helpers to annotate the massive amount of news articles. However, the method was found to be unfeasible when we had to extract information from a large number of hard copies. Therefore, I had to change to recruit part-time helpers offline, who could conduct data screening and annotation at libraries, and impose close training and supervision of the helpers to ensure their work quality. Using this method, I could only manage to supervise a maximum of four helpers at the same time, which was a much smaller manpower number than I expected. Nonetheless, with extension approval, the project managed to complete all data collection and analysis on time. However, some manuscripts are still under review or preparation. For example, one manuscript to report the findings on the media and policy agenda setting and representations of suicide in China from 1985 to 2019 has been submitted to a Q1 journal and is currently under review. One manuscript to report findings on the same topic but focusing on Hong Kong is under preparation. As mental illness, especially depression, is one of the major risk factors for suicide, the project originally proposed to highlight how suicide and depression were related in the media reporting, research publications, and authoritative documents. However, after data collection and analysis, we found that the mention of depression in suicide-related documents was not as frequent as expected. The finding reflected that the researchers, media professionals, and government policymakers in Hong Kong and Mainland China more frequently attributed suicide to social factors rather than psychiatric/psychological conditions. Hence, the relationship between suicide and depression was not highlighted in the titles of the publications generated from this project. Nonetheless, findings on the relationship between the two were reported and discussed in those publications.

17628916.label: Major findings and research outcome
17628916.value: Suicide research in Mainland China (CN) in the early years benefited from collaborations with international experts and receiving overseas funding support, including Hong Kong (HK) ones. After 2002, more provincial and national levels of funding have been provided to suicide research in CN which led to a boom in the number of publications. The number of CN suicide research publications in English journals has even outperformed HK ones since 2008 (more details in Publication 4, Part C). The research and media reporting agenda and framing angles on suicide in CN were found to be closely influenced by government policies. Although market-oriented newspapers in CN have been influenced by HK ones to publish more sensational reporting of suicide incidents, generally speaking, CN newspapers reported more frequently and prominently on government policies and prevention measures but less frequently on suicide incidents than the HK ones. In both the government documents and news reports, a few frames of suicide were noted (details are reported in an under-review manuscript): 1) as an indicator of the severity of a social problem; 2) as an individual’s erroneous choice to tackle personal difficulties; 3) as ideological and political deficiencies and weak willpower; 4) as a threat to public security or social stability; 5) as a psychiatric/psychological problem; and 6) as a public health problem and stressing cross-sectoral collaboration on suicide prevention. In addition, some news articles described certain suicides as virtuous (Frame 7). Frame 6 has become mainstream recently, as the Health China 2030 Strategic Plan was issued by the highest authority and explicitly included suicide prevention. Compared to CN, HK policy documents have consistently framed suicide as a public health problem and developed various suicide intervention measures, some of which were reported by the CN newspapers as good examples for learning. However, suicide prevention efforts in HK were assigned to different departments for different target populations. There is a lack of centralized leadership to coordinate cross-sectoral collaborations. Suicide news has always been frequently reported by Hong Kong newspapers (see details in Publications 2&3, Part C). All the 7 frames aforementioned were also found in HK media representations, except Frame 3. Although media coverage of preventive information, such as interviews with suicide researchers, NGO representatives, and government officials, has increased in recent years, sensational representation of suicide is still a challenge for suicide prevention in HK (see details in Publication 1, Part C).

17628916.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
17628916.value: As explored in the project, suicide news reporting characteristics can be utilized as one of the indicators and predictors of suicide incidence trends. Future research can follow this direction to develop more accurate prediction models and evaluate the utilities and effectiveness of monitoring of suicide news and research publications as a part of an integrated suicide prevention strategy. The scoping review of suicide research identified a few research topics that have received more empirical studies, which can be developed into systematic reviews and meta-analyses in the next step. The project’s findings demonstrated dynamic changes over the years regarding suicide research, news reporting, policies in Hong Kong and Mainland China. As the two societies are continuously experiencing rapid change, it is worth further monitoring and studies on the same topic to understand suicide and suicide prevention with a historical overview. The project also demonstrated that advanced text mining methods can be a useful and powerful tool to analyze a massive amount of content. The same methodology can be applied to study other social science research topics, such as examining research trends, news reporting trends, online discussion, and sentiments regarding suicide or other social issues.

17628916.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
17628916.value: The project provided insight into how researchers, mass media, and governments represented suicide in contemporary Hong Kong and Mainland China. The historical examination over three decades equipped us with more extensive knowledge to understand suicide and suicide prevention in the local contexts, and identified research and policy gaps. The findings can further inform policy, research, and media agenda settings to maintain the downward trend of suicide rates in both regions. By comparing the patterns in the two regions, we noted that the suicide research and prevention efforts in Mainland China have benefited from learning from Hong Kong, as well as international experts. However, over the past decade, suicide research in the Mainland is surpassing Hong Kong, and the policymaking in Mainland has already included cross-sectoral collaborations on suicide prevention in its national strategic plan, whereas such kind of plans has not been laid out in detail in Hong Kong’s policy agenda. More exchanges and collaboration between the two regions should be carried out to achieve mutual benefits.

17629016.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17629016.value: Background: Adolescent smoking prevention is a public health priority. In Hong Kong, 64.5% of smokers start smoking in their teens. Of adolescents, 15.0% are ever smokers and 3.3% are current smokers. Moreover, 11.8% of never-smoking adolescents and 45.8% of experimenters are susceptible for smoking, and 40.6% overestimate the youth smoking rate. Smoking susceptibility and overestimation of peer smoking are significant predictors of smoking initiation. Social norms approach, a theory-based intervention, has demonstrated its strong effect in correcting smoking misperceptions and reducing smoking intensity among youth in western countries. However, previous research either employed convenience sampling method or included no control group. Additionally, whether the approach can change smoking norms and prevent smoking uptake in regions with low smoking rate remains unknown. Our study aims to employ a cluster randomized controlled trail (RCT) to examine the effect of a school-based social norms campaign on smoking perceptions, smoking susceptibility, and smoking-related behaviors among adolescents in Hong Kong. Methods/Design: This stratified cluster RCT will randomly select 18 secondary schools in 5 regions in Hong Kong. In each region, 2 or 4 schools will be randomly selected and allocated to either an intervention or a control group (allocation ratio: 1:1). Students in secondary grades 1-5 from the participating schools will complete a voluntary anonymous paper-and-pencil questionnaire at baseline, 3 and 9 months after the baseline. A two-month multimedia campaign (posters, flyers, table tents, web ads, etc.) will be implemented in intervention schools right after baseline survey. The campaign will highlight the fact that most students do not smoke, and most students have a firm decision not to smoke. No intervention will be carried out in control schools. We will match the baseline and follow-ups responses, and compare the changes in primary outcomes (perceived youth smoking rate, and smoking susceptibility) and secondary outcomes (smoking initiation, smoking intensity, cessation, quit attempts and intention) during 2 time intervals (from baseline to 3-month follow-up, and from baseline to 9-month follow-up) between intervention and control groups. Discussion: This study represents the first effort to address youth smoking through changing the norms in Chinese adolescents. Findings will inform the effect of social norms approach in reducing smoking misperceptions and smoking susceptibility, as well as reducing smoking initiation and cigarette consumption using a cluster RCT in a region with low smoking prevalence. Findings will help develop messaging for future smoking interventions among Chinese adolescents. 背景及研究目的：针对青少年的吸烟预防项目是公共卫生的重点之一。在香港，64.5%的吸烟者都是从十几岁的时候开始吸烟的。15.0%的香港青少年曾经吸过烟，3.3%的香港青少年在过去30天吸过烟，但是40.6%的香港青少年高估了青少年吸烟率。此外，在那些从未吸过烟的青少年中，11.8%有吸烟意向；在那些有过初试吸烟经历的青少年中，则有高达45.8%有吸烟意向。对吸烟率的高估和吸烟意向与青少年将来吸烟行为相关。 社会认同干预方法具备理论支持依据，该干预方法在纠正高估吸烟率和降低吸烟方面有着显著的效果，并在西方青少年科研试验中得到了证实。但是，社会认同干预在吸烟率低的国家或地区能否同样纠正高估吸烟率和预防吸烟仍然未知，并且已有的西方研究均采用任意抽样法（convenience sampling method）或者在研究设计上没有包括对照组。鉴于上述情况，我们设计了该研究，通过群体分层随机对照试验（stratified cluster randomized controlled trail）来检验社会认同干预在校园中对青少年三个方面的响应，包括高估吸烟率，吸烟意向和吸烟行为。 研究方法：该群体分层随机对照试验将在香港5个区随机选出18所中学（每个区随机选出2所或者4所中学以达到总共18所学校），选出的学校在每个区内按照1:1进行随机分组，即9所干预学校和9所对照学校。 该18所中学的中一至中五年级的学生将被邀请参加该研究，在基线时间及其后3个月和9个月各填写一份纸笔问卷，问卷均为自愿、匿名填写。干预组学校在基线问卷后立即在校内开展为期两个月的社会认同干预活动，利用海报、传单、桌牌、校园电视等多媒体途径宣传两个信息：（1）大多数香港青少年不吸烟；（2）大多数香港青少年有强烈的决心不吸烟。对照组学校将不开展该干预活动。我们将比较干预组和对照组的主要结果（即吸烟率估计和吸烟意向）和次要结果（即吸烟率、吸烟强度、戒烟率、戒烟尝试、戒烟意愿）。 讨论：该试验首次尝试用社会认同的方法干预亚洲青少年吸烟问题，该研究将证明社会认同干预方法在吸烟率低的地区是否能够有效纠正青少年的高估吸烟率、降低青少年吸烟意向和减少吸烟行为。

17629016.label: Realisation of objectives
17629016.value: This study aimed to evaluate the effects of a social norms campaign on addressing tobacco use in Hong Kong adolescents, including reducing smoking misperceptions, reducing smoking susceptibility, and changing smoking-related behaviours. The social norms campaign delivered to students the actual norms about adolescent smoking in Hong Kong through posters, leaflets, table tents and an online banner. A cluster randomised controlled trial was conducted to evaluate the campaign. Recruited schools were randomised into the intervention and control group in 1:1 ratio. Baseline, 3-month follow-up and 9-month follow-up surveys were conducted to evaluate the effects, and qualitative interviews were conducted for process evaluation. A total of 16 schools were recruited, with 8 in each group. At baseline, data from 7031 students (intervention 3692, control 3339). The sample was smaller than the planned 18 schools and 12868 students due to difficulties in recruitment amid busy school schedules. Repeated follow-up calls were made for persuasion, and a school report on aggregated results of the school were provided as an incentive to encourage participation. The campaign lasted for 2 months in intervention schools, while control schools received the campaign materials only after the last follow-up. The campaign materials highlighted the messages “Most (97%) students do not smoke”, “Most (87%) never smokers have firmly decided not to smoke” and “Half (47%) the smokers want to quit smoking”. The data for the messages were derived from the territory-wide survey, School-based Survey on Smoking among Students 2014/15. Qualitative interviews, including focus group discussions in students and one-on-one interviews with teachers, were conducted after graphic design and before production of the materials. Opinions from students and teachers were collected to improve the materials. Intervention schools were instructed to place the posters at prominent locations, disseminate the leaflets to students, place the table tents on tables at student canteen, and post the online banner on the school website. The 3 surveys assessed the (i) perceived smoking prevalence in Hong Kong adolescents in all students, (ii) smoking susceptibility in never smokers (in the next 12 months; when good friends offer a cigarette; when good friends smoke in front), (iii) smoking susceptibility in experimenters, (iv) smoking intensity in current smokers (i.e. cigarettes per day), (v) quit attempts in current smokers, and (vi) quit intention in current smokers. Anonymous self-administered questionnaires were used in all 3 surveys. One intervention school dropped out at the 9-month follow-up due to busy school schedule. Data were successfully matched for 4936 students (70.2%), including 2063 students in the intervention group and 2873 students in the control group. Intention-to-treat was adopted for loss-to-follow-up. Major findings of the study are detailed in section 6.1. In brief, the campaign had no effect on addressing adolescent tobacco use in Hong Kong. Qualitative interviews with students and teachers may provide explanations for the under-achievements of the objectives. One-on-one interviews were conducted with the teacher-in-charge, who was responsible for the campaign at each intervention school. The teachers agreed that an education campaign to discourage adolescent smoking was needed, and the procedures (e.g. putting up posters and distributing leaflets) were easy to follow and efficient. However, they suggested more appealing means of message delivery, such as video clips. In focus group discussions, students also thought printed materials (posters, leaflets and table tents) were not attractive as they were too commonly used. The 3-month survey showed low exposure to the campaign materials (poster 38.2%, leaflet 17.6%, table tent 12.9%, online banner 9.5%). Although the campaign materials used as many graphics and as few words as possible, few students read them in detail. They preferred more interactive ways suchs as exhibitions, game booths, videos and health talks. Since the present study focused on reducing smoking misperception, the campaign materials only stated the descriptive norms of smoking (e.g. adolescent smoking prevalence) but not the health harms of smoking. Although smoking prevention programmes in Hong Kong typically emphasise smoking harms, students still wished information on harms of smoking could be included in the campaign materials.

17629016.label: Major findings and research outcome
17629016.value: At baseline, students in the intervention group were older than students in the control group (14.3 years, SE 0.03 vs 14.2 years, SE 0.03; p for t-test<0.05), and were more likely to be boys (53.3% vs 44.8%; p for chi-square<0.001). Ever smoking was more common (intervention 8.7% vs control 6.5%, p for chi-square < 0.001), while current smoking did not differ significantly between the 2 groups (0.3% vs 0.4%, p for chi-square>0.05). The proportion of overestimation of adolescent smoking prevalence decreased by 7.3% from baseline to 3-month follow-up in the intervention group and 5.9% in the control group, while decreased by 8.8% from baseline to 9-month follow-up in the intervention group and 6.5% in the control group. Logistic regression analysed the effect of the campaign on overestimation of smoking prevalence, adjusting for baseline characteristics (age, sex, perceived family affluence, highest parental education and ever smoking) and school clustering effect. The overestimation did not differ significantly in the intervention versus control group at 3-month (adjusted odds ratio [AOR] 0.95, 95% CI 0.64-1.40) and at 9-month (0.87, 0.60-1.25). In never smokers, the proportion of smoking susceptibility did not change from baseline to 3-month follow-up in the intervention group but decreased by 2.4% in the control group. The proportion decreased by 1.3% from baseline to 9-month follow-up in the intervention group, and 9.8% in the control group. In experimenters, the proportion of smoking susceptibility decreased by 8.1% from baseline to 3-month follow-up in the intervention group and 3.6% in the control group. The proportion decreased by 6.7% from baseline to 9-month follow-up in the intervention group and 2.8% in the control group. In both never smokers and experimenters, logistic regression showed that smoking susceptibility did not differ significantly in the intervention versus control group at 3-month (never smokers: 1.00, 0.79-1.26; experimenters: 1.00, 0.56-1.77). At 9-month, no significant effect was observed in never smokers (1.05, 0.82-1.34) while an increased smoking susceptibility was observed in experimenters (1.70, 1.01-2.86). Baseline characteristics (age, sex, perceived family affluence and highest parental education) and school clustering effect were adjusted for. The intervention had no effect on smoking initiation in never smokers. The AORs (95% CI) were 1.61 (0.87-3.01) at 3-month and 1.66 (0.84-3.30) at 9-month. Baseline characteristics (age, sex, perceived family affluence and highest parental education) and school clustering effect were adjusted for. The small number of current smokers precluded comparison of other secondary outcomes between the 2 groups.

17629016.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
17629016.value: The results indicated that the campaign which emphasised the social norms of smoking had no effect on addressing tobacco use in Hong Kong adolescents. Low exposure to the campaign materials and lack of interest in reading the materials might explain the absence of effect. Comments from the qualitative interviews highlighted the need for interactive elements in the campaigns. Conventional campaign materials such as posters and leaflets failed to draw students’ attention. Since most smoking are initiated during adolescence, smoking prevention programmes in adolescents are important. Teachers also mentioned the need for smoking prevention campaigns at school. Future research on school smoking prevention campaigns may consider measures to increase student exposure to and interest in the campaigns. Exhibitions, game booths, health talks, video clips and e-messages should be considered. Students also suggested that the harms of smoking should be included in the campaign so as to emphasise the aim of discouraging smoking.

17629016.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
17629016.value: The present study aimed to evaluate the effectiveness of a social norms campaign in addressing adolescent tobacco use through correcting the overestimation of adolescent smoking. Messages in the campaign focused on the actual norms of smoking in adolescents, such as prevalence of smoking and smoking susceptibility. Half the participating schools were randomised to the intervention group and received the campaign materials, including posters, leaflets, table tents and an online banner, for 2 months; while the other half were randomised to the control group and received no materials. Overall, the campaign had no effect on addressing tobacco use in Hong Kong adolescents. It did not change the overestimation of smoking prevalence in students and the smoking susceptibility in the never smokers, while marginally increased smoking susceptibility in experimenters. Low exposure to and lack of interest in the campaign materials might explain the absence of effect. Process evaluation, in terms of qualitative interviews with teachers and students, suggested alternative means of message delivery to draw student attention, such as game booths and video clips. Addition of information about harms of smoking into the campaign materials was also suggested for improvement.

17630616.label: Project Objectives
17630616.value: Develop a novel and systematic perspective on the threefold sources of the European malaise: economic crisis (Eurozone), security challenge (conflict in Ukraine) and refugee crisis. Critically examine the vision of ‘borderless Europe’ by analyzing both its ideological roots and practical limitations. Advance a systematic defense of territoriality and borders as an important dimension of democratic politics in Europe and more generally. Analyze the Europe-Russia relationship and assess the importance of geopolitics. Demonstrate the usefulness of an alternative (if at times more traditional) view on national sovereignty in Europe building on the insights of liberal nationalism. Shed light on Germany’s perceived hegemony in Europe and assess its advantages and pitfalls. Critically engage with some of the dominant theories of European integration, such as federalism, neofunctionalism and liberal intergovernmentalism.

17630616.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17630616.value: The European Union faces an existentialist crisis that tests its very foundations. The crisis has three interrelated aspects, which challenge the vision of a borderless Europe. First, the protracted Eurozone crisis has undermined the ideal of a single market, which is the bedrock of the European project. Integrating monetary policies, while fiscal policies remained under the control of sovereign member states, has resulted in growing tensions both within and between EU member states. Second, the crisis in Ukraine has eroded people’s confidence in Europe as a peace project. The European Union served as a source of inspiration for Ukrainians striving for democracy, but the same union proved powerless in response to Russia’s intervention in Crimea and Eastern Ukraine. Third, the refugee crisis threatens the vision of freedom of movement, as the EU member states seek to regain (some) control over their borders. All three aspects of the crisis brought into sharp relief one of the key paradoxes of recent integration history. While national boundaries in the EU have been losing importance owing to the Maastricht Treaty of 1992 (e.g. the creation of European citizenship and the introduction of the common currency) and the Schengen agreement of 1995, more and more people in Europe feel uneasy about their nation states’ diminishing capacity for self-government. The policies, which aimed to solidify Europe’s unity, appear to be contributing to Europe’s fragmentation, with member states seeking to reclaim aspects of national sovereignty (Hungary, Slovakia), or even contemplating exit (UK). Place, geography and boundaries remain very salient in contemporary Europe. This project will identify manifold sources of Europe’s current discontent, and sketch contrasting future scenarios that are likely to make a bad situation worse, and those that might make it better. Drawing on rich academic debates about the desirability and feasibility of a ‘cosmopolitan Europe’ (Ulrich Beck) underpinned by the ideal of ‘post-national citizenship’ (Jürgen Habermas), I will argue in favour of a more measured approach to Europe’s many challenges. Reclaiming the legacy of scholars weary of quasi-utopian political projects (ranging from Edmund Burke, Hannah Arendt to Margaret Canovan and Hans Sluga) I will challenge Europe’s ideal of an ‘ever closer’ and ‘ever wider’ union. This bold vision threatens not just European unity, but its very rationale: the preservation of peace and democracy in Europe. To retain the viability of its project, Europe may well need to reclaim borders both internally and externally. 歐盟正面對生存危機，其根基受到重大的衝擊。這危機體現在三個互有關聯的層面，挑戰沒有國界的歐洲這一願景。首先，曠日持久的歐元區危機使人懷疑作為歐洲計劃核心的共同市場理念。沒有統合財政政策的貨幣政策一體化引致歐盟成員國日益嚴重的摩擦。再者，烏克蘭危機令人對歐洲作為一個和平計劃失去信心。歐盟曾是啟發烏克蘭人民爭取民主的精神泉源之一，但此聯盟亦正正在俄羅斯對克里米亞及烏克蘭東部的干預之中表現得軟弱無能。第三，成員國在面對難民危機時都試圖重置（部份）邊境控制，使人員流動自由變得名存實亡。 這三重危機所顯示的正是歐洲統合史中的一個弔詭。當國界在歐盟中的重要性在歷次統合進程後（如一九九二年簽訂的歐洲聯盟條約和一九九五年創立的神根區）日趨式微的同時，越來越多歐洲人對自己國家政府日漸喪失自我管治能力感到不安。志在鞏固歐洲團結的政策反而增加了歐洲的分化；不僅英國已公投脫歐，其他成員國如匈牙利和斯洛伐克亦嘗試取回部份國家主權。地位、地域和疆界在當代歐洲仍然是重要課題。 本研究計劃將審視歐洲人的不安的多重來源，並勾劃出截然不同的將來情況。在關於「世界歐洲」（Ulrich Beck）及「後國族市民」（哈伯馬斯）的豐富學術辯論基礎上，我主張以更為審慎的方式去處理歐洲的多項挑戰。沿用懷疑學派的眼光（如伯克和鄂蘭）去看疑似烏托邦的政治構建，我批判歐洲的「更緊密」丶「更擴大」理念。這妄大的願景不僅對歐洲團結構成威脅，更使其存在失去理據：亦即是保存歐洲的和平和民主政制。歐洲計劃若要繼續向前邁進，很可能要回到內外均有國界的年代。

17630616.label: Realisation of objectives
17630616.value: I am pleased to report that I have realised all project objectives, albeit not all of them to one hundred percent. I shared my research findings at eight conferences in Hong Kong, Europe and Australia, including by giving a keynote address at the Australasian Association for European History 50th Anniversary Conference / 26th Biennial Conference "The Revenge of Europe’s Past?", University of Queensland, 15-17 July 2019, which was very well received and will be published as a paper in a special issue of the Australian Journal of Politics and History later this year (2020). Further to this, I published two articles in major, high-impact journals, a book chapter, and a number of book reviews. I also organised and took part in a number of public events based on this project, such as a panel at the Institute for Human Sciences in Vienna (27 June, 2019) about ‘The European Union and The Challenge of Technocracy’, which led to an hour long interview about 'Depoliticisation and Technocracy' on the main Austrian Radio Station, ORF1 (in German on 1 July, 2019). Researching and writing about contemporary European politics is a Sisyphean task. In the midst of my project, the protracted negotiations about the future of UK-EU relations based on the Brexit referendum vindicated basic theoretical assumptions underpinning my project (particularly objectives 2. 3. 5. 7.), all the while they complicated the collection and evaluation of relevant empirical material. As I am writing this final report, the concerns that have dominated the research agenda within EU studies have been overshadowed by the outbreak of coronavirus pandemic that is bound to fundamentally re-shape the European project. Once again, national sovereignty, concern with territoriality and the protection of borders, which are at the heart of this research project, became all the more important, even if for a reason few people could have expected. More than ever, European politics and its research resemble the attempt at 'Rebuilding the Ship at Sea' (Claus Offe, 1998). Against this background, it proved fortuitous to focus my outputs on research articles, and postpone the production of the monograph. In fact, political science as a discipline has moved steadily towards journal articles as the main vehicle for scholarly debates. As mentioned below (6.2), I will publish a monograph with Hurst (London) in 2021, which will give me the opportunity to recast the project in the view of most recent dramatic developments. The coronavirus crisis has further intensified the existing challenges, while narrowing the window of opportunities for their effective management. The future of the European Union is more uncertain than ever in its post-Second World War history.

17630616.label: Major findings and research outcome
17630616.value: As I argued in the forthcoming article in "Government and Opposition" (WoS Impact Factor 2018: 2.582), 'The European Union is caught between technocracy and the politics of the exception, eroding in the process the very political sphere that makes democracy work. Partly a cause of this erosion and partly an effect, the EU retreats into the ‘rule of rules’ when faced with what are, in fact, profoundly political problems. Whether it be in response to the eurozone crisis, EU–Russia–Ukraine relations or the influx of refugees, the EU's policies led to conflicts over geopolitics, sovereignty and redistribution. Its apolitical responses were as ubiquitous as they were inadequate. They reflect Germany's preference for consensual politics, which is paradoxically enforced by Angela Merkel's dictum about there being ‘no alternative’. In order to think of alternatives to the Europe that exists, we need to revive ‘the political’, theorized by the likes of Carl Schmitt, Max Weber and Hannah Arendt at times when democracy was under duress.' Expanding on these findings, in the article (co-authored by Nicole Scicluna) in West European Politics (WoS Impact Factor 2018: 3.508), I demonstrated that there were 'two trends emerging through the eurozone crisis, both of which diminish the quality of democracy in the EU and its member states. Firstly, the crisis has led to an increased reliance on non-majoritarian institutions, such as the ECB, at the expense of democratic accountability. Secondly, the crisis has led to a new emphasis on coercive enforcement at the expense of the voluntary cooperation that previously characterised (and sustained) the EU as a community of law. Thus, the ECB’s (over-)empowerment is a synecdoche of a wider problem: The EU’s tendency to resort to technocratic governance in the face of challenges that require political contestation. In the absence of opportunities for democratic contestation, EU emergency governance – Integration through Crisis – oscillates between moments of heightened politicisation, in which ad hoc decisions are justified as necessary, and the (sometimes coercive) appeal to the depoliticised rule of rules.'

17630616.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
17630616.value: The starting proposition of my project has been proven alarmingly prescient in ways that were impossible to predict: "The European Union faces an existentialist crisis that tests its very foundations", a test that became all the more challenging with the outbreak of the coronavirus. Even more than the problems I analysed in my project to date - the eurozone crisis, EU-Russia relations, refugee crisis - Covid-19 "threatens the vision of freedom of movement, as the EU member states seek to regain (some) control over their borders". I am pleased to report that I succeeded in securing a publisher for my forthcoming monograph, 'Post-Brexit European Union: A Sovereign Europe, or a Europe of Nation States?'. Even more than Brexit, the book will assess the impact of the coronavirus on the European project. I signed the contract with Hurst Publishers, London, on December 8, 2019 and will deliver the manuscript by October 30, 2020. Michael Dwyer, publisher, described the project as an ‘original, provocative and much needed contribution to debates on the future of European integration’ (e-mail correspondence, November 16, 2019). The book will also be published under the OUP label in the US.

17630616.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
17630616.value: As Europe has been facing a series of unprecedented challenges - from the Eurozone crisis, EU-Russia relationship, refugee crisis, to Brexit and the Covid-19 outbreak, the pull towards the nation state became irresistible, undermining the very idea of borderless Europe. Relying on a number of traditional concepts and key modern thinkers, such as Hannah Arendt, Carl Schmitt and Max Weber, my research project offers a novel interpretation of these developments. It exposes the weaknesses of the European ideal of supranational governance and maps the process through which the European Union became an obstacle to the very aims it seeks to promote: democracy, prosperity and political stability. In times of radical uncertainty, the EU’s very existence is questioned. As I discuss in a number of journal articles, book chapters and book reviews, Europe’s politics will be recast by elevating Germany further to a hegemonic position it seeks to avoid, strengthening territorial nation states in ways many scholars considered unthinkable and bringing to the fore the possibility of international conflict, including between the EU and Russia.

17631316.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17631316.value: 《尚書》與金文文獻語言的比較研究

17631316.label: Project Objectives
17631316.value: 詞匯學及語法學：本計劃的語言考察以詞匯學為重點，借助《尚書》與金文詞匯的分析，描寫與歸納同義詞與同義結構現象。語法討論以虛詞作為切入點，選取每種材料中詞頻較高的虛詞作深入剖析，描述其語法功能及相關的句法現象。然後，通過兩種材料間詞匯與語法現象的比較，探討兩者語言的相同與相異之處，歸納與討論所反映的共時性與歷時性語言特徵，為上古漢語研究提供資料。 古文字學及訓詁學：借助語言的比較與具體辭例的互證，結合古文字學、文字學、聲韻學及訓詁學等研究方法，探討兩種材料中疑難字詞的通讀，解決《尚書》文句訓詁與金文字詞考釋的問題。 文獻學：透過詞匯與語法歷時特徵的歸納，以金文材料作為參照，從語言角度探討《尚書》篇章的著成年代及文獻真偽等問題。 語體學：結合語體學研究，對兩種材料所反映的語言現象進行比較，就其語體性質、特徵及類型等作出討論，從而探索兩者的文獻來源與形成關係。

17631316.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17631316.value: 《尚書》為我國早期重要典籍，歷代傳習者甚眾。然而，由於其語言古奧，艱澀難懂，再加上形成及流傳問題複雜，內容真偽難辨，其研究仍至今存在大量懸而未決的問題。 王國維先生於1925年提出「二重證據法」，提倡借助今日出土的新材料，印證、補充及修訂傳世文獻的記錄。金文乃指鑄或刻在青銅器上的文字，屬出土的文獻材料，其性質雖然與《尚書》有所差異，但兩者卻有不少可參照之處：《尚書》典、謨、訓、誥、誓、命等內容均見於殷周金文，又今文《尚書》大致撰寫於先秦時期，與金文應該是共時的語言材料。倘若再從語言的角度作出比較，便會發現兩者於詞匯及語法上均有不少可資對照之處。過去雖然有學者嘗就兩者的共見詞匯進行對比，但大多均屬個別字詞的考釋或隨文釋義的注疏，全面且系統的語言對比分析迄今未見。 有鑑於此，本計劃旨在通過兩種材料的語言考察，從詞匯及語法角度進行全面的比較研究。除語言間存在的共性外，我們亦希望探討其相異之處。而且，本研究亦擬通過兩種材料間具體辭例的比對與互證，解決當中字詞訓詁與文句通讀問題。語言的使用具有歷時性變化，本計劃期望借助金文語言歷時性特徵的歸納與參照，嘗試探討《尚書》篇章的著成年代與真偽問題。最後，本研究擬借助語體學的分析，就兩種材料間的文獻來源與形成關係作出深入的討論。因此，本研究涉及的範疇相當廣泛，包括古文字學、語法學、詞匯學、訓詁學、文獻學及語體學等，傳世典籍與出土文獻兼重，乃屬跨材料、跨領域、跨學科的研究計劃。

17631316.label: Realisation of objectives
17631316.value: 《尚書》在群經中地位尊崇，歷代傳習者眾。雖然如此，其語言古奧深湛，一直以艱澀難解著稱，韓愈《進學解》嘗謂“周誥殷盤，佶屈聱牙”，王國維亦稱“《詩》、《書》為人人誦習之書，然於六藝中最難讀”，並有“以弟之愚闇，於《書》所不能解者殆十之五”之歎，于省吾更因《尚書》通讀之難，遂有“《尚書》於諸經中最為難讀”的論述。而且，《尚書》成書與流傳問題複雜，篇章形成年代不盡相同，內容真偽難辨，相關研究仍存在不少尚待解決的問題。事實上，自古以來，中國古書經歷過不同程度的殘損與散佚，早期文獻於歷代的輾轉傳鈔、流傳與刊刻過程中，曾經被後人作過一定的竄改、增益與刪削，今日所見典籍確非本來面貌，《隋書‧牛弘列傳》嘗謂中國文獻流傳有“書之五厄”，一爲秦始皇焚書，二爲西漢末年王莽之亂，三爲董卓之亂，四爲晉世洛陽覆沒，五爲梁末之亂，明胡應麟《少室山房筆叢‧經籍會通一》更增補“五厄”成為“十厄”，總括了隋至宋間另外五次的文獻厄難。歷代以來，古籍散佚情況相當嚴重。 近世紀地不愛寶，出土文物與日俱增，王國維在1925年清華大學“古史新証”課上提出著名的“二重證據法”，提倡利用今日地下出土的新發現及新材料，補苴、印證，以至修訂傳世文獻的記錄。1929年，傅斯年《史料論略》將研究材料區別為“直接的史料”與“間接的史料”，指出研究工作要超越前人，能夠得到並且利用前人不曾見或不曾用的材料是其中一個關鍵。1930年，陳寅恪《敦煌劫餘錄序》更提出“一時代之學術，必有其新材料與新問題”的學說。近世紀以來，考古學發展迅速，地下出土文獻數量龐大，研究者借助地下材料補證與修訂傳世文獻記錄，從而對其早期形態與流傳狀況作出探討。據我們蒐集所得，現今已著錄的金文逾18,000件，數量極為龐大，金文與《尚書》在遣字用詞上非常類近，我們通過《尚書》與金文的語言考察，從詞匯及語法角度探討兩者在語言特徵上的共性，並且通過材料的排比，對疑難字詞的訓詁及文句通讀問題作出討論。最後，我們亦從語體學角度分析兩種文獻的來源與形成關係。近幾年來，清華簡《書》類文獻陸續發表，楚簡雖非本研究的重點，但其異文現象卻是非常重要的參考材料，不容忽視。因此，我們將原本兩年的研究工作延長至兩年半年完成，把新出楚簡的《書》類文獻亦納入研究範圍。總括而言，研究工作歷時兩年半完成，大體都能夠圍繞研究目標有序進行。 1. 詞匯語法形式：同義手段及口語虛詞 就內容性質而言，《尚書》與金文皆屬於上古禮儀活動的記錄。《尚書》是政治類文獻，《尚書序》曾分析“書之六體”，即“典、謨、訓、誥、誓、命之文百篇”，其記敘內容皆與禮儀有關。至於金文以青銅禮器作為載體，先秦時期彝器廣泛應用於祭祀、燕饗、喪葬、征伐等儀式。《尚書》與金文無論在語言用途、背景場合或應用對象上皆存在不少共通之處。我們知道，語境對於語言表達起著一定的約制作用，決定語言手段的選擇。 同義形式的選擇是決定語體類型的重要因素，主要通過詞匯與語法手段得以反映。同義詞包括等義詞與近義詞兩類，前者指意義完全相同的詞，後者的意義雖然基本相同，但仔細分析下仍有差別。在現實語言使用中，絕對等義詞所起的積極作用不大，近義詞間存在意義的差異，其區別可從語境意義或附屬意義展現出來。在上古文獻中，《爾雅》匯集了大量的上古漢語同義詞，我們在前人同義詞理論的基礎上，參考《爾雅》的同義詞資料，利用第三階段研究工作整理的“殷周金文詞匯分類表”及“《尚書》詞類分類表”，通過材料中同義詞的歸納與比較，討論同義手段選擇的問題。此部分討論耗時大約半年完成，研究計劃按照頌德、賞賜、禮儀、享孝、冊命六個不同類目，討論當中的同義選擇現象。研究結果發現，《尚書》與金文在同義手段的選擇上呈現相當一致的傾向，兩種文獻皆偏向使用較為正式、典雅的用語，在語體上具有許多共同特徵，由是能夠說明兩者語言的高度一致性應該與其語體類型存在密切的聯繫。 語法方面，虛詞的使用是古漢語語法的研究重點，我們亦對兩種材料所反映的虛詞現象作出比較研究。由於古漢語虛詞數量龐多，用法錯綜複雜，難以全部納入考察範圍，計劃以詞頻作為篩選條件，選擇每類虛詞裡詞頻最高的五例作為探討對象，這部分工作歷時三個月完成。在研究過程中，我們發現《尚書》與金文的虛詞反映濃烈的口語特色。宋熊朋來《經說》區分《尚書》“誥”體為正、變兩類，共36篇，《說文》嘗訓“誥”為“告”，“誥”指告訴、訓誥，從《周禮‧大祝》“六辭”的記載可知，誥是上古禮儀中訓誥的說話。兩周金文記錄大量的嘏辭，《禮記‧禮運》：“祝以孝告，嘏以慈告”，祝、嘏散言有別，皆是指尸、祝間的言辭。從語言性質來說，《尚書》與金文皆屬禮儀語言，表現濃厚的口語性質，當中最為顯著是歎詞的使用。《尚書》較常見的歎詞包括鳴呼、俞、吁、嗟、咨、己、都、猷、於及噫，雖然書寫形式或有不同，但此等歎詞皆見於兩周金文，可證明《尚書》與金文於口語表演的性質上相當一致。 2. 疑難字詞訓詁與金文學 從近代出土的楚簡可知，先秦《尚書》大致是單篇流傳，當時仍未編纂成書。秦定六國，天下經歷焚書之厄，漢代《尚書》學出現今古文經的激烈論爭，經學家或囿限於師承與學派，或受政治因素影響，在《尚書》今古異文及字詞訓釋的處理上執持己見，各有偏頗。隨著經學思潮的發展變遷，《尚書》學歷經兩漢今古文論爭、魏晉南北分列、唐一統及宋明理學各個階段，清代是經學復興之集大成時代。清代學術一掃宋學末流之虛浮空疏，轉向成為實是求是的踏實態度，學風偏向漢學，著重文字考據校勘與經文輯佚整理。在清代經學全盛之時，傳統學術範式中附屬於經學之金石研究，亦隨考據學盛行而蓬勃發展，與當時銅器的新發現不無關係，不少青銅重器如散氏盤、小盂鼎、大盂鼎、虢季子伯盤、毛公鼎、天亡簋、曶鼎、大克鼎、師望鼎等皆在這段期間出土或發現，再加上當時傳拓技術漸趨成熟，文人普遍雅好庋藏金石文物，金石學家多兼為收藏家，文人往來間相互交換與流通金石訊息。金石學家徵引《尚書》資料，溯源於古訓古注以外，亦運用新出材料作為旁證，在證成與補充《尚書》舊說之餘，亦審定及修正成說，提出新見。當時，利用金文考證《尚書》的研究主要見於金石學的論著中，為了充分瞭解前人研究成果，我們在蒐集資料之外，亦對乾嘉至晚清時期金石著述中的《尚書》考證材料作出整理，總共獲得共58條資料，分別來源自阮元《積古齋鐘鼎彝器款識》、吳榮光《筠清館金石文字》、徐同柏《從古堂款識學》、吳式芬《攗古錄金文》、潘祖蔭《攀古樓彝器款識》、吳大澂《愙齋集古錄》、劉心源《奇觚室吉金文述》、孫詒讓《古籀拾遺》、《古籀餘論》及《韡華閣集古錄跋尾》。清代學者普遍重視金文材料於《尚書》研究的運用，王懿榮形容銘文為“可敵真古文《尚書》”、“治今古文《尚書》者，非得此無以為”，又“寧王”為“文王”訛誤之考證廣為研究者採納，研究方法亦為民國以來經學家如楊樹達、于省吾、楊筠如、屈萬里、劉起釪等繼承與開拓。我們蒐集前人論說，並嘗試作出補證與修訂，以下是其中兩例。a. 吳榮光《筠清館金石文字》提出《尚書》“不弔”之“弔”當通“淑”，我們以逆鐘、頌鼎、寡子卣等銘文為佐證，結合《逸周書》“不淑充天對”的記述，印證經典所見“不弔”當即“不淑”。b. 徐同柏《從古堂款識學》以為《尚書‧微子之命》“旅天子之命也”之“旅”當即“魯”，我們借助上古音說明“旅”、“魯”音同通用，兩周金文“對揚”文例亦有類近格式的例子，故“旅天子之命”可理解為“對揚天子魯命”的變式。此外，隨著近世紀金文材料數量倍增，在補證前人舊說之外，我們同時於部分《尚書》疑難字詞的訓詁上提出新說，有需要時亦參考了新出楚簡資料，我們的討論較為重要者有“平、伻”、“析因夷隩”、“嗟”、“越”、“亂”、“僉”等。此部分的研究工作歷時半年完成。 3. 《尚書》篇章年代與真偽問題 傳世本《尚書》共有58篇，包括伏生所傳的今文《尚書》33篇，再加上普遍視為是偽書的孔安國古文《尚書》25篇。北宋學者已經就古文《尚書》的真確性提出質疑。兩周金文屬於原始材料，年代較為明確，科學考古出土金文不涉及作偽問題，所反映的語言現象也應該比較接近當時原貌。我們在詞匯與語法研究的基礎上，進一步將古文《尚書》與金文語言作出比較。我們提出，從詞匯角度，古文《尚書》用語與金文差異較大，確實並非先秦語言，較為明顯的如《仲虺之誥》“簡賢附勢”、“寔繁有徒”、“若苗之有莠，若粟之有秕”、《湯誥》“兆民允殖”、“慄慄危懼”、“自赦”等。因此，我們同意古文《尚書》當屬後世偽作之說。此部分的研究工作歷時三個月完成。 4. 《尚書》與金文語體研究 《尚書》與金文的對比研究最早可上溯至北宋，但大致仍以文句考釋及校勘為主要目的，從語言角度對兩種材料作出比較大多見於西方漢學著作。杜百勝（W.A.C.H. Doson）從詞匯、句式、句法等討論早期上古漢語特點，提出《尚書》與金文是語言性質相同的材料。此外，夏含夷（Edward L. Shaughnessy）、柯馬丁（Martin Kern）、畢鶚（Wolfgang Behr）等亦曾經論證兩種材料語言共通之處。前人研究既有以描述語言共通現象為中心，亦有通過語言分析延展至不同範疇課題的討論，但研究者較少關注語言一致性的構成原因，所以我們結合語體的考察，對《尚書》與金文語言共性的構成因素提出意見。語體是指人們在進行言語交際時，為了適應目的、對象、背景或場合的需要，所構成不同的語言運用體系特徵。馮勝利在口語與書面語語體之外，認為語體區別中有通俗、正式、典雅三大要素。我們在考察《尚書》的同義手段，亦從歷時角度，考察詞匯的時代特徵，發現《尚書》大量運用仿古詞匯，在語言表達上刻意營造出正式、典雅的特點，這亦說明了《尚書》在語體上與禮儀性質銘文具有相同的特徵。這部分的研究工作歷時半年完成。 總括而言，上述圍繞研究目標的各項研究工作前後歷時共兩年完成，再加上計劃前期六個月的資料蒐集，以及計劃後三個月的綜合整理工作，整個計劃以兩年半的時間完成。由於本研究內容較為專門，在計劃開始初期未能招聘合適的研究助理，首年的研究工作主要是由首席研究員親自進行，隨著其後有相關專業的碩士研究生畢業，兼職研究助理才開始協助研究工作的進行。

17631316.label: Major findings and research outcome
17631316.value: 本計劃旨在對《尚書》及金文進行全面的語言比較，研究成果豐碩，內容涉及語法、詞匯、古文字學、文獻學等多個範疇，部分已經撰寫為學術論文出版。迄今為止，與計劃相關的論文共有8篇，當中包括4篇已正式出版的論文，1篇論文通過審查待刊，另外3篇正等待評審結果。受疫情影響，國內外不少學術機構停止運作，部分論文評審需時較長。此外，本計劃的部分研究成果已在國際研討會上發表，共10篇。現就本計劃的研究結果扼要述說如下： 1. 在詞匯研究上，我們參考了《爾雅》匯集的上古漢語同義詞資料，發現《尚書》與金文在同義手段的選擇上呈現相當一致的傾向。上古禮制強調以誠敬態度侍奉上天、鬼神、先祖、君主，《爾雅》收錄“敬”的同義詞多個，兩者共用的同義詞有“敬、祇、翼、恭、欽、寅”，而“儼、諲、熯”皆不出現於兩種文獻。又《尚書》及金文記錄頌揚之辭，與“光”同義而並見於兩種文獻的詞有“熙、烈、顯、昭”，“緝、皓”皆不見於兩種文獻。（參Part C 8 No. 4） 2. 在語法研究上，我們通過《尚書》與金文的比較，發現雖然部分虛詞的書寫形式存在差異，但兩種材料的使用情況大體相同，並出現一些其他文獻未見的虛詞，其中“越”是一個重要的例子。在《尚書》中，“越”除了作為方國名之外，更兼有動詞、連詞、助詞等多種用途，金文書作“(雨于)”。我們通過兩種材料的比較，提出虛詞“越”的本字是“(雨于)”，後代“越”異文作“粵”，是傳抄譌誤所致，語助詞“越 / (雨于)”是《尚書》與金文獨有的語言現象。（參Part C 9 No. 10） 3. 《尚書》與金文在語言上呈現不少共通特點，前人多集中於兩者的參證，解決文字訓詁問題，但對於語言一致性的構成原因卻甚少關注。我們結合語言學考察，提出《尚書》與金文詞匯及句式的一致性，應該與語體類型有關： (a) 金文是禮儀語言，《尚書》內容亦多與儀節有關，故兩者偏向採用正式典雅的語體，當中，早期文言詞匯的使用尤能體現此特點。例如，動詞“格”在兩種材料中甚為常見，其使用在春秋戰國或以後的古書中甚少出現。另一個較為重要的例子是“純”，“純”表示“大”義屬於早期文言的現象，在《尚書》及金文經常出現，但在春秋戰國的語言材料中“純”通常用為單純、厚實、質樸的意思。（參Part C 8 No. 5） (b) 《尚書》和金文的語體多表現濃厚的口語色彩，最具有明顯特點的是歎詞的使用。“嗟”是《尚書》詞頻最高的嘆詞之一，語法學家大致認為“嗟”有嘆息、憂歎的語氣，但《尚書》“嗟”出現於誓辭，有譴責意味。兩周金文有“且”而無“嗟”，“且”用法與《尚書》“嗟”相當，亦含譴責意思，可知兩者是一詞異寫。此外，“嗟 / 且”在兩種材料的廣泛使用，體現出其口語語特色。（參Part C 8 No. 3） 4. 在方法學上，我們對歷代學者“以金文考證《尚書》”的源流及特點作出詳細考察，提出此方法應該肇始於乾嘉時期的阮元及吳榮光，從今日研究材料及角度來看，其研究雖然仍有可補足之處，但不少觀點具有相當的價值。（參Part C 9 No. 4）在現代學者中，較為重要的相關學者有屈萬里。屈萬里治學重視求新，在圖書館工作期間長時間接觸原始資料，非常重視材料的可靠性與真確性，其經學研究以運用甲骨文與金文資料為主要特點。（參Part C 10 No. 1） 5. 在理論實踐上，我們利用金文的新材料，對《尚書》的疑難字作出訓釋，提出“平、辯”異文情況及“伻，使也”之訓釋，皆是因“平、釆”譌混造成。（參Part C 8 No. 1）此外，我們詳細考證“亂”之具“治”義的反訓現象，認為是出於字形譌誤。（參Part C 8 No. 7）除了金文之外，我們的考釋亦參其他出土文獻材料，從而分析《尚書》詞義現象，如對祭名“析因夷隩”提出新說（參Part C 8 No. 2），並且借助《尚書‧盤庚》異文重探楚簡“僉”字。（參Part C 8 No. 8） 6. 在文獻學上，我們從語言角度重新討論古文《尚書》的真偽，提出其語言特徵明顯與先秦不符，但當中有不少詞匯跟金文相當接近，推斷文本摻雜了兩漢出土的金文資料。（參Part C 8 No. 5）同時，我們亦運用文獻辨偽方法於金文研究上，通過王子申盞蓋各拓本的比較，說明現存著錄所見拓本大致都是據摹本而成的翻刻本，並非原拓。（參Part C 8 No. 6）

17631316.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
17631316.value: 本計劃擬於將來以專書的形式將全部的研究成果出版，題為《〈尚書〉與金文的比較研究》，現在大部分的內容已經完成，正進行整合及潤飾的工作，擬於明年提交出版社進行評審。此外，近十年以來，本計劃研究人員曾經進行多個以出土文獻為主題的研究計劃，對古文字材料研究方法及語言對比分析工作上累積豐富的經驗，取得了相當豐碩的成果，曾經出版多部學術專著，並且以論文形式在國際期刊及研討會上發表，研究結果受到國內外學者的肯定和重視。在本計劃的基礎上，我們將進一步拓展相關的研究方法，發展成為新的項目。 《尚書》與金文的語法現象是本計劃的主要研究要點之一。語法涉及的範疇相當廣泛，包括詞類、語序、句式等多個層次，但囿於時間及經費所限，本計劃只能以抽樣形式，討論詞頻較高的虛詞，尚未能對兩種材料所見的虛詞現象作出全盤的整理討論。受到本計劃的啟發，我們認為金文虛詞尚有許多可待研究的空間。首先，我們發現金文虛詞使用情況極為複雜，這亦是構成銘辭艱澀難讀的主要因素之一，如果要讀懂金文，必須對其虛詞有充分的認識和掌握。在進行《尚書》與金文的對比過程中，我們注意到金文裡有不少虛詞未嘗見於傳世古書，部分就算於古籍中已廣泛出現，但金文卻往往存在不同的書寫形式，故必須結合古文字學、聲韻學、訓詁學等專業學科知識才能清楚辨識。第二，前人雖然曾經就金文虛詞作過若干探索，但相關著述的撰寫年代普遍較早，近十年來新發現的金文資料尚未納入研究範圍，故現在仍有大量可供補充及開展的研究空間。第三，通過本計劃的虛詞研究，我們發現過去學者往往忽略金文語助詞的使用，並很多時會將無實在意義的語助用法誤辨為實詞，造成金文解讀上的偏差。 此外，隨著更多新出楚簡材料的公布，《書》類文獻主要以單篇竹書的形式出現，這對於《尚書》的文獻起源形成過程有著重要的啟示。雖然過去不少學者曾經對楚簡《書》類文獻作出探討，但礙於時間或專業所限，大多是利用楚簡與今本《尚書》進行疏理或印證工作，能再結合殷周金文作出三重互證者甚少。本計劃已從比較的角度討論《尚書》與金文的異同，當中亦適量參考了楚簡材料，而在研究的過程中，我們發現《尚書》、金文、楚簡三種材料間的互證具有相當重要的研究意義，能為早期《尚書》的型態及形成問題提供珍貴的研究資料。因此，我們擬在《尚書》與金文的研究工作上，把材料進一步延展，結合新發現的楚簡《書》類文獻，從文獻角度對其內容進行三重的互證討論。

17631316.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
17631316.value: 《尚書》在群經中地位尊崇，歷代傳習者眾，但其語言古奧深湛，一直以艱澀難解著稱，加上其成書與流傳問題複雜，篇章形成年代不盡相同，內容真偽難辨，相關研究存在不少尚待解決的問題。近世紀以來地不愛寶，出土文物與日俱增，現今著錄的青銅器銘文已逾18,000件，數量極為龐大。金文與《尚書》的語言非常類近，本計劃通過《尚書》與金文的考察，從詞匯及語法角度探討兩者在語言特徵上的共性，並且借助材料的排比，對疑難字詞的訓詁及文句通讀問題提供意見。最後，我們從語體學角度，分析兩種文獻的來源與形成關係。大致上，我們藉助詞匯同義手段的分析，提出兩者語言的一致性應該與語體類型有關。金文是一種高度禮儀性質的語言，包含大量正式、典雅的語詞，而今文《尚書》成篇年代雖然應在春秋戰國或以後，但當中不少詞匯現象卻明顯與西周金文近似，由此證明《尚書》作者曾經刻意運用仿古詞匯融入文獻之中，使其語言表達具有更正式、典雅的特點。

17633216.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17633216.value: Common mental disorders are leading causes of disability in the world, and are increasingly recognised to have origins in early life. It is therefore critical to identify modifiable childhood exposures for interventions. Although more than a quarter of adults in Hong Kong and mainland China have reported childhood neglect, a recent systematic review could not identify relevant health studies in the Chinese population. Studies conducted in the West have suggested an association between child neglect and common mental disorders. However, do such findings hold in populations where child neglect is highly prevalent? Compelling research has shown childhood environment to be related to both child neglect and mental health disorders. The childhood environment could thus exert substantial confounding in studies of child neglect, and yet these influences have been largely ignored. A corollary question would naturally be: to what extent are previously observed associations confounded by early childhood disadvantage? Traditional study designs are likely to result in residual confounding due to unmeasured or unknown confounding by childhood environment and genetic predisposition. To obtain a clearer appreciation of the role of child neglect in adult mental health, a study design that can effectively control for early life familial confounders is needed. Sibling studies are designed to detect and control for all shared childhood exposures and genetic vulnerabilities. We accordingly propose a sibling study nested in a large prospective population-representative cohort (FAMILY Cohort). Our proposed sibling study would improve upon studies that relied on cross-sectional samples, overcomes the limitation of relying on samples selected from treatment seekers as treatment seeking itself may be associated with child neglect, and most importantly, eliminates confounding from all shared childhood exposures including unmeasured and unknown confounders. We will also identify effect modifiers that modulate the potential mental health impact of child neglect. These methodological advances will provide new insights into the social determinants of mental health disorders. Our findings will have important implications for populations where child neglect is widespread. There are currently more than 60 million “left-behind children” in China, children whom are more likely to experience neglect due to parental absence. As Hong Kong shares a high prevalence of child neglect with other populations, it could serve as an epidemiologic sentinel for rapidly developing cities in China and Asia. In turn, our proposed research will inform how to target early life interventions appropriately to reduce the immense health and economic burden of common mental disorders. 童年時被忽略對精神障礙的影響 精神障礙（Common mental disorder, CMD）是全球引致殘疾的頭號成因，並已日益取得認同病徵是源於早年生活。因此儘早在童年期認出並介入及予以修正是緊要的。雖然在香港及中國內地超過四分之一的成年人曾報稱有童年被忽略的遭遇，但近期的系統綜述均未能找到與中國人口相關的健康研究。有西方研究顯示，童年被忽略與常見精神障礙是有關連的。然而，這些發現是否普遍適用於兒童被忽略的人口中？ 有力的研究確證童年成長環境與童年時被忽略及精神障礙都有關連。因此，童年成長的環境和對於研究童年時被忽略的研究可以發揮大的混淆，而這些影響卻大部份被忽略了。由此，可以推論，由觀察所得有關早期童年的缺失的結論有多大的成份是給混淆了？傳統研究設計由於受到童年環境和遺傳傾向的無法測量和未知，因此更易產生殘餘混淆 (residual confounding) 的結果。因此，研究設計需有效地控制家庭對早期生活的干擾，來獲取童年被忽略對於成年後心理健康所扮演角色的清楚認識。 Sibling studies 設定是偵察及控制所有童年共同的環境和遺傳上的漏洞。我們在大型前瞻性及具人口代表性的「愛+人」隊列中嵌套了sibling study。我們建議的sibling study 能改善只依靠橫斷面 (cross-sectional) 的抽樣研究；並克服僅對求醫者抽樣的限制，因求醫行為本身可能與被忽略有關。而最重要的是，sibling study剔除了童年共同環境及遺傳因素所包含的各種不可預測及未知的混淆，亦將找出童年被忽略對心理健康潛在影響的有效調整方式。這個研究方式的優點將會為精神健康障礙的社會決定因素，提供新的見解。 我們的研究對那些有普遍地大量兒童被忽略的人口有重要意義。中國現時有超過六千萬名「留守兒童」(left-behind children) ，他們更有可能因父母不在而被忽視的經歷。而香港與其他群組一樣，兒童被忽略率高。因此可成為中國及其他亞洲在發展中的城市作為流行病學的前瞻。隨之，本研究可以報告如何適當地介入早期生活以減低常見精神障礙所帶來的健康及經濟負擔。

To evaluate the effectiveness of a behavioural voice therapy comprised of vocal hygiene education with resonant voice production for children with voice problems, compared to a placebo-treatment group.

17634416.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17634416.value: Voice problems, or dysphonia, are common in children. High prevalence figures of voice disorders have been reported in this population with a rate of at least 6%. Children with voice problems suffer from adverse impacts on their academic, daily and social functioning. They can receive negative stereotyping by their peers and adult listeners because of the deviant voice qualities. Voice problems in children can persist if left untreated. The impacts of voice problems on children are significant and long-term, that warrants intervention to address. The majority of voice problems in children are caused by phonotrauma, a term to describe trauma on vocal folds due to phonation. Phonotrauma is caused by excessive impact forces on the vocal folds. Common phonotraumatic activities in children include overuse and misuse of voice. Conservative, behavioral (non-surgical) therapy focusing on vocal hygiene education and effective voice production is always the first-line approach for reducing phonotrauma. Early published data in the literature provide some support for applying behavioral voice therapy in children. However, these studies are limited by methodological concerns: First, no control group was included for comparison. Second, outcome measures in these studies focus primarily on the impairment of vocal fold structures and functions. There is a lack of functional outcome measures on voice-related quality of life. Finally, treatment protocols are not standardised across subjects which makes replication of study difficult. The lack of strong scientific evidence hinders effective clinical decision-making when working with dysphonic children. There is a need for well-controlled clinical trial, which has broader range of subjective and objective voice outcome measures, and evaluates the long-term maintenance effects of the program. The present proposal aims to evaluate the effectiveness of vocal hygiene education with resonant voice production for managing children voice problems using a randomised controlled trial. In this study, 147 children with vocal pathologies will be randomised into three groups: voice therapy group, placebo treatment group and no-treatment control group. All children will be assessed at three time points as pre-therapy, immediate post-therapy, and follow-up at two months after completion of therapy. The World Health Organisation's International Classification of Functioning, Disability and Health-Children & Youth will be used as the over-arching framework to guide the evaluation of treatment efficacy. Results from this study will provide much-needed empirical efficacy data for treating children with voice problems. 學童患上聲線問題的情況日趨普遍，而學童聲線健康與其身心及學術發展有極密切關係。但聲線問題，若果沒有得到適當的治療，是有機會持續的，對學童的身心帶來長期的負面影響。大多數的學童聲線問題是由聲線創傷（phonotrauma）引起。常見的學童聲線創傷行為包括過度使用聲線和錯誤使用聲線，因而對聲帶造成創傷。治療學童聲線問題的方法主要針對用聲行為，包括用聲衛生教育(vocal hygiene education)和使用共鳴發聲（resonant voice training)。本研究目的是為建立一套學齡兒童聲線治療課程及探討其成效。在這項研究中，147名患有聲線問題的學童將隨機分為三組，所有參加的學童會先跟據電腦隨機安排到三組之其中一組。第一組會接受為期六個星期的聲線治療計劃；第二組會接受六個星期與聲線沒有直接關係的訓練，作對照用途；第三組不會接受任何訓練。治療成效將跟據世界衞生組織的「國際功能丶殘疾和健康分類」(International Classification of Functioning, Disability and Health, World Health Organization, 2001) 而作出評估。是項研究將能增進我們更了解香港學齡兒童對聲線的認知，以及建立一套有科學證據的學齡兒童聲線治療課程。

17634416.label: Realisation of objectives
17634416.value: The project was carried out in two stages. In Stage One, instructional manuals for treatment group (vocal hygiene education with resonant voice training) and placebo group (presentation skills training) were developed. The manuals were then used for data collection in Stage Two. STAGE ONE: PREPARATION STAGE 1) Development of Instructional Manual of Voice Therapy Program for School-aged Children An instructional manual of vocal hygiene education with resonant voice therapy for school-aged children was developed. The manual laid out in details the clinician's instructions to be given in each of the six voice therapy sessions. Clinical materials were also prepared including picture cards and handouts. The draft manual was evaluated by two experienced speech therapists to establish its face and content validity. The instructional manual ensures the voice therapy was delivered with the same amount of input and feedback to participants from different clinicians, which contributes to the reliability and validity of the study. A book proposal has been submitted to publish the instructional manual. A sample chapter is attached in Part C of this report. 2) Development of a placebo therapy program A program on presentation skills training was developed for the placebo group. This placebo program has i) the same number of sessions, ii) similar amount of interaction between the clinician and the child, and iii) similar amount of talking in the session as the treatment group. The materials were evaluated by two experienced speech therapists for clarity, and was also piloted with 10 children to ensure appropriate reading levels for school-aged children. STAGE TWO: SUBJECT RECRUITMENT A total of 87 children expressed their interests to participate. They were invited to attend a full voice assessment at the HKU Voice Research Lab. Among these children, 45 were excluded from the study either because they did not fit the selection criteria (n = 15), did not attend the assessment session (n = 15) or they attended the assessment session but were reluctant to undergo laryngeal endoscopic examination and hence withdrew from the study (n = 15). The remaining 42 children met the selection criteria and were eligible for the study. They were randomly assigned to the treatment group (vocal hygiene education with resonant voice training), placebo group (presentation skills training) or no treatment control group. Eleven of them did not complete the data collection (3 withdrew half-way through and 8 did not show up at post-assessments). The remaining 31 children completed the data collection (18 in treatment group, 6 in placebo group and 7 in control group). In the present study, selection of treatment outcome measures was guided by the World Health Organization’s International Classification of Functioning, Disability and Health. Subjective outcome measures included the Children’s Voice Handicap Index-10 (CVHI-10; Ricci-Maccarini, et al., 2013) for assessing children's perception of their voice problems; the pediatric Voice Handicap Index (pVHI; Zur et al., 2007) for assessing parents' perception of their child's voice problems; and auditory-perceptual evaluation of overall voice severity. Objective outcome measures included acoustic analysis of fundamental frequency, jitter, shimmer and noise-to-harmonic ratio in connected speech. Assessments were performed before and after treatment, or at the end of the no treatment period for the control group. Two research assistants who were blinded to the participant’s group assignment performed the assessments. This blinding procedure was to minimize any potential experimenter bias on voice performance.

17634416.label: Major findings and research outcome
17634416.value: MAJOR FINDINGS i) Subjective evaluation -- Children’s Voice Handicap Index-10 (CVHI-10): For all groups of children, there was no significant differences in CVHI-10 total scores between pre- and post-measurements. Children’s self-perceived voice severity and impacts were similar before and after treatment. -- Pediatric Voice Handicap Index (pVHI): In the treatment group, there was significant decrease in perceived voice severity level (p = .018) and Total Score (p = .017) after treatment. There were no significant differences in any of the pVHI scores in the placebo group (all ps > .05), except the significantly less severe voice in the control group after treatment (p = .04). -- Auditory-perceptual evaluation of overall severity: Four final year speech therapy students participated as listeners and rated the overall voice severity of the voice samples using paired-comparison paradigm. They received perceptual training before rating the experimental voice samples. The change in overall voice severity was rated on a 7-point equal-appearing interval scale, with -3 units representing the most negative change, 0 representing no change and +3 representing the most positive improvements. The ICC values for inter-listener and intra-listener was 0.73 and 0.85 respectively, indicating moderate to good reliability. Improvements in overall severity was found in treatment group (mean change = +0.70 units). However, there was a deterioration of overall voice severity in the placebo group (mean change = -0.80 units) after treatment. Interestingly, improvements in overall severity was also noted in the no-treatment control group (mean change = +0.35 units). ii) Objective evaluation: Acoustic analysis No significant differences were found in any of the acoustic parameters in all groups. SUMMARY OF RESEARCH OUTCOME Consistent with the hypothesis, the improvements in treatment group suggest that vocal hygiene education with resonant voice training is effective in improving voice quality and voice-related quality of life for children with voice problems. Children in the no-treatment control group did not show any significant changes in voice-related quality of life. However, surprisingly, they showed some improvements in the overall voice severity (OBJECTIVE 1). Children in the placebo group received presentation skills training. The lack of improvements in this group suggest that voice exercises not addressing the underlying cause of the dysphonia are not effective (OBJECTIVE 2). The research findings were reported at three international conferences. A manuscript was submitted to The Laryngoscope for publication. Moreover, a book proposal was submitted for publishing the instructional manual of the voice therapy programme developed to optimise the study's publicity value.

17634416.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
17634416.value: Our results suggest that vocal hygiene education with resonant voice training is effective for treating voice problems in children. The study has the potential for further research development in two directions: In the present study, voice therapy was delivered face-to-face. One future research direction is to modify the voice therapy program to be delivered online (that is, tele-voice therapy) and compare its effectiveness with voice therapy delivered face-to-face. The results would have implications for providing tele-voice therapy with children when clinical access is restricted (e.g., under pandemic times). Secondly, because the majority of voice problems in children are hyperfunctional in nature which can be prevented, another future research direction is to adopt the present voice therapy program as a preventive program for children and evaluate its efficacy.

17634416.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
17634416.value: Voice problems are common in children which can lead to significant adverse impacts on their daily and social functioning. The majority of voice problems in children are caused by misuse and overuse of voice. Behavioural (non-surgical) voice therapy has been the first-line management approach for voice problems in children. Nevertheless, paediatric voice is a clinical area with a lack of high level evidence to guide its therapy. This study was set out to evaluate the effectiveness of voice care education with resonant voice training for managing voice problems in children. Findings of the study suggest that behavioural voice therapy can be useful in improving voice quality and voice-related quality of life in children. The results also show that voice exercises that do not address the underlying cause of the dysphonia are not effective in improving voice problems. In summary, the study provides a much needed efficacy data to guide health care professionals best practice for treating children with voice problems.

17636016.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17636016.value: 舊鄰裡，新空間：中國都市化過程中的城市改造與治理

17636016.label: Project Objectives
17636016.value: To challenge standard approaches to urbanization in China and their tendency to focus only on top-down changes occurred in the post-socialist period; To develop a nuanced analysis of urbanization that sees the reconfiguration of the built environment, forms of governance and political economy as interactive processes and dynamic assemblages with multiple actors and multiple historical layers; To provide a multi-temporal and multi-sited qualitative account of the process of urbanization in the city of Guangzhou, offering a Southern Chinese regional perspective on long-term processes of urban transformation nationwide; To provide an in-depth analysis of three case studies of urban reconfiguration in Guangzhou: the construction of new streets in the western part of the city in the 1920s and 1930s, the "socialist housing transformation" project in the old city center in the 1950s and 1960s, and the reconstruction of an "urban village" in the new city center in the contemporary context; To make a contribution to recent debates on infrastructures, material powers, and techniques of modern governance in the fields of urban studies, anthropology, post-colonial studies, and STS, adding a much-needed non-Western critical perspective into these debates.
