26300316.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
26300316.value: Inflation is the leading paradigm of the very early universe cosmology. During inflation, the universe expands exponentially. The characteristic energy scale of the inflationary universe is much higher than the current lab experiments and those in the foreseeable future. Over the 30 years since inflation has been proposed, a huge number of inflation models have been built. However, two other fundamental topics have attracted relatively much less efforts: (1) Considering that inflation has access to energy much higher than particle physics colliders, it would be very valuable to make use of inflation to probe high energy particle physics at the energy scale of inflation, in a less model dependent way than model building. (2) A number of alternative-to-inflation scenarios have also been proposed for the very early universe. There lacks a satisfactory way to universally and model-independently distinguish alternative-to-inflation scenarios from inflation. Those two topics converge at one program, starting from the work Quasi-Single Field (QSF) inflation by Chen and the PI in 2009 (the first two papers are cited 254 times and the impact keeps rising), which investigated the dynamics of massive fields during inflation. Massive fields exist in any fundamental theory which contains inflation. They provide the key to access the above research directions because: (1) On particle colliders, the most important mission is to discover new massive particles and study their properties. If we would like to make use of cosmology to study high energy physics, detection methods and properties of massive particles should play a similar central role. (2) Massive fields oscillate, at least quantum mechanically, in the very early universe. The oscillation provides a standard clock, keeping track of physical time. Comparing this standard clock with the clock of density fluctuations (which keep track of conformal time because of horizon crossing), the expansion history of the very early universe can be reconstructed. The expansion history, by definition, distinguishes inflation between alternative scenarios. This approach is known as the quantum primordial standard clock (QPSC) In this proposal, we will first review the work done by us and other groups on massive fields, in the Background of Research Section. We will then show the significant missing parts of the program, especially, the strong mixing and loops for the QSF, and the details of the cosmological three point correlation function (non-Gaussianity) for QPSC in real world inflation and alternative models and their shape templates. 暴漲宇宙學是解釋原初宇宙的最成功的理論。暴漲期間宇宙指數膨脹。暴漲的能標遠遠高於目前以及可預計的加速器實驗。 暴漲提出三十年以來，人們構造了非常多的暴漲模型。然而，其它兩個基本問題並沒有得到充分的重視： 一、由於暴漲能標高於粒子物理加速器，暴漲可以用於探測高能物理（以不依賴於具體模型的方式）。 二、暴漲不是解釋原初宇宙的唯一理論。目前幾個其它理論（替代理論）也可以解釋現有實驗，無法從觀測上區分暴漲和替代理論。 這兩個論題有一個共同的解決方案——從2009年開始，項目負責人與合作者陳新剛研究了暴漲期間重場的動力學（稱為准單場暴漲）。在任何基礎理論裡，都有重場存在。這些重場是解決上述問題的鑰匙。因為： 一、在粒子物理加速器上，最重要的科學目的是發現新的重粒子以及研究它們的性質。如果我們用宇宙學去研究高能物理，重粒子的觀測效應是同等重要的。 二、重粒子（至少）在量子層面上具有振盪的相位。在早期宇宙中，這個相位是一個標準鐘，為我們提供物理時間。比較這個標準鐘和共形時間（由密度擾動在出視界時提供），就可以重建原初宇宙的膨脹歷史。根據暴漲和替代理論的定義，它們的區別就是原初宇宙的膨脹歷史。所以，我們可以區別暴漲和替代理論。這種方法叫做量子原初標準鐘。 在這個提案中，我們首先在研究背景部分回顧我們和其他研究人員關於重場的工作。接著，我們提議進行下列研究：准單場暴漲的強混合情況以及圈圖，以及量子標準鐘在暴漲和替代模型中的具體細節，包括非高斯性的形狀範本。我們也計畫總結和發表多年來發展出的相關計算技術。

26300316.label: Realisation of objectives
26300316.value: We have completed the strongly coupled case and discussed resummation techniques extensively. This completed Objective 1. We have studied throughly the massive loops for gauge bosons and fermions. This completes Objective 2. We have calculated amplitudes of the clock signal in various models of QPSC which completes Objective 3. We have studied the structure of the correlation functions for inflation and alternative-to inflation. This contributes to Objective 4. We have also studied the non-standard clock signals and compares inflation and alternative-to-inflation. This two projects completes Objective 4. We have studied the correlation structure for inflaton gravitons, and the impact from electric fields for the shape of non-Gaussianity. We have studied the shape of non-Gaussianities arising from Higgs and dark matter, and use IR expansion to simplify the shapes, making them easy to access for data analysis. This completes Objective 5. We have systematically summarized the calculation technique of cosmological correlation functions in "Schwinger-Keldysh Diagrammatics for Primordial Perturbations". This can be considered as completion of Objective 6. But we note that some numerical methods mentioned in Objective 6 can be further reviewed and developed. Recently, we have completed a paper "Numerical prescriptions of early-time divergences of the in-in formalism" and published as JCAP07(2022)014 which summarized and extended the numerical technique of cosmological perturbations. This completes the Objective 6.

26300316.label: Major findings and research outcome
26300316.value: We systematically study how to probe massive fields using inflationary probes in cosmology. In the reporting period we have published 12 research papers on peer-review journals, all are among leading journals in our field. In publications "Standard Model Background of the Cosmological Collider" [1] in Part C, "Standard Model mass spectrum in inflationary universe" [2] we systematically studied the cosmological implication of the particle physics standard model during inflation and the massive fields related (the mass of the standard model particles are naturally uplifted to Hubble scale). In [4, 5, 6], we systematically studied the calculation technique of massive fields during inflation. We note that partial effective field theory can be used, and some modes can be integrated out. We also studied the effect of temperature. In addition , in [7] we study the massive field effect in hybrid quasi-single field inflation. In [12] a Higgs switching model is studied. In [9] the Schwinger effect is studied. We studied the structure of cosmological correlation functions in [8] and [10] and show how some Minkowski space results can be applicable to inflationary correlation functions after modifications. In [11] we studied alternative-to-inflation and show that though the standard clock signals are applicable, non-minimal coupling results in non-standard clock signals. Both standard and non-standard clock signals arise from the mass of the fields. In [3] we reviewed extensively the computation technique of the in-in formalism as well as made additional contribution in resumation of correlation functions in cosmology.

26300316.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
26300316.value: Over the report period, the study of massive fields during inflation has become one of the major research direction in the early universe cosmology, and was given a name "cosmological collider physics" by Arkani-Hamed and Maldacena. As one of the pioneer in this field, our work was highly recognized by colleagues. Our research reports here made solid foundation to cosmological collider physics. Many future developments can be considered, such as more phenomenological studies of particle physics during inflation, formal studies of cosmological bootstrap with massive fields with chemical potential and sound speed, and future experiments exploring the non-Gaussianities that we predict.

26300316.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
26300316.value: We have systematically studied how to use cosmological observables, such as density contracts in our universe, to probe high energy particle physics, especially massive fields during the primordial stage of the universe. In other words, this project use the largest object in the universe -- the universe itself (the observable part) -- to explore the smallest object in the universe -- elementary particles. Our work unveils a model-independent way of connecting these largest and smallest objects in our universe. As the universe is believed to undergo a stage with a temperature much higher than that can be accessed by human in man-made experiments, our research can be used to explore higher energy new physics compared to what we can access on particle physics colliders.

26300716.value: 积分微分方程的解的正则性原理

26300716.label: Project Objectives
26300716.value: Extend the regularity theory of second order elliptic equations to integro-differential equations. Explore the regularity properties that are unique to integro-differential equations and different from those for second order equations.
rows: Extend the regularity theory of second order elliptic equations to integro-differential equations.
Explore the regularity properties that are unique to integro-differential equations and different from those for second order equations.

26300716.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
26300716.value: 在这里我们要分析非线性积分微分方程的解的正则性。古典的偏微分方程是由一个未知函数和它的导数所组成。要验证这种方程在一个点是否成立，我们只需要知道这个函数在这个点的任意小的邻域中的值。而积分微分方程是由一个未知函数和它的导数以及积分所组成。因此，要验证积分微分方程在一个点是否成立，我们需要知道这个函数在整个域中的值。这也是在很多文献中它们被称为非局部方程的原因。 积分微分方程的来源有很多，比如出现在概率论，几何，物理和生态学中。积分微分方程本身非常丰富，事实上，二阶偏微分方程可以由积分微分方程取极限所得到。在这里，我们主要研究椭圆性积分微分方程。 绝大多数积分微分方程是不可能找到显示解的。所以首先我们需要研究积分微分方程的解的存在性。对椭圆方程而言，在很多情况下我们首先可以通过变分法或者粘性解方法找到一个弱解，然后再证明这些弱解的正则性，也就是说这些弱解是不是足够光滑以至于我们可以把它们代入方程来验证。 Luis Caffarelli 和 Luis Silvestre 在一系列文章中建立了很多根本性的积分微分方程的解的正则性原理。而且，我们可以对他们建立的正则性估计求极限来重获二阶椭圆方程的解的正则性估计。从此以后，有很多积分微分方程的解的正则性结果。其中一些可以认为是对二阶椭圆方程的正则性的推广，还有一些是对积分微分方程的新发现。在这里，我们继续研究积分微分方程的解的正则性，包括凸方程的解的L^p估计，非凸方程是否有正则性，以及散度方程的Schauder估计。这些会是对二阶椭圆方程的正则性的推广。我们也会研究混合阶的积分微分方程的解的正则性，而这些性质会是积分微分方程所特有的。

26300716.label: Realisation of objectives
26300716.value: We obtained a number of regularity results for integro-differential equations. They include general fully nonlinear integro-differential equations, and also those with the fractional Laplacian operator, which the typical example of integro-differential operators. In the joint paper with Hongjie Dong and Hong Zhang, on one hand, we extended the Dini estimate and Schauder estimates to fully nonlinear integro-differential parabolic equations. On the other hand, we established regularity estimates for integro-differential equations with drifts, when the diffusion order is of one. This case is unique to integro-differential equations, since the diffusion operator and the drift operator are of the same order and compete with each other. This paper was published in Anal. PDE. In the joint paper with Rupert Frank and Jingang Xiong, we obtained the sharp lower and upper bound of the solutions to the Euler-Lagrange equation of the fractional Sobolev inequality in half spaces, where the diffusion operator is the regional fractional Laplacian operator in the half space. This property is unique to the regional fractional Laplacian operator, since there does not exist such solutions in the second order case. Moreover, this upper and lower bounds are used afterwards for the Sobolev inequality in general domains. This paper was published in Calc. Var. Partial Differential Equations. In the joint paper with Jingang Xiong, we studied a nonlinear integral equation with isolated singularity, and obtained the sharp asymptotic behavior of the solutions near the isolated singularity (see Theorem 1.3 in that paper). This not only extends the classical results for second order equations, but also solves the cases of higher order differential equations and higher order integro-differential equations as corollaries. This paper will be published in Ann. Inst. H. Poincaré Anal. Non Linéaire, and it has been in press. In the joint preprint with Dennis Kriventsov and Jingang Xiong, we study the Rayleigh-Faber-Krahn inequality for the regional fractional Laplacian. We proved lower and upper bound of the minimiser, and its smoothness in the interior of its support. This extends the results of the Laplacian case to the regional fractional Laplacian case. The preprint is attached in Part 3, item 8.

26300716.label: Major findings and research outcome
26300716.value: In research output 1, we proved the Dini estimate and Schauder estimates for fully nonlinear integro-differential parabolic equations with drifts, when the kernels of the integro-differential operators are Dini continuous and Holder continuous, respectively. We also studied linear integro-differential parabolic equations with drifts, where the coefficients of the equations are only measurable in the time variable, and proved the Dini estimates and Schauder estimates for the solutions in the spatial variables. In research output 2, we proved existence of minimisers to the fractional Sobolev inequality in general domains. An essential step for general domains is the optimal global regularity (Proposition 1.5 there) for an integro-differential equation involving the regional fractional Laplacian operator in the half space. We obtained the sharp lower and upper bound of the solutions to the Euler-Lagrange equation in half spaces. In research output 3, we studied a nonlinear integral equation with isolated singularity, and obtained the sharp asymptotic behavior of the solutions near the isolated singularity (see Theorem 1.3 in that paper). Our approach uses blow up analysis for local integral equations, and is unified for all critical elliptic (differential and integro-differential) equations of order smaller than the dimension. In research output 4, we study the Rayleigh-Faber-Krahn inequality for the regional fractional Laplacian. We first proved the upper bound of the minimiser using De Giorgi iteration and its smoothness in the interior of its support, when we restricted the problem in a large domain. Then we proved its lower bound, which leads to the existence of minimisers to the global problem.

26300716.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
26300716.value: There is a great potential in studying higher order regularity of the minimisers to the Rayleigh-Faber-Krahn inequality for the regional fractional Laplacian. In our current preprint, our regularity results were essentially obtained by making use of the inward minimising phenomenon. But it is unclear yet what the mechanism is on the outward minimising property. The PI plans to continue to investigate them with collaborators.

26300716.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
26300716.value: On one hand, the research project provides general and unified approach to establishing regularity of solutions to certain differential equations and integro-differetial equations. On the other hand, it discovered many new regularity results for integro-differential equations. The techniques developed in the project, as well as the research outcome, will be useful in the mathematical community.

26301016.label: Project Title(Chinese)
26301016.value: 等离子纳米球的光学性质的数学理论分析及其应用

26301016.label: Project Objectives
26301016.value: Propose a rigorous definition of plasmon resonant frequency for a single nanoparticle based on Maxwell equations and the Drude model. Derive analytical formulas for the resonant frequency in terms of the electromagnetic parameters of the particle, the shape and size of the particle, and the electromagnetic parameters of the environment; Characterize the enhancement of scattering and absorption near the resonant frequencies. Characterize the shift in the plasmon resonant frequency due to changes in the electromagnetic parameters of the background and derive rigorous formulas for the shift.
rows: Propose a rigorous definition of plasmon resonant frequency for a single nanoparticle based on Maxwell equations and the Drude model. Derive analytical formulas for the resonant frequency in terms of the electromagnetic parameters of the particle, the shape and size of the particle, and the electromagnetic parameters of the environment;
Characterize the enhancement of scattering and absorption near the resonant frequencies.
Characterize the shift in the plasmon resonant frequency due to changes in the electromagnetic parameters of the background and derive rigorous formulas for the shift.

26301016.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
26301016.value: Plasmonic nanoparticles are metallic particles with size ranging from several nano meters to hundreds of nano meters (smaller than the wavelength of light). Under the illumination of light, they may exhibit strong light scattering and absorption. This is mainly due to the excitation of localized surface plasmon resonance which is the collective charge density oscillations of the conduction electrons in the nanoparticles. Plasmonic nanoparticles have many applications. In biosensing, they can be used to detect molecular binding events and changes in molecular conformation due to the sensitivity of the localized surface plasmon resonance to electromagentic properties of the environment. In cellular and biological imaging, they are used as contrast agents because of their large scattering cross-section. In medical therapy, they are used to kill cancerous cells by their photothermal effect. Besides, plasmonic particles can also be used for super-focusing and for building photonic structures which allow control of light on a subwavelength scale. In this project, we aim to conduct a rigorous mathematical analysis of the optical properties of plasmonic nanoparticles. We will investigate the scattering of plasmonic particles near the resonant frequencies and propose a mathematical definition of surface plasmon resonant frequency. The enhancement of scattering and absorption will be characterized. For this purpose, we will use Maxwell equations with the Drude model which describes the electric and magnetic properties of the particles (greater than 10 nms in size). Mathematically, the excitation of surface plasmon resonance is due to the fact that the real part of the dielectric constant of metals becomes negative in the optical and near infrard regime. This yields a new class of partial differential equations whose ellipticity are lost due to the fact that the leading order coefficients have changing signs. Motivated by applications in biosensing, we also will investigate the shift in plasmon resonant frequency due to changes of electromagnetic properties of the environment. We will consider various practical cases and derive rigorous asymptotic formulas for the shift in each case. These formulas may provide guidance and justification for the sensing methods used in practice and motivate new methods for sensing in other fields. 等离子纳米球指的是大小从几纳米到几百纳米的金属球（比可见光的波长小）。在可见光的照射下，它们可以表现出很强的散射和吸收能力。这主要是由纳米金属球中的自由传导电子在特定的可见光频率下的一致振动所激发的局部表面等离子共振所产生的。 等离子纳米球具有许多应用。在生物传感中，它们可以用来探测分子形变中的成键过程和其他变化， 这主要是由于表面等离子共振对周围环境的电磁学性质十分敏感的缘故。 在分子和生物成像中， 由于强散射能力它们被用作造影剂。 在药物治疗中，因为光热效应它们可以用于杀死癌细胞。 在这个研究项目中，我们的目标是对等离子纳米球的光学性质进行严格的数学理论分析。我们将研究它们在共振频率附近的散射性质，提出表面等离子共振频率的数学定义，并且刻画它们对光的散射和吸收的增强效应。为了这些目的，我们使用了麦克斯韦方程和Drude模型来描述金属球的电学和磁学性质（这个模型对尺寸大于10纳米的球成立）。在数学上，表面等离子体共振的是由于金属的介电常数的实部在可见光频率附近变成负数值产生的。这将产生新的一类偏微分方程。 这些方程的椭圆性由于最高阶项的参数改变正负号而不再成立。 受生物传感应用的启发，我们还考察等离子体共振频率由于周围环境的电磁特性的发生变化而造成的偏移。我们将考虑各种实际情况，并推导出这些偏移的严格渐近公式。这些公式可以对在实践中使用的这类传感方法提供理论的基础和指导，并且能激发其他领域的传感的新的方法。

26301016.label: Realisation of objectives
26301016.value: All the objectives have been satisfactorily realized. Specifically, we analyzed the Maxwell model for the plasmonic particle and characterized their resonant frequency in terms of the following three factors: 1. the spectrum of the Neumann-Poincare operator associated with the particle which appears in the leading order term; 2. the particle size which appears as a perturbative term; and 3. the electromagnetic parameters of both the particle and the environment. By deriving asymptotic expansion, we have characterized the enhancement factor of scattering and absorption near the resonant frequencies. We also have considered plasmonic sensing where one uses the shift of plasmonic resonant frequency to detect changes in the electromagnetic parameters of the background. Specifically, the changes are induced by the presence of an unknown particle. We derived a formula for the shift in terms of the generalized polarization tensor of the unknown particle. We further proposed an effective algorithm to reconstruct the shape of the unknown particle.

26301016.label: Major findings and research outcome
26301016.value: We found that plasmonic resonance frequency depends mainly on the shape of the particle, the dependence on the size can be viewed as a perturbative term. The resonance also depends on the environment that is close to it very sensitive. In all cases, we have derived an analytic formula for the resonant frequency. The main results are published in top journals in the field.

26301016.value: Explore the applications of plasmonic structures in biomedical sensing.

26301016.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
26301016.value: The study has developed a rigorous mathematical foundation for the optical properties of plasmonic nanoparticles. The fundamental question on the characterization of plasmonic resonant frequency is addressed and analytic formulas are derived. These paved a foundation for their applications in sensing and in the design of plasmonic materials.

26301216.label: Project Title(Chinese)
26301216.value: 动态伪发现率及其在序贯和空间模式检测的应用

26301216.label: Project Objectives
26301216.value: To develop a novel notion of dynamic false discovery rate in large-scale inference: efforts will be made to define, estimate and control the dynamic false discovery rate under a general framework. To apply the new methodology for continual surveillance of high dimensional data: this aims at exploiting the sequential feature in the time-domain involved in the high dimensional data as the selection criteria. All the necessary formulas used in our dynamic procedure will be derived, resulting in an operational procedure. To detect emerging events in the massive spatial-temporal data sets via the procedure proposed in Objective 1: we will design a new selection criterion by adaptively using spatial constraints. The new dynamic testing procedure will naturally be fitted into this configuration, expecting to have some optimality compared to some conventional FDR procedures designed for spatial data.

To apply the new methodology for continual surveillance of high dimensional data: this aims at exploiting the sequential feature in the time-domain involved in the high dimensional data as the selection criteria. All the necessary formulas used in our dynamic procedure will be derived, resulting in an operational procedure.

To detect emerging events in the massive spatial-temporal data sets via the procedure proposed in Objective 1: we will design a new selection criterion by adaptively using spatial constraints. The new dynamic testing procedure will naturally be fitted into this configuration, expecting to have some optimality compared to some conventional FDR procedures designed for spatial data.

26301216.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
26301216.value: To reduce the multiplicity issue in large-scale inference, the hypotheses being tested are commonly selected by some preliminary screening methods. This naturally leads to a situation where the test index set is random and dynamic. However, most of the existing approaches ignore the effect of screening on the follow-up multiple testing procedures by assuming that the test index set is non-random, thus are inefficient. This inspires us to revisit and modify conventional error measure in statistical inference. In this research project, we mainly focus on the false discovery rate, but the method proposed can be readily extended to other error measure. The proposed research project focuses on developing a new notion of dynamic false discovery rate (dFDR) in multiple testing when the test index set is random. We explicitly model the "randomness" via a series of random events and their associated probabilities, and further provide valid statistical procedures to estimate and control the dFDR under some mild conditions. To illustrate the practical utility of the proposed method, we apply it to continual surveillance of high dimensional data for detecting anomalous patterns or emerging events. The central idea of the proposed research is to develop a dynamic false discovery rate in large-scale inference by incorporating the randomness involved in the test index set. This brings new challenges and opportunities to reformulate existing theories and methodologies developed during the last two decades since the introduction of false discovery rate, with the promise of better describing random process.

26301216.label: Realisation of objectives
26301216.value: Objective 1 has been fully addressed in the paper titled ‘Online control of false discovery rates for multiple datastreams’. We found a novel setting on continual surveillance where the process of the some data streams with an alarm is halted. The resulting set of data streams for testing becomes a dynamic set, which is determined by the previous complex designs. To embed the information involved in the dynamic set, we analytically formulate the false discovery rate via a form of conditional distribution when test statistics are constructed based on the well-known exponentially weighted moving average (EWMA) scheme. Although the discussion is restricted to the EWMA scheme, the selection rule is allowed to be correlated with the testing rule, enabling us to generalize the results in a general framework. This paper has been published in Journal of Statistical Planning and Inference, 194, 1-14. The second objective focuses on incorporation of the sequential feature in the time domain in high-dimensional data. In the midterm of this ECS project, the manuscript titled ‘Screening-assisted dynamic multiple testing with false discovery rate control’ was written to fully explore the sequential feature. To enhance the applicability of the proposed method, I invited Dr. Jingshen Wang, previously a PhD student at University of Michigan, and Dr. Zhenke Wu, an assistant professor at University of Michigan, to join the project. In particular, we are interested in constructing a large-scale dynamic tracking and screening procedure capable of rapidly identifying irregular individual streams whose behavioral patterns deviate from the majority. By fully exploiting the sequential feature of data streams, we first develop a robust estimation approach under a framework of varying coefficient model. The procedure naturally accommodates unequally-spaced design points and updates the coefficient estimates as new data arrive without the need to store historical data. A data-driven choice of an optimal smoothing parameter is accordingly proposed. Further, we suggest a new online model-specification test tailored to the streaming environment. The resulting DTS scheme is able to adapt time-varying structures appropriately, track changes in the underlying models, and hence maintain high accuracy in detecting time periods during which individual streams exhibit irregular behavior. Moreover, we derive the asymptotic properties of the procedure and investigate its finite-sample performance through simulation studies. We demonstrate the proposed methods through a mobile health example from an Intern Health Study (IHS) to estimate the timings when subjects’ sleep and physical activities have unusual influence upon their mood. The IHS is an on-going mobile health cohort study that enrolls more than 3,000 interns annually. The long-term goal of the IHS is to elucidate the pathophysiological architecture underlying depression to facilitate the development of improved treatments. One of the important goals of IHS is to identify data driven behavioral phenotypes, derived from mobile data elements that predict short-term risk for mood changes. Our new results show that individuals have distinct timings and durations when the joint effect of sleep hours and step counts change the mood to a different degree than others in the population, highlighting the timings to intervene upon sleep and activities, for example, through push notifications via their mobile phone. We completely reshape the manuscript by modelling the sequential feature in the framework of varying coefficient model, and propose a novel specification test to detect anomaly via a dynamic tracking and screening method. The revised manuscript titled ‘Dynamic tracking and screening in massive datastreams’ has been submitted to Journal of American Statistical Association for review on March, 2020. The third objective concentrates on the application of the false discovery rates method to detect the emerging events in massive spatial-temporal data. Dr. Yunlong Wang and Professor Changliang Zou from Nankai University were invited to join this project. In many applied areas, such as disease surveillance, brain imaging, and geological data monitoring, data are collected at spatial grid points overtime, and a large-scale multiple testing procedure is required to detect the presence of spatially and temporally clustered signals. We formulate a spatiotemporal framework in the presence of multiple change points for multiple testing, and propose a data-driven procedure that aims to fully utilize the clustering information. With the aim of grouping data into several sets, we develop a new change-point detection algorithm that integrates the kernel-based aggregation of spatial observations with a global loss function at the temporal level. Then, we derive an FDR control scheme for set-wise multiple testing. Under some mild conditions on the spatiotemporal dependence structure, the FDR is shown to be strongly controlled. Theoretical analysis and numerical studies demonstrate the advantages of our algorithm over competing methods. We submitted the resulting manuscript titled ‘Change-detection-assisted multiple testing for spatiotemporal data’ to Annals of Statistics, and received mixed reports. We are on the process of a possible revision for addressing the comments from Annals of Statistics. Specifically, the criticism that the new test statistics obtained via kernel smoothing may contaminate the null and non-null features if the signal is not completely smoothing, can be addressed via a sample-splitting idea, where half of the sample is used to construct the conventional test statistics with valid false discovery rate control and the rest is used to construct a new test statistic that fully uses the spatial and temporal smoothing constraints for power enhancement. Then, we suggest the product of the two statistics for multiple testing, and is expected to have valid false discovery rate control while it is robust to various model misspecifications. Under this new direction, we believe the new proposed methodology could be very promising. Once the manuscript is eventually accepted by journal, acknowledge on this ECS project will be made. Finally, I listed all the related papers published in the duration of the project. Acknowledges on this project are made in the Acknowledge Section of each paper. 1. 26301216.label: Major findings and research outcome
26301216.value: The major findings of this project are: (1) the power of a multiple testing procedure can be dramatically enhanced if some internal/external side information can be encoded as some covariates and used to modify the conventional false discovery rate procedures; (2) Massive datastreams are usually not homogeneous, making the proposed dynamic testing procedure useful in analysing such complex data structures. Screening and kernel smoothing are two useful tools for exploring the dynamic features of the data. Equipped with these techniques, data with spatial and temporal constraints can be efficiently handled via the proposed general framework. There are a total of three research articles produced under the support of the ECS grant. The work “On-line control of false discovery rates for multiple datastreams” has been published in Journal of Statistical Planning and Inference, 194, 1-14. The manuscript ‘Dynamic tracking and screening for massive datastreams’ has been submitted for peer review. The new one ‘Change-detection-assisted multiple testing for spatiotemporal data’ is under re-construction.

26301216.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
26301216.value: During the development of third paper ‘Change-detection-assisted multiple testing for spatiotemporal data’, we have developed a new approach for data aggregation. The basic idea is to split the sample into two parts, where one part is used for data exploration and the other prat is used for constructing a simple test statistic with global symmetry property. The product of two test statistic enables us to effectively utilize all of data information, and can be broadly applied to other settings. For instance, we have developed a new method for multiple testing under general dependence; see a recent paper on arXiv:2002.11992 for details. There are certainly further developments along this direction.

26301216.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
26301216.value: Massive and complex datastreams pose challenges and new opportunities for data scientists to exploit the heteroscedasticity. Observation and its neighbours are more likely to share with similar properties, making the dynamic inference a necessity. Although we focus on dynamic false discovery rates, other methods can certainly be developed in a similar fashion. As a result, we hope our research outputs can serve as a starting point, and provide a framework for other further developments. From a practice viewpoint, we have provided a new angle for analysing the mobile-health data, and our method would serve as an alternative for improving the human health through push notifications via mobile phone.

26301316.value: 幾何流的奇異點及漸近性

26301316.label: Project Objectives
26301316.value: Deepen the current understanding about finite-time singularities of the Kähler-Ricci flow by extending some of the PI's and others' notable works to a wider class of manifolds. 26301316.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
26301316.value: Geometric flows are time-dependent differential equations on geometric shapes. The study of geometric flows is one of the most central topics in Differential Geometry and Partial Differential Equations, because some of them were successfully applied to resolve a number of long-standing problems in Geometry and Topology, notably the Poincaré Conjecture by Hamilton-Perelman (2002-03) and the Differentiable Sphere Theorem by Brendle-Schoen (2007). In this proposed project, the PI will study the singularity formation and asymptotic properties of some geometric flows. Analysis of singularities and asymptotics of the Ricci flow was a key ingredient in the solutions to the above-mentioned long-standing problems. Under a geometric flow, the shape may either encounter singularity in finite time, or else the flow has a long-time solution which often approaches asymptotically a nice geometric structure such as the round sphere. The singular region and the asymptotic limit often capture crucial topological information about the shape. Although the analysis of singularity formulation and asymptotic properties of geometric flows has brought tremendous success in resolving some long-standing conjectures, there are still many open problems concerning singularities and asymptotics of geometric flows from broader perspectives. For instance, the Kähler-Ricci flow is a very active topic of research since the past decade due to its relation to major problems in Algebraic Geometry, and there are many crucial analytic and geometric issues yet to be resolved, such as its behavior under Hamilton-Perelman's type blow-up analysis. The PI will deepen and broaden the current understanding on some open and central issues about singular and asymptotic behaviors of geometric flows, especially the Kähler-Ricci flow. Some very recent progress on Ricci solitons (known as quasi-Einstein metrics in Physics) provides plausible ways to extend current results to cover for a broader class of geometric objects and flows. It is expected that the proposed research will promote closer interactions between Differential Geometry and other fields including Topology, Algebraic Geometry, Partial Differential Equations and Physics. 幾何流是微分幾何和偏微分方程的重要範疇。它曾用作解決許多重要數學難題，包括龐卡萊猜想及球定理等等。幾何流的奇異點和漸近性的研究在上述問題的解決扮演重要的角色，原因是奇異點往往蘊含重要拓撲資訊。 幾何流的奇異點和漸近性研究在高維的流形上還有許多未解決的問題和有待研究的空間，例如在凱勒・瑞奇流在這方面的研究於過去十數年間是很活躍的題材。在這個研究計劃中我們希望對凱勒・瑞奇流及其有關的幾何流的奇異點和漸近性分析有更深入和更廣濶的了解。我們期待研究結果對於代數幾何、拓撲學、偏微分方程及物理學等等有廣泛應用。

26301316.label: Realisation of objectives
26301316.value: Among all four objectives, the PI has achieved significant progress on Objective 2, and gained a lot more insights on Objectives 1 and 4. It appears to the PI that Objective 3 seems more technical and difficulty than it appears. For Objective 2, the PI has proved in a preprint with Man-Chun Lee (https://arxiv.org/abs/2001.11555) a higher-order estimates of the Kahler-Ricci flow when the underlying manifold has semi-ample canonical line bundle and the regular fibers are biholomorphic to each other. For Objective 1, the PI has observed that some former works by the PI about the Kahler-Ricci flow on projective bundles with Calabi symmetry can be reproved by slightly different approach using conformal submersions. It opens a new problem on whether the PI's former work on projective bundles can be generalized to conformal submersions. For Objective 4, the PI has studied some variational aspects of the H-functional involved, and exhibited in some cases the gradient flow of the H-functional indeed behaves as expected in the proposal. After enormous trial-and-error, it seems like construction of Ricci solitons using gluing constructions is a bit hard, and many other PI's and others' results show that Ricci solitons are quite rigid.

The PI has adopted various analysis technique to prove various convergence and rigidity results of geometric flows and its special solutions. The research outcome has brought closer two major areas of mathematics, namely analysis and geometry, so that the PI expects to see more interactions between these two areas.

26500016.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
26500016.value: 在过去三十多年里，大量的工业污水排放和广泛的化肥使用让中国的地表水系统受到严重污染。据世界银行报道，中国七大流域约70%的地表水已经不适合作为引用水源。然而，中国仍然有很多地区缺乏干净的饮用水，部分落后农村地区仍然依靠地表水作为日常生活用水。严重的水污染威胁到人们（尤其是婴儿）的健康。本课题通过研究中国主要河流上游排污对下游水域水质的影响，估计水污染对婴儿死亡率的影响。 本研究将搜集从2004年到2013年中国的地表水水质数据、废水排放数据、婴儿死亡率数据、天气以及社会经济数据。其中，婴儿死亡率的数据来自于中国卫生部，地表水质数据来自于中国环保部和水利部，废水排放和社会经济变量将来自于各省统计年鉴。我们会以区/县为单位将所有数据匹配到一起，通过计量方法分析水污染与婴儿死亡率的关系。本研究主要关注以下几个与政策紧密相关的问题：首先，过去十年中国的婴儿死亡率和水污染的趋势是什么样的？其次，上游排污对下游水质的影响有多大？最后，水污染与婴儿死亡率之间是否存在因果关系？最后，水污染与废水排放所带来的健康成本有多大？ 研究通过工具变量的方法解决内生性问题。上游排污以及上游降雨量将作为研究的工具变量。上游更多的废水排放将使下游水质恶化，而更多的降雨将能够改善下游的水质。由于上游的排放和降雨相对于下游区域是外生的，因此通过研究年与年之间排放强度与降雨的不同，我们可以估计水污染对婴儿死亡率的影响。 本研究在经济学、环境科学、公共卫生以及公共政策领域都十分重要。研究的发现将加深我们对水污染及健康问题的认识。近年来中国政府已经把环境保护列为一项发展目标，我们的研究结果将为未来的一系列环境政策提供依据。

26500016.label: Realisation of objectives
26500016.value: We summarize the realization of each objective below. More detailed discussions can be found in the paper attached to this report. (1) Data collection We have collected panel data on surface water pollution from 2004 to 2010 from various environmental statistical yearbooks, which include the China Environmental Yearbooks, China Environmental Statistical Yearbooks, and China Environmental Quality Statistical Yearbooks. Data available in more than two different sources are cross-validated. The number of monitoring stations varied slightly between years in these reports, ranging from 400 to 500 stations. Through our on-going collaboration with the Chinese CDC, we also got access to the infant mortality data for 161 counties/districts in the Disease Surveillance System from 2004 to 2012. We also collected data on wastewater discharges at the county level from the Environmental Survey Reporting database and socio-economic data for all prefectures from 2000 to 2012. We further collected tap water provision data from the Population Census in 2000 and 2010. In addition, we collected several other datasets that are NOT listed in the Objectives, including: (1) finer and more accurate infant mortality data from the National Maternal and Child Health Monitoring System (NMCHMS) administrated by the Ministry of Health, (2) key drinking water sources data from the Ministry of Ecology and Environment, and (3) county-level income, fiscal expenditure per capita, healthcare expenditure per capita, and maternal and child healthcare expenditure per capita from the Population Census 2010. Not all the data collected are used in the paper, and please refer to the Data Section for more details of these datasets. (2) Data Matching We geocoded all the data sets used in the paper and matched them at the county level, based on which we carried on the empirical analyses. The matched data sets include the following information: piped water coverage of each county, surface water pollution of each county (which is matched to its closest surface water quality monitoring site), infant mortality and death of cause data of each NMCHMS county, and a rich set of control variables available at the county level. Please refer to the attached paper for details (Figure 1 and Appendix Figures A1–A5). (3) Patterns of water pollution and infant mortality We collected all the data required for this analysis. China reduced its infant mortality rate by more than two thirds from 30.1 per 1,000 live births to 9.2 per 1,000 live births between 2000 and 2015. Our empirical analyses are based on infant mortality rate in 2010. Infant mortality patterns can be found in the attached paper (Table 1 and Appendix Figures A1–A3). Regarding water pollution, northern China is more polluted than in southern China. According to our data, the average water quality level in northern China is 3.7 compared with 2.5 in the south. Approximately 36 percent of China’s surface water is severely polluted (IV, V and VI) in 2010. We visualize the geographical distribution of China’s surface water quality in the attached paper (Figure 3 and Appendix Figure A4). (4) Estimate the impacts of tap water coverage on infant mortality We estimate the impacts of piped water provision on infant mortality using a novel instrumental variable approach. Specifically, we calculated the least-cost route from water sources to destinations using GIS network analysis. Because constructing water pipelines are costly, and the costs depend critically on the geographical characteristics between a surveillance area (where infant mortality data are gathered) and its nearby clean water sources (e.g. reservoirs), we can use the least-cost distance between them as the instrument for piped water coverage. Since the least-cost path is constructed purely based on cost considerations, it should be uncorrelated with demand-side determinants of infant mortality (such as income and social preferences). Our analyses show that having piped water in the household significantly reduces infant mortality. Increasing piped water coverage by 10 percentage points can reduce infant mortality by 16.1%. Notably, access to piped water is particularly beneficial in rural areas, and in regions with marginally polluted surface waters. This counter-intuitive result can be attributed to people’s avoidance behavior: when surface water is visually polluted, people avoid using them. In contrast, slightly polluted water is more harmful to infant health because people cannot tell the difference between slightly polluted water and clean water and continue to use it. (5) Evaluate the health benefits (measured by averted infant deaths) of tap water provision We use an entire section (VII. Cost-Benefit Analysis of Piped Water Provision) in the paper to address this issue. Intuitively, we can calculate the cost of providing piped water in different regions based on engineering estimates, then we quantify the health benefit of piped water provision using the Value of Statistical Life (VSL). Our analysis shows that the health benefit of providing safe drinking water to the rural population, measured by reduction in infant deaths alone, is almost four times larger than the cost. As the access to clean drinking water can also reduce morbidity of young children and adults, as well as enhance labor productivity and improve well-being, we conclude that the total benefits of providing piped water to rural people will be much larger than the costs.

26500016.label: Major findings and research outcome
26500016.value: In this paper, we examine the impact of clean drinking water on infant mortality in China. We have compiled what is to our knowledge the most comprehensive data set for clean water access, infant mortality, and surface water quality in China. The household-level piped water access is aggregated to the county level. These data are linked to the infant mortality data from China’s Ministry of Health, a nationally-representative sample that tracks all infant deaths among inhabitants in 331 Chinese counties and city districts. By combining these two data sets, we are able to examine an accurate sample of mortality and clean water access at a level of quality not commonly found in developing countries. By combining both digital and print resources, we also assembled a data set of surface water quality taken across over 800 monitoring stations. To address the endogeneity concerns of piped water coverage, we construct a novel instrumental variable based on the least-cost route from water sources to destinations using GIS network analysis. Because constructing water pipelines are costly, and the costs depend critically on the geographical characteristics between a surveillance area (where infant mortality data are gathered) and its nearby clean water sources (e.g. reservoirs), we can use the least-cost distance between them as the instrument for piped water coverage. Since the least-cost path is constructed purely based on cost considerations, it should be uncorrelated with demand-side determinants of infant mortality (such as income and social preferences). We find that the provision of piped water significantly decreases infant mortality with a 10 percentage-point increase in piped water coverage reducing infant mortality by 16 percent. Access to piped water is particularly beneficial in rural areas, and in regions with marginally polluted surface waters. The economic benefits of piped water in rural China are significantly greater than the estimated costs of its provision; the annual economic benefits are estimated at more than 299 million dollars, while the economic costs are 58-86 million dollars per year.

26500016.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
26500016.value: I am working on three directions to further develop the research. First, through this project, I assembled comprehensive infant mortality data for recent years, which can be linked to air pollution. I am now working with my collaborators to quantify the impacts of air pollution on infant mortality. Second, we received several insightful comments from the referees when we submitted the American Economic Review and are now working on improving the instrumental variable approach. Specifically, we are trying to combine the least-cost path instrument with a time dimension, which allows for including fixed effects and thus better identification. Third, when we collected the infant mortality data in China, a by-product is that we also got access to the by-cause-of-death mortality data for other age groups from Chinese CDC. The third direction of exploration is to assess the long-term impact of clean drinking water. We plan to calculate life expectancy of different counties in China and estimate how piped water provision increases life expectancy.

26500016.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
26500016.value: Water is an important input in household health production. Infants are especially sensitive to water quality due to their immature immune systems and small bodies. Providing safe drinking water to every household in China is Chinese government’s goal (e.g. the 12th and 13th Five-Year Plan). Therefore, understanding the costs and benefits of provision of piped water has important policy implications. Analyzing comprehensive data of surface water quality, piped water coverage, and infant mortality in China, we find that the provision of piped water can significantly reduce infant mortality. The health gains of piped water are similar for males and females and the impact of piped water is greater for post-neonatal mortality than for neonatal mortality. In addition, we find that the impacts of piped water are highly heterogeneous. Health gains from access to piped water are large for infants living in areas with moderate surface water pollution and small for infants living in severely polluted areas. Based on our estimates, we show that the economic benefits of piped water in rural China outweigh the estimated costs of its provision. Therefore, further expansion of piped water coverage will improve infant health and increase social welfare.

26500116.value: 食物標籤在社交環境中的影響

26500116.label: Project Objectives
26500116.value: Understand the effect of low-calorie labels on consumer choice in private versus public settings. Understand how choosing low-calorie labeled options serves as a mean to convey a desired image to others. Examine whether individual differences (e.g., self-monitoring) and different social goals (e.g., to signal one’s competence versus sociability) would moderate the effect of low-calorie labels.

26500116.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
26500116.value: Obesity has become the most challenging public health problem. According to the World Health Organization (WHO)’s report in 2015, the obesity rate has doubled since 1980 and now more than 13% of the world’s adult population is obese. Providing nutritional information and health claims is one of the major government policy initiatives to reduce obesity and help consumers make healthier food choices. In Hong Kong, the Food Amendment Regulation has required nutrition labeling on prepackaged foods since 2010. In the United States, calorie labeling is enforced not only on prepackaged foods but also on restaurant menus. This nutritional information and the substantial number of health claims used in restaurants and packaged foods highlights the importance of understanding how food labels influence consumers’ decisions. Although these legislative initiatives aim at increasing healthier choice by disclosing calorie information at the point-of-purchase, the results of recent food labeling studies have been mixed (for review, see Chandon, 2013). This inconsistent effect of calorie disclosures may be, in part, due to the failure to incorporate social context into how consumers respond to calorie labels. Although previous studies have examined the effect of food labels on food intake, they were mostly conducted in private settings focusing on how food labels change consumers’ inferences on tastiness and healthiness. However, as people often consume food within the context of social interaction, it is important to understand the food labeling effects in social settings, not only in private settings. Based on the literature on food labels and impression management, we suggest that low-calorie labels will increase consumer choice in social settings where consumers are motivated to convey their competence to others, but not in private settings. This is because consumers expect others to evaluate them more competent if they choose low-calorie labeled options. When consumers are motivated to convey their sociability (vs. competence) to others, however, low-calorie labels no longer increase consumer choice. Our findings will have important implications for public policy and for understanding how food labels influence consumer motivation and choice. 肥胖已經成為最富挑戰性的公共健康問題。根據世界衛生組織（WHO）2015年的報告，肥胖率自1980年以來翻了一番，現時全球成人人口的13%以上均為肥胖。提供營養資訊及健康宣稱是政府其中一項主要的政策措施，以減少肥胖及幫助消費者作出更健康的食物選擇。在香港，自2010年起，《食物修訂規例》已規定預先包裝食品必須附有營養標籤。在美國，熱量標籤不僅實施於預先包裝食品，還實施於餐館的菜單。這些用於餐館和預先包裝食品的營養資訊及大量健康宣稱，令了解食物標籤如何影響消費者決策的重要性顯得更為突出。雖然這些立法舉措旨在通過於購買點披露熱量資料來增加健康的選擇，但近期的食物標籤研究結果卻沒有一致的見解 (評論見Chandon 2013)。 關於熱量披露的這種不一致的效果，部分原因可能是未能把消費者如何回應熱量標籤融入社交環境中。儘管以前的研究已調查了食物標籤對食物攝取的影響，它們大多是在私人的場合下進行，而且側重食物標籤如何改變消費者對味道和健康的推論。但是，由於人們常常在社交場合進食，因此了解食物標籤的影響不僅於私人場合重要，在社交場合也很重要。基於食物標籤和印象管理的文獻，我們提出當消費者處於社交場合中，而且動機是向他人傳達他們的能力時，低熱量的標籤將增加消費者的選擇，而這情況並不會在私人場合出現。這是因為消費者希望如果他們選擇低熱量的選項時，別人會把他們評為更有能力。但當消費者的動機是向他人傳達他們的社交能力 (相對於能力) 時，低熱量的標籤將不再增加消費者的選擇。我們的研究結果將對公共政策和了解食物標籤如何影響消費動機和選擇具有重要意義。

26500116.label: Realisation of objectives
26500116.value: We ran more than 10 experiments to achieve the three goals specified above. Each of the goals has been achieved with the following results: 1. Understand the effect of low-calorie labels on consumer choice in private versus public settings: We found that people strategically use decisions about food to make a desired impression on others. Specifically, we found that women are likely to choose low-calorie-labeled food when they want to signal their competence to others. They are more likely to choose low-calorie labeled food/drinks in public than in private. 2. Understand how choosing low-calorie labeled options serves as a mean to convey a desired image to others: Across different experiments, including a field experiment conducted during job interviews, we found that women, but not men, are more likely to choose low-calorie-labeled food when they make decisions in the presence of others whom they want to impress with their competence. Women who believe that food consumption reflects one’s inner qualities are more likely to choose low-calorie-labeled options to impress others. 3. Examine whether individual differences (e.g., self-monitoring) and different social goals (e.g., to signal one’s competence versus sociability) would moderate the effect of low-calorie labels: We found that tendency to choose low-calorie labeled food is moderated by gender and social goals. Specifically, we found that women, but not men, are more likely to choose low-calorie labeled foods/drinks to signal their competence to others. We also found that those choices are driven by the motivation to signal competence, but not necessarily other positive traits, such as sociability.

26500116.label: Major findings and research outcome
26500116.value: People manage their behaviors in order to influence how others perceive them. Building on the literature on impression management and consumption stereotypes, we investigate whether people strategically use decisions about food to make a desired impression on others. Specifically, we suggest that women are likely to choose low-calorie-labeled food when they want to signal their competence to others. Across five experiments, including a field experiment conducted during job interviews, we demonstrate that women, but not men, are more likely to choose low-calorie-labeled food when they make decisions in the presence of others whom they want to impress with their competence (Experiments 1 to 5). We show that this effect is driven by the motivation to signal one’s competence and the belief that people can do so through their food choices. Women who believe that food consumption reflects one’s inner qualities are more likely to choose low-calorie-labeled options to impress others (Experiment 3). Those choices are driven by the motivation to signal competence, but not necessarily other positive traits, such as sociability (Experiment 4).

26500116.value: The current project has focused on low-calorie labeled food but the future research can extend the current findings to other types of food labels such as low-fat.

26500616.label: Realisation of objectives
26500616.value: All the research objectives listed above have been achieved. I (and my collaborators) draw on justice literature to develop theories and arguments on how individuals (i.e., board directors) would react to perceived injustice if their high status/qualifications vis-à-vis their peers on the same board are not recognized by appointments to leadership positions (e.g., chair positions on the board). Through the analysis of panel data of firms that did their IPOs from 2004 to 2011 in the US, we found those individuals would reduce their commitment, exert less efforts, be more likely to exit, and bring in less qualified new directors. Managerial and practical implications are also discussed in our paper.

26500616.label: Major findings and research outcome
26500616.value: I (and my collaborators) examine how boards that undervalue their high status directors (defined as board undervaluation) affects firm performance via the qualification of newly recruited directors and director turnover. We find that board undervaluation is associated with higher director turnover. Furthermore, we find that director turnover is associated with poor firm performance. In terms of new director recruitment, we suggest that incumbent directors faced with unfavorable, unfair, or otherwise untenable situations may seek to reduce the potential for negative comparisons. This may occur through the recruitment process. Therefore, incumbent directors may prefer to recruit directors with lower qualifications so that the new directors do not threaten the incumbents or compete for chair positions, allowing incumbent directors to solidify their own standing. The firm may also recruit new directors with lower qualifications for non-chair positions to create more board harmony. In a 5-year panel analysis of 406 technology firms that went public in the 2004 to 2011 period, we find support for our argument. Our findings provide key insights for firms on how to design their board of directors. Managerial and practice implications are also discussed.

26500616.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
26500616.value: Future efforts can be made to cross-validate our findings. For example, we can conduct experiments to validate the mechanism underlying the concept of board undervaluation. We can further identify contingencies under which individuals react to undervaluation differently. Moreover, we can investigate how board undervaluation affects other important firm outcomes and how firms react to board undervaluation and the implication for firm performance in a more dynamic way.

26500616.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
26500616.value: How should a privately-held entrepreneurial firm design its board leadership structure at IPO? What are the implications for board evolution and even firm performance? We find that higher board undervaluation, i.e., the average degree to which directors’ qualifications based on normatively accepted criteria for board leadership are not duly reflected in their appointments to the board chair and committee chair positions, is associated with higher director turnover, and with lower qualifications among new directors in the subsequent years. These two evolutionary paths act in opposite ways on performance—director turnover lowers firm performance, but lower new-director-qualifications improve firm performance. This has important implications for boards, investors, and stock exchange guidelines on board leadership structure.

26503316.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
26503316.value: Valuation ratios, in particular, dividend-price ratio and earnings-price ratio, are found to be able to predict the subsequent returns on the U.S. aggregate stock market. However, this in-sample predictability has received serious challenge from the out-of-sample test. Goyal and Welch (2008) find that valuation ratios fail to deliver consistent out-of-sample forecasting gains relative to the historical average. This proposal attempts to take up Goyal and Welch's (2008) challenge and propose a new real time out-of-sample forecasting method by exploiting the quantitative coefficient restrictions from the theory, i.e. Campbell and Shiller (1988a) loglinear return approximation. Brennan and Xia (2005) and Cochrane (2008) present simulation studies and show that the 'poorly' estimated predictive coefficients are the heart for the poor out-of-sample performance in standard regression based forecasting method. We argue that imposing the theoretically-motivated qualitative restrictions on predictive coefficients may alleviate the above concerns, and therefore deliver superior out-of-sample performance. And we expect the benefits of theoretical restrictions will propagate and show up even more strongly in long-horizon predictions. First, our promising preliminary empirical results show that our new method presents quantitatively large out-of-sample gains relative to the historical average. Moreover, the gains significantly increase with the forecasting horizon. We plan to evaluate whether such gains of our new method are both statistically and economically significant, both at the short and long horizons. In order to translate the statistical out-of-sample gains into economic measures and emphasize the long-horizon gains, we consider a long term investor's dynamic portfolio choice problem, and compare the optimal strategies implied by different forecasting methods. Second, we attempt to find the statistical explanations for the benefits of the new prediction method. We plan to conduct the standard decomposition of the mean square prediction error (MSPE hereafter), and evaluate whether the gains come from a reduction in forecast bias, or in forecast variance, or both. We will also have an additional special focus on analyzing the increasing pattern of out-of-sample gains with the forecasting horizon. The study will make several important contributions for both the academia and the industry. First, it attempts to propose a new useful method in forming real-time forecasts or market-timing portfolios, particularly useful for long-term investors. Second, it intends to show that the time variation in expected returns, though hard to detect in standard regression based approach, is present out of sample and carries important gains for long-term dynamic portfolio investment strategies. 估值比率，特別是價格股利率和市盈率，被過去的研究發現能夠預測美國股票指數隨後的回報率。然而，樣本外的實證檢測對於股價在樣本內的這種可預測性已經提出了嚴峻的挑戰。戈亞爾和韋爾奇（2008）發現，在樣本外的股價回報率的預測中，估值比率並不優於用簡單的歷史平均值來作預測。 本研究提出了一個實時的樣本外預測的新方法，即從理論出發，利用坎貝爾和希勒（1988a）對數線性回歸近似方法，對於預測係數加以量化的限制。本研究將從經濟學和統計學角度，來驗證並且解釋這種新的預測方法相比較於用歷史平均值來作預測的優越性。並且，這種優越性將隨著投資者投資期限的延長而增加。 這項研究將對學術界和業界有幾個重要貢獻。首先，它試圖提出一個實時預測股票股票回報率的新方法。對於股票投資者，尤其是長期投資者的投資組合選擇尤為有效。其次，它嘗試證明，雖然在標準的回歸分析種很難被發現，但是股票超額回報率的可預測性在樣本外確實存在。投資者如果意識到並且利用這種可預測性，對他們的長期資產組合投資將非常有益。

26503316.label: Realisation of objectives
26503316.value: Campbell and Thompson (2008) asks ``Can anything beat the historical average?'' in out-of-sample (OOS) equity premium forecasts, in response to Goyal and Welch (2008) that shows regression-based predictors have poor forecast performance. This project picks up this challenge and proposes a real-time forecasting method which can beat the historical average. In this study, we join a large literature on using the log dividend-to-price ratio (dp) to predict the stock market return. In this context, we first analyse why the historical average (i.e. the predictive slope before dp is equal to 0) is difficult to beat. The key framework to answer this question is about the trade-off between estimation bias and noise. The regression-based predictors may have smaller bias than historical mean method, but they are also subject to large estimation noise as compared with zero noise of a zero predictive slope in historical average method. We show the observation that regression-based predictors have poorer forecast performance than historical mean is because their estimation noise is large enough to dominate the benefit of a smaller bias. In this paper, we propose an alternative predictor by setting the predictive slope to be a small but constant number, which is free of estimation noise but at the same time contains smaller bias than historical average. For long horizon predictions, we further use the theoretical net present value restriction to imply the predictive slope to converge to approximately 1 when the forecast horizon increases. This means excess dp translate one-for-one into excess return when dp mean reverts in the long run. We show that our new method has superior out-of-sample performance than the sample average forecasts at both short and long horizons and the performance gain is statistically significant. We also compare our new method's forecasting performance with other existing out-of-sample forecasting methods and show our method outperforms all these known predictors. These alternative forecasting methods for comparison include OLS forecast, the Cochrane (2008) forecast, the Campbell and Thompson (2008) forecast imposing positive slope restrictions, the Campbell and Thompson (2008) forecast imposing both positive slope and positive expected return forecast restrictions. Lastly, we further study the statistical properties of the new forecasting method, and explain the sources of the out-of-sample performance gains in terms of the trade-off between estimation noise and bias through a simulation study. As an important methodological contribution to the literature, we propose a real-time test of the existence of return predictability. This predictor does not require estimation hence is subject to minimal contamination from estimation noise. Our method outperforms the historical average and therefore serves as a new benchmark in future predictability tests.

26503316.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
26503316.value: Our current analysis is based on a widely used return predictive variable—dividend-price ratio, and the net present value relationship implies a positive predictability slope. Motivated by the idea of a guess-the-number game, we propose a powerful real time return forecasting method by guessing a positive small predictive slope. It outperforms the historical mean, which effectively assumes a zero slope, because our method contains zero estimation noise but a smaller bias than the historical mean. As our further research agenda, our method can potentially be generalized to any other predictive variables. In order to achieve this, we have to develop a method to detect the sign of the predictive slope in real time, if we do not have a strong theoretical prior on it. This is our current focus in further developing our research. Once this challenge is overcome, our method can be a more informative benchmark as compared with regression-based methods, for testing the existence of return predictability for any potential candidate predictive variables. If a small positive (or negative) predictive slope always beats the zero slope, it shows the predictability exists.

26503316.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
26503316.value: Goyal and Welch (2008) shows that most of the regression-based return predictors proposed by academic research perform even worse than simply using historical mean in predicting the aggregate stock market return in real time. In this paper, we demonstrate that such under-performance may not be because the economic mechanism about the predictive relation is not there, but because too much noise when estimating the predictive coefficient. In a guess-the-number game where the closest guess wins and the true number is either 0 or positive, if the other player guesses zero, the optimal guess is slightly above 0 instead of the expected value of the true number. Motivated by this idea, we propose a powerful real time return forecasting method by guessing a positive small predictive slope if theory predicts the slope should be positive. It outperforms the historical mean, which assumes a zero slope, because it contains zero estimation noise but a smaller bias than the historical mean. Our method offers a more informative benchmark as compared with regression-based methods, for testing whether a variable can predict stock market return or not in real time. If a small positive predictive slope always beats the zero slope, it shows the predictability exists.

26503416.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
26503416.value: This project examine how firms plausibly twist the information they publicly disclose about competition in order to fool the government about their underlying market structure. Specifically, I want to examine how firms over-estimate the disclosed level of competition in their financial statements when they operate in colluding environment in order not to attract the attention of public agencies. Similarly, I investigate how firms do not increase the level of reported competition in their mandatory publicly available statements when they plausibly move from a colluding to a competitive environment in order not to reveal to public agencies that the shift in profitability is due to the break-up of a cartel that could lead to prosecutions. In general, this project lies at the intersection between strategic disclosure choices and firms; legal risk with respect to business practices in terms of collusion. 本研究旨在考察企业如何通过在公开报告中扭曲对竞争环境的信息披露，以达到混淆政府部门对市场结构的认知的目的。具体而言，本研究提出了合谋的企业会通过在公开财务报告中夸大其所面临的竞争水平以规避政府部门的审查这一假设。通过研究发现，当合谋企业受到政策冲击而偏离原有的卡特尔联盟后，企业的经营利润会受到显著的负面影响。与此同时，企业在公开披露的财务报告中会维持甚至减少对其所处竞争环境的讨论，以避免政府部门将其利润下滑归因于合谋失败并对其先前的合谋行为进行审查。综合而言，本研究从企业合谋的角度，丰富了对企业如何利用信息披露策略以应对法律风险的研究。

26503416.label: Major findings and research outcome
26503416.value: We empirically study how collusion in product markets affects firms’ financial disclosure strategies. We find that after a rise in cartel enforcement, U.S. firms start sharing more detailed information in their financial disclosure about their customers, contracts, and products. This new information potentially benefits peers by helping to tacitly coordinate actions in product markets. Indeed, changes in disclosure are associated with higher future profitability. Our results highlight the potential conflict between securities and antitrust regulations.

26606516.label: Project Title(Chinese)
26606516.value: 當代中國農村喪禮與遺體的政治經濟學

26606516.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
26606516.value: This project will describe and analyze death ritual, funeral governance, and the funeral industry in contemporary rural China through ethnographic fieldwork. The three objectives of this study are to investigate 1) the ways in which rural Chinese people are commemorated in death ritual today, 2) the political economy of death and dead bodies in rural areas; and, 3) the effect of urbanization on rural death ritual, funeral governance, and the funeral industry. The first points this research toward tackling whether and how we might understand the processes of becoming a subject through ritualized, externalized, repetitive acts. The second guides an examination of how the political economy of death and dead bodies affects the form of death ritual and the ritually constructed perception of self and person. The third takes these understandings and analyzes them in terms of whether and the extent to which cultural changes in funeral forms and conceptualizations of self are moving from urban forms towards China's rural areas or vice versa. The primary method of data collection involves participant observation fieldwork, informal and formal interviews, and document collection. The PI will conduct ethnographic fieldwork in two different kinds of “rural” sites in China: one is a rural village and the other is a village enclave (a type of space that is now geographically located in cities and yet remains in important but diverse ways a transitional space between rural and urban life) in Jiangsu Province. Chinese funeral policies are distinguished between rural and urban areas (such as mandatory cremation in cities). The design of two fieldsites enables the project to describe and analyze examples of both rural and semi-rural areas while still maintaining proper ethnographic depth. Furthermore, it will articulate the influences of urbanization on cultural change such as on the form of death ritual and ritually constructed perceptions of self by not only showing the “direction” of cultural change, but also in which particular areas more rural influence versus more urban influence predominates and to what extent. Overall, this project contributes to China Studies by providing an ethnography of death ritual and the political economy of death and dead bodies in rural China that few have written about. Meanwhile, it will also make significant contributions to social theories on subjectivity, ritual, rural urbanization, and cultural change.
